- [ ] **Step 3: Write the failing tests, part 2: helpers and the Workspace tests.**

Append everything below to the end of `test/workspace.test.js`. The helpers use the real Team Room code, not a copy of its output: `saveInRoom` puts a file proposal in a real room's log and calls the real `applyFileProposal` (what Approve calls), and the tests call the real `undoAction`. Only `decision.json` edits (damage, a backdated clock) are done by hand. `withPinnedRuntime` (used by every new test) pins `AGENT_OS_HOME` as well as `HERMES_AGENT_OS_HOME`, because `AGENT_OS_HOME` wins when both are set. A shell that exports `AGENT_OS_HOME` therefore cannot send the new tests to a real data folder. The older `withTempRuntime` above it only sets the second variable and stays as it is (see the note in the summary).

```js
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// "Saved by": who saved each file (SP2, Workspace)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const UNKNOWN = { kind: "unknown", label: "—" };
const ROOM_LIMITS = { maxTurns: 6, maxMinutes: 10, maxCostUsd: null };
const GATE_ENV_NAMES = ["HERMES_AGENT_OS_ENABLE_EXEC", "DEMO_PUBLIC", "HERMES_AGENT_OS_PUBLIC_MODE"];

// withTempRuntime plus: AGENT_OS_HOME pinned to the temp folder (it outranks
// HERMES_AGENT_OS_HOME, so a shell that exports it cannot send these tests to a
// real data folder), no environment override of the execution gate, no demo
// mode, and the gate switched on, so a Team Room save really writes its file.
async function withPinnedRuntime(fn) {
  await withTempRuntime(async (root) => {
    const names = ["AGENT_OS_HOME", ...GATE_ENV_NAMES];
    const previous = Object.fromEntries(names.map((name) => [name, process.env[name]]));
    process.env.AGENT_OS_HOME = root;
    for (const name of GATE_ENV_NAMES) delete process.env[name];
    try {
      await setExecutionGateStatus({ enabled: true, reason: "workspace test" });
      await fn(root);
    } finally {
      for (const name of names) {
        if (previous[name] === undefined) delete process.env[name];
        else process.env[name] = previous[name];
      }
    }
  });
}

function newRoom() {
  return createRoom({ task: "who saved this file", limits: ROOM_LIMITS });
}

// What Approve does in the Team Room: a file proposal that waits for the
// person, then the real applyFileProposal. Returns the action record.
async function saveInRoom(roomId, { name, content, by = "hermes", byLabel = "Hermes" }) {
  const proposalId = await updateDecision(roomId, (decision) => {
    const id = `P${decision.proposals.length + 1}`;
    decision.proposals.push({
      id,
      by,
      byLabel,
      kind: "file",
      summary: `Save ${name}`,
      file: { name, content },
      status: "needs_approval",
      turn: 1,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
    });
    return id;
  });
  return applyFileProposal(roomId, proposalId);
}

const teamFileId = (roomId, name) => `workspace/team/${roomShort(roomId)}/${name}`;
const teamFilePath = (root, roomId, name) => path.join(root, "workspace", "team", roomShort(roomId), name);

async function savedByOf(id, input = {}) {
  const listing = await listWorkspaceFiles(input);
  return listing.files.find((file) => file.id === id)?.savedBy;
}

  await withPinnedRuntime(async (root) => {
    await listWorkspaceFiles(); // seeds the welcome note
    await fs.writeFile(path.join(root, "workspace", "dropped.txt"), "by hand");
    const listing = await listWorkspaceFiles();
    const by = Object.fromEntries(listing.files.map((file) => [file.id, file.savedBy]));
    assert.deepEqual(by["workspace/inbox/welcome.md"], { kind: "agent-os", label: "Agent OS" });
    assert.deepEqual(by["workspace/dropped.txt"], UNKNOWN);
    assert.equal(listing.summary.savedByAgents, 0);
  });
});

test("savedBy: a damaged provenance file never breaks the listing, and the next save repairs it", async () => {
  await withPinnedRuntime(async (root) => {
    await writeWorkspaceText({ folder: "loop", name: "mine.md", content: "# mine" }, { savedBy: "you" });
    const record = path.join(root, "config", "workspace-provenance.json");
    for (const damage of ["{ not json", "", "null", "[]", JSON.stringify({ files: "nope" })]) {
      await fs.writeFile(record, damage);
      assert.deepEqual(await savedByOf("workspace/loop/mine.md"), UNKNOWN, `damage: ${damage || "(empty)"}`);
    }
    await writeWorkspaceText({ folder: "loop", name: "again.md", content: "# again" }, { savedBy: "you" });
    assert.equal((await savedByOf("workspace/loop/again.md")).kind, "you");
  });
});

test("savedBy: a Team Room save reads the agent's name, with the room and the action to undo", async () => {
  await withPinnedRuntime(async () => {
    const room = await newRoom();
    const action = await saveInRoom(room.id, { name: "plan.md", content: "# plan" });
    const listing = await listWorkspaceFiles();
    const file = listing.files.find((item) => item.id === teamFileId(room.id, "plan.md"));
    assert.deepEqual(file.savedBy, {
      kind: "team-room",
      label: "Hermes",
      at: action.at,
      roomId: room.id,
      actionId: "A1"
    });
    assert.equal(listing.summary.savedByAgents, 1);
    assert.equal(listing.summary.total, 2, "the welcome note and the saved file");
  });
});

test("savedBy: the latest save wins, and Undo hands the file back to the earlier save", async () => {
  await withPinnedRuntime(async (root) => {
    const room = await newRoom();
    const id = teamFileId(room.id, "plan.md");
    await saveInRoom(room.id, { name: "plan.md", content: "v1", by: "hermes", byLabel: "Hermes" });
    await saveInRoom(room.id, { name: "plan.md", content: "v2", by: "openclaw", byLabel: "OpenClaw" });
    let by = await savedByOf(id);
    assert.deepEqual([by.kind, by.label, by.actionId], ["team-room", "OpenClaw", "A2"]);

    // The person clicks Undo a minute later, not a moment later: the saves in the
    // log are now a minute old, but the copy Undo puts back is brand new.
    const logPath = path.join(root, "teams", room.id, "decision.json");
    const log = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(logPath, "utf8"));
    for (const action of log.actions) action.at = new Date(Date.parse(action.at) - 60_000).toISOString();
    await fs.writeFile(logPath, JSON.stringify(log));

    await undoAction(room.id, "A2");
    assert.equal(await fs.readFile(teamFilePath(root, room.id, "plan.md"), "utf8"), "v1", "Undo put the first save back");
    by = await savedByOf(id);
    assert.deepEqual([by.kind, by.label, by.actionId], ["team-room", "Hermes", "A1"], "the copy Undo restored is not an outside edit");

    await undoAction(room.id, "A1");
    const listing = await listWorkspaceFiles();
    assert.equal(listing.files.some((file) => file.id === id), false, "a file the room created is gone after Undo");
    assert.equal(listing.summary.savedByAgents, 0);
  });
});

test("savedBy: after Undo puts back a file that was there before the room, nobody is named", async () => {
  await withPinnedRuntime(async (root) => {
    const room = await newRoom();
    const id = teamFileId(room.id, "plan.md");
    const file = teamFilePath(root, room.id, "plan.md");
    await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
    await fs.writeFile(file, "what was already here");
    assert.deepEqual(await savedByOf(id), UNKNOWN);

    await saveInRoom(room.id, { name: "plan.md", content: "agent version" });
    assert.equal((await savedByOf(id)).kind, "team-room");
    await undoAction(room.id, "A1");
    assert.equal(await fs.readFile(file, "utf8"), "what was already here");
    assert.deepEqual(await savedByOf(id), UNKNOWN);
  });
});

test("savedBy: a deleted room, a missing log or a damaged log reads —, never a crash", async () => {
  await withPinnedRuntime(async (root) => {
    const damages = {
      "the room folder was deleted": (roomDir) => fs.rm(roomDir, { recursive: true, force: true }),
      "decision.json is missing": (roomDir) => fs.rm(path.join(roomDir, "decision.json"), { force: true }),
      "decision.json is empty": (roomDir) => fs.writeFile(path.join(roomDir, "decision.json"), ""),
      "decision.json is not JSON": (roomDir) => fs.writeFile(path.join(roomDir, "decision.json"), "{ not json"),
      "decision.json holds the wrong shapes": (roomDir) =>
        fs.writeFile(
          path.join(roomDir, "decision.json"),
          JSON.stringify({ proposals: "none", actions: [null, 7, "A1", { id: "A1" }, { id: "A1", kind: "file_write" }] })
        )
    };
    for (const [what, damage] of Object.entries(damages)) {
      const room = await newRoom();
      const id = teamFileId(room.id, "notes.md");
      await saveInRoom(room.id, { name: "notes.md", content: "# notes" });
      assert.equal((await savedByOf(id)).kind, "team-room", `${what}: named before the damage`);
      await damage(path.join(root, "teams", room.id));
      assert.deepEqual(await savedByOf(id), UNKNOWN, what);
    }
  });
});

test("savedBy: a record for another room's folder, a refused save and a bad action id are ignored", async () => {
  await withPinnedRuntime(async (root) => {
    const roomA = await newRoom();
    const roomB = await newRoom();
    await saveInRoom(roomA.id, { name: "a.md", content: "# a" });
    const folderA = path.join(root, "workspace", "team", roomShort(roomA.id));
    const folderB = path.join(root, "workspace", "team", roomShort(roomB.id));
    await fs.mkdir(folderB, { recursive: true });
    for (const name of ["c.md", "d.md"]) await fs.writeFile(path.join(folderA, name), "# by hand");
    await fs.writeFile(path.join(folderB, "b.md"), "# by hand");

    // Room A's log is edited so that it claims room B's file, holds a save that
    // was refused, and holds an action id that is not an action id.
    const logPath = path.join(root, "teams", roomA.id, "decision.json");
    const log = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(logPath, "utf8"));
    const base = { kind: "file_write", proposalId: "P1", created: true, updated: false, backup: null, at: new Date().toISOString(), undone: false, undoneAt: null };
    log.actions.push(
      { ...base, id: "A2", path: `team/${roomShort(roomB.id)}/b.md` },
      { ...base, id: "A3", path: `team/${roomShort(roomA.id)}/c.md`, failed: true },
      { ...base, id: "../../etc", path: `team/${roomShort(roomA.id)}/d.md` }
    );
    await fs.writeFile(logPath, JSON.stringify(log));

    const listing = await listWorkspaceFiles();
    const by = Object.fromEntries(listing.files.map((file) => [file.id, file.savedBy]));
    assert.equal(by[teamFileId(roomA.id, "a.md")].kind, "team-room", "the real save is still named");
    assert.deepEqual(by[teamFileId(roomB.id, "b.md")], UNKNOWN, "room A cannot claim room B's file");
    assert.deepEqual(by[teamFileId(roomA.id, "c.md")], UNKNOWN, "a refused save wrote nothing");
    assert.deepEqual(by[teamFileId(roomA.id, "d.md")], UNKNOWN, "an action id that is not A<number> is never passed on");
  });
});

test("savedBy: the agent name is short plain text even if the log was edited", async () => {
  await withPinnedRuntime(async (root) => {
    const room = await newRoom();
    await saveInRoom(room.id, { name: "plan.md", content: "# plan" });
    const logPath = path.join(root, "teams", room.id, "decision.json");
    const log = JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(logPath, "utf8"));
    log.proposals[0].byLabel = `Hermes\n\u0007${"x".repeat(200)}`;
    await fs.writeFile(logPath, JSON.stringify(log));
    const by = await savedByOf(teamFileId(room.id, "plan.md"));
    assert.equal(by.kind, "team-room");
    assert.ok(by.label.length <= 60, `label is ${by.label.length} characters`);
    assert.doesNotMatch(by.label, /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/);
    assert.match(by.label, /^Hermes/);

    log.proposals[0].byLabel = "";
    delete log.proposals[0].by;
    await fs.writeFile(logPath, JSON.stringify(log));
    assert.equal((await savedByOf(teamFileId(room.id, "plan.md"))).label, "An agent", "no name on record: say so plainly");
  });
});

test("savedBy: a file changed after an agent saved it reads Changed outside Agent OS and has nothing to undo", async () => {
  await withPinnedRuntime(async (root) => {
    const room = await newRoom();
    const id = teamFileId(room.id, "plan.md");
    const file = teamFilePath(root, room.id, "plan.md");
    await saveInRoom(room.id, { name: "plan.md", content: "agent v1" });
    assert.equal((await savedByOf(id)).kind, "team-room");

    // The person edits it in their own editor a little later.
    await fs.writeFile(file, "my own edit");
    const later = new Date(Date.now() + 10_000);
    await fs.utimes(file, later, later);
    const edited = await savedByOf(id);
    assert.equal(edited.kind, "unknown", "Agent OS cannot tell who changed it, so it does not guess");
    assert.equal(edited.label, "Changed outside Agent OS");
    assert.equal(edited.roomId, undefined, "no room and no action, so the page has no Undo to offer");
    assert.equal(edited.actionId, undefined);
    assert.equal((await listWorkspaceFiles()).summary.savedByAgents, 0);

    // The agent saves a newer version after the person approves it again: the file is the agent's again.
    await saveInRoom(room.id, { name: "plan.md", content: "agent v2", by: "openclaw", byLabel: "OpenClaw" });
    const again = await savedByOf(id);
    assert.deepEqual([again.kind, again.label, again.actionId], ["team-room", "OpenClaw", "A2"]);
  });
});
```

What each test proves (the last six are Review Focus 3):

| Test | Proves |
|---|---|
| the welcome note reads Agent OS ... | seed is "Agent OS"; a hand-dropped file is "—"; count is 0 |
| the demo files read Agent OS in demo mode | demo files are "Agent OS" |
| a note the person saves reads You ... | `savedBy: "you"` is recorded; a later Agent OS write over it clears "You" |
| a damaged provenance file ... | a bad record file never breaks the list, and the next save repairs it |
| a Team Room save reads the agent's name ... | label, `at`, `roomId`, `actionId`, `savedByAgents` |
| the latest save wins, and Undo hands the file back ... | saved-then-undone: the earlier save is named again; the copy Undo restored (a minute later) is not mistaken for an outside edit; a file the room created is gone after Undo |
| after Undo puts back a file that was there before the room ... | saved-then-undone over a file that was there first: nobody is named, "—" |
| a deleted room, a missing log or a damaged log ... | room deleted, log missing, empty, not JSON, wrong shapes: "—", no crash |
| a record for another room's folder, a refused save and a bad action id ... | a hand-edited log cannot claim another room's file, a refused save, or put a non-action id in a URL |
| the agent name is short plain text ... | name capped at 60 characters, no control characters, "An agent" if absent |
| a file changed after an agent saved it reads Changed outside Agent OS ... | changed after the save: kind "unknown", label "Changed outside Agent OS", no `roomId`/`actionId` (so no Undo); a newer agent save takes the file back |

- [ ] **Step 6: Make them pass, part 1: the import and the "Saved by" section in `server/runtime/workspace.js`.**

Replace line 5:


```js

```

(`room-store.js` imports only `store.js`, and `workspace.js` is imported by `team-room/actions.js`, not by `room-store.js`, so this adds no import cycle.)

Insert this whole block directly before `export async function listWorkspaceFiles(input = {}) {` (line 144):

```js
// ---- who saved each file ("Saved by") ------------------------------------------
//
// Every listed file carries `savedBy`: { kind, label, at?, roomId?, actionId? }
//   kind "you"        label "You"         a note from POST /api/workspace/files (kept in
//                                          config/workspace-provenance.json)
//   kind "unknown"    label "Changed outside Agent OS"
//                                          a Team Room file changed after the agent saved it
//                                          (Agent OS cannot tell who changed it)
//   kind "agent-os"   label "Agent OS"    the one-time welcome note, and the demo files
//   kind "team-room"  label <agent name>  a Team Room saved it; roomId and actionId name the
//                                          save, read from the room's own decision.json
//   kind "unknown"    label "—"           nothing on record (dropped in by hand, written by
//                                          an agent run, or the room's log is gone or damaged)
// The screen offers "Undo this save" only for kind "team-room", because only
// then are roomId and actionId present and the save is still the file's content.
const PROVENANCE_FILE = "workspace-provenance.json";
const WELCOME_MARKER = "workspace-welcome-seeded.json";
// A file's modified time and the log's clock are read a moment apart. A change
// counts as made outside Agent OS only if it is later than the last thing Agent
// OS did to the file by more than this.
const CLOCK_SLACK_MS = 2000;
const TEAM_FILE_PATH = /^team\/([^/]+)\/([^/]+)$/;
const NO_ONE = Object.freeze({ kind: "unknown", label: "—" });

function provenancePath() {
  return path.join(runtimePaths().config, PROVENANCE_FILE);
}

function millis(iso) {
  const value = Date.parse(iso);
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
}

// The person's own notes: { "workspace/loop/x.md": { kind: "you", at } }. A
// missing, empty or damaged file reads as "no notes on record".
async function readUserRecords() {
  const data = await readJson(provenancePath(), null);
  const files = data && typeof data === "object" ? data.files : null;
  return files && typeof files === "object" && !Array.isArray(files) ? files : {};
}

// Changes are queued one after another so two quick saves cannot lose a record.
// `change(files)` returns true when it changed something worth writing.
let provenanceQueue = Promise.resolve();
function updateUserRecords(change) {
  const job = provenanceQueue.then(async () => {
    const files = await readUserRecords();
    if (change(files)) await writeJson(provenancePath(), { version: 1, files });
  });
  provenanceQueue = job.catch(() => {});
  return job;
}

function recordUserWrite(fileId) {
  return updateUserRecords((files) => {
    files[fileId] = { kind: "you", at: new Date().toISOString() };
    return true;
  });
}

// Anything but the person's own save makes the content someone else's.
function forgetUserWrite(fileId) {
  return updateUserRecords((files) => {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(files, fileId)) return false;
    delete files[fileId];
    return true;
  });
}

// A save worth naming: a real, finished file_write for a file inside this
// room's own folder. Mirrors what Undo itself insists on (actions.js).
function isUsableSave(action, short) {
  if (!action || typeof action !== "object" || action.kind !== "file_write" || action.failed) return false;
  if (typeof action.id !== "string" || !ACTION_ID_PATTERN.test(action.id)) return false;
  const match = typeof action.path === "string" ? TEAM_FILE_PATH.exec(action.path) : null;
  return Boolean(match) && match[1] === short;
}

// Each listed Team Room file's saves, from its room's actions log
// (teams/<room>/decision.json). Only rooms that have a file in the listing are
// read, and a room whose log is gone or damaged just has no saves.
async function readTeamSaves(files) {
  const shorts = new Set();
  for (const file of files) {
    const match = file.root === "workspace" ? TEAM_FILE_PATH.exec(file.relativePath) : null;
    if (match) shorts.add(match[1]);
  }
  const byPath = new Map();
  for (const short of shorts) {
    const roomId = `room-${short}`;
    if (!isValidRoomId(roomId)) continue;
    let decision;
    try {
      decision = await readDecision(roomId);
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    for (const action of decision.actions) {
      if (!isUsableSave(action, short)) continue;
      const proposal = decision.proposals.find((item) => item && item.id === action.proposalId) || null;
      const saves = byPath.get(action.path) || [];
      saves.push({ roomId, action, proposal });
      byPath.set(action.path, saves);
    }
  }
  return byPath;
}

// The save whose content the file holds now: the latest one that was not
// undone. `lastTouch` is the last moment Agent OS itself changed the file (a
// save, or an Undo that put an older copy back).
function currentTeamSave(saves) {
  const live = saves.filter((save) => !save.action.undone).sort((a, b) => millis(a.action.at) - millis(b.action.at));
  const current = live[live.length - 1];
  if (!current) return null;
  const lastTouch = Math.max(...saves.map((save) => Math.max(millis(save.action.at), save.action.undone ? millis(save.action.undoneAt) : 0)));
  return { ...current, lastTouch };
}

// Plain, short text, whatever the log holds.
function agentNameOf(save) {
  const raw = save.proposal?.byLabel || save.proposal?.by;
  const name = typeof raw === "string" ? raw.replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 60) : "";
  return name || "An agent";
}

function savedByFor(file, { userRecords, teamSaves, welcomeFile, demoPaths }) {
  if (file.root !== "workspace") return NO_ONE;
  const saves = teamSaves.get(file.relativePath);
  const team = saves ? currentTeamSave(saves) : null;
  if (team) {
    if (millis(file.updatedAt) > team.lastTouch + CLOCK_SLACK_MS) {
      // Changed after Agent OS last touched it: someone edited it outside. Undo
      // would throw that edit away, so no room and no action are given.
      return { kind: "unknown", label: "Changed outside Agent OS", at: file.updatedAt };
    }
    return { kind: "team-room", label: agentNameOf(team), at: team.action.at, roomId: team.roomId, actionId: team.action.id };
  }
  const record = userRecords[file.id];
  if (record && record.kind === "you") {
    return { kind: "you", label: "You", ...(typeof record.at === "string" ? { at: record.at } : {}) };
  }
  if (file.relativePath === welcomeFile || demoPaths.has(file.relativePath)) return { kind: "agent-os", label: "Agent OS" };
  return NO_ONE;
}

async function attachSavedBy(files, { demoOn }) {
  const [userRecords, teamSaves, marker] = await Promise.all([
    readUserRecords(),
    readTeamSaves(files),
    readJson(path.join(runtimePaths().config, WELCOME_MARKER), null)
  ]);
  const welcomeFile = typeof marker?.file === "string" ? marker.file : "";
  const demoPaths = new Set(demoOn ? demoWorkspaceFiles().map((item) => item.relativePath) : []);
  for (const file of files) file.savedBy = { ...savedByFor(file, { userRecords, teamSaves, welcomeFile, demoPaths }) };
}
```

```ts
// Who saved a listed file (server/runtime/workspace.js, "Saved by"). Undo this
// save is offered only for kind "team-room": that is the only kind that carries
// roomId and actionId.
export interface WorkspaceSavedBy {
  kind: "you" | "agent-os" | "team-room" | "unknown";
  // "You", "Agent OS", the agent's name for a Team Room save, or "—" when unknown.
  label: string;
  // When it was saved (ISO time). Absent for "agent-os" and "unknown".
  at?: string;
  roomId?: string;
  actionId?: string;
}

// A file as GET /api/workspace lists it. The one-file detail
// (GET /api/workspace/file) is a plain WorkspaceFile and carries no savedBy.
export interface WorkspaceListedFile extends WorkspaceFile {
  savedBy: WorkspaceSavedBy;
}

export interface WorkspaceListing {
  ok: boolean;
  generatedAt: string;
  roots: Array<{
    id: string;
    label: string;
    publicPath: string;
    fileCount: number;
  }>;
  files: WorkspaceListedFile[];
  empty: boolean;
  summary: {
    total: number;
    shown: number;
    // Files a Team Room saved, counted over every file, not only the shown ones.
    savedByAgents: number;
  };
}
```

(`WorkspaceFile` at line 2247 stays as it is; the one-file detail `WorkspaceFileDetail` keeps using it, because that endpoint carries no `savedBy`.)

**Decisions taken while drafting (the owner can overturn any of them):**

| # | Question | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-C3-1 | The board's Task column needs the task text. The run list only carries the adapter's title ("Claude Code (stream-json transport)"); the prompt is saved privately and no API returns it. | A small server change records `task.line` (the first line, at most 140 characters) on each run, for all five agents and for continued runs. Older runs fall back to their title. | The Board is not readable without the task. It adds one field to the existing run metadata, no new route, and the person's text never leaves their machine. Dropping Steps 1 to 3 leaves a working page that shows titles. |
| D-C3-2 | The prototype's strips are boxed cards with a coloured tab, but the kit's table classes are hairline rows. | The strips use their own grid (`.os-runs-strip`) and the kit's `StatusWord`, `Tabs`, `Banner`, `EmptyState`. | The strip has a tab shape and a second "more" row, which hairline rows do not draw. |
| D-C3-3 | What happens to the old master-detail (list + console)? | The Board replaces the list. A run opens in its console view (`?run=<id>`) with an "All runs" back button. The old filters (All, Live, Failed, Stopped) go: the bays are the filter. After "Start run" the person lands on the new run's console, as after the old Launch. | Every `navigateTo("runs", { run })` link keeps working. Watching a run start is what a person wants right after pressing Start. One line (`onStarted`) changes it to the Board. |
| D-C3-4 | The spec lists three dialog fields: Task, Agent, Folder. The old launch panel also had "Allow edits" and "Brain for this run". | The dialog has only the three fields and the hint. Runs never allow edits; the brain follows what is saved on Agents. | Spec is binding. Reported to the owner as a loss of two choices. |
| D-C3-5 | The spec's hint says "A risky step ends the run as Held instead of going ahead", but the server only has one kind of Held: a plan limit. A refused risky step ends the run Failed or Stopped, in Landed. | The hint is used word for word, in one constant (`RISKY_STEP_HINT`). Raised to the owner as a copy question. | The spec fixes the words; the mismatch is the owner's to settle. |
| D-C3-6 | "Wait for reset ... press Keep going after the reset". No plan-continue route exists: `continue.js` only offers OpenRouter, Composer and hand-overs. | "Wait for reset" is a page-only choice (nothing is saved or scheduled). The run stays in Held, the words say nothing will carry on by itself, and the button becomes "Keep going", which shows the same choices again. | No invented API. Raised to the owner. |
| D-C3-7 | The prototype's Failed strip has "Run again". | Not offered. The strip has "Open". | The full task text is not available to the page (only its first line), so a re-run could start the wrong job. Raised to the owner. |
| D-C3-8 | Which runs are Held? | Not running, `limit` set, and not carried on (`continuedBy` empty). A carried-on run is Landed with the word "Carried on" and an "Open it" link to the new run. | A Held run offers choices; a carried-on one has no choice left. |
| D-C3-9 | Folder field: the prototype has a drop-down of folders. | A text field with suggestions (a `datalist`) built from the folders in the real Workspace listing. Relative names only; empty means `runs-work/<agent>`. | The server accepts any relative name inside the Workspace and creates it. |
| D-C3-10 | Where does "New run" sit? | In the Active bay's empty state (primary), and in the page header when that empty state is not on screen. Never two at once. | One primary button per view, and a way to start a run when Active has runs. |
| D-C3-11 | The Get started card's "Try a safe example" opened the Agents launch panel with the example typed in. SP2 removes that panel. | It goes to `?page=runs&agent=<id>&example=safe`, which opens the dialog with the agent chosen and the safe example typed in. Nothing starts until the person presses Start run. | Keeps the onboarding step working. |

Create `server/runtime/runs/task-line.js`:

```js
// The first line of a run's task, saved on the run (meta.task.line) so the Runs
// board can say what the run is for. Only the first line, at most 140 characters,
// and the home folder is written as "~" like every other path the app shows.
import { redactText } from "../safety.js";

const MAX = 140;

export function taskLine(prompt) {
  const first =
    String(prompt ?? "")
      .split(/\r?\n/)
      .map((line) => line.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim())
      .find(Boolean) || "";
  const safe = redactText(first);
  return safe.length > MAX ? `${safe.slice(0, MAX - 1).trimEnd()}…` : safe;
}

// A copy of the run plan with meta.task.line set. Nothing else about the plan changes.
export function withTaskLine(plan, prompt) {
  const line = taskLine(prompt);
  if (!line || !plan || typeof plan !== "object") return plan;
  return { ...plan, meta: { ...(plan.meta || {}), task: { ...(plan.meta?.task || {}), line } } };
}
```

Wire it in (the run manager already copies `plan.meta.task`, because `PLAN_META_KEYS` in `run-manager.js` line 33 contains `"task"`):

```js
// Pure logic of the Runs board and the New run dialog (src/ui/runsBoard.ts, src/ui/newRun.ts).

const run = (over = {}) => ({ id: "run_1", agentId: "claude", status: "succeeded", title: "", commandPreview: "", ...over });
const LIMIT = { kind: "five_hour", message: "Claude Code's plan limit was reached." };

test("bays: working runs are Active; a plan limit that nothing carried on is Held; the rest Landed", () => {
  assert.equal(bayOf(run({ status: "running" })), "active");
  assert.equal(bayOf(run({ status: "queued" })), "active");
  assert.equal(bayOf(run({ status: "failed" })), "landed");

  assert.equal(bayOf(run({ status: "succeeded", limit: LIMIT })), "held", "an agent that exits 0 at its limit did not finish");

  assert.deepEqual([split.active, split.held, split.landed].map((list) => list.map((r) => r.id)), [["a"], ["c"], ["b", "d"]], "the API order (newest first) is kept");

    { root: "exports", relativePath: "export-folder/x.md" }
  ];
  assert.deepEqual(folderSuggestions(files), ["notes", "runs-work", "runs-work/claude"]);
  assert.deepEqual(folderSuggestions([]), []);
});
```

Create `src/ui/runsBoard.ts`:

```ts
// Pure logic of the Runs board: which bay a run sits in, the word and colour of its state, the
// task it shows, and the note under a landed strip. No React and no imports except types, so
// `node --test` can load it (test/runs-board.test.js).
import type { RunMeta } from "../types";

export type BayId = "active" | "held" | "landed";
// A subset of the kit's StatusWord states.
export type RunState = "live" | "idle" | "held" | "failed" | "stopped" | "ready" | "unknown";
// The colour of the strip's tab. The word and icon always say the same thing, so colour is never alone.
export type EdgeKind = "live" | "held" | "failed" | "finished" | "stopped" | "idle";

const ACTIVE = new Set(["queued", "running"]);

export function bayOf(run: Pick<RunMeta, "status" | "limit" | "continuedBy">): BayId {
  if (ACTIVE.has(run.status)) return "active";
  // Stopped at the plan's limit and nothing carried it on yet: the person still has a choice to make.
  if (run.limit && !run.continuedBy) return "held";
  return "landed";
}

export function splitBays(runs: RunMeta[]): Record<BayId, RunMeta[]> {
  const bays: Record<BayId, RunMeta[]> = { active: [], held: [], landed: [] };
  for (const run of runs) bays[bayOf(run)].push(run);
  return bays;
}

export function stateOf(run: Pick<RunMeta, "status" | "limit" | "continuedBy">): { state: RunState; label: string; edge: EdgeKind } {
  if (run.status === "queued") return { state: "idle", label: "Queued", edge: "idle" };
  if (run.status === "running") return { state: "live", label: "Working", edge: "live" };
  if (run.limit && run.continuedBy) return { state: "idle", label: "Carried on", edge: "idle" };
  if (run.limit) return { state: "held", label: "Held", edge: "held" };
  switch (run.status) {
    case "succeeded":
      return { state: "ready", label: "Finished", edge: "finished" };
    case "failed":
      return { state: "failed", label: "Failed", edge: "failed" };
    case "timed_out":
      return { state: "failed", label: "Timed out", edge: "failed" };
    case "stopped":
      return { state: "stopped", label: "Stopped", edge: "stopped" };
    case "interrupted":
      return { state: "stopped", label: "Interrupted", edge: "stopped" };
    default:
      return { state: "unknown", label: "—", edge: "idle" };
  }
}

// What the Task column says: the first line of the task the server saved (meta.task.line), else the
// adapter's title (older runs), else the first line of the command, else "Run".
export function taskText(run: Pick<RunMeta, "title" | "commandPreview" | "task">): string {
  const line = typeof run.task?.line === "string" ? run.task.line.trim() : "";
  if (line) return line;
  const title = String(run.title || "").trim();
  if (title) return title;
  const command = String(run.commandPreview || "").split(/\r?\n/)[0].trim();
  return command ? (command.length > 80 ? `${command.slice(0, 79)}…` : command) : "Run";
}

// The quiet sentence under a landed strip that did not finish well. `took` is the duration text
// ("9s", or "—" when unknown). Empty for a run that finished or was stopped on purpose.
export function landedNote(run: Pick<RunMeta, "status" | "limit" | "continuedBy">, took: string): string {
  if (run.limit && run.continuedBy) return "Plan limit reached. This task was carried on in another run.";
  const after = took && took !== "—" ? ` after ${took}` : "";
  if (run.status === "failed") return `The agent stopped with an error${after}. Open it to see what happened.`;
  if (run.status === "timed_out") return `The agent ran out of time${after} and was ended. Open it to see how far it got.`;
  if (run.status === "interrupted") return "This run was cut short before it finished. Open it to see how far it got.";
  return "";
}
```

Create `src/ui/newRun.ts`:

```ts
// Pure logic of the New run dialog: how any page asks for it, the checks that give a plain reason
// before anything is sent, and the words for what the server may answer. No React; only types are
// imported, so `node --test` can load it (test/runs-board.test.js).
import type { ExecutionGateStatus } from "../types";

export const NEW_RUN_EVENT = "aos-new-run";
export interface NewRunRequest {
  agentId?: string;
  prompt?: string;
}

// The Shell listens for this and shows the one New run dialog, so the page button and the ⌘K action are the same thing.
export function openNewRun(request: NewRunRequest = {}) {
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent<NewRunRequest>(NEW_RUN_EVENT, { detail: request }));
}

// The spec's words. See decision D-C3-5: the server's only kind of Held is a plan limit.
export const RISKY_STEP_HINT = "A risky step ends the run as Held instead of going ahead.";
export const TASK_MAX = 20000;

type Gate = Pick<ExecutionGateStatus, "enabled" | "level"> | null;

// The same words as the top bar: "Level 1 · Run agents". Empty while the safety level is not known.
export function levelWord(gate: Gate): string {
  if (!gate) return "";
  const level = typeof gate.level === "number" ? gate.level : gate.enabled ? 1 : 0;
  return level === 0 ? "Level 0 · Look only" : level === 1 ? "Level 1 · Run agents" : "Level 2 · Machine control";
}

// Why a run cannot start because of safety, or null when nothing is in the way. Both reasons point at Safety.
export function gateBlock(gate: Gate): { kind: "look-only" | "gate-off"; text: string } | null {
  if (!gate) return null;
  if (gate.level === 0) {
    return { kind: "look-only", text: "Safety is set to Look only, so agents can't run yet. Raise it to Run agents on the Safety page." };
  }
  if (!gate.enabled) {
    return { kind: "gate-off", text: "Running agents is switched off (the execution gate is off). Turn it on in Safety." };
  }
  return null;
}

export function taskProblem(task: string): string {
  const text = task.trim();
  if (!text) return "Write what the agent should do first.";
  if (text.length > TASK_MAX) return `That task is too long. The limit is ${TASK_MAX.toLocaleString("en-US")} characters.`;
  return "";
}

// The folder is a name INSIDE the Workspace; the server checks this again and refuses anything outside.
export function folderProblem(folder: string): string {
  const text = folder.trim();
  if (!text) return "";
  if (text.includes("\0") || /^([\\/]|~|[A-Za-z]:)/.test(text)) {
    return "Type a folder name inside the Workspace, such as notes/today. A full path to somewhere else is not allowed.";
  }
  if (text.split(/[\\/]+/).includes("..")) return 'A folder can\'t go up and out of the Workspace. Remove the ".." parts.';
  return "";
}

// The agent the dialog starts on: the one asked for, else the first installed one in `order`, else the first.
export function pickAgent(agents: Array<{ id: string; detected: { installed: boolean } }> | null, order: string[], wanted?: string): string {
  if (wanted && order.includes(wanted)) return wanted;
  const installed = agents ? order.find((id) => agents.some((agent) => agent.id === id && agent.detected.installed)) : undefined;
  return installed || order[0];
}

// Real folders inside the Workspace (first two levels), for the Folder field's suggestions.
export function folderSuggestions(files: Array<{ root: string; relativePath: string }>): string[] {
  const found = new Set<string>();
  for (const file of files) {
    if (file.root !== "workspace") continue;
    const parts = file.relativePath.split(/[\\/]+/).filter(Boolean);
    for (let depth = 1; depth < parts.length && depth <= 2; depth += 1) found.add(parts.slice(0, depth).join("/"));
  }
  return [...found].sort().slice(0, 30);
}

// Words for the answers the start route can give. null means "not one I know": the caller falls back
// to friendlyError(). `fix` says which button helps.
export function startError(code: string): { text: string; fix?: "safety" | "folder" } | null {
  if (code === "execution_gate_off") return { text: "Safety is set to Look only. Agents can't run until you allow it.", fix: "safety" };
  if (code === "folder_outside_sandbox") return { text: "That folder is outside the Workspace. Type a folder name inside it, or leave the folder empty.", fix: "folder" };
  if (code === "too_many_runs") return { text: "Too many runs are already working. Wait for one to finish, then press Start run again." };
  return null;
}
```

States and exact words (Review Focus 4):

| Situation | What the person sees | Start run |
|---|---|---|
| Opening | The fields at once; the safety line reads "Runs follow your safety level." until the level arrives | disabled until agents and level are known |
| Server not answering | Danger banner "Agent OS isn't responding" / "Agent OS can't check your safety level or your agents right now. Try again in a moment." + "Try again" | disabled |
| Look only (`level 0`) | Warning banner "Safety is set to Look only, so agents can't run yet. Raise it to Run agents on the Safety page." + "Open Safety" | disabled |
| Gate off (`enabled` false, level not 0) | Warning banner "Running agents is switched off (the execution gate is off). Turn it on in Safety." + "Open Safety" | disabled |
| Agent not installed | Warning banner "<Agent> isn't installed". Hermes and OpenClaw: "Install it from Setup, then come back." + "Open Setup". Others: "Install <Agent> from its website, then press Re-check." + "Open website" and "Re-check" | disabled |
| Empty task | After the person presses Start run (or leaves the field with text then clears it): under the field, "Write what the agent should do first."; focus goes to the field; nothing is sent | enabled |
| Folder is a path outside the Workspace | Under the field: "Type a folder name inside the Workspace, such as notes/today. A full path to somewhere else is not allowed." (or the ".." sentence) | disabled |
| The server still refuses | `execution_gate_off`: "Safety is set to Look only. Agents can't run until you allow it." + "Open Safety". `folder_outside_sandbox`: "That folder is outside the Workspace. Type a folder name inside it, or leave the folder empty." + "Use the default folder". `too_many_runs`: "Too many runs are already working. Wait for one to finish, then press Start run again." Anything else: `friendlyError` (for example "Couldn't reach Agent OS.") | enabled again |
| Starting | the button reads "Working…" (the modal's own busy word) | disabled |

```tsx
// The New run dialog: one task, one agent, one folder inside the Workspace. Both the Runs page button
// and the ⌘K "New run…" action open this one (the Shell mounts it). It never sends anything it knows will
// be refused: it says why in plain words and points at the fix (Safety, Setup).
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { getExecutionGateStatus, getWorkspaceListing, listAgents, startAgentRun } from "../../api";
import { navigateTo } from "../../nav";
import type { AgentSummary, ExecutionGateStatus } from "../../types";
import { AGENTS_ORDER, AGENT_LABEL, SETUP_INSTALLED_AGENT_SET, friendlyError } from "../agentsShared";
import { RISKY_STEP_HINT, TASK_MAX, folderProblem, folderSuggestions, gateBlock, levelWord, pickAgent, startError, taskProblem } from "../newRun";
import type { NewRunRequest } from "../newRun";
import AgentConfirmModal from "./AgentConfirmModal";
import Banner from "./Banner";

export default function NewRunDialog({ request, onClose }: { request: NewRunRequest; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<AgentSummary[] | null>(null);
  const [agentsFailed, setAgentsFailed] = useState(false);
  const [gate, setGate] = useState<ExecutionGateStatus | null>(null);
  const [gateFailed, setGateFailed] = useState(false);
  const [folders, setFolders] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [task, setTask] = useState(request.prompt || "");
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState(request.agentId || "");
  const [folder, setFolder] = useState("");
  // The "write a task" reason appears only after the person tried to start, so a fresh dialog is not shouting.
  const [triedStart, setTriedStart] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [rechecking, setRechecking] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<{ text: string; fix?: "safety" | "folder" } | null>(null);
  const taskRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  async function loadAgents(refresh = false) {
    try {
      setAgents((await listAgents(refresh)).agents);
      setAgentsFailed(false);
    } catch {
      setAgentsFailed(true);
    }
  }
  async function loadGate() {
    try {
      setGate(await getExecutionGateStatus());
      setGateFailed(false);
    } catch {
      setGateFailed(true);
    }
  }
  function reload() {
    void loadAgents(true);
    void loadGate();
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadAgents();
    void loadGate();
    // Folder suggestions are a nicety: if the list cannot load, the field still works as plain text.
    getWorkspaceListing()
      .then((listing) => setFolders(folderSuggestions(listing.files)))
      .catch(() => undefined);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const agentId = picked || pickAgent(agents, AGENTS_ORDER);
  const agent = agents?.find((item) => item.id === agentId);
  const label = AGENT_LABEL[agentId] || agentId;
  const installed = agent ? agent.detected.installed : null; // null: not known yet
  const offline = (gate === null && gateFailed) || (agents === null && agentsFailed);
  const block = gateBlock(gate);
  const taskIssue = taskProblem(task);
  const folderIssue = folderProblem(folder);
  const cannotStart = busy || gate === null || agents === null || block !== null || installed !== true || folderIssue !== "";
  const showTaskIssue = triedStart && taskIssue !== "";

  function openElsewhere(page: string) {
    onClose();
    navigateTo(page);
  }

  async function recheck() {
    setRechecking(true);
    await loadAgents(true);
    setRechecking(false);
  }

  async function start() {
    if (taskIssue) {
      setTriedStart(true);
      taskRef.current?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const run = await startAgentRun(agentId, { prompt: task.trim(), folder: folder.trim() || undefined });
      // Land on the new run's console (D-C3-3). To land on the Board instead, call navigateTo("runs") here.
      navigateTo("runs", { run: run.id });
      onClose();
    } catch (caught) {
      const code = caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "";
      setError(startError(code) || { text: friendlyError(caught) });
      if (code === "execution_gate_off") void loadGate();
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const level = levelWord(gate);

  return (
    <AgentConfirmModal
      title="New run"
      confirmLabel="Start run"
      confirmDisabled={cannotStart}
      busy={busy}
      wide
      onConfirm={() => void start()}
      onClose={() => (busy ? null : onClose())}
    >
      <p className="os-newrun__lede">A run is one task an agent does on its own.</p>

      {offline ? (
        <Banner
          tone="danger"
          title="Agent OS isn't responding"
          actions={
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={reload}>
              Try again
            </button>
          }
        >
          Agent OS can&apos;t check your safety level or your agents right now. Try again in a moment.
        </Banner>
      ) : null}
      {block ? (
        <Banner
          tone="warn"
          actions={
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => openElsewhere("safety")}>
              Open Safety
            </button>
          }
        >
          {block.text}
        </Banner>
      ) : null}
      {installed === false ? (
        <Banner
          tone="warn"
          title={`${label} isn't installed`}
          actions={
            SETUP_INSTALLED_AGENT_SET.has(agentId) ? (
              <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => openElsewhere("setup")}>
                Open Setup
              </button>
            ) : (
              <>
                <a className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" href={agent?.homepage} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                  Open website
                </a>
                <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={() => void recheck()} disabled={rechecking}>
                  {rechecking ? "Checking…" : "Re-check"}
                </button>
              </>
            )
          }
        >
          {SETUP_INSTALLED_AGENT_SET.has(agentId) ? "Install it from Setup, then come back." : `Install ${label} from its website, then press Re-check.`}
        </Banner>
      ) : null}

      <div className="os-field">
        <label className="os-field__label" htmlFor="os-newrun-task">
          Task
        </label>
        <textarea
          id="os-newrun-task"
          ref={taskRef}
          rows={4}
          value={task}
          maxLength={TASK_MAX}
          placeholder="For example: Describe this project"
          aria-invalid={showTaskIssue ? true : undefined}
          aria-describedby="os-newrun-task-note"
          onChange={(event) => {
            setTask(event.target.value);
            setError(null);
          }}
        />
        <p id="os-newrun-task-note" className={`os-newrun__note${showTaskIssue ? " os-newrun__note--bad" : ""}`} role={showTaskIssue ? "alert" : undefined}>
          {showTaskIssue ? taskIssue : "One clear job. The agent works on it alone and the result lands on this page."}
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="os-newrun__row">
        <div className="os-field">
          <label className="os-field__label" htmlFor="os-newrun-agent">
            Agent
          </label>
          <select
            id="os-newrun-agent"
            value={agentId}
            disabled={agents === null}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setPicked(event.target.value);
              setError(null);
            }}
          >
            {AGENTS_ORDER.map((id) => {
              const found = agents?.find((item) => item.id === id);
              return (
                <option key={id} value={id}>
                  {AGENT_LABEL[id]}
                  {found && !found.detected.installed ? " (not installed)" : ""}
                </option>
              );
            })}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="os-field">
          <label className="os-field__label" htmlFor="os-newrun-folder">
            Folder
          </label>
          <input
            id="os-newrun-folder"
            type="text"
            list="os-newrun-folders"
            value={folder}
            placeholder={`runs-work/${agentId}`}
            autoComplete="off"
            spellCheck={false}
            aria-invalid={folderIssue ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby="os-newrun-folder-note"
            onChange={(event) => {
              setFolder(event.target.value);
              setError(null);
            }}
          />
          <datalist id="os-newrun-folders">
            {folders.map((name) => (
              <option key={name} value={name} />
            ))}
          </datalist>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p id="os-newrun-folder-note" className={`os-newrun__note${folderIssue ? " os-newrun__note--bad" : ""}`} role={folderIssue ? "alert" : undefined}>
        {folderIssue || `Runs can only work inside the Workspace. Leave this empty to use runs-work/${agentId}.`}
      </p>

      <p className="os-newrun__hint">
        {level ? `Runs follow your safety level (${level}). ` : "Runs follow your safety level. "}
        {RISKY_STEP_HINT}
      </p>

      {error ? (
        <p className="os-newrun__error" role="alert">
          {error.text}{" "}
          {error.fix === "safety" ? (
            <button type="button" className="os-newrun__link" onClick={() => openElsewhere("safety")}>
              Open Safety
            </button>
          ) : null}
          {error.fix === "folder" ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="os-newrun__link"
              onClick={() => {
                setFolder("");
                setError(null);
              }}
            >
              Use the default folder
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </AgentConfirmModal>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 9: Create `src/ui/components/RunBoard.tsx`** (the bays and strips of `runs.html`). Every value comes from the run list (`GET /api/runs`, one `RunMeta` each): agent `agentId` → name; task `task.line` or `title`; state from `status`, `limit` and `continuedBy`; time `startedAt`/`endedAt`; cost `usage.costUsd` ("—" when the agent reports none); started `createdAt`. A strip's whole job is to say that and offer one next step.

```tsx
// The Runs board: three bays (Active, Held, Landed) of strips, one strip per real run. A strip is a
// card with a coloured tab on its left, drawn as a shape in runs.css (never a thick coloured border),
// the state as an icon plus a word, and one button. A Held strip also carries the choices for carrying on.
import { Activity, CircleCheck, CircleDashed, CirclePause, Plus } from "lucide-react";
import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import type { RunMeta } from "../../types";
import { AGENT_LABEL } from "../agentsShared";
import { costLabel, durationLabel } from "../fleetShared";
import { landedNote, splitBays, stateOf, taskText } from "../runsBoard";
import type { BayId } from "../runsBoard";
import EmptyState from "./EmptyState";
import RelativeTime, { TimeAgo } from "./RelativeTime";
import RunLimitBanner from "./RunLimitBanner";
import StatusWord from "./StatusWord";

const BAYS: Array<{ id: BayId; name: string; icon: LucideIcon; blurb: string; none: string }> = [
  { id: "active", name: "Active", icon: Activity, blurb: "Working right now.", none: "" },
  { id: "held", name: "Held", icon: CirclePause, blurb: "Paused by a limit. Nothing is lost.", none: "Nothing is held by a limit." },
  { id: "landed", name: "Landed", icon: CircleCheck, blurb: "Finished, failed or stopped, newest first.", none: "Nothing has landed yet. Finished runs are listed here." }
];

function Strip({ run, bay, onOpen }: { run: RunMeta; bay: BayId; onOpen: (id: string) => void }) {
  const word = stateOf(run);
  const task = taskText(run);
  const took = durationLabel(run);
  const note = bay === "landed" ? landedNote(run, took) : "";
  const action = bay === "active" ? "Watch" : word.state === "ready" ? "Open result" : "Open";
  return (
    <li className="os-runs-strip" data-edge={word.edge}>
      <span className="os-runs-strip__agent">{AGENT_LABEL[run.agentId || ""] || "—"}</span>
      <span className="os-runs-strip__task">
        <button type="button" className="os-runs-strip__open" title={task} onClick={() => onOpen(run.id)}>
          <span className="os-trunc">{task}</span>
        </button>
      </span>
      <span className="os-runs-strip__state">
        <StatusWord state={word.state} label={word.label} />
      </span>
      <span className="os-runs-strip__num">
        <span className="os-visually-hidden">Time </span>
        {bay === "active" && run.startedAt ? <RelativeTime since={run.startedAt} live /> : <span className="os-mono">{took}</span>}
      </span>
      <span className="os-runs-strip__num">
        <span className="os-visually-hidden">Cost </span>
        <span className="os-mono">{costLabel(run.usage)}</span>
      </span>
      <span className="os-runs-strip__num os-runs-strip__num--soft">
        <span className="os-visually-hidden">Started </span>
        <TimeAgo since={run.createdAt} />
      </span>
      <span className="os-runs-strip__act">
        <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" aria-label={`${action}: ${task}`} onClick={() => onOpen(run.id)}>
          {action}
        </button>
      </span>
      {bay === "held" ? (
        <div className="os-runs-strip__more">
          <RunLimitBanner run={run} compact />
        </div>
      ) : note ? (
        <div className="os-runs-strip__more">
          <p>{note}</p>
          {run.continuedBy ? (
            <button type="button" className="os-runs-link" onClick={() => onOpen(run.continuedBy || "")}>
              Open it
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </li>
  );
}

export default function RunBoard({ runs, onOpen, onNew }: { runs: RunMeta[] | null; onOpen: (id: string) => void; onNew: () => void }) {
  const bays = runs ? splitBays(runs) : null;
  return (
    <div className="os-runs-board">
      <div className="os-runs-cols" aria-hidden="true">
        <span>Agent</span>
        <span>Task</span>
        <span>State</span>
        <span className="os-runs-cols__end">Time</span>
        <span className="os-runs-cols__end">Cost</span>
        <span className="os-runs-cols__end">Started</span>
        <span />
      </div>
      {BAYS.map(({ id, name, icon: Icon, blurb, none }) => {
        const list = bays ? bays[id] : null;
        return (
          <section key={id} className="os-runs-bay" aria-labelledby={`os-runs-bay-${id}`}>
            <div className="os-runs-bay__head">
              <h2 id={`os-runs-bay-${id}`} className="os-runs-bay__name">
                <Icon size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
                {name}
              </h2>
              <span className="os-runs-bay__n">
                <span className="os-mono">{list ? list.length : "…"}</span> {list && list.length === 1 ? "run" : "runs"}
              </span>
              <p className="os-runs-bay__blurb">{blurb}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="os-runs-bay__body">
              {list === null ? (
                <div className="os-skeleton os-runs-skeleton" aria-hidden="true" />
              ) : list.length > 0 ? (
                <ul className="os-runs-strips" role="list">
                  {list.map((run) => (
                    <Strip key={run.id} run={run} bay={id} onOpen={onOpen} />
                  ))}
                </ul>
              ) : id === "active" ? (
                <EmptyState
                  icon={CircleDashed}
                  title="No runs in the air"
                  body="A run appears here while an agent works on it, then moves to Landed."
                  action={
                    <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--primary" onClick={onNew}>
                      <Plus size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
                      New run
                    </button>
                  }
                />
              ) : (
                <p className="os-runs-bay__none">{none}</p>
              )}
            </div>
          </section>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`RunBoard` receives `onNew`; the page decides which "New run" button shows in the header (D-C3-10).

   ```tsx
   // "Keep going on OpenRouter (~$0.42)" / "Keep going with Composer" / "Hand to Claude Code (~$0.01)"
   function buttonLabel(run: RunMeta, option: ContinueOption) {
     let text: string;
     if (option.id === "cursor-composer") text = "Keep going with Composer";
     else if (option.agentId === run.agentId) text = "Keep going on OpenRouter";
     else text = `Hand to ${AGENT_LABEL[option.agentId]}`;
     return typeof option.estimateUsd === "number" ? `${text} (~${usd(option.estimateUsd)})` : text;
   }

   function confirmLabel(run: RunMeta, option: ContinueOption) {
     return option.id === "cursor-composer" || option.agentId === run.agentId ? "Keep going" : "Hand over";
   }
   ```

- [ ] **Step 12: Rewrite `src/pages/RunsPage.tsx`.** Data: `listRuns({ limit: 100 })` (`GET /api/runs`) loaded on mount and every 5 s (`useInterval`, which pauses on a hidden tab); one run's console reads `?run=<id>` as before. All the states:

| State | What shows |
|---|---|
| Loading (first load, under 15 s) | Header, tabs, tally "… in the air · … held · … landed", and three bays with a static skeleton strip each |
| Normal | Bays with strips. Active empty: "No runs in the air" with the primary "New run" |
| Offline at first load (the call failed, or 15 s passed with no answer) | Danger banner "Agent OS isn't responding" with "Try again"; the tally reads "— in the air · — held · — landed"; no bays, no spinner. The 5 s poll fills the page in by itself when the server returns |
| Went offline after a good load | The last list stays, with a warning banner "Can't reach Agent OS" above it; it recovers by itself |
| Session recordings tab | Designed empty state (SP3 fills it) |
| A run is open (`?run=<id>`) | "All runs" back button and the run's console |

```tsx
// Runs: the Board of every run in three bays (Active, Held, Landed), a Session recordings tab that is a
// designed empty state until sessions arrive (SP3), and one run's console when ?run=<id> is set.
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, CircleDot, Plus } from "lucide-react";
import { listRuns } from "../api";
import { navigateTo, queryParam } from "../nav";
import type { RunMeta } from "../types";
import Banner from "../ui/components/Banner";
import EmptyState from "../ui/components/EmptyState";
import PageHeader from "../ui/components/PageHeader";
import RunBoard from "../ui/components/RunBoard";
import RunConsole from "../ui/components/RunConsole";
import Tabs from "../ui/components/Tabs";
import { useInterval } from "../ui/components/useInterval";
import { openNewRun } from "../ui/newRun";
import { SAFE_EXAMPLE_PROMPT } from "../ui/onboardingShared";
import { splitBays } from "../ui/runsBoard";
import "../ui/runs.css";

const WATCHDOG_MS = 15000;
type TabId = "board" | "recordings";

export default function RunsPage() {
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState<RunMeta[] | null>(null);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false); // the last load failed
  const [timedOut, setTimedOut] = useState(false); // nothing has loaded for 15 seconds
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState(() => queryParam("run"));
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<TabId>("board");

  async function loadRuns() {
    try {
      const { runs: list } = await listRuns({ limit: 100 });
      setRuns(list);
      setFailed(false);
    } catch {
      setFailed(true);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadRuns();
  }, []);
  useInterval(() => void loadRuns(), 5000);

  // Never wait forever on a server that does not answer.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (runs !== null) {
      setTimedOut(false);
      return undefined;
    }
    const id = setTimeout(() => setTimedOut(true), WATCHDOG_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [runs]);

  useEffect(() => {
    function sync() {
      setSelectedId(queryParam("run"));
      // The Get started checklist sends ?example=safe: open the dialog with the example typed in, then tidy
      // the address. The timer lets the Shell (the parent, whose listener is added after this page's effects
      // on a first load) be listening before the request is sent.
      if (queryParam("example") === "safe") {
        const agentId = queryParam("agent") || undefined;
        window.setTimeout(() => openNewRun({ agentId, prompt: SAFE_EXAMPLE_PROMPT }), 0);
        navigateTo("runs");
      }
    }
    sync();
    window.addEventListener("aos-navigate", sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("aos-navigate", sync);
  }, []);

  function open(id: string) {
    setSelectedId(id);
    navigateTo("runs", { run: id });
  }
  function back() {
    setSelectedId("");
    navigateTo("runs");
  }

  const bays = runs ? splitBays(runs) : null;
  const offline = runs === null && (failed || timedOut);
  // "New run" lives in the Active bay while that bay shows its empty state, and in the header otherwise.
  const activeEmpty = tab === "board" && !selectedId && bays !== null && bays.active.length === 0;
  const count = (n: number | undefined) => (n === undefined ? (offline ? "—" : "…") : n);

  const lede = selectedId
    ? undefined
    : tab === "board"
      ? "A run is one task an agent does on its own. It starts Active, may be Held by a limit, and ends Landed."
      : "Sessions will be recorded here, so you can watch what happened and pick the conversation up again.";

  return (
    <section className={`os-runs${selectedId ? " os-runs--detail" : ""}`} aria-labelledby="os-runs-title">
      <PageHeader
        title="Runs"
        titleId="os-runs-title"
        lede={lede}
        actions={
          selectedId || activeEmpty ? undefined : (
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--primary" onClick={() => openNewRun()}>
              <Plus size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
              New run
            </button>
          )
        }
      />

      {selectedId ? (
        <div className="os-runs__detail">
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost os-runs__back" onClick={back}>
            <ArrowLeft size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
            All runs
          </button>
          <RunConsole runId={selectedId} onEnded={() => void loadRuns()} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="os-runs__tabbar">
            <Tabs
              label="Runs views"
              idPrefix="runs"
              tabs={[
                { id: "board", label: "Board" },
                { id: "recordings", label: "Session recordings" }
              ]}
              value={tab}
              onChange={(id) => setTab(id as TabId)}
            />
            <p className="os-runs__tally">
              {tab === "board" ? (
                <>
                  <span className="os-mono">{count(bays?.active.length)}</span> in the air
                  <span className="os-runs__sep" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span className="os-mono">{count(bays?.held.length)}</span> held
                  <span className="os-runs__sep" aria-hidden="true" />
                  <span className="os-mono">{count(bays?.landed.length)}</span> landed
                </>
              ) : (
                "Nothing recorded yet"
              )}
            </p>
          </div>

          {tab === "board" ? (
            <div role="tabpanel" id="runs-panel-board" aria-labelledby="runs-tab-board">
              {offline ? (
                <Banner
                  tone="danger"
                  title="Agent OS isn't responding"
                  actions={
                    <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void loadRuns()}>
                      Try again
                    </button>
                  }
                >
                  {failed ? "The runs can't be listed right now." : "It is taking too long to answer, so the runs can't be listed yet."} Agent OS keeps trying, and
                  this page fills in by itself when it is back.
                </Banner>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {runs && failed ? (
                    <Banner tone="warn" title="Can't reach Agent OS">
                      This is the last list it got. It keeps trying, and this page updates by itself when Agent OS is back.
                    </Banner>
                  ) : null}
                  <RunBoard runs={runs} onOpen={open} onNew={() => openNewRun()} />
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div role="tabpanel" id="runs-panel-recordings" aria-labelledby="runs-tab-recordings">
              <EmptyState
                icon={CircleDot}
                title="Session recordings arrive with Sessions"
                body="Once you work in a session, it is recorded on this Mac as it happens. A replay plays back what was on screen. It never runs anything again and never answers anything for you."
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

Four hunks, in this order, each with the Edit tool (the file is 504 lines now). Every colour is a token; the one literal left is the modal scrim `rgba(5, 7, 11, 0.6)`, which SP1's menu scrim (`shell.css`) already uses and which has no token.

The columns are the prototype's (`--rn-cols`), the breakpoint is derived from the content width: the prototype stacks the bays when its content is 1028 px or less, and with the 64 px rail the content is `viewport - 112`, so the stacked layout starts at a 1140 px viewport (the full sidebar only exists from 1367 px, where the content is always wider).

- [ ] **Step 16: Create the probe `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/runs.mjs`** (git-ignored; Review Focus 4 and 5 and the spec's "SP2 done when").

The probe drives the real throwaway server for the empty board, starting a fake run, the deep link and ⌘K. It stubs only the replies that set up a state the fakes cannot produce: Look only, gate off, an agent not installed, a held run, and offline. Every stub is page-level (`tab.route`) and comes off with its tab.

```js
// Task C3: the Runs Board and the New run dialog.
// Run: node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/runs.mjs
const W = 1470, H = 956;
const json = (route, body, status = 200) =>
  route.fulfill({ status, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
const iso = (msAgo) => new Date(Date.now() - msAgo).toISOString();
const primaryNewRun = (tab) => tab.locator(".os-btn--primary", { hasText: "New run" });

export default async function ({ browser, openPage, shot, pass, fail, api }) {
  const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));

  // 1. The empty board, its one primary button, the tabs and the recordings empty state.
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "runs");
    check((await tab.locator("h1").first().textContent())?.trim() === "Runs", "h1 reads Runs");
    check(await tab.getByText("No runs in the air").isVisible(), "Active bay empty state");
    check((await primaryNewRun(tab).count()) === 1, "exactly one primary New run", await primaryNewRun(tab).count());
    await shot(tab, "runs", W, H, "board-empty");
    await tab.getByRole("tab", { name: "Board" }).focus();
    await tab.keyboard.press("ArrowRight");
    check(/Session recordings/.test((await tab.getByRole("tab", { selected: true }).textContent()) || ""), "ArrowRight selects Session recordings");
    check(await tab.getByText("Session recordings arrive with Sessions").isVisible(), "recordings tab: designed empty state");
    await tab.keyboard.press("Home");
    check(/Board/.test((await tab.getByRole("tab", { selected: true }).textContent()) || ""), "Home selects Board");
    check(errors.length === 0, "no console errors (board)", errors.join(" / "));
    await context.close();
  }

  // 2. "SP2 done when": the New run dialog starts a fake run through the existing API.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "runs");
    await primaryNewRun(tab).click();
    const dialog = tab.getByRole("dialog");
    check(/New run/.test((await dialog.locator("#os-modal-title").textContent()) || ""), "dialog titled New run");
    check(await dialog.getByText("A risky step ends the run as Held instead of going ahead.").isVisible(), "risky-step hint, word for word");
    const start = dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Start run" });
    check(await start.isDisabled(), "Start run disabled while the task is empty");
    check(await dialog.getByText("Write what the agent should do first.").isVisible(), "empty task: the reason in words");
    await tab.fill("#os-newrun-task", "Describe this project in three lines");
    await tab.selectOption("#os-newrun-agent", "claude");
    await shot(tab, "runs", W, H, "dialog-filled");
    await start.click();
    await tab.waitForURL(/[?&]run=/, { timeout: 10000 }).catch(() => {});
    const runId = new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("run");
    check(Boolean(runId), "Start run opens the new run's console", tab.url());
    const { json: run } = runId ? await api("GET", `/api/runs/${runId}`) : { json: null };
    check(run?.agentId === "claude" && ["queued", "running"].includes(run?.status), "a fake claude run started", JSON.stringify(run && { agentId: run.agentId, status: run.status }));
    check(run?.task?.line === "Describe this project in three lines", "the task line is recorded on the run", run?.task?.line);
    if (runId) await api("POST", `/api/runs/${runId}/stop`); // the fake claude sleeps 300 s
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "All runs" }).click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(800);
    check(await tab.getByText("Describe this project in three lines").first().isVisible(), "the board shows the task line");
    await shot(tab, "runs", W, H, "board-with-run");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 3. Review Focus 4: a run that cannot start says why and points to the fix.
  for (const c of [
    { name: "look-only", gate: { enabled: false, level: 0 }, text: "Safety is set to Look only, so agents can't run yet.", fix: "Open Safety" },
    { name: "gate-off", gate: { enabled: false, level: 1 }, text: "Running agents is switched off", fix: "Open Safety" }
  ]) {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "runs");
    await tab.route("**/api/execution-gate", (r) => json(r, c.gate));
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(800);
    await primaryNewRun(tab).click();
    const dialog = tab.getByRole("dialog");
    await tab.fill("#os-newrun-task", "Describe this project");
    check(await dialog.getByText(c.text, { exact: false }).first().isVisible(), `${c.name}: says why in plain words`);
    check(await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: c.fix }).isVisible(), `${c.name}: offers ${c.fix}`);
    check(await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Start run" }).isDisabled(), `${c.name}: Start run disabled`);
    await shot(tab, "runs", W, H, `blocked-${c.name}`);
    await context.close();
  }
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "runs");
    await tab.route("**/api/agents**", async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() !== "GET" || !/\/api\/agents(\?|$)/.test(route.request().url())) return route.continue();
      const res = await route.fetch();
      const body = await res.json();
      for (const a of body.agents || []) if (a.id === "hermes") a.detected = { ...a.detected, installed: false };
      return route.fulfill({ response: res, json: body });
    });
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(800);
    await primaryNewRun(tab).click();
    await tab.fill("#os-newrun-task", "Summarise my notes");
    await tab.selectOption("#os-newrun-agent", "hermes");
    const dialog = tab.getByRole("dialog");
    check(await dialog.getByText(/isn't installed/).first().isVisible(), "not installed: says so");
    check(await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Open Setup" }).isVisible(), "not installed: offers Open Setup");
    check(await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Start run" }).isDisabled(), "not installed: Start run disabled");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 4. A held run (plan limit): its strip offers Keep going and Wait for reset; nothing carries on by itself.
  {
    const held = {
      id: "run_probe_held", agentId: "claude", status: "stopped", title: "Claude Code (stream-json transport)",
      createdAt: iso(600000), startedAt: iso(600000), endedAt: iso(300000),
      limit: { kind: "usage_limit", message: "You've hit your 5-hour limit" }, continuedBy: null,
      task: { line: "Write the release notes" }
    };
    const option = (id, label, mode) => ({ id, agentId: "claude", label, brain: { mode, model: null }, approach: "fork", available: true, estimateUsd: 0.42, estimateTokens: 120000, estimateNote: "about" });
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "runs");
    await tab.route("**/api/runs?*", (r) => json(r, { runs: [held] }));
    await tab.route("**/api/runs/run_probe_held/continue-options", (r) => json(r, {
      runId: held.id, agentId: "claude", limit: held.limit, continuedBy: null, onLimit: "ask", perRunBudgetUsd: null,
      canContinue: true, auto: { eligible: false, optionId: null },
      options: [option("or", "Claude Code on OpenRouter", "openrouter"), option("plan", "Claude Code on your plan", "plan")]
    }));
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1200);
    check(await tab.getByText("Write the release notes").first().isVisible(), "held: the strip shows the task line");
    check(await tab.getByText("Held").first().isVisible(), "held: the state is a word (Held)");
    check(await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /Keep going on OpenRouter/ }).first().isVisible(), "held: Keep going on OpenRouter offered");
    const wait = tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Wait for reset" }).first();
    check(await wait.isVisible(), "held: Wait for reset offered");
    await shot(tab, "runs", W, H, "board-held");
    await wait.click();
    check(await tab.getByText(/press Keep going after the reset/i).first().isVisible(), "held: Wait for reset says nothing carries on by itself");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 5. Review Focus 5: offline shows a designed state, never an endless spinner, and recovers on the next poll.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "runs");
    await tab.route("**/api/runs?*", (r) => r.abort());
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(6000);
    check(await tab.getByText(/Can't reach Agent OS|Agent OS isn't responding/).first().isVisible(), "offline: designed state");
    check((await tab.locator(".os-skeleton").count()) === 0, "offline: no loading skeleton left on screen");
    await shot(tab, "runs", W, H, "offline");
    await tab.unroute("**/api/runs?*");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(6000);
    check(await tab.getByText(/No runs in the air|Describe this project in three lines/).first().isVisible(), "offline: recovers on the next 5 s poll");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 6. ⌘K "New run…" opens the same dialog; Escape closes it and gives focus back.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "fleet");
    const hold = tab.getByRole("button", { name: /hold to stop all/i });
    await hold.focus();
    await tab.keyboard.press("Meta+k");
    await tab.keyboard.type("New run");
    await tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(400);
    check(/New run/.test((await tab.locator("#os-modal-title").textContent().catch(() => "")) || ""), "⌘K New run… opens the dialog");
    await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(300);
    check((await tab.getByRole("dialog").count()) === 0, "Escape closes the dialog");
    check(await tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement && document.activeElement !== document.body), "focus is returned, not dropped to the page");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 7. The onboarding deep link types the safe example and starts nothing.
  {
    const before = (await api("GET", "/api/runs?limit=1000")).json.runs.length;
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "runs&agent=claude&example=safe");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(800);
    check((await tab.inputValue("#os-newrun-task").catch(() => "")).length > 0, "safe example typed in");
    check((await tab.inputValue("#os-newrun-agent").catch(() => "")) === "claude", "agent chosen from the link");
    const after = (await api("GET", "/api/runs?limit=1000")).json.runs.length;
    check(after === before, "the link starts nothing by itself", `${before} -> ${after}`);
    await context.close();
  }

  // 8. Layout: no sideways scroll at the 1024 px window minimum with the dialog open, and the 1280 rail shot.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, 1024, 640, "runs");
    await primaryNewRun(tab).click();
    const wide = await tab.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth);
    check(wide <= 0, "1024x640: no sideways scroll with the dialog open", `${wide}px too wide`);
    await shot(tab, "runs", 1024, 640, "dialog-1024");
    await context.close();
    const r = await openPage(browser, 1280, 720, "runs");
    await shot(r.tab, "runs", 1280, 720, "board-rail");
    await r.context.close();
  }
}
```
