**Decisions taken while drafting (the owner can overturn any of them):**

| # | Question | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-C2-1 | The prototype's h1 is the tagline "Five agents from five makers, live on one screen." | The h1 is "Home"; the lede says what is happening right now. | The menu name is the page name (Global Constraints, Copy; kit convention). The tagline promises "live" even when nothing runs. Reported as a deliberate difference. |
| D-C2-2 | What lights a line on the Orbit before Sessions exist (SP3)? | A queued or running **agent** run (kinds `agent` and `team-turn`, and any kind not in the R14 list). Service jobs (gateway start or stop) and setup jobs never light it. Amber (waiting) is never set until SP4. | The spec says lit only while working. A gateway restart is not the agent working. |
| D-C2-3 | The waiting strip until SP4. | Nothing waits yet, so the strip does not render. That is the prototype's own "Nothing running" state, which has no strip. `WaitingStrip` is the slot SP4 fills. | Spec "Placeholders until later". An empty banner would be noise. |
| D-C2-4 | Each agent's status line ("where"). | Live: "<task> · <elapsed>". Held: "Plan limit reached". Ready: "Nothing running". Not installed: "Not installed" plus "Install it from Setup". The prototype's session words ("No session open", "idle 26 m") wait for SP3. | Real run data only. Before SP3 there are no sessions to describe. |
| D-C2-5 | The Gateways counter and the per-agent service checks. | Not on Home. Gateways are on Agents, each with its own Start and Stop. | The prototype's Home has no gateway readout. It also saves two requests every 20 s. |
| D-C2-6 | "Open sessions n" in the Recent activity line. | Hidden until SP3. | No sessions exist yet. "0" would suggest a feature that is off. |
| D-C2-7 | The Orbit's dial face (a gradient and drop-shadow filters in `orbit.js`). | Flat token fills: face `--os-surface-2`, edge `--os-line-2`, rings and ticks `--os-line-1/2/3`. No SVG filters or gradients. | Global Constraints: tokens only, no decorative gradients. The shape and layout of the approved Orbit stay. |

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `src/ui/homeShared.ts`.**

```ts
// Home's pure logic: what lights the Orbit, each agent's status line, the lede,
// the recent activity rows and today's spend. `import type` only (decision P14):
// the logic test loads this file straight from src/ and Node strips the types.
import type { AgentSummary, RunMeta } from "../types";
import type { StatusState } from "./components/StatusWord";

export const HOME_AGENTS = [
  { id: "hermes", name: "Hermes Agent", maker: "Nous Research", role: "operator" },
  { id: "openclaw", name: "OpenClaw", maker: "Open source", role: "operator" },
  { id: "claude", name: "Claude Code", maker: "Anthropic", role: "builder" },
  { id: "codex", name: "Codex CLI", maker: "OpenAI", role: "builder" },
  { id: "cursor", name: "Cursor Agent", maker: "Cursor", role: "builder" }
] as const;
export type HomeAgentId = (typeof HOME_AGENTS)[number]["id"];
export type OrbitStates = Partial<Record<HomeAgentId, "live" | "waiting">>;

// A value the page loads: still loading, loaded, or Agent OS could not be reached.
export type Source<T> = { state: "loading" } | { state: "ok"; data: T } | { state: "error"; message: string };

const ACTIVE = new Set(["queued", "running"]);
// Agent OS's own jobs: the same list "Hold to stop all" skips (ruling R14).
const NOT_AGENT_WORK = new Set(["service", "install", "configure", "signin", "pull"]);
const NAME: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(HOME_AGENTS.map((a) => [a.id, a.name]));
const isHomeAgent = (id: string | null): id is HomeAgentId => Boolean(id && id in NAME);

export function isAgentWork(run: Pick<RunMeta, "kind">): boolean {
  return !NOT_AGENT_WORK.has(run.kind);
}

// The newest live agent run per agent (the list comes newest first).
export function liveRunsByAgent(runs: RunMeta[]): Partial<Record<HomeAgentId, RunMeta>> {
  const out: Partial<Record<HomeAgentId, RunMeta>> = {};
  for (const run of runs) {
    if (isHomeAgent(run.agentId) && isAgentWork(run) && ACTIVE.has(run.status) && !out[run.agentId]) out[run.agentId] = run;
  }
  return out;
}

// The newest agent run per agent, live or not.
export function lastRunsByAgent(runs: RunMeta[]): Partial<Record<HomeAgentId, RunMeta>> {
  const out: Partial<Record<HomeAgentId, RunMeta>> = {};
  for (const run of runs) {
    if (isHomeAgent(run.agentId) && isAgentWork(run) && !out[run.agentId]) out[run.agentId] = run;
  }
  return out;
}

// A line lights only while that agent works. "waiting" (amber) arrives with SP4.
export function orbitStates(runs: RunMeta[]): OrbitStates {
  const out: OrbitStates = {};
  for (const id of Object.keys(liveRunsByAgent(runs)) as HomeAgentId[]) out[id] = "live";
  return out;
}

function namesOf(states: OrbitStates): string[] {
  return HOME_AGENTS.filter((a) => states[a.id]).map((a) => a.name);
}

export function orbitLabel(states: OrbitStates): string {
  const lit = namesOf(states);
  return `Agent OS at the centre with five agents around it. ${lit.length ? `Working now: ${lit.join(", ")}.` : "No agent is working right now."}`;
}

export function orbitNote(states: OrbitStates): string {
  return namesOf(states).length
    ? "A line lights only while that agent works. Amber means it needs you."
    : "Nothing is running. A line lights only while that agent works.";
}

export function elapsedLabel(fromIso: string | null | undefined, now: number): string {
  const from = fromIso ? Date.parse(fromIso) : NaN;
  if (!Number.isFinite(from) || now < from) return "—";
  const minutes = Math.floor((now - from) / 60_000);
  if (minutes < 1) return "under 1 m";
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes} m`;
  return `${Math.floor(minutes / 60)} h ${String(minutes % 60).padStart(2, "0")} m`;
}

export interface AgentLine {
  state: StatusState;
  label?: string;
  where: string;
}

export function agentLine(input: {
  agents: "loading" | "ok" | "error";
  summary?: AgentSummary;
  live?: RunMeta;
  last?: RunMeta;
  now: number;
}): AgentLine {
  if (input.agents === "loading") return { state: "loading", where: "" };
  if (input.agents === "error") return { state: "unknown", where: "Can't reach Agent OS" };
  if (!input.summary?.detected.installed) return { state: "unknown", label: "Not installed", where: "Install it from Setup" };
  if (input.live) {
    const task = input.live.task?.line || input.live.title;
    return { state: "live", where: `${task} · ${elapsedLabel(input.live.startedAt || input.live.createdAt, input.now)}` };
  }
  const last = input.last;
  if (last && last.limit && !last.continuedBy && !ACTIVE.has(last.status)) return { state: "held", where: "Plan limit reached" };
  return { state: "ready", where: "Nothing running" };
}

function joinNames(list: string[]): string {
  return list.length <= 1 ? list.join("") : `${list.slice(0, -1).join(", ")} and ${list[list.length - 1]}`;
}

export function homeLede(input: { agents: Source<AgentSummary[]>; states: OrbitStates }): string {
  if (input.agents.state === "loading") return "Checking your agents…";
  if (input.agents.state === "error") return "Can't reach Agent OS right now. This page tries again every few seconds.";
  const lit = namesOf(input.states);
  if (lit.length) return `${joinNames(lit)} ${lit.length === 1 ? "is" : "are"} working.`;
  const installed = input.agents.data.filter((a) => isHomeAgent(a.id) && a.detected.installed).length;
  if (installed === 5) return "All five are installed and ready. Nothing is running right now.";
  if (installed === 0) return "No agents are installed yet. Setup installs them.";
  return `${installed} of 5 agents are installed. Nothing is running right now.`;
}

export function activityRuns(runs: RunMeta[], max: number): RunMeta[] {
  return runs.filter(isAgentWork).slice(0, max);
}

// Known costs of runs that started today (this computer's day). "—" when none is
// known: only Claude Code and OpenClaw report a cost.
export function spendToday(runs: RunMeta[], now: number): string {
  const day = new Date(now).toDateString();
  let total = 0;
  let known = false;
  for (const run of runs) {
    const started = run.startedAt ? new Date(run.startedAt) : null;
    if (!started || started.toDateString() !== day || typeof run.usage?.costUsd !== "number") continue;
    total += run.usage.costUsd;
    known = true;
  }
  return known ? `$${total.toFixed(2)}` : "—";
}

// A request that does not answer in time fails, so the page shows "offline"
// instead of loading for ever (Review Focus 5).
export function withTimeout<T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number): Promise<T> {
  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("Agent OS did not answer in time.")), ms);
    promise.then(
      (value) => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve(value); },
      (error) => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(error); }
    );
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Write `src/ui/useHomeData.ts`.**

```ts
// Loads what Home shows and keeps it fresh. Runs every 5 s. Agents every 30 s,
// but every 5 s while Agent OS can't be reached, so the page recovers quickly.
// Every request has a time limit, so nothing loads for ever (Review Focus 5).
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { listAgents, listRuns } from "../api";
import type { BuilderBrains } from "../buildersApi";
import { getAgentModel, type AgentModelInfo } from "../setupApi";
import type { AgentSummary, RunMeta } from "../types";
import { friendlyError } from "./agentsShared";
import { useBuilderBrains } from "./components/useBuilderBrains";
import { useInterval } from "./components/useInterval";
import { withTimeout, type Source } from "./homeShared";

const LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;

export interface HomeData {
  agents: Source<AgentSummary[]>;
  runs: Source<RunMeta[]>;
  // Hermes and OpenClaw brains: key missing = still loading, null = unknown.
  models: Partial<Record<"hermes" | "openclaw", AgentModelInfo | null>>;
  brains: BuilderBrains | null;
  now: number;
}

export function useHomeData(): HomeData {
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<Source<AgentSummary[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState<Source<RunMeta[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [models, setModels] = useState<HomeData["models"]>({});
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const { brains } = useBuilderBrains();

  const loadAgents = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const { agents: list } = await withTimeout(listAgents(), LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS);
      setAgents({ state: "ok", data: list });
      const operators = list.filter((a) => (a.id === "hermes" || a.id === "openclaw") && a.detected.installed);
      const pairs = await Promise.all(
        operators.map(async (a) => {
          const id = a.id as "hermes" | "openclaw";
          const info = await withTimeout(getAgentModel(id), LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS).catch(() => null);
          return [id, info] as const;
        })
      );
      setModels(Object.fromEntries(pairs));
    } catch (error) {
      setAgents({ state: "error", message: friendlyError(error) });
    }
  }, []);

  const loadRuns = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const { runs: list } = await withTimeout(listRuns({ limit: 50 }), LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS);
      setRuns({ state: "ok", data: list });
    } catch (error) {
      setRuns({ state: "error", message: friendlyError(error) });
    }
    setNow(Date.now());
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadAgents();
    void loadRuns();
  }, [loadAgents, loadRuns]);
  useInterval(() => void loadRuns(), 5000);
  useInterval(() => void loadAgents(), agents.state === "error" ? 5000 : 30000);

  return { agents, runs, models, brains, now };
}
```

`src/ui/components/Orbit.tsx` is the prototype's `orbit.js` as SVG in React, on tokens (D-C2-7). Each agent's group carries `data-agent` and `data-state`, so the probe can read what is lit.

```tsx
import { Activity, CircleDashed, CircleHelp } from "lucide-react";
import { HOME_AGENTS, type HomeAgentId, type OrbitStates } from "../homeShared";

const W = 470, H = 340, CX = 222, CY = 190, R = 144;
const ANGLE: Record<HomeAgentId, number> = { hermes: 220, openclaw: 140, claude: -56, codex: 0, cursor: 56 };
const TONE = {
  live: { stroke: "var(--os-accent)", text: "var(--os-accent-strong)", word: "Live", Icon: Activity },
  waiting: { stroke: "var(--os-warn)", text: "var(--os-warn)", word: "Waiting", Icon: CircleHelp }
} as const;
const rad = (a: number) => (a * Math.PI) / 180;
const pt = (a: number, r: number) => [CX + r * Math.cos(rad(a)), CY + r * Math.sin(rad(a))] as const;
const TICKS = Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, i) => i);

export default function Orbit({ states, label, note }: { states: OrbitStates; label: string; note: string }) {
  return (
    <figure className="os-orbit">
      <svg className="os-orbit__svg" viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`} role="img" aria-label={label}>
        <line className="os-orbit__divider" x1={CX} y1={40} x2={CX} y2={H - 8} />
        <text className="os-orbit__group" x={CX - 14} y={20} textAnchor="end">Operators</text>
        <text className="os-orbit__group" x={CX + 14} y={20} textAnchor="start">Builders</text>
        <line className="os-orbit__rule" x1={CX - 14} y1={30.5} x2={CX - 118} y2={30.5} />
        <line className="os-orbit__rule" x1={CX + 14} y1={30.5} x2={CX + 118} y2={30.5} />
        <circle className="os-orbit__ring" cx={CX} cy={CY} r={R} />
        <circle className="os-orbit__ring os-orbit__ring--inner" cx={CX} cy={CY} r={R - 54} />
        {HOME_AGENTS.map(({ id }) => {
          const state = states[id];
          const tone = state ? TONE[state] : null;
          const [x1, y1] = pt(ANGLE[id], 78);
          const [x2, y2] = pt(ANGLE[id], R - 11);
          const [mx, my] = pt(ANGLE[id], 78 + (R - 89) * 0.58);
          return tone ? (
            <g key={`c-${id}`}>
              <line x1={x1} y1={y1} x2={x2} y2={y2} style={{ stroke: tone.stroke }} strokeWidth={2.4} strokeLinecap="round" />
              <circle cx={mx} cy={my} r={3} style={{ fill: tone.stroke }} />
            </g>
          ) : (
            <line key={`c-${id}`} className="os-orbit__connector" x1={x1} y1={y1} x2={x2} y2={y2} />
          );
        })}
        {TICKS.map((i) => {
          const [ax, ay] = pt(i * 6, 59);
          const [bx, by] = pt(i * 6, i % 5 === 0 ? 67 : 63);
          return <line key={`t-${i}`} className={i % 5 === 0 ? "os-orbit__tick os-orbit__tick--major" : "os-orbit__tick"} x1={ax} y1={ay} x2={bx} y2={by} />;
        })}
        <circle className="os-orbit__face" cx={CX} cy={CY} r={51} />
        <circle className="os-orbit__face-edge" cx={CX} cy={CY} r={43.5} />
        <text className="os-orbit__core" x={CX} y={CY + 1} textAnchor="middle">Agent OS</text>
        <text className="os-orbit__version" x={CX} y={CY + 16} textAnchor="middle">v{__APP_VERSION__}</text>
        {HOME_AGENTS.map(({ id, name, maker }) => {
          const state = states[id];
          const tone = state ? TONE[state] : null;
          const [px, py] = pt(ANGLE[id], 73);
          const [x, y] = pt(ANGLE[id], R);
          const left = ANGLE[id] > 90 && ANGLE[id] < 270;
          const tx = left ? x - 18 : x + 18;
          const anchor = left ? "end" : "start";
          const dy = tone ? -8 : -2;
          const wordWidth = tone ? tone.word.length * 6.3 + 20 : 0;
          return (
            <g key={`n-${id}`} data-agent={id} data-state={state ?? "dim"}>
              <circle className="os-orbit__port" cx={px} cy={py} r={2.6} style={tone ? { stroke: tone.stroke } : undefined} />
              <circle className="os-orbit__node" cx={x} cy={y} r={9} style={tone ? { stroke: tone.stroke } : undefined} />
              <circle className="os-orbit__dot" cx={x} cy={y} r={3.2} style={tone ? { fill: tone.stroke } : undefined} />
              <text className="os-orbit__name" x={tx} y={y + dy} textAnchor={anchor}>{name}</text>
              <text className="os-orbit__maker" x={tx} y={y + dy + 16} textAnchor={anchor}>{maker}</text>
              {tone ? (
                <>
                  <tone.Icon x={left ? tx - wordWidth : tx} y={y + dy + 20} width={14} height={14} color={tone.text} aria-hidden="true" />
                  <text className="os-orbit__state" x={left ? tx : tx + 20} y={y + dy + 32} textAnchor={anchor}>{tone.word}</text>
                </>
              ) : null}
            </g>
          );
        })}
      </svg>
      <figcaption className="os-orbit__note">
        <CircleDashed size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
        <span>{note}</span>
      </figcaption>
    </figure>
  );
}
```

`src/ui/components/HomeAgentTable.tsx`:

```tsx
import type { CSSProperties, MouseEvent } from "react";
import { navigateTo } from "../../nav";
import { describeBrain, isBuilderId, PLAN_OF } from "../builderShared";
import { agentLine, HOME_AGENTS, lastRunsByAgent, liveRunsByAgent, type HomeAgentId } from "../homeShared";
import type { HomeData } from "../useHomeData";
import StatusWord from "./StatusWord";

const COLS = { "--os-table-cols": "140px minmax(0, 1fr) 170px" } as CSSProperties;

function Brain({ id, data, installed }: { id: HomeAgentId; data: HomeData; installed: boolean }) {
  if (!installed) return <span className="os-home-brain__t">—</span>;
  if (isBuilderId(id)) {
    if (!data.brains) return <span className="os-home-brain__t">…</span>;
    const words = describeBrain(id, data.brains[id]);
    return (
      <>
        <span className="os-home-brain__t">{words.modeLabel}</span>
        {words.model ? (
          <code className="os-home-brain__model os-mono" title={words.fullModel || undefined}>{words.model}</code>
        ) : words.mode === "plan" ? (
          <span className="os-table__sub">Uses {PLAN_OF[id]}</span>
        ) : null}
      </>
    );
  }
  const op = id as "hermes" | "openclaw";
  if (!(op in data.models)) return <span className="os-home-brain__t">…</span>;
  const info = data.models[op];
  if (!info || !info.providerLabel) return <span className="os-home-brain__t">Not set</span>;
  return (
    <>
      <span className="os-home-brain__t">{info.providerLabel}</span>
      {info.model ? <code className="os-home-brain__model os-mono">{info.model}</code> : null}
    </>
  );
}

export default function HomeAgentTable({ data }: { data: HomeData }) {
  const list = data.agents.state === "ok" ? data.agents.data : [];
  const runs = data.runs.state === "ok" ? data.runs.data : [];
  const live = liveRunsByAgent(runs);
  const last = lastRunsByAgent(runs);
  const open = (event: MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    navigateTo("agents", { agent: id });
  };
  const group = (role: "operator" | "builder", title: string, blurb: string) => (
    <>
      <div className="os-table__group" role="presentation">
        {title}
        <span>{blurb}</span>
      </div>
      {HOME_AGENTS.filter((a) => a.role === role).map((a) => {
        const summary = list.find((x) => x.id === a.id);
        const line = agentLine({ agents: data.agents.state, summary, live: live[a.id], last: last[a.id], now: data.now });
        return (
          <a key={a.id} className="os-table__row os-home-agent" role="row" href={`?page=agents&agent=${a.id}`} onClick={(e) => open(e, a.id)}>
            <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">
              <span className="os-table__title">{a.name}</span>
              <span className="os-table__sub">{a.maker}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="os-table__cell os-home-brain" role="cell">
              <Brain id={a.id} data={data} installed={Boolean(summary?.detected.installed)} />
            </div>
            <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">
              <StatusWord state={line.state} label={line.label} />
              {line.where ? <span className="os-home-agent__where os-trunc" title={line.where}>{line.where}</span> : null}
            </div>
          </a>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
  return (
    <div className="os-table os-home-agents" role="table" aria-label="Agents" style={COLS}>
      <div className="os-table__head" role="row">
        <span className="os-table__cell" role="columnheader">Agent</span>
        <span className="os-table__cell" role="columnheader">Brain</span>
        <span className="os-table__cell" role="columnheader">Status</span>
      </div>
      {group("operator", "Operators", "Always-on assistants")}
      {group("builder", "Builders", "Coding agents")}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { CSSProperties, MouseEvent } from "react";
import { Activity } from "lucide-react";
import { navigateTo } from "../../nav";
import { AGENT_LABEL } from "../agentsShared";
import { costLabel, durationLabel } from "../fleetShared";
import { activityRuns, spendToday } from "../homeShared";
import { stateOf, taskText } from "../runsBoard";
import type { HomeData } from "../useHomeData";
import EmptyState from "./EmptyState";
import { TimeAgo } from "./RelativeTime";
import StatusWord from "./StatusWord";

const COLS = { "--os-table-cols": "150px minmax(0, 1fr) 124px 80px 60px 84px" } as CSSProperties;

export default function RecentActivity({ data }: { data: HomeData }) {
  const runs = data.runs.state === "ok" ? data.runs.data : null;
  const rows = runs ? activityRuns(runs, 8) : [];
  const go = (event: MouseEvent, page: string, extra: Record<string, string> = {}) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    navigateTo(page, extra);
  };
  return (
    <section className="os-home-activity" aria-labelledby="os-home-activity-title">
      <div className="os-home-activity__head">
        <h2 id="os-home-activity-title">Recent activity</h2>
        <p className="os-home-activity__quiet">
          Spend today <span className="os-mono">{runs ? spendToday(runs, data.now) : "—"}</span> (only Claude Code and OpenClaw report cost)
          <span className="os-home-activity__bar" aria-hidden="true" />
          <a href="?page=runs" onClick={(e) => go(e, "runs")}>All runs</a>
        </p>
      </div>
      {data.runs.state === "loading" ? (
        <p className="os-home-activity__status"><StatusWord state="loading" /></p>
      ) : data.runs.state === "error" ? (
        <p className="os-home-activity__status"><StatusWord state="unknown" label="Can't reach Agent OS" /></p>
      ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={Activity}
          title="No runs yet"
          body="When an agent runs a task, it shows up here with its result, time and cost."
          action={<button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => navigateTo("runs")}>Open Runs</button>}
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="os-table os-home-runs" role="table" aria-label="Recent runs" style={COLS}>
          <div className="os-table__head" role="row">
            <span className="os-table__cell" role="columnheader">Result</span>
            <span className="os-table__cell" role="columnheader">Task</span>
            <span className="os-table__cell" role="columnheader">Agent</span>
            <span className="os-table__cell os-table__cell--end" role="columnheader">Time</span>
            <span className="os-table__cell os-table__cell--end" role="columnheader">Cost</span>
            <span className="os-table__cell os-table__cell--end" role="columnheader">Started</span>
          </div>
          {rows.map((run) => {
            const word = stateOf(run);
            const task = taskText(run);
            const agent = run.agentId ? (AGENT_LABEL as Record<string, string>)[run.agentId] : undefined;
            return (
              <a key={run.id} className="os-table__row" role="row" href={`?page=runs&run=${run.id}`} onClick={(e) => go(e, "runs", { run: run.id })}>
                <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell"><StatusWord state={word.state} label={word.label} /></div>
                <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">
                  <span className="os-table__title os-trunc" title={task}>{task}</span>
                  {run.limit && !run.continuedBy ? <span className="os-table__sub">Plan limit reached</span> : null}
                </div>
                <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">{agent || "—"}</div>
                <div className="os-table__cell os-table__cell--end os-mono" role="cell">{durationLabel(run)}</div>
                <div className="os-table__cell os-table__cell--end os-mono" role="cell">{costLabel(run.usage)}</div>
                <div className="os-table__cell os-table__cell--end os-mono" role="cell">{run.startedAt ? <TimeAgo since={run.startedAt} /> : "—"}</div>
              </a>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```css
.os-orbit { margin: 0; }

.os-orbit__connector { stroke: var(--os-line-3); stroke-width: 1.3; stroke-dasharray: 1.6 4.6; stroke-linecap: round; }
.os-orbit__tick { stroke: var(--os-line-2); stroke-width: 1; }
.os-orbit__tick--major { stroke: var(--os-line-3); }
.os-orbit__face { fill: var(--os-surface-2); stroke: var(--os-line-2); stroke-width: 1.25; }
.os-orbit__face-edge { fill: none; stroke: var(--os-line-1); stroke-width: 1; }
.os-orbit__port { fill: var(--os-bg-0); stroke: var(--os-line-3); stroke-width: 1.25; }
.os-orbit__node { fill: var(--os-surface-2); stroke: var(--os-text-3); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.os-orbit__dot { fill: var(--os-line-2); }
.os-orbit__group { font-size: var(--os-fs-13); font-weight: 620; fill: var(--os-text-2); font-stretch: 90%; }
.os-orbit__name { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 620; fill: var(--os-text-1); font-stretch: 90%; }
.os-orbit__maker { font-size: 12.5px; fill: var(--os-text-2); }
.os-orbit__core { font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 650; fill: var(--os-text-1); font-stretch: 87.5%; }
.os-orbit__version { font-family: var(--os-font-mono) !important; font-size: 11px; fill: var(--os-text-3); }
.os-orbit__state { font-size: var(--os-fs-12); font-weight: 560; fill: var(--os-text-1); }
.os-orbit__note {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--os-sp-2);
  max-width: 460px;
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-1);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-orbit__note svg { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--os-text-3); flex: 0 0 auto; }

/* The agent table */
.os-home-agents .os-table__row { min-height: 58px; }
.os-home-brain__t { display: block; font-size: var(--os-fs-14); font-weight: 520; line-height: 1.3; }
.os-home-brain__model { display: block; margin-top: 3px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--os-text-2); overflow-wrap: anywhere; line-height: 1.3; }
.os-home-agent__where { display: block; margin-top: 3px; font-size: var(--os-fs-13); color: var(--os-text-2); line-height: 1.35; }

/* Recent activity */
.os-home-activity { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--os-sp-3); }
.os-home-activity__head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--os-sp-4); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.os-home-activity__head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: var(--os-fs-20); font-stretch: 87.5%; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.os-home-activity__quiet { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--os-sp-2); flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0; font-size: var(--os-fs-13); color: var(--os-text-2); }
.os-home-activity__quiet .os-mono { color: var(--os-text-1); }
.os-home-activity__quiet a { color: var(--os-accent-strong); }
.os-home-activity__bar { width: 1px; height: 14px; background: var(--os-line-2); }
.os-home-activity__status { margin: 0; padding: var(--os-sp-3) 0; }
.os-home-runs .os-table__row { min-height: 56px; }
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Create the probe `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/home.mjs`** (git-ignored). It covers the quiet and working states, the Orbit, Review Focus 5 (not installed, offline, and recovery on the poll) and the layout.

```js
// Task C2: Home. Run: node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/home.mjs
const W = 1470, H = 956;
const AGENTS_LIST = /\/api\/agents(\?|$)/;
export default async function ({ browser, openPage, shot, pass, fail, api }) {
  const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));

  // 1. Quiet: nothing running, all five fake agents installed.
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "fleet");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    check((await tab.locator("h1").first().textContent())?.trim() === "Home", "h1 reads Home");
    check(await tab.getByText("All five are installed and ready. Nothing is running right now.").isVisible(), "quiet lede");
    check((await tab.locator(".os-orbit [data-state='live']").count()) === 0, "no line lit while nothing runs");
    check(/No agent is working right now/.test((await tab.locator(".os-orbit__svg").getAttribute("aria-label")) || ""), "the Orbit's label says so in words");
    check((await tab.locator(".os-home-agents .os-table__row").count()) === 5, "five agent rows");
    check(await tab.getByText("Operators").first().isVisible() && await tab.getByText("Builders").first().isVisible(), "grouped Operators / Builders");
    check((await tab.getByText(/^(Installed|Gateways)$/).count()) === 0, "the old metric row is gone");
    check(await tab.getByText("No runs yet").isVisible(), "recent activity: designed empty state");
    check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New session" }).count()) === 0, "New session stays hidden until SP3");
    check(errors.length === 0, "no console errors", errors.join(" / "));
    await shot(tab, "home", W, H, "quiet");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 2. A fake run lights Claude Code's line and shows in the table and in Recent activity.
  {
    const r = await api("POST", "/api/agents/claude/runs", { prompt: "Fix the login page", confirm: true });
    const runId = r.json.run?.id || r.json.id;
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "fleet");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    check((await tab.locator(".os-orbit [data-agent='claude']").getAttribute("data-state")) === "live", "Claude Code's line is lit");
    check((await tab.locator(".os-orbit [data-state='live']").count()) === 1, "only that line is lit");
    check(await tab.getByText("Claude Code is working.").isVisible(), "the lede names who is working");
    const row = (await tab.locator(".os-home-agents .os-table__row", { hasText: "Claude Code" }).textContent()) || "";
    check(/Live/.test(row) && /Fix the login page/.test(row), "the table row says Live and the task", row);
    check(await tab.locator(".os-home-runs").getByText("Fix the login page").first().isVisible(), "recent activity lists the run");
    await shot(tab, "home", W, H, "working");
    if (runId) await api("POST", `/api/runs/${runId}/stop`);
    await tab.waitForTimeout(6000);
    check((await tab.locator(".os-orbit [data-state='live']").count()) === 0, "the line goes dim after the run stops (5 s poll)");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 3. Review Focus 5: an agent that is not installed.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "fleet");
    await tab.route("**/api/agents**", async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() !== "GET" || !AGENTS_LIST.test(route.request().url())) return route.continue();
      const res = await route.fetch();
      const body = await res.json();
      for (const a of body.agents || []) if (a.id === "codex") a.detected = { ...a.detected, installed: false };
      return route.fulfill({ response: res, json: body });
    });
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    const row = (await tab.locator(".os-home-agents .os-table__row", { hasText: "Codex CLI" }).textContent()) || "";
    check(/Not installed/.test(row) && /Install it from Setup/.test(row), "not installed reads Not installed", row);
    check(await tab.getByText("4 of 5 agents are installed.", { exact: false }).isVisible(), "the lede counts installed agents");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 4. Review Focus 5: offline, no endless loading, and recovery on the poll.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "fleet");
    const offline = /\/api\/(agents|runs)(\?|$)/;
    await tab.route(offline, (route) => route.abort());
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(9000);
    check(await tab.getByText("Can't reach Agent OS").first().isVisible(), "offline banner");
    check((await tab.getByText("Checking your agents…").count()) === 0, "no endless 'Checking…' after the time limit");
    check(/—/.test((await tab.locator(".os-home-agents").textContent()) || ""), "unknown values read —");
    await shot(tab, "home", W, H, "offline");
    await tab.unroute(offline);
    await tab.waitForTimeout(6500);
    check((await tab.getByText("Can't reach Agent OS").count()) === 0, "recovers on its own within one poll");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 5. Layout: the icon rail at 1280, and no sideways scroll at 1024.
  for (const [w, h] of [[1280, 720], [1024, 640]]) {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, w, h, "fleet");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1200);
    const extra = await tab.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth);
    check(extra <= 0, `${w}x${h}: no sideways scroll`, `${extra}px`);
    await shot(tab, "home", w, h, "quiet");
    await context.close();
  }
}
```

- From `src/nav.ts`: `navigateTo(page, extra)` and `queryParam(name)`.

*Assumptions about A1 and A2 (server, D10). Written into the UI as is; if a name differs, change only `types.ts` and `teamRoomShared.ts`:*
1. **Fields.** `GET /api/team-rooms/:id` returns `room.pausedFor: string | null` (the id of the proposal the room waits on, for example `"P1"`) and `room.clockUsedMs: number | null` (the time the room had used when it paused, in milliseconds; null whenever it is not paused). Both live on `room` because the existing `room.clockStartedAt` does. Task A1 owns them (its `pauseRoom` stores them, `continueRoom` clears them).
2. **Status.** A paused room has `status: "needs_you"` and a proposal with `status: "needs_approval"`. No new status value.
3. **Clock contract.** While the room is **running**, `now - room.clockStartedAt` is the time used (that is how the UI draws the running clock, and it is what today's code does). While the room is **paused**, the UI draws `clockUsedMs` and never ticks. Continue restarts the clock, as the spec says (item 5): `clockStartedAt = now`. **Open point for the controller:** after a *decision* resumes a paused room, Task A2 must leave `clockStartedAt` rewound by the time already used (`clockStartedAt = now - clockUsedMs`, which is exactly A2's internal `state.clockStart`), and then clear `clockUsedMs`. In the A2 draft written alongside this one, that update sets `clockStartedAt` to the resume instant instead. With that, the Time meter would restart at 0s after Approve, while the server's limit keeps counting from the old total, so the meter would under-report. Change that one line in A2 (see "Spec gaps"). If the two tasks end up with a different rule, only `roomElapsedMs()` (Step 4) and its test (Step 1) change.
4. **Decision route.** `POST /api/team-rooms/:id/proposals/:pid` keeps returning `{ proposal, action }`. It answers 403 `{ error: "execution_gate_off", message: "Turn on the execution gate to let the room save files." }` on Approve with the gate off, and 409 `{ error: "not_pending" }` when the proposal was already decided (that is today's code, and it is what A2's "already decided" answer must keep).
5. **List rows.** `GET /api/team-rooms` summaries carry `pausedFor` (Task A1 adds it to `summarizeRoom`), so a paused room reads "Paused for your decision" in Past rooms too. A room at a limit with a card waiting reads "Needs you" and "n waiting for your approval" (from the existing `needsApproval`).

*Produces (used only inside this task; nothing else imports them):*

Removed: `roomStatusMark`, `roomStatusWord`, `proposalMark`, `clockEnd`.
- `TeamRoomDecision.tsx`: named exports `TeamRoomNeedsYou` and `TeamRoomDecided`, both with props `{ room: TeamRoom; proposals: TeamProposal[]; actions: TeamAction[]; onDecided: () => Promise<void>; onChanged: () => Promise<void> }`.
- `default TeamRoomLimits(props: { room: TeamRoom; nowMs: number })`; its section carries `data-elapsed-ms`.
- `default TeamRoomTimeline(props: { items: TimelineItem[]; running: boolean; currentRunId: string | null; turnsAllowed: number })`.
- `default TeamRoomTurn(props: { turn: TurnView; live: boolean; turnsAllowed: number })` and the named export `ClampText(props: { text: string; className?: string })`.

- Unchanged signatures: `default TeamRoomView(props: { roomId: string; onBack: () => void })`, `default TeamRoomStart(props: { onOpenRoom: (id: string) => void })`, `default TeamRoomPage()`.

**Design notes (decisions made in this task; the prototype is silent or the real data differs):**
- **One timeline, not two columns.** The prototype draws one list in turn order. The old page had a Hermes column and an OpenClaw column.
- **Per-turn time is the time of day, not "since the room started".** With a pause in the middle, a since-start offset would be wrong. The time of day (`ended.t`) is always true. It is shown in mono at the right of the turn header.
- **No confirm dialog for Approve or Reject.** The card already says what each does, and the prototype has none. Undo keeps its confirm dialog because it removes a file. `AgentConfirmModal` stays for Start, Stop, Continue and Undo.
- **Limits stay numeric fields, not the prototype's drop-downs.** The server accepts any whole number of turns from 2 to 12 and minutes from 1 to 30, and an optional cost cap. Drop-downs of 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 would remove choices that work today.
- **"Who is in the room" shows only facts the API has:** the name, the maker, installed or not and the version (from `listAgents`). The prototype's brain and model lines have no cheap API here, so a sentence points to Agents for the brain. Maker names (Nous Research, Open source) are the prototype's, kept as a small map.
- **"Continue without deciding" is added** to a paused room's header, as a secondary button. The spec (item 5) says Continue accepts a paused room, and without it a person whose gate is off has no way to keep the room moving. The prototype does not show it.
- **Side column order:** the "Needs you" cards, then Limits, then the cards already decided, then "Still being discussed" (proposals the agents have not agreed on), then the Notebook. The Notebook is kept (real data, not in the prototype) and is drawn only when it has text.
- **"Jump to the decision"** is a link in the task area, shown only at 900 px and below, where the side column drops under the timeline.
- **The proposal tags** (`NOTE`, `PROPOSE`, `AGREE P1`) are shown as sentence case: "Note", "Proposal", "File proposal", "Agrees with P1", "Disagrees with P1".
- **A turn shows a status word only when it did not finish** (Failed, Timed out, Stopped). A finished turn shows nothing extra.
- **After Approve or Reject the card is replaced by the card in its new state** (the prototype's "After Approve" shot): Saved to the Workspace with Undo save and Open the Workspace, or Rejected. The prototype's "Approve again" and "Take another look" buttons are not built, because the server cannot re-open a decided proposal.
- **Past rooms** are a hairline table (not in the prototype, which has no list). A whole row is one button, drawn with a stretched hit area, so the row is one tab stop.

**Review Focus coverage.** Items 1 and 2 of the plan's Review Focus belong to Tasks A1 and A2 (the server). This task's UI side of them is in the probe: after a reload the paused room still reads "Paused for your decision" with the clock at 2m 50s (item 1), and a second Approve answered with 409 `not_pending` shows a calm "already decided" note and no error (item 2). Item 5's "Agent OS unreachable while a page is open" is covered for this page too: the first load fails into a designed error with Retry, and a later loss shows "Lost contact with Agent OS" and clears by itself.

**Data map: where every value on the page comes from** (nothing is invented; an unknown value is "—", a loading one is "…").

| Page area | Value | Source (api.ts function, field) | When unknown or loading |
|---|---|---|---|
| Start, gate | Gate on or off | `getExecutionGateStatus()` fields `enabled`, `level` (off when `!enabled` or `level === 0`) | Call failed and never answered: info Banner "Couldn't check the Safety setting just now. Starting a room will tell you if it is blocking."; Start stays usable |
| Start, who is in the room | Installed, version | `listAgents()` then `agents[].detected.installed` and `detected.version` for ids `hermes` and `openclaw` | Loading "…"; failed, or the id is missing: "—"; not installed: "Not installed" plus an "Open Setup" link |
| Start, who is in the room | Maker | `TEAM_AGENT_MAKER` in `teamRoomShared.ts` (Nous Research, Open source: the prototype's words) | Empty string |
| Start, past rooms | Status, task, turns, cost, started, waiting count | `listTeamRooms()` then `rooms[].status`, `pausedFor`, `task`, `turnsDone`, `turnsAllowed`, `costUsd` (null shows "—"), `createdAt`, `needsApproval` | Loading "…"; failed and never loaded: danger Banner with Retry; failed after a good load: warn Banner "Couldn't refresh your rooms just now. This is the last list Agent OS sent." and the old rows stay; none: EmptyState "No rooms yet" |
| Room, header | Status word | `getTeamRoom(id)` then `room.status`, `room.pausedFor` through `roomStatusView` | Unknown status: the status text with underscores removed, state `unknown` |
| Room, header | Lede, end sentence | `room.status`, `room.endReason` through `roomLede`, `roomEndSentence` | A paused room has no end sentence |
| Room, bar | Task | `room.task` | n/a |
| Timeline | Turns | `detail.events` merged with the live stream (`mergeEvents`), folded by `deriveTurns` | None yet: EmptyState "Waiting for the first turn…" while running, "No turns were recorded" when ended |
| Timeline, a turn | Time | `ended.t` (the `turn_ended` event) as a time of day | "—" when missing or not a date |
| Timeline, a turn | Model, cost | `ended.model`; `ended.costUsd` through `turnCostLabel` | Cost "—" when the turn reported none (never "$0"); a reported $0 on an `ollama/` model reads "free (local)" |
| Timeline, a turn | Tag, tools, run link | `ended.parsed.kind` through `tagLabel`; `ended.toolSummary`; `turn.runId` | "No tag" when none |
| Timeline | Agent OS and You rows | Events `proposal_status` (needs_approval), `proposal_decided`, `action_undone`, `limits_extended` | No row when the event is absent |
| Decision card | Proposer, turn, who agreed, summary, file | `proposal.by`, `.turn`, `.agreedBy`, `.summary`, `.file.name`, `.file.content` | No `agreedBy`: "Both agents agree." |
| Decision card | Saved path, created or updated, refusal reason | `actions[].path`, `.created`, `.undone`, `.failed`, `.failReason`, found by `action.proposalId` | Missing action on a saved proposal: no Undo (nothing is offered that cannot work) |
| Limits | Turns | `room.turnsDone` of `room.turnsAllowed` | n/a |
| Limits | Time | `roomElapsedMs(room, now)` of `room.limits.maxMinutes`; `room.clockUsedMs` while paused | "— of 10m" when the clock is unknown |
| Limits | Cost | `room.cost.knownUsd` (or `room.costUsd`), `room.limits.maxCostUsd`, `room.cost.unknownTurns` | "(not reported yet)" in the label and "—" for the amount until a turn reports a cost; no cap: "no cap" |
| So far | Messages, files saved, files waiting | Counted from the turns, `actions` (not failed, not undone) and `proposals` (needs_approval) | n/a |
| Notebook | Text | `detail.notebook` | Section is not drawn when empty |

**States the page has, with their copy** (all of them are in the probe):

| State | What the person sees |
|---|---|
| Start, normal | Title "Team Room"; lede "Hermes Agent and OpenClaw talk a task through, one message at a time. You set the limits, read along, and decide what gets saved."; form; who is in the room; what Agent OS does by itself; past rooms |
| Start, gate off | Warn Banner "Safety is on Look only, so agents can't run. Allow running agents in Safety, then come back." with "Open Safety"; Start room is off |
| Start, a start failed | The Banner for the server's error code (`agent_missing`, `safeguards_off`, `room_already_running`, or the server's own message) |
| Start, offline | "Couldn't load your rooms. Agent OS isn't responding." with Retry; the form still works |
| Room, loading | "Loading this room…" under the title |
| Room, not found | Warn Banner "That room doesn't exist (it may have been removed)." (All rooms button above) |
| Room, cannot load | Danger Banner "Couldn't load this room. <reason>" with Retry; a failed fetch with no server answer says "Agent OS isn't responding." |
| Room, lost contact later | Warn Banner "Lost contact with Agent OS. This page shows the last thing it saw and keeps trying." (polls every 3 s; clears by itself) |
| Room, running | Status "Talking"; header button "Stop room"; the live turn shows "<Agent> is writing turn N of M." and the real run console |
| Room, paused for a decision | Status "Paused for your decision"; card "Needs you: save this file?"; Limits note "Paused: the time limit does not run while the room waits for you."; header button "Continue without deciding (+4 turns)" |
| Room, needs you at a limit | Status "Needs you"; end sentence; primary button "Continue (+4 turns)" |
| Room, ended | Status Agreed, Stopped, Failed, Cost cap reached or Interrupted, with the end sentence |
| Card, Approve refused by the gate | In the card: "Turn on the execution gate to let the room save files." and an "Open Safety" button; the card stays "Needs you: save this file?" and the room stays paused |
| Card, already decided | Info note "That was already decided, maybe in another window. The card now shows the result." |
| Card, saved / rejected / undone / refused | "Saved to the Workspace" with Undo save and Open the Workspace; "Rejected, nothing saved"; "Save undone"; "Refused, nothing saved" with the server's reason |

Node strips the types itself (on by default in Node ≥ 22.18; CI runs Node 24), so the test imports the `.ts` file directly. There is no bundler and no new dependency. This only works while `teamRoomShared.ts` stays erasable TypeScript: imports are `import type` only, with no enums, no namespaces and no parameter properties. Keep it that way (it is today). No server, no browser.

```js
// Team Room screen logic (src/ui/teamRoomShared.ts): the status words, the clock that
// stops while a room is paused for a decision (D10), the card states and the timeline.
// Node strips the TypeScript types itself (Node >= 22.18; CI runs 24), so the .ts file is
// imported directly. It must keep only `import type` imports. No server, no browser.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { test } from "node:test";
import * as shared from "../src/ui/teamRoomShared.ts";

const T0 = Date.parse("2026-10-12T10:00:00.000Z");
const iso = (ms) => new Date(T0 + ms).toISOString();

function room(over = {}) {
  return {
    id: "r1",
    task: "Draft a launch checklist",
    status: "running",
    createdAt: iso(0),
    updatedAt: iso(170_000),
    endedAt: null,
    limits: { maxTurns: 8, maxMinutes: 10, maxCostUsd: null },
    turnsAllowed: 8,
    turnsDone: 4,
    clockStartedAt: iso(0),
    currentTurn: null,
    costUsd: null,
    costKnownTurns: 0,
    costUnknownTurns: 4,
    endReason: null,
    folder: "team/r1",
    ...over
  };
}
function proposal(over = {}) {
  return {
    id: "P1",
    by: "hermes",
    byLabel: "Hermes Agent",
    kind: "file",
    summary: "Launch checklist",
    file: { name: "drafts/launch-checklist.md", content: "# Launch\n- a\n" },
    status: "needs_approval",
    turn: 3,
    createdAt: iso(1000),
    agreedBy: "openclaw",
    ...over
  };
}
function action(over = {}) {
  return {
    id: "A1",
    proposalId: "P1",
    kind: "file_write",
    path: "team/r1/launch-checklist.md",
    created: true,
    updated: false,
    backup: null,
    at: iso(2000),
    undone: false,
    undoneAt: null,
    ...over
  };
}

test("status: a room with pausedFor reads Paused for your decision, otherwise plain needs_you wording", () => {
  const paused = shared.roomStatusView(room({ status: "needs_you", pausedFor: "P1" }));
  assert.deepEqual(paused, { state: "waiting", label: "Paused for your decision" });
  assert.deepEqual(shared.roomStatusView(room({ status: "needs_you", pausedFor: null })), { state: "waiting", label: "Needs you" });
  assert.deepEqual(shared.roomStatusView(room({ status: "needs_you" })), { state: "waiting", label: "Needs you" });
  assert.deepEqual(shared.roomStatusView(room({ status: "needs_you", pausedFor: "" })), { state: "waiting", label: "Needs you" });
  // A stale pausedFor on a room that is not waiting must never read "Paused".
  assert.equal(shared.roomStatusView(room({ status: "running", pausedFor: "P1" })).label, "Talking");
  assert.equal(shared.roomStatusView(room({ status: "stopped", pausedFor: "P1" })).label, "Stopped");
  assert.equal(shared.isPaused(room({ status: "needs_you", pausedFor: "P1" })), true);
  assert.equal(shared.isPaused(room({ status: "failed", pausedFor: "P1" })), false);
});

test("status: every other status has an icon-and-word state, and an unknown one is not hidden", () => {
  const want = {
    running: ["live", "Talking"],
    agreed: ["ready", "Agreed"],
    cost_cap: ["held", "Cost cap reached"],
    stopped: ["stopped", "Stopped"],
    failed: ["failed", "Failed"],
    interrupted: ["stopped", "Interrupted"],
    some_new_state: ["unknown", "some new state"]
  };
  for (const [status, [state, label]] of Object.entries(want)) {
    assert.deepEqual(shared.roomStatusView(room({ status })), { state, label }, status);
  }
});

test("clock: while paused it shows clockUsedMs and never runs (also after a restart)", () => {
  const paused = room({ status: "needs_you", pausedFor: "P1", clockUsedMs: 170_000, updatedAt: iso(171_000) });
  assert.equal(shared.roomElapsedMs(paused, T0 + 170_000), 170_000);
  // One minute later, one day later: the same value. The clock is stopped.
  assert.equal(shared.roomElapsedMs(paused, T0 + 230_000), 170_000);
  assert.equal(shared.roomElapsedMs(paused, T0 + 86_400_000), 170_000);
});

test("clock: running counts from clockStartedAt (the server rewinds it on resume); ended rooms stop at the end", () => {
  assert.equal(shared.roomElapsedMs(room({ status: "running" }), T0 + 61_000), 61_000);
  // A resumed room: clockUsedMs is old news, the running clock follows clockStartedAt.
  assert.equal(shared.roomElapsedMs(room({ status: "running", clockUsedMs: 170_000 }), T0 + 200_000), 200_000);
  assert.equal(shared.roomElapsedMs(room({ status: "stopped", endedAt: iso(90_000) }), T0 + 999_000), 90_000);
  // needs_you at a limit (not paused): ends at updatedAt, and clockUsedMs is ignored.
  assert.equal(shared.roomElapsedMs(room({ status: "needs_you", pausedFor: null, clockUsedMs: 5_000 }), T0 + 999_000), 170_000);
  assert.equal(shared.roomElapsedMs(room({ clockStartedAt: "not a date" }), T0), null);
});

test("clock: minutesLabel", () => {
  assert.equal(shared.minutesLabel(170_000), "2m 50s");
  assert.equal(shared.minutesLabel(9_000), "9s");
  assert.equal(shared.minutesLabel(-5), "0s");
});

test("end sentence: paused says nothing extra, agreed has a D10 fallback, a limit keeps its text", () => {
  assert.equal(shared.roomEndSentence(room({ status: "needs_you", pausedFor: "P1" })), null);
  assert.match(shared.roomEndSentence(room({ status: "agreed", endReason: null })), /approved a file/);
  assert.match(shared.roomEndSentence(room({ status: "needs_you", pausedFor: null })), /Continue to give them more/);
  assert.equal(shared.roomEndSentence(room({ status: "running" })), null);
});

test("lede: one sentence per state", () => {
  assert.match(shared.roomLede(room({ status: "running" })), /reading along/);
  assert.match(shared.roomLede(room({ status: "needs_you", pausedFor: "P1" })), /Nothing is saved until you decide/);
  assert.match(shared.roomLede(room({ status: "stopped" })), /has ended/);
});

test("card state: where each proposal belongs", () => {
  const f = (p, a) => shared.decisionCardState(p, a);
  assert.equal(f(proposal(), undefined), "pending");
  assert.equal(f(proposal({ status: "applied", actionId: "A1" }), action()), "saved");
  assert.equal(f(proposal({ status: "applied", actionId: "A1" }), action({ undone: true })), "undone");
  assert.equal(f(proposal({ status: "refused" }), action({ failed: true, failReason: "a link is in the way" })), "refused");
  assert.equal(f(proposal({ status: "rejected", userDecision: "reject" }), undefined), "rejected");
  assert.equal(f(proposal({ kind: "decision", file: undefined, status: "approved" }), undefined), "recorded");
  assert.equal(f(proposal({ status: "open" }), undefined), "talking");
  assert.equal(f(proposal({ status: "disputed" }), undefined), "talking");
  assert.equal(f(proposal({ status: "agreed" }), undefined), "talking");
});

test("card order: the proposal the room is paused on comes first among the ones waiting for you", () => {
  const list = [
    proposal({ id: "P1", turn: 1, status: "open" }),
    proposal({ id: "P2", turn: 2, status: "needs_approval", kind: "decision", file: undefined }),
    proposal({ id: "P3", turn: 3, status: "needs_approval" }),
    proposal({ id: "P4", turn: 4, status: "rejected" }),
    proposal({ id: "P5", turn: 5, status: "applied", actionId: "A1" })
  ];
  const ordered = shared.orderProposals(list, [action({ proposalId: "P5" })], "P3");
  assert.deepEqual(ordered.needs.map((p) => p.id), ["P3", "P2"]);
  assert.deepEqual(ordered.settled.map((p) => p.id), ["P4", "P5"]);
  assert.deepEqual(ordered.talking.map((p) => p.id), ["P1"]);
  assert.deepEqual(shared.orderProposals(list, [], null).needs.map((p) => p.id), ["P2", "P3"]);
});

test("timeline: turns and Agent OS rows in event order, and agreement never says it saved", () => {
  const events = [
    { seq: 1, t: iso(1000), type: "turn_started", turn: 1, agentId: "hermes", runId: "run-1" },
    { seq: 2, t: iso(14_000), type: "turn_ended", turn: 1, agentId: "hermes", runId: "run-1", status: "succeeded", text: "Hello" },
    { seq: 3, t: iso(15_000), type: "turn_started", turn: 2, agentId: "openclaw", runId: "run-2" },
    { seq: 4, t: iso(40_000), type: "turn_ended", turn: 2, agentId: "openclaw", runId: "run-2", status: "succeeded", text: "I agree" },
    { seq: 5, t: iso(40_100), type: "proposal_status", proposalId: "P1", status: "needs_approval", reason: "Both agents agree. Waiting for your approval." },
    { seq: 6, t: iso(60_000), type: "proposal_decided", proposalId: "P1", decision: "approve", status: "applied" },
    { seq: 7, t: iso(70_000), type: "action_undone", actionId: "A1", proposalId: "P1", path: "team/r1/launch-checklist.md" },
    { seq: 8, t: iso(80_000), type: "limits_extended", extraTurns: 4, turnsAllowed: 12 }
  ];
  const items = shared.deriveTimeline(events, [proposal({ status: "applied" })], [action()]);
  assert.deepEqual(items.map((i) => i.kind), ["turn", "turn", "system", "system", "system", "system"]);
  assert.equal(items[0].turn.turn, 1);
  assert.equal(items[1].turn.agentId, "openclaw");
  const [, , ask, approved, undone, more] = items;
  assert.equal(ask.tone, "ask");
  assert.equal(ask.who, "Agent OS");
  assert.match(ask.text, /both agents agreed on drafts\/launch-checklist\.md/);
  assert.match(ask.text, /waits for you instead of saving by itself/);
  assert.equal(approved.who, "You");
  assert.match(approved.text, /approved drafts\/launch-checklist\.md/);
  assert.match(undone.text, /undid the save of team\/r1\/launch-checklist\.md/);
  assert.equal(undone.tone, "undo");
  assert.match(more.text, /gave the room 4 more turns/);
});

test("timeline: a rejection and a refused write read honestly; unknown ids do not crash", () => {
```
