**Why it stubs the room API.** A real room needs both fake agents to answer in the PROPOSE and AGREE format with the gate on. The harness's fake agents do not do that, so the probe answers every `/api/team-rooms` call and `/api/execution-gate` itself, with `context.route`. The stub behaves like the D10 server: a room paused on proposal P1 with `clockUsedMs`, 403 `execution_gate_off` on Approve, 409 `not_pending`, and a room that resumes after a decision. The shell, the menu and `/api/agents` are the real throwaway server. Because the stub is not the real server, the server-side behaviour (agreement never writes, the pause, the resume) is covered by the tests in Tasks A1 and A2, not here.

```js
// Task A3: the Team Room page.
//   node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/teamroom.mjs
//
// A real two-agent room cannot be driven from the audit harness: it needs both fake agents
// to answer in the PROPOSE / AGREE format and the execution gate on. So every /api/team-rooms
// call and /api/execution-gate is STUBBED with context.route. The stub answers like the D10
// server: a room paused for P1 with clockUsedMs, 403 execution_gate_off on Approve, 409
// not_pending, and a resumed room after a decision. Everything else (shell, menu, /api/agents)
// is the real throwaway server with its fake agents.

const NOW = Date.now();
const ago = (ms) => new Date(NOW - ms).toISOString();
const FILE_NAME = "drafts/launch-checklist.md";
const FILE_BODY = [
  "# Launch checklist: blog-site",
  "## Content",
  "- [ ] Every title is proofread",
  "- [ ] Every image has alt text",
  "## Links",
  "- [ ] Every link opens",
  "- [ ] No link points at localhost",
  "## Speed",
  "- [ ] Home page opens in under 3 seconds",
  "- [ ] Images are under 300 KB",
  "## Last look"
].join("\n");
const LONG_PATH = `team/${"very-long-folder-name/".repeat(7)}file.md`;
const TASK = "Draft a one-page launch checklist for the blog-site and agree on one version.";

const GATE_ON = { enabled: true, source: "local-config", envLocked: false, localEnabled: true, dryRunDefault: false, updatedAt: null, updatedBy: null, reason: "", level: 1 };
const GATE_OFF = { ...GATE_ON, enabled: false, localEnabled: false, level: 0 };

function turnEvents(n, agentId, text, parsed, base) {
  const runId = `run-${n}`;
  const model = agentId === "hermes" ? "nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free" : "ollama/phi4";
  return [
    { seq: n * 2 - 1, t: ago(base + 14_000), type: "turn_started", turn: n, agentId, runId },
    { seq: n * 2, t: ago(base), type: "turn_ended", turn: n, agentId, runId, status: "succeeded", text, costUsd: null, model, toolSummary: null, parsed }
  ];
}

function baseRoom(over = {}) {
  return {
    id: "r-stub",
    task: TASK,
    status: "needs_you",
    createdAt: ago(300_000),
    updatedAt: ago(119_000),
    endedAt: null,
    limits: { maxTurns: 8, maxMinutes: 10, maxCostUsd: 0.5, openclawModel: null },
    turnsAllowed: 8,
    turnsDone: 4,
    clockStartedAt: ago(300_000),
    currentTurn: null,
    costUsd: null,
    costKnownTurns: 0,
    costUnknownTurns: 4,
    cost: { knownUsd: 0, unknownTurns: 4 },
    costWarning: null,
    hints: [],
    endReason: "Paused for your decision: Hermes Agent's file drafts/launch-checklist.md needs your approval.",
    folder: "team/r-stub",
    pausedFor: "P1",
    clockUsedMs: 170_000,
    ...over
  };
}

function pausedDetail() {
  const events = [
    ...turnEvents(1, "hermes", "A launch checklist should fit on one page. I suggest five groups: Content, Links, Speed, Sharing and Last look.", { kind: "note", text: "x" }, 280_000),
    ...turnEvents(2, "openclaw", "Five groups works. One rule from me: every item must be a yes or no check.", { kind: "note", text: "x" }, 250_000),
    ...turnEvents(3, "hermes", `Agreed on the rule. I propose we save them as ${FILE_NAME}. ${LONG_PATH}`, { kind: "propose_file", summary: "Launch checklist", file: { name: FILE_NAME, content: FILE_BODY } }, 200_000),
    ...turnEvents(4, "openclaw", "I agree with all 10 items, no changes. Same file.", { kind: "agree", proposalId: "P1" }, 120_000),
    { seq: 9, t: ago(119_000), type: "proposal_status", proposalId: "P1", status: "needs_approval", reason: "Both agents agree. Waiting for your approval." }
  ];
  return {
    room: baseRoom(),
    proposals: [
      {
        id: "P1", by: "hermes", byLabel: "Hermes Agent", kind: "file", summary: "Launch checklist",
        file: { name: FILE_NAME, content: FILE_BODY }, status: "needs_approval",
        statusReason: "Both agents agree. Waiting for your approval.", turn: 3,
        createdAt: ago(200_000), agreedBy: "openclaw", agreedAt: ago(120_000)
      }
    ],
    actions: [],
    notebook: "**Hermes Agent** (turn 1): five groups\n",
    events
  };
}

function makeStub() {
  const stub = { gate: GATE_ON, rooms: [], roomsStatus: 200, detail: pausedDetail(), detailMode: "ok", decide: "ok", posts: [] };
  stub.handle = async (route) => {
    const req = route.request();
    const p = new URL(req.url()).pathname;
    const method = req.method();
    const json = (status, body) => route.fulfill({ status, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
    if (p === "/api/execution-gate") return json(200, stub.gate);
    if (!p.startsWith("/api/team-rooms")) return route.continue();
    const parts = p.split("/").filter(Boolean); // api, team-rooms, :id, sub, :subId, verb
    if (parts.length === 2) {
      if (method === "GET") return stub.roomsStatus === 200 ? json(200, { rooms: stub.rooms }) : json(stub.roomsStatus, { error: "boom", message: "Something broke." });
      return json(500, { error: "not_stubbed", message: "POST /api/team-rooms is not stubbed" });
    }
    const detail = stub.detail;
    if (parts.length === 3 && method === "GET") {
      if (stub.detailMode === "abort") return route.abort();
      if (stub.detailMode === "404") return json(404, { error: "room_not_found", message: "Room not found." });
      return json(200, detail);
    }
    if (parts[3] === "stream") {
      return route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: "text/event-stream", headers: { "cache-control": "no-cache" }, body: "event: end\ndata: {}\n\n" });
    }
    if (method === "POST" && parts[3] === "proposals") {
      const body = JSON.parse(req.postData() || "{}");
      stub.posts.push({ path: p, body });
      const proposal = detail.proposals.find((x) => x.id === parts[4]);
      if (stub.decide === "gate_off" && body.decision === "approve") {
        return json(403, { ok: false, error: "execution_gate_off", message: "Turn on the execution gate to let the room save files." });
      }
      if (stub.decide === "already") {
        return json(409, { ok: false, error: "not_pending", message: "That proposal is approved, so it is not waiting for your decision." });
      }
      let action = null;
      if (body.decision === "approve" && proposal.kind === "file") {
        proposal.status = "applied";
        proposal.actionId = "A1";
        action = { id: "A1", proposalId: proposal.id, kind: "file_write", path: "team/r-stub/launch-checklist.md", created: true, updated: false, backup: null, at: new Date().toISOString(), undone: false, undoneAt: null };
        detail.actions.push(action);
      } else {
        proposal.status = body.decision === "approve" ? "approved" : "rejected";
      }
      proposal.userDecision = body.decision;
      proposal.decidedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      detail.events.push({ seq: 10 + detail.events.length, t: new Date().toISOString(), type: "proposal_decided", proposalId: proposal.id, decision: body.decision, status: proposal.status });
      // The D10 server resumes a room that was paused on this proposal.
      if (detail.room.pausedFor === proposal.id) {
        // Like the server: the clock keeps what was used (clockStartedAt moves back by clockUsedMs)
        // and clockUsedMs goes back to null.
        detail.room.clockStartedAt = new Date(Date.now() - detail.room.clockUsedMs).toISOString();
        detail.room.pausedFor = null;
        detail.room.clockUsedMs = null;
        detail.room.status = "running";
      }
      return json(200, { proposal, action });
    }
    if (method === "POST" && parts[3] === "actions" && parts[5] === "undo") {
      const action = detail.actions.find((x) => x.id === parts[4]);
      action.undone = true;
      action.undoneAt = new Date().toISOString();
      detail.events.push({ seq: 10 + detail.events.length, t: new Date().toISOString(), type: "action_undone", actionId: action.id, proposalId: action.proposalId, path: action.path });
      return json(200, { action });
    }
    if (method === "POST" && parts[3] === "continue") {
      stub.posts.push({ path: p });
      detail.room.status = "running";
      detail.room.pausedFor = null;
      detail.room.clockUsedMs = null;
      detail.room.clockStartedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      return json(200, detail.room);
    }
    return json(404, { error: "not_stubbed", message: p });
  };
  return stub;
}

const summary = (over = {}) => ({
  id: "r-stub", task: TASK, status: "needs_you", createdAt: ago(300_000), endedAt: null, endReason: null,
  turnsDone: 4, turnsAllowed: 8, costUsd: null, costUnknownTurns: 4, openProposals: 0, needsApproval: 1, actions: 0,
  pausedFor: "P1", ...over
});

export default async function ({ browser, shot, pass, fail, BASE, TOKEN }) {
  const check = (ok, name, detail = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(detail).slice(0, 300)));

  async function open(w, h, stub, query = "") {
    const context = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: w, height: h } });
    await context.route("**/api/**", (route) => stub.handle(route));
    const tab = await context.newPage();
    const errors = [];
    // Chromium logs every stubbed 4xx and 5xx as a console error. Those are expected here.
    tab.on("console", (m) => { if (m.type() === "error" && !/Failed to load resource/.test(m.text())) errors.push(m.text()); });
    tab.on("pageerror", (e) => errors.push(String(e)));
    await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?launch=${TOKEN}`);
    await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=team${query}`);
    await tab.waitForSelector(".os-team", { timeout: 8000 }).catch(() => {});
    await tab.waitForTimeout(900);
    return { context, tab, errors };
  }
  const noSideways = (tab) =>
    tab.evaluate(() => {
      const page = document.querySelector(".os-team");
      const host = page.closest("main") || page.parentElement;
      const doc = document.scrollingElement;
      return doc.scrollWidth <= doc.clientWidth && host.scrollWidth <= host.clientWidth + 1 && page.scrollWidth <= page.clientWidth + 1;
    });
  // Visible copy that is typed in capitals (4 or more capital letters in a row) or has an em dash
  // (a lone "—" for unknown is fine). Code, mono data and file previews are not copy.
  const typedCopyProblems = (tab) =>
    tab.evaluate(() => {
      const bad = [];
      const walker = document.createTreeWalker(document.querySelector(".os-team"), NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
      for (let n = walker.nextNode(); n; n = walker.nextNode()) {
        const s = (n.textContent || "").trim();
        if (!s || n.parentElement.closest("code, pre, .os-mono")) continue;
        if (/\b[A-Z]{4,}\b/.test(s.replace(/\b(HTML|README)\b/g, ""))) bad.push(`capitals: ${s.slice(0, 60)}`);
        if (s.includes("—") && !/^—( of .*)?$/.test(s)) bad.push(`em dash: ${s.slice(0, 60)}`);
      }
      return bad;
    });
  // The clock in seconds, read from the Limits panel's data-elapsed-ms (the same number the Time meter draws).
  const clockSeconds = async (tab) => {
    const raw = await tab.locator(".os-team__limits").getAttribute("data-elapsed-ms");
    return raw === null || raw === "" ? null : Number(raw) / 1000;
  };
  const bar = (tab) => tab.locator(".os-team__bar").innerText();
  const card = (tab) => tab.locator(".os-team__decision").first();
  const cardTitle = (tab) => card(tab).getByRole("heading", { level: 2 }).innerText();

  // ---- A. Start page ------------------------------------------------------------------
  {
    const stub = makeStub();
    const { context, tab, errors } = await open(1470, 956, stub);
    const h1 = await tab.locator("h1").allInnerTexts();
    check(h1.length === 1 && h1[0].trim() === "Team Room", "start: one h1 reading Team Room", JSON.stringify(h1));
    const text = await tab.locator(".os-team").innerText();
    for (const want of ["The task", "Limits", "Who is in the room", "What Agent OS does by itself", "Past rooms"]) {
      check(text.includes(want), `start: has "${want}"`);
    }
    check((await tab.locator(".os-micro", { hasText: /agent os/i }).count()) === 0, "start: the all-capitals caption is gone");
    check(!/AGENT OS/.test(text), "start: no AGENT OS typed in capitals");
    check(/only after both agents agree and you press Approve/.test(text), "start: the D10 copy says Approve comes first");
    check(!/it saves that file in the sandbox folder/.test(text), "start: the old saves-on-agreement copy is gone");
    check(!/hold to stop all/i.test(text), "start: no Hold to stop all claim on this page (D11)");
    const startBtn = tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Start room", exact: true });
    check(await startBtn.isDisabled(), "start: Start room is off while the task is empty");
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Launch checklist" }).click();
    const filled = await tab.locator("textarea").inputValue();
    check(/launch checklist/i.test(filled), "start: an example chip fills the task", filled);
    check(!(await startBtn.isDisabled()), "start: Start room is on once there is a task");
    await startBtn.click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(300);
    const dialogTitle = await tab.locator("#os-modal-title").innerText().catch(() => "");
    check(/Start this Team Room\?/.test(dialogTitle), "start: Start asks first (modal title)", dialogTitle);
    await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(250);
    check((await tab.locator('[role="dialog"]').count()) === 0, "start: Escape closes the confirm");
    const focused = await tab.evaluate(() => (document.activeElement?.textContent || "").trim());
    check(/Start room/.test(focused), "start: focus returns to Start room", focused);
    check(/No rooms yet/.test(await tab.locator(".os-team").innerText()), "start: designed empty state for Past rooms");
    const who = await tab.locator(".os-team__who li").allInnerTexts();
    check(who.length === 2 && who.every((t) => /Installed|Not installed|—|…/.test(t)), "start: both agents listed with their real install state", JSON.stringify(who));
    check(await noSideways(tab), "start@1470: no sideways scroll");
    const bad = await typedCopyProblems(tab);
    check(bad.length === 0, "start: no copy typed in capitals or with an em dash", JSON.stringify(bad));
    check(errors.length === 0, "start: console clean", errors.join(" | "));
    await shot(tab, "teamroom", 1470, 956, "start");
    await context.close();
  }
  for (const [w, h] of [[1280, 720], [1024, 640]]) {
    const { context, tab } = await open(w, h, makeStub());
    check(await noSideways(tab), `start@${w}: no sideways scroll`);
    await shot(tab, "teamroom", w, h, "start");
    await context.close();
  }

  // ---- B. Start page: gate off, rooms list, errors ------------------------------------
  {
    const stub = makeStub();
    stub.gate = GATE_OFF;
    const { context, tab } = await open(1470, 956, stub);
    await tab.locator("textarea").fill("hello");
    const alert = await tab.locator('.os-team [role="alert"]').first().innerText();
    check(/Safety is on Look only/.test(alert), "start: gate off says Safety is on Look only", alert);
    check(await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Start room", exact: true }).isDisabled(), "start: Start room stays off while the gate is off");
    check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Open Safety" }).count()) === 1, "start: the notice has an Open Safety button");
    await context.close();
  }
  {
    const stub = makeStub();
    stub.rooms = [
      summary(),
      summary({ id: "r-limit", task: "Plan the next sprint.", pausedFor: null, needsApproval: 1 }),
      summary({ id: "r-old", task: "Compare two ways to organise my research notes and agree on one.", status: "agreed", createdAt: ago(86_400_000), endedAt: ago(86_000_000), endReason: "x", turnsDone: 6, turnsAllowed: 6, costUsd: 0.012, costUnknownTurns: 0, needsApproval: 0, actions: 1, pausedFor: null })
    ];
    const { context, tab } = await open(1470, 956, stub);
    const rows = tab.locator(".os-team__room-row");
    check((await rows.count()) === 3, "past rooms: one row per room", String(await rows.count()));
    const first = await rows.nth(0).innerText();
    check(/Paused for your decision/.test(first) && !/waiting for your approval/.test(first), "past rooms: a paused room reads Paused for your decision", first);
    const second = await rows.nth(1).innerText();
    check(/Needs you/.test(second) && /1 waiting for your approval/.test(second), "past rooms: a room at a limit reads Needs you and says what waits", second);
    const third = await rows.nth(2).innerText();
    check(/Agreed/.test(third) && /\$0\.012/.test(third), "past rooms: an agreed room shows its status and cost", third);
    await shot(tab, "teamroom", 1470, 956, "start-with-rooms");
    await rows.nth(0).getByRole("button").click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1200);
    check(new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("room") === "r-stub", "past rooms: a row opens its room", tab.url());
    check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "All rooms" }).count()) === 1, "room: has an All rooms button");
    check((await tab.locator(".os-team__decision").count()) === 1, "room: the decision card is there after opening");
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "All rooms" }).click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(500);
    check(!new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("room"), "room: All rooms leaves the room");
    await context.close();
  }
  {
    const stub = makeStub();
    stub.roomsStatus = 500;
    const { context, tab } = await open(1470, 956, stub);
    check(/Couldn't load your rooms/.test(await tab.locator(".os-team").innerText()), "past rooms: a failed list is a designed error");
    stub.roomsStatus = 200;
    stub.rooms = [summary()];
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Retry" }).click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(600);
    check((await tab.locator(".os-team__room-row").count()) === 1, "past rooms: Retry loads the list");
    await context.close();
  }

  // ---- C. Room view, paused for a decision --------------------------------------------
  {
    const stub = makeStub();
    const { context, tab, errors } = await open(1470, 956, stub, "&room=r-stub");
    const h1 = await tab.locator("h1").allInnerTexts();
    check(h1.length === 1 && h1[0].trim() === "Team Room", "room: one h1 reading Team Room", JSON.stringify(h1));
    check(/Paused for your decision/.test(await bar(tab)), "room: status reads Paused for your decision", await bar(tab));
    check(/Needs you: save this file\?/.test(await cardTitle(tab)), "room: the card asks Needs you: save this file?", await cardTitle(tab));
    const cardText = await card(tab).innerText();
    check(cardText.includes(FILE_NAME) && /Markdown/.test(cardText), "room: the card names the file and its kind", cardText);
    check(/# Launch checklist: blog-site/.test(cardText) && /… 5 more lines/.test(cardText), "room: the card previews the start of the file", cardText);
    check(/Hermes Agent proposed it in turn 3\. OpenClaw agreed\./.test(cardText), "room: the card says who proposed and who agreed", cardText);
    check((await card(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Approve and save" }).count()) === 1 && (await card(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Reject" }).count()) === 1, "room: Approve and save and Reject are there");
    check(/Nothing is saved until you press Approve/.test(cardText), "room: the card says nothing is saved until Approve");
    const timeline = await tab.locator(".os-team__timeline > li").count();
    check(timeline === 5, "room: four turns and one Agent OS row in the timeline", String(timeline));
    const tlText = await tab.locator(".os-team__timeline").innerText();
    check(/waits for you instead of saving by itself/.test(tlText) && /File proposal/.test(tlText) && /Agrees with P1/.test(tlText), "room: timeline rows and sentence-case tags", tlText.slice(0, 200));
    const so = await tab.locator(".os-team__sofar").innerText();
    check(/Passed 4 messages between the agents and saved 0 files/.test(so) && /1 file waits for your decision/.test(so), "room: what Agent OS did so far", so);
    check(/Hermes Agent/.test(await tab.locator(".os-team__notebook").innerText()), "room: the notebook is kept");
    const limits = tab.locator(".os-team__limits");
    const t1 = await limits.innerText();
    check(/4 of 8/.test(t1) && /2m 50s of 10m/.test(t1), "room: limits show 4 of 8 turns and 2m 50s of 10m", t1);
    check(/Paused: the time limit does not run while the room waits for you/.test(t1), "room: the limits say the clock is stopped");
    check((await clockSeconds(tab)) === 170, "room: the clock number is clockUsedMs, 170 s", String(await clockSeconds(tab)));
    await tab.waitForTimeout(2300);
    const t2 = await limits.innerText();
    check(t1 === t2 && (await clockSeconds(tab)) === 170, "room: the paused clock does not tick", `${t1} -> ${t2}`);
    check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /Continue without deciding \(\+4 turns\)/ }).count()) === 1, "room: a paused room offers Continue without deciding");
    check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /Stop room/ }).count()) === 0, "room: a paused room has nothing to stop");
    check(await noSideways(tab), "room@1470: no sideways scroll (a 150-character path is in the fixture)");
    const bad = await typedCopyProblems(tab);
    check(bad.length === 0, "room: no copy typed in capitals or with an em dash", JSON.stringify(bad));
    check(errors.length === 0, "room: console clean", errors.join(" | "));
    await shot(tab, "teamroom", 1470, 956, "room-paused");
    // Agent OS restarts: a reload gives the same paused room with the clock still at clockUsedMs.
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForSelector(".os-team__decision", { timeout: 6000 }).catch(() => {});
    await tab.waitForTimeout(600);
    check(/Paused for your decision/.test(await bar(tab)) && /2m 50s of 10m/.test(await limits.innerText()), "room: after a reload it is still paused and the clock is still 2m 50s");
    // Continue without deciding opens its own confirm.
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /Continue without deciding/ }).click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(250);
    const cTitle = await tab.locator("#os-modal-title").innerText().catch(() => "");
    check(/Continue for 4 more turns\?/.test(cTitle) && /still decide on it later/.test(await tab.locator('[role="dialog"]').innerText()), "room: Continue without deciding says the file keeps waiting", cTitle);
    await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
    await context.close();
  }
  for (const [w, h] of [[1280, 720], [1024, 640]]) {
    const { context, tab } = await open(w, h, makeStub(), "&room=r-stub");
    check(await noSideways(tab), `room@${w}: no sideways scroll`);
    check((await tab.locator(".os-team__decision").count()) === 1, `room@${w}: the card is there`);
    await shot(tab, "teamroom", w, h, "room-paused");
    await context.close();
  }

  // ---- D. Approve with the gate off (403), then Open Safety ---------------------------
  {
    const stub = makeStub();
    stub.decide = "gate_off";
    const { context, tab } = await open(1470, 956, stub, "&room=r-stub");
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Approve and save" }).click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(600);
    const alert = card(tab).locator('[role="alert"]');
    check(/Turn on the execution gate to let the room save files\./.test(await alert.innerText()), "gate off: Approve shows the plain sentence");
    check((await alert.getByRole("button", { name: "Open Safety" }).count()) === 1, "gate off: the sentence has an Open Safety button");
    check(/Needs you: save this file\?/.test(await cardTitle(tab)) && /Paused for your decision/.test(await bar(tab)), "gate off: the card stays pending and the room stays paused");
    check(stub.posts.length === 1 && stub.posts[0].body.decision === "approve", "gate off: exactly one POST was sent", JSON.stringify(stub.posts));
    await shot(tab, "teamroom", 1470, 956, "room-gate-off");
    await alert.getByRole("button", { name: "Open Safety" }).click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(600);
    check(new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("page") === "safety", "gate off: Open Safety goes to Safety", tab.url());
    await context.close();
  }

  // ---- E. Approve (by keyboard), the room resumes, Undo -------------------------------
  {
    const stub = makeStub();
    const { context, tab, errors } = await open(1470, 956, stub, "&room=r-stub");
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Approve and save" }).focus();
    await tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
    await tab.waitForSelector('.os-team__decision[data-state="saved"]', { timeout: 5000 }).catch(() => {});
    await tab.waitForTimeout(400);
    check(/Saved to the Workspace/.test(await cardTitle(tab)), "approve: the card turns into Saved to the Workspace", await cardTitle(tab));
    check(stub.posts.length === 1, "approve: exactly one POST was sent", String(stub.posts.length));
    check(/Talking/.test(await bar(tab)) && !/Paused for your decision/.test(await bar(tab)), "approve: the room is running again (status Talking)", await bar(tab));
    const focusInCard = await tab.evaluate(() => !!document.activeElement?.closest(".os-team__decision"));
    check(focusInCard, "approve: focus moved to the card, not lost");
    const cardText = await card(tab).innerText();
    check(/team\/r-stub\/launch-checklist\.md/.test(cardText) && /Undo save/.test(cardText) && /Open the Workspace/.test(cardText), "approve: the card shows the saved path, Undo save and Open the Workspace", cardText);
    check(/You: approved drafts\/launch-checklist\.md/.test(await tab.locator(".os-team__timeline").innerText()), "approve: the timeline says what you did");
    const limits = tab.locator(".os-team__limits");
    const a = await clockSeconds(tab);
    check(a !== null && a >= 170 && a < 176, "approve: the clock continues from 2m 50s", String(a));
    await tab.waitForTimeout(2300);
    const b = await clockSeconds(tab);
    check(b !== null && a !== null && b - a >= 1, "approve: the running clock ticks again", `${a} -> ${b}`);
    check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /Stop room/ }).count()) === 1, "approve: a running room can be stopped");
    check(/saved 1 file/.test(await tab.locator(".os-team__sofar").innerText()), "approve: the so far line counts the saved file");
    await shot(tab, "teamroom", 1470, 956, "room-saved");
    // Undo asks first, then the card says the save is undone.
    await card(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Undo save" }).click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(250);
    const dialog = tab.locator('[role="dialog"]');
    check(/Undo this save\?/.test(await tab.locator("#os-modal-title").innerText()), "undo: asks first (modal title)");
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Undo save" }).click();
    await tab.waitForSelector('.os-team__decision[data-state="undone"]', { timeout: 5000 }).catch(() => {});
    check(/Save undone/.test(await cardTitle(tab)) && /gone from the Workspace again/.test(await card(tab).innerText()), "undo: the card says Save undone", await cardTitle(tab));
    check(errors.length === 0, "approve and undo: console clean", errors.join(" | "));
    await context.close();
  }

  // ---- F. Reject, double decision, plain needs_you ------------------------------------
  {
    const stub = makeStub();
    const { context, tab } = await open(1470, 956, stub, "&room=r-stub");
    await card(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Reject" }).click();
    await tab.waitForSelector('.os-team__decision[data-state="rejected"]', { timeout: 5000 }).catch(() => {});
    check(/Rejected, nothing saved/.test(await cardTitle(tab)) && /agents are told you said no/.test(await card(tab).innerText()), "reject: the card says nothing saved and the agents are told", await card(tab).innerText());
    check(/rejected drafts\/launch-checklist\.md\. Nothing was saved/.test(await tab.locator(".os-team__timeline").innerText()), "reject: the timeline says what you did");
    await context.close();
  }
  {
    const stub = makeStub();
    stub.decide = "already";
    const { context, tab } = await open(1470, 956, stub, "&room=r-stub");
    await card(tab).getByRole("button", { name: "Approve and save" }).click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(600);
    const note = await card(tab).locator('[role="status"]').innerText().catch(() => "");
    check(/already decided/.test(note), "double decision: a calm already-decided note, no error", note);
    await context.close();
  }
  {
    const stub = makeStub();
    stub.detail.room = baseRoom({ pausedFor: null, clockUsedMs: null, endReason: null });
    stub.detail.proposals = [];
    stub.detail.events = stub.detail.events.filter((e) => e.type !== "proposal_status");
    const { context, tab } = await open(1470, 956, stub, "&room=r-stub");
    const text = await bar(tab);
    check(/Needs you/.test(text) && !/Paused for your decision/.test(text), "plain needs_you: the plain wording, not Paused", text);
    check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /Continue \(\+4 turns\)/ }).count()) === 1, "plain needs_you: Continue (+4 turns) is the primary action");
    check(/Continue to give them more/.test(await tab.locator(".os-team__end").innerText()), "plain needs_you: the end sentence is there");
    check((await tab.locator(".os-team__decision").count()) === 0, "plain needs_you: no decision card");
    check(!/Paused:/.test(await tab.locator(".os-team__limits").innerText()), "plain needs_you: no paused note on the limits");
    await shot(tab, "teamroom", 1470, 956, "room-needs-you");
    await context.close();
  }

  // ---- G. A running room, and a room that cannot be loaded ----------------------------
  {
    const stub = makeStub();
    const d = stub.detail;
    d.room = baseRoom({ status: "running", pausedFor: null, clockUsedMs: null, endReason: null, clockStartedAt: ago(60_000), turnsDone: 4, currentTurn: { turn: 5, agentId: "hermes", runId: "run-5" } });
    d.proposals = [];

    const { context, tab } = await open(1470, 956, stub, "&room=r-stub");
    check(/Talking/.test(await bar(tab)), "running: status reads Talking", await bar(tab));
    check(/is writing turn 5 of 8/.test(await tab.locator(".os-team__timeline").innerText()), "running: the live turn says who is writing");
    check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /Stop room/ }).count()) === 1, "running: Stop room is offered");
    const limits = tab.locator(".os-team__limits");
    const a = await clockSeconds(tab);
    await tab.waitForTimeout(2300);
    const b = await clockSeconds(tab);
    check(a !== null && b !== null && b - a >= 1, "running: the clock ticks", `${a} -> ${b}`);
    await shot(tab, "teamroom", 1470, 956, "room-running");
    await context.close();
  }
  {
    const stub = makeStub();
    stub.detailMode = "404";
    const { context, tab } = await open(1470, 956, stub, "&room=r-missing");
    check(/That room doesn't exist/.test(await tab.locator(".os-team").innerText()), "missing room: a designed not-found message");
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "All rooms" }).click();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(400);
    check(!new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("room"), "missing room: All rooms leaves it");
    await context.close();
  }
  {
    const stub = makeStub();
    stub.detailMode = "abort";
    const { context, tab } = await open(1470, 956, stub, "&room=r-stub");
    check(/Couldn't load this room/.test(await tab.locator(".os-team").innerText()), "offline: a designed error, not a spinner");
    stub.detailMode = "ok";
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Retry" }).click();
    await tab.waitForSelector(".os-team__decision", { timeout: 5000 }).catch(() => {});
    check((await tab.locator(".os-team__decision").count()) === 1, "offline: Retry loads the room");

  console.log("Screenshots: .superpowers/ui-audit/shots/teamroom/<size>/*.png");
```

```ts
// Pure helpers for the Team Room screen: the status words, the clock (which
// stops while a room is paused for a decision, D10), what each proposal card
// says, the one plain sentence for each way a room can end, and folding the
// room's event log into one timeline. No fetching and no React here.
import type { TeamAction, TeamParsedReply, TeamProposal, TeamRoom, TeamRoomEvent } from "../types";

export const TEAM_AGENT_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  hermes: "Hermes Agent",
  openclaw: "OpenClaw"
};

// Who makes each agent (a small fixed map, as in the approved prototype).
export const TEAM_AGENT_MAKER: Record<string, string> = {
  hermes: "Nous Research",
  openclaw: "Open source"
};

export function agentLabel(agentId: string | undefined) {
  return (agentId && TEAM_AGENT_LABEL[agentId]) || agentId || "Agent";
}

export function agentMaker(agentId: string | undefined) {
  return (agentId && TEAM_AGENT_MAKER[agentId]) || "";
}

export function plural(count: number, one: string, many?: string) {
  return `${count} ${count === 1 ? one : many || `${one}s`}`;
}

// ---- Status ---------------------------------------------------------------

// The same states the page kit's StatusWord accepts (icon plus word).
export type RoomWordState = "live" | "ready" | "waiting" | "idle" | "held" | "failed" | "stopped" | "unknown" | "loading";

export interface RoomStatusView {
  state: RoomWordState;
  label: string;
}

// A room is paused for a decision when it waits on one proposal (D10). The
// status stays the existing "needs_you"; pausedFor says why. A stale pausedFor
// on a room that is not waiting is ignored, so an ended room never reads "Paused".
export function isPaused(room: Pick<TeamRoom, "status" | "pausedFor">): boolean {
  return room.status === "needs_you" && typeof room.pausedFor === "string" && room.pausedFor !== "";
}

export function roomStatusView(room: Pick<TeamRoom, "status" | "pausedFor">): RoomStatusView {
  if (isPaused(room)) return { state: "waiting", label: "Paused for your decision" };
  switch (room.status) {
    case "running":
      return { state: "live", label: "Talking" };
    case "needs_you":
      return { state: "waiting", label: "Needs you" };
    case "agreed":
      return { state: "ready", label: "Agreed" };
    case "cost_cap":
      return { state: "held", label: "Cost cap reached" };
    case "stopped":
      return { state: "stopped", label: "Stopped" };
    case "failed":
      return { state: "failed", label: "Failed" };
    case "interrupted":
      return { state: "stopped", label: "Interrupted" };
    default:
      return { state: "unknown", label: String(room.status || "").replace(/_/g, " ") || "—" };
  }
}

// One sentence per ending, so nobody has to guess what a status means.
export function roomEndSentence(room: TeamRoom): string | null {
  const reason = room.endReason ? ` ${room.endReason}` : "";
  switch (room.status) {
    case "agreed":
      return room.endReason || "The room finished. You approved a file and nothing is still open.";
    case "stopped":
      return "You stopped this room. Nothing else will run.";
    case "failed":
      return `This room failed.${reason || " No reason was recorded."}`;
    case "cost_cap":
      return `This room stopped because it reached your cost cap.${reason}`;
    case "interrupted":
      return "Agent OS restarted while this room was running, so the room stopped where it was.";
    case "needs_you":
      // A paused room says so in its status word and on its card.
      if (isPaused(room)) return null;
      return (
        room.endReason ||
        "The agents used all their turns (or minutes) without finishing. Continue to give them more, or leave it here."
      );
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

// The line under the page title.
export function roomLede(room: Pick<TeamRoom, "status" | "pausedFor">): string {
  if (isPaused(room)) return "The agents agreed on a file. Nothing is saved until you decide.";
  if (room.status === "running") return "Hermes Agent and OpenClaw are talking it through. You are reading along.";
  if (room.status === "needs_you") return "The room is waiting for you. Continue to give the agents more turns.";
  return "This room has ended. What was said stays on this page.";
}

// ---- Tags, proposals, cost -------------------------------------------------

export function hasTag(parsed: TeamParsedReply | undefined): boolean {
  return !!parsed && parsed.kind !== "none";
}

export function tagLabel(parsed: TeamParsedReply | undefined): string {
  if (!parsed) return "No tag";
  switch (parsed.kind) {
    case "note":
      return "Note";
    case "propose":
      return "Proposal";
    case "propose_file":
      return "File proposal";
    case "agree":
      return parsed.proposalId ? `Agrees with ${parsed.proposalId}` : "Agrees";
    case "disagree":
      return parsed.proposalId ? `Disagrees with ${parsed.proposalId}` : "Disagrees";
    default:
      return "No tag";
  }
}

const PROPOSAL_WORD: Record<string, string> = {
  open: "Open",
  agreed: "Agreed",
  disputed: "Disputed",
  needs_approval: "Needs approval",
  approved: "Approved",
  rejected: "Rejected",
  applied: "Saved",
  refused: "Refused"
};

export function proposalWord(proposal: TeamProposal) {
  return PROPOSAL_WORD[proposal.status] || proposal.status.replace(/_/g, " ");
}

export function usd(value: number | null | undefined) {
  return typeof value === "number" ? `$${value.toFixed(value < 0.1 ? 3 : 2)}` : "—";
}

// A turn's cost: "—" when the agent reported none (unknown), "free (local)"
// for a reported $0 on a local Ollama model, otherwise dollars (so a real $0
// reads "$0.000", never "—").
export function turnCostLabel(costUsd: number | null | undefined, model?: string | null) {
  if (typeof costUsd !== "number") return "—";
  if (costUsd === 0 && typeof model === "string" && model.toLowerCase().startsWith("ollama/")) return "free (local)";
  return usd(costUsd);
}

// The limits panel's cost note: what was reported, and how many turns reported
// nothing. Rooms saved by an older version only have costUsd / costUnknownTurns.
export function roomCostText(room: Pick<TeamRoom, "cost" | "costUsd" | "costUnknownTurns">) {
  const known = room.cost?.knownUsd ?? room.costUsd ?? 0;
  const unknown = room.cost?.unknownTurns ?? room.costUnknownTurns ?? 0;
  return `${usd(known)} known · ${unknown} turn${unknown === 1 ? "" : "s"} unknown`;
}

// Same rule the server applies to the "OpenClaw model for this room" field:
// plain letters, digits and . _ : / -, up to 100 characters, never starting
// with "-" (so it can't be read as a flag).
export const OPENCLAW_MODEL_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z0-9._:/][A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{0,99}$/;

export const COST_CAP_NOTE =
  "Hermes doesn't report cost (its model is a subscription or the version doesn't say); the cost cap only counts OpenClaw.";

// A finished turn shows nothing extra; a turn that did not finish shows a word.
export function turnStatusView(status: string | undefined): RoomStatusView | null {
  if (!status || status === "succeeded") return null;
  if (status === "failed") return { state: "failed", label: "Failed" };
  if (status === "timed_out") return { state: "failed", label: "Timed out" };
  if (status === "stopped") return { state: "stopped", label: "Stopped" };
  if (status === "interrupted") return { state: "stopped", label: "Interrupted" };
  return { state: "unknown", label: status.replace(/_/g, " ") };
}

// ---- Events and the timeline -----------------------------------------------

export interface TurnView {
  // Sequence number of the turn_started event, so the turn sorts among the Agent OS rows.
  seq: number;
  turn: number;
  agentId: "hermes" | "openclaw";
  runId: string;
  ended: TeamRoomEvent | null;
  protocolNotes: string[];
}

// Merges the saved history with whatever the live stream has delivered so far
// (the stream replays history first, so most events arrive twice) and returns
// the events in order, one per sequence number.
export function mergeEvents(...lists: TeamRoomEvent[][]): TeamRoomEvent[] {
  const bySeq = new Map<number, TeamRoomEvent>();
  for (const list of lists) for (const event of list) bySeq.set(event.seq, event);
  return Array.from(bySeq.values()).sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
}

export function deriveTurns(events: TeamRoomEvent[]): TurnView[] {
  const turns = new Map<number, TurnView>();
  for (const event of events) {
    if (typeof event.turn !== "number") continue;
    if (event.type === "turn_started" && event.agentId && event.runId) {
      turns.set(event.turn, { seq: event.seq, turn: event.turn, agentId: event.agentId, runId: event.runId, ended: null, protocolNotes: [] });
    } else if (event.type === "turn_ended") {
      const existing = turns.get(event.turn);
      if (existing) existing.ended = event;
    } else if (event.type === "protocol_note") {
      const existing = turns.get(event.turn);
      const message = typeof event.message === "string" ? event.message : "";
      if (existing && message) existing.protocolNotes.push(message);
    }
  }
  return Array.from(turns.values()).sort((a, b) => a.turn - b.turn);
}

// One row of the timeline: an agent's turn, or a short line about what Agent OS
// did or what you did ("ask" = waits for you, "undo" = an undone save,
// "more" = turns you added, "plain" = anything else).
export type TimelineItem =
  | { kind: "turn"; key: string; turn: TurnView }
  | { kind: "system"; key: string; tone: "ask" | "plain" | "undo" | "more"; who: "Agent OS" | "You"; text: string };

function proposalName(proposal: TeamProposal | undefined, fallbackId: string): string {
  if (!proposal) return fallbackId || "a proposal";
  return proposal.kind === "file" && proposal.file?.name ? proposal.file.name : proposal.id;
}

export function deriveTimeline(events: TeamRoomEvent[], proposals: TeamProposal[], actions: TeamAction[]): TimelineItem[] {
  const byId = new Map(proposals.map((proposal) => [proposal.id, proposal]));
  const rows: Array<{ seq: number; item: TimelineItem }> = deriveTurns(events).map((turn) => ({
    seq: turn.seq,
    item: { kind: "turn", key: `turn-${turn.turn}`, turn }
  }));
  for (const event of events) {
    const id = typeof event.proposalId === "string" ? event.proposalId : "";
    const proposal = id ? byId.get(id) : undefined;
    const name = proposalName(proposal, id);
    const isFile = proposal?.kind === "file";
    const key = `sys-${event.seq}`;
    if (event.type === "proposal_status" && event.status === "needs_approval") {
      rows.push({
        seq: event.seq,
        item: {
          kind: "system",
          key,
          tone: "ask",
          who: "Agent OS",
          text: isFile
            ? `both agents agreed on ${name}. It waits for you instead of saving by itself.`
            : `both agents agreed on ${name}. It waits for your approval.`
        }
      });
    } else if (event.type === "proposal_decided") {
      if (event.status === "refused") {
        rows.push({ seq: event.seq, item: { kind: "system", key, tone: "plain", who: "Agent OS", text: `could not save ${name}. See its card on the right.` } });
      } else if (event.decision === "approve") {
        rows.push({
          seq: event.seq,
          item: {
            kind: "system",
            key,
            tone: "plain",
            who: "You",
            text: isFile ? `approved ${name}. Agent OS saved it in the Workspace sandbox.` : `approved ${name}. Nothing was run.`
          }
        });
      } else {
        rows.push({
          seq: event.seq,
          item: {
            kind: "system",
            key,
            tone: "plain",
            who: "You",
            text: isFile ? `rejected ${name}. Nothing was saved.` : `rejected ${name}. Nothing was changed.`
          }
        });
      }
    } else if (event.type === "action_undone") {
      const path = typeof event.path === "string" && event.path ? event.path : actions.find((a) => a.id === event.actionId)?.path || "the file";
      rows.push({ seq: event.seq, item: { kind: "system", key, tone: "undo", who: "You", text: `undid the save of ${path}.` } });
    } else if (event.type === "limits_extended") {
      const extra = typeof event.extraTurns === "number" ? event.extraTurns : 0;
      rows.push({ seq: event.seq, item: { kind: "system", key, tone: "more", who: "You", text: `gave the room ${extra} more ${extra === 1 ? "turn" : "turns"}.` } });
    }
  }
  return rows.sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq).map((row) => row.item);
}

// ---- Clock -----------------------------------------------------------------

export function minutesLabel(ms: number) {
  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms / 1000));
  const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const s = seconds % 60;
  return m > 0 ? `${m}m ${String(s).padStart(2, "0")}s` : `${s}s`;
}

// Time the room has used, in ms, or null when it cannot be known.
// - Paused for a decision: the stored clockUsedMs, whatever "now" is. The clock
//   is stopped, so this never ticks (and survives a restart of Agent OS).
// - Running: now minus clockStartedAt (the server moves clockStartedAt on a
//   resume so this stays true, see "Assumptions about A1 and A2").
// - Anything else: up to the end (or the last update).
export function roomElapsedMs(room: TeamRoom, nowMs: number): number | null {
  if (isPaused(room) && typeof room.clockUsedMs === "number" && Number.isFinite(room.clockUsedMs)) {
    return Math.max(0, room.clockUsedMs);
  }
  const start = new Date(room.clockStartedAt).getTime();
  if (!Number.isFinite(start)) return null;
  const end = room.status === "running" ? nowMs : new Date(room.endedAt || room.updatedAt).getTime();
  return Number.isFinite(end) ? Math.max(0, end - start) : null;
}

// A time of day for a turn ("14:03:22"), or "—" when the event has no valid time.
export function clockTime(iso: string | undefined): string {
  const ms = iso ? new Date(iso).getTime() : NaN;
  if (!Number.isFinite(ms)) return "—";
  return new Date(ms).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit" });
}

// ---- Decision cards --------------------------------------------------------

// pending = waits for you; saved / undone / rejected / refused / recorded = decided;
// talking = still being discussed by the agents (open, agreed a moment ago, disputed).
export type DecisionCardState = "pending" | "saved" | "undone" | "rejected" | "refused" | "recorded" | "talking";

// The newest action for a proposal, if the room wrote one.
export function actionForProposal(proposal: TeamProposal, actions: TeamAction[]): TeamAction | undefined {
  for (let i = actions.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
    if (actions[i].proposalId === proposal.id) return actions[i];
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function decisionCardState(proposal: TeamProposal, action: TeamAction | undefined): DecisionCardState {
  if (proposal.status === "needs_approval") return "pending";
  if (action?.failed || proposal.status === "refused") return "refused";
  if (action?.undone) return "undone";
  if (proposal.status === "applied" || (proposal.kind === "file" && action)) return "saved";
  if (proposal.status === "rejected") return "rejected";
  if (proposal.status === "approved") return "recorded";
  return "talking";
}

// Splits the proposals into the ones waiting for you (the one the room is
// paused on first), the ones already decided, and the ones still being discussed.
export function orderProposals(proposals: TeamProposal[], actions: TeamAction[], pausedFor: string | null) {
  const byTurn = (a: TeamProposal, b: TeamProposal) => a.turn - b.turn;
  const needs: TeamProposal[] = [];
  const settled: TeamProposal[] = [];
  const talking: TeamProposal[] = [];
  for (const proposal of proposals) {
    const state = decisionCardState(proposal, actionForProposal(proposal, actions));
    if (state === "pending") needs.push(proposal);
    else if (state === "talking") talking.push(proposal);
    else settled.push(proposal);
  }
  needs.sort((a, b) => (a.id === pausedFor ? -1 : b.id === pausedFor ? 1 : byTurn(a, b)));
  settled.sort(byTurn);
  talking.sort(byTurn);
  return { needs, settled, talking };
}

export function fileKindLabel(name: string): string {
  const ext = name.toLowerCase().split(".").pop() || "";
  if (ext === "md") return "Markdown";
  if (ext === "txt") return "Plain text";
  if (ext === "html" || ext === "htm") return "HTML";
  return "File";
}

// The first lines of a proposed file, and how many more there are.
export function previewLines(content: string, max = 6): { lines: string[]; more: number } {
  const all = content.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n");
  while (all.length > 1 && all[all.length - 1] === "") all.pop();
  return { lines: all.slice(0, max), more: Math.max(0, all.length - max) };
}

// ---- "What Agent OS did so far" ---------------------------------------------

export interface RoomSoFar {
  messages: number;
  saved: number;
  savedPaths: string[];
  waitingFiles: number;
  waitingOther: number;
}

export function roomSoFar(turns: TurnView[], proposals: TeamProposal[], actions: TeamAction[]): RoomSoFar {
  const live = actions.filter((action) => !action.failed && !action.undone);
  const waiting = proposals.filter((proposal) => proposal.status === "needs_approval");
  const waitingFiles = waiting.filter((proposal) => proposal.kind === "file").length;
  return {
    messages: turns.filter((turn) => turn.ended).length,
    saved: live.length,
    savedPaths: live.map((action) => action.path),
    waitingFiles,
    waitingOther: waiting.length - waitingFiles
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Replace `src/ui/components/TeamRoomProblem.tsx`.** It now draws a kit `Banner`, and the gate-off sentence depends on where it is shown (`where="decision"` gives the exact sentence from the spec). A network failure is "Couldn't reach Agent OS. Nothing was changed. Try again." instead of the browser's "Failed to fetch".

```tsx
// A plain-English notice for the Team Room, shared by the start form, the room
// view and the decision cards. Each known server error code gets one sentence
// and, where there is one, a button that goes straight to the screen that
// fixes it. It is drawn with the page kit's Banner (alert for warn and danger).
import { TeamRoomError } from "../../api";
import { navigateTo } from "../../nav";
import { agentLabel } from "../teamRoomShared";
import Banner from "./Banner";

export interface TeamProblem {
  code: string;
  message: string;
  agent?: string;
  agents?: string[];
  roomId?: string | null;
}

export function problemFromError(error: unknown): TeamProblem {
  if (error instanceof TeamRoomError) {
    return { code: error.code, message: error.message, agent: error.agent, agents: error.agents, roomId: error.roomId };
  }
  // fetch() itself failed: Agent OS did not answer, so nothing was changed.
  return { code: "unreachable", message: "Couldn't reach Agent OS. Nothing was changed. Try again." };
}

// "start" = starting, stopping or continuing a room. "decision" = approving a file card.
export type ProblemWhere = "start" | "decision";

export default function TeamRoomProblem({
  problem,
  where = "start",
  onOpenRoom
}: {
  problem: TeamProblem;
  where?: ProblemWhere;
  onOpenRoom?: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  let tone: "info" | "warn" | "danger" = "danger";
  let body: string = problem.message || "Something went wrong.";
  let action: { label: string; run: () => void } | null = null;
  if (problem.code === "execution_gate_off") {
    tone = "warn";
    body =
      where === "decision"
        ? "Turn on the execution gate to let the room save files."
        : "Safety is on Look only, so agents can't run. Allow running agents in Safety, then come back.";
    action = { label: "Open Safety", run: () => navigateTo("safety") };
  } else if (problem.code === "agent_missing") {
    tone = "warn";
    body = `${agentLabel(problem.agent)} isn't installed, and a Team Room needs both Hermes Agent and OpenClaw.`;
    action = { label: "Open Setup", run: () => navigateTo("setup") };
  } else if (problem.code === "safeguards_off") {
    tone = "warn";
    const names = (problem.agents?.length ? problem.agents : [problem.agent || ""]).map((id) => agentLabel(id || undefined));
    body = `${names.join(" and ")} could run commands without asking. Turn its safeguard back on, then try again.`;
    action = { label: "Open Agents", run: () => navigateTo("agents", { agent: problem.agents?.[0] || problem.agent || "" }) };
  } else if (problem.code === "room_already_running") {
    tone = "warn";
    body = "Another Team Room is still running. Stop it or wait for it to finish before starting a new one.";
    const id = problem.roomId;
    if (id && onOpenRoom) action = { label: "Open the running room", run: () => onOpenRoom(id) };
  } else if (problem.code === "not_pending") {
    // Two windows, or a double click: the proposal was already decided.
    tone = "info";
    body = "That was already decided, maybe in another window. The card now shows the result.";
  }
  return (
    <Banner
      tone={tone}
      actions={
        action ? (
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={action.run}>
            {action.label}
          </button>
        ) : undefined
      }
    >
      {body}
    </Banner>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Create `src/ui/components/TeamRoomLimits.tsx`.** The three meters. The section carries `data-elapsed-ms`, the same number the Time meter draws, so the probe can read the clock without parsing the kit's markup.

```tsx
// The "Limits" panel of a room: turns, time and cost as three meters, plus the
// two honest notes. While the room is paused for a decision the Time meter
// shows the time stored when it paused and does not tick (D10).
import type { TeamRoom } from "../../types";
import { isPaused, minutesLabel, roomCostText, roomElapsedMs, usd } from "../teamRoomShared";
import Meter from "./Meter";

export default function TeamRoomLimits({ room, nowMs }: { room: TeamRoom; nowMs: number }) {
  const paused = isPaused(room);
  const elapsedMs = roomElapsedMs(room, nowMs);
  const maxMinutes = room.limits.maxMinutes;
  const timeValue = elapsedMs === null ? null : Math.min(1, elapsedMs / (maxMinutes * 60_000));
  const timeDetail = `${elapsedMs === null ? "—" : minutesLabel(elapsedMs)} of ${maxMinutes}m`;

  const cap = room.limits.maxCostUsd;
  const hasCap = typeof cap === "number";
  const known = room.cost?.knownUsd ?? room.costUsd;
  const noCostYet = typeof known !== "number" || (known === 0 && room.costKnownTurns === 0);
  const costValue = hasCap && typeof known === "number" ? Math.min(1, known / (cap as number)) : null;
  const costDetail = hasCap ? `${usd(known)} of $${cap}` : `${usd(known)} · no cap`;

  const turnsValue = Math.min(1, room.turnsDone / Math.max(room.turnsAllowed, 1));
  return (
    <section className="os-team__limits" aria-labelledby="os-team-limits-h" data-elapsed-ms={elapsedMs === null ? "" : Math.round(elapsedMs)}>
      <h2 id="os-team-limits-h" className="os-team__h">
        Limits
      </h2>
      <div className="os-team__meters">
        <Meter label="Turns" value={turnsValue} detail={`${room.turnsDone} of ${room.turnsAllowed}`} />
        <Meter label="Time" value={timeValue} detail={timeDetail} tone={timeValue !== null && timeValue >= 0.85 ? "warn" : "accent"} />
        <Meter
          label={noCostYet ? "Cost (not reported yet)" : "Cost"}
          value={costValue}
          detail={costDetail}
          tone={costValue !== null && costValue >= 1 ? "danger" : costValue !== null && costValue >= 0.8 ? "warn" : "accent"}
        />
      </div>
      <p
        className="os-team__foot-note os-mono"
        title="Known cost is what the agents reported. A turn that reported none is counted as unknown, never as $0."
      >
        {roomCostText(room)}
      </p>
      {room.costWarning ? <p className="os-team__foot-note">{room.costWarning}</p> : null}
      {paused ? (
        <p className="os-team__foot-note">Paused: the time limit does not run while the room waits for you.</p>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```

A turn that is writing right now shows the real `RunConsole` under "<Agent> is writing turn N of M."

```tsx
// One turn of the conversation, drawn as a row of the timeline. Agent text is
// untrusted: it is only ever rendered as plain React text inside a pre-wrap
// block, never as HTML.
import { useState } from "react";
import { Activity } from "lucide-react";
import { navigateTo } from "../../nav";
import { agentLabel, agentMaker, clockTime, hasTag, tagLabel, turnCostLabel, turnStatusView, type TurnView } from "../teamRoomShared";
import RunConsole from "./RunConsole";
import StatusWord from "./StatusWord";

const COLLAPSE_CHARS = 600;
const COLLAPSE_LINES = 10;

// Long text collapses behind "Show all" so one chatty turn can't bury the rest.
export function ClampText({ text, className = "" }: { text: string; className?: string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const long = text.length > COLLAPSE_CHARS || text.split("\n").length > COLLAPSE_LINES;
  return (
    <div className={className}>
      <div className={`os-team__text${long && !open ? " os-team__text--clamped" : ""}`}>{text}</div>
      {long ? (
        <button type="button" className="os-team__link" aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}>
          {open ? "Show less" : "Show all"}
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function TeamRoomTurn({ turn, live, turnsAllowed }: { turn: TurnView; live: boolean; turnsAllowed: number }) {
  const ended = turn.ended;
  const status = turnStatusView(ended?.status);
  const failed = status?.state === "failed";
  const model = typeof ended?.model === "string" && ended.model ? ended.model : null;
  const costKnown = typeof ended?.costUsd === "number";
  const tools = ended?.toolSummary || null;
  const tagged = hasTag(ended?.parsed);
  const maker = agentMaker(turn.agentId);

  return (
    <li className={`os-team__item${live ? " is-live" : ""}${failed ? " is-failed" : ""}`}>
      <span className="os-team__node os-mono" aria-hidden="true">
        {turn.turn}
      </span>
      <div className="os-team__item-body">
        <div className="os-team__item-head">
          <b className="os-team__who-name">{agentLabel(turn.agentId)}</b>
          {maker ? <span className="os-team__maker">{maker}</span> : null}
          {status ? <StatusWord state={status.state} label={status.label} /> : null}
          {ended ? (
            <time className="os-team__time os-mono" dateTime={ended.t} title="When this turn ended">
              {clockTime(ended.t)}
            </time>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        {ended ? (
          <>
            {ended.text ? <ClampText text={ended.text} className="os-team__msg" /> : <p className="os-team__muted">This turn produced no text.</p>}
            <div className="os-team__foot">
              <span className={`os-chip os-team__tag${tagged ? "" : " os-team__tag--none"}`}>{tagLabel(ended.parsed)}</span>
              {model ? (
                <span className="os-mono os-team__small" title="The model that answered this turn">
                  {model}
                </span>
              ) : null}
              <span
                className="os-mono os-team__small"
                title={costKnown ? undefined : "This turn didn't report a cost"}
              >
                {turnCostLabel(ended.costUsd, model)}
              </span>
              <a
                className="os-team__link"
                href={`?page=runs&run=${encodeURIComponent(turn.runId)}`}
                onClick={(event) => {
                  event.preventDefault();
                  navigateTo("runs", { run: turn.runId });
                }}
              >
                Open this run
              </a>
            </div>
            {tools && tools.calls > 0 ? (
              <p className="os-team__muted">
                {tools.failures > 0
                  ? `Tried ${tools.calls} tool call${tools.calls === 1 ? "" : "s"}; ${tools.failures} failed.`
                  : `Used ${tools.calls} tool call${tools.calls === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`}
              </p>
            ) : null}
            {ended.parsed?.problem ? <p className="os-team__protocol">{ended.parsed.problem}</p> : null}
            {turn.protocolNotes.map((note, index) => (
              <p key={index} className="os-team__protocol">
                {note}
              </p>
            ))}
          </>
        ) : live ? (
          <>
            <p className="os-team__typing">
              <Activity size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>
                <b>{agentLabel(turn.agentId)}</b> is writing turn {turn.turn} of {turnsAllowed}.
              </span>
            </p>
            <div className="os-team__turn-live">
              <RunConsole runId={turn.runId} compact />
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <p className="os-team__muted">This turn never reported back (the room stopped first).</p>
        )}
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Create `src/ui/components/TeamRoomTimeline.tsx`.** The ordered list, the Agent OS and You rows, and the two empty states.

```tsx
// The conversation of a room, in turn order, with a short line wherever Agent OS
// or you did something (an agreement that waits for you, an approval, an undo).
import { FileText, ListPlus, MessagesSquare, ShieldCheck, Undo2 } from "lucide-react";
import type { TimelineItem } from "../teamRoomShared";
import EmptyState from "./EmptyState";
import TeamRoomTurn from "./TeamRoomTurn";

const SYSTEM_ICON = { ask: FileText, plain: ShieldCheck, undo: Undo2, more: ListPlus } as const;

export default function TeamRoomTimeline({
  items,
  running,
  currentRunId,
  turnsAllowed
}: {
  items: TimelineItem[];
  running: boolean;
  currentRunId: string | null;
  turnsAllowed: number;
}) {
  if (items.length === 0) {
    return running ? (
      <EmptyState icon={MessagesSquare} title="Waiting for the first turn…" body="Hermes Agent speaks first. Its message will appear here." />
    ) : (
      <EmptyState icon={MessagesSquare} title="No turns were recorded" body="This room ended before any agent answered." />
    );
  }
  return (
    <ol className="os-team__timeline" aria-label="Messages in turn order">
      {items.map((item) => {
        if (item.kind === "turn") {
          return (
            <TeamRoomTurn
              key={item.key}
              turn={item.turn}
              turnsAllowed={turnsAllowed}
              live={running && !item.turn.ended && currentRunId === item.turn.runId}
            />
          );
        }
        const Icon = SYSTEM_ICON[item.tone];
        return (
          <li key={item.key} className={`os-team__item os-team__item--system is-${item.tone}`}>
            <span className="os-team__node" aria-hidden="true">
              <Icon size={16} />
            </span>
            <p className="os-team__sys">
              <b>{item.who}:</b> {item.text}
            </p>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );
}
```
