- [ ] **Step 9: Create `src/ui/components/TeamRoomDecision.tsx`.** The card and its two lists. Points a reviewer should check:
  - Approve and Reject have no confirm dialog (design note above); both call `decideProposal`, and both buttons use `aria-disabled` while a request is in flight, so a double click sends one request and the focused button never loses focus.
  - On success the card waits for the refreshed room (`await onDecided()`), then the focus moves to the card in its new state (`focusCardAfterChange`), even when the card moves from the "needs you" list to the "decided" list.
  - On any error the card shows the Banner in place and reloads the room, so a 403 leaves it pending and a 409 shows the result.
  - Undo keeps its confirm dialog (title "Undo this save?").

```tsx
// The decision cards of a room (D10). A file the agents agree on is never saved
// by itself: it becomes "Needs you: save this file?" with Approve and Reject.
// After you decide, the same card turns into what happened: saved (with Undo),
// rejected, undone or refused. All agent text is rendered as plain text.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowRight, Check, CheckCircle2, FileText, Undo2, XCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { decideProposal, undoTeamAction } from "../../api";
import { navigateTo } from "../../nav";
import type { TeamAction, TeamProposal, TeamRoom } from "../../types";
import {
  actionForProposal,
  agentLabel,
  decisionCardState,
  fileKindLabel,
  orderProposals,
  previewLines,
  proposalWord,
  type DecisionCardState
} from "../teamRoomShared";
import AgentConfirmModal from "./AgentConfirmModal";
import TeamRoomProblem, { problemFromError, type TeamProblem } from "./TeamRoomProblem";

// After a decision the card that held the focus is replaced by the card in its
// new state (it can even move to another list). The id of the card that should
// take the focus is kept here, outside React state, so it survives that swap.
let focusCardAfterChange: string | null = null;

interface CardCopy {
  title: string;
  sub: string;
}

function cardCopy(state: DecisionCardState, proposal: TeamProposal, action: TeamAction | undefined, room: TeamRoom): CardCopy {
  const isFile = proposal.kind === "file";
  switch (state) {
    case "pending": {
      const agreed = proposal.agreedBy ? `${agentLabel(proposal.agreedBy)} agreed.` : "Both agents agree.";
      return {
        title: isFile ? "Needs you: save this file?" : "Needs you: record this decision?",
        sub: `${agentLabel(proposal.by)} proposed it in turn ${proposal.turn}. ${agreed}`
      };
    }
    case "saved":
      return { title: "Saved to the Workspace", sub: "You approved it. It is in the sandbox now." };
    case "undone":
      return {
        title: "Save undone",
        sub: action?.created ? "The file is gone from the Workspace again." : "The Workspace has the earlier copy back."
      };
    case "rejected":
      return {
        title: isFile ? "Rejected, nothing saved" : "Rejected",
        sub:
          room.status === "running"
            ? "The agents are told you said no, and the room carries on."
            : `You said no. ${isFile ? "Nothing was saved." : "Nothing was changed."}`
      };
    case "refused":
      return { title: "Refused, nothing saved", sub: action?.failReason || proposal.statusReason || "No reason was recorded." };
    case "recorded":
      return { title: "Decision recorded", sub: "You approved it. Nothing was run." };
    default:
      return { title: proposal.id, sub: "" };
  }
}

function DecisionCard({
  room,
  proposal,
  action,
  state,
  onDecided,
  onChanged
}: {
  room: TeamRoom;
  proposal: TeamProposal;
  action: TeamAction | undefined;
  state: DecisionCardState;
  onDecided: () => Promise<void>;
  onChanged: () => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<"approve" | "reject" | null>(null);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<TeamProblem | null>(null);
  const [undoOpen, setUndoOpen] = useState(false);
  const [undoBusy, setUndoBusy] = useState(false);
  const [showAll, setShowAll] = useState(false);
  const cardRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const file = proposal.kind === "file" ? proposal.file : undefined;
  const copy = cardCopy(state, proposal, action, room);
  const headingId = `os-team-card-${proposal.id}`;
  const pausedHere = room.status === "needs_you" && room.pausedFor === proposal.id;
  const Icon = state === "pending" ? FileText : state === "undone" ? Undo2 : state === "rejected" || state === "refused" ? XCircle : CheckCircle2;

  // Move the focus to the card once it shows its new state, so a keyboard or
  // screen reader user hears what happened instead of losing the button.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (focusCardAfterChange === proposal.id && state !== "pending") {
      focusCardAfterChange = null;
      cardRef.current?.focus();
    }
  });

  async function decide(decision: "approve" | "reject") {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(decision);
    setProblem(null);
    try {
      await decideProposal(room.id, proposal.id, decision);
      focusCardAfterChange = proposal.id;
      await onDecided();
    } catch (error) {
      setProblem(problemFromError(error));
      // Always reload: after a 403 the card stays pending, after a 409 it shows the result.
      await onChanged();
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  async function undo() {
    if (!action) return;
    setUndoBusy(true);
    setProblem(null);
    try {
      await undoTeamAction(room.id, action.id);
      setUndoOpen(false);
      focusCardAfterChange = proposal.id;
      await onChanged();
    } catch (error) {
      setUndoOpen(false);
      setProblem(problemFromError(error));
      await onChanged();
    } finally {
      setUndoBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const preview = file && state === "pending" ? previewLines(file.content, showAll ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : 6) : null;

  return (
    <div ref={cardRef} tabIndex={-1} className="os-team__decision" data-state={state} role="group" aria-labelledby={headingId}>
      <div className="os-team__decision-head">
        <Icon size={20} aria-hidden="true" />
        <h2 id={headingId} className="os-team__h3">
          {copy.title}
        </h2>
      </div>
      {copy.sub ? <p className="os-team__sub">{copy.sub}</p> : null}
      {proposal.summary ? <p className="os-team__summary">{proposal.summary}</p> : null}

      {file ? (
        <div className="os-team__file">
          <code>{state === "saved" && action ? action.path : file.name}</code>
          <span className="os-team__tag">{fileKindLabel(file.name)}</span>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {preview && file ? (
        <div className="os-team__prev-wrap">
          <pre
            className="os-team__prev"
            role="region"
            tabIndex={showAll ? 0 : undefined}
            aria-label={showAll ? `${file.name}, the whole file` : `Start of ${file.name}`}
          >
            {preview.lines.join("\n")}
          </pre>
          {preview.more > 0 || showAll ? (
            <button type="button" className="os-team__more" aria-expanded={showAll} title="Show the whole file" onClick={() => setShowAll((v) => !v)}>
              {showAll ? "Show less" : `… ${preview.more} more ${preview.more === 1 ? "line" : "lines"}`}
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {state === "pending" ? (
        <>
          <p className="os-team__note">
            {file
              ? "Saved in the Workspace sandbox only, in this room's folder. Nothing is saved until you press Approve, and you can undo it afterwards."
              : "Approving records your decision. It does not run anything."}
          </p>
          {pausedHere ? (
            <p className="os-team__note">
              The room is paused until you decide. Then it carries on with the turns it has left, and the agents are told what you decided.
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </>
      ) : null}
      {state === "saved" && action ? (
        <p className="os-team__note">
          {action.created
            ? "Changed your mind? Undo removes the file and leaves the sandbox as it was before."
            : "Changed your mind? Undo puts back the copy that was there before."}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      {problem ? <TeamRoomProblem problem={problem} where="decision" /> : null}

      {state === "pending" ? (
        <div className="os-team__acts">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="os-btn os-btn--primary"
            aria-disabled={busy !== null}
            aria-busy={busy === "approve"}
            onClick={() => void decide("approve")}
          >
            <Check size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
            {busy === "approve" ? "Saving…" : file ? "Approve and save" : "Approve"}
          </button>
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" aria-disabled={busy !== null} onClick={() => void decide("reject")}>
            {busy === "reject" ? "Rejecting…" : "Reject"}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {state === "saved" && action ? (
        <div className="os-team__acts">
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => setUndoOpen(true)}>
            <Undo2 size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
            Undo save
          </button>
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={() => navigateTo("workspace")}>
            Open the Workspace
            <ArrowRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {undoOpen && action ? (
        <AgentConfirmModal
          title="Undo this save?"
          confirmLabel="Undo save"
          danger
          busy={undoBusy}
          onConfirm={() => void undo()}
          onClose={() => (undoBusy ? null : setUndoOpen(false))}
        >
          <p className="os-mono">{action.path}</p>
          <p>
            {action.created
              ? "This removes the file the room created."
              : "This puts back the saved copy of the file from before the room changed it."}
          </p>
        </AgentConfirmModal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

interface ListProps {
  room: TeamRoom;
  proposals: TeamProposal[];
  actions: TeamAction[];
  // After Approve or Reject: reload the room (and the room may start running again).
  onDecided: () => Promise<void>;
  // After anything else: reload the room.
  onChanged: () => Promise<void>;
}

// The cards that wait for you: the top of the side column.
export function TeamRoomNeedsYou(props: ListProps) {
  const { needs } = orderProposals(props.proposals, props.actions, props.room.pausedFor ?? null);
  if (needs.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="os-team__cards" id="os-team-decisions">
      {needs.map((proposal) => (
        <DecisionCard
          key={proposal.id}
          room={props.room}
          proposal={proposal}
          action={actionForProposal(proposal, props.actions)}
          state="pending"
          onDecided={props.onDecided}
          onChanged={props.onChanged}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// Everything already decided, then the proposals the agents are still discussing.
export function TeamRoomDecided(props: ListProps) {
  const { settled, talking } = orderProposals(props.proposals, props.actions, props.room.pausedFor ?? null);
  if (settled.length === 0 && talking.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <>
      {settled.length > 0 ? (
        <section className="os-team__decided" aria-labelledby="os-team-decided-h">
          <h2 id="os-team-decided-h" className="os-team__h">
            Decided
          </h2>
          <div className="os-team__cards">
            {settled.map((proposal) => {
              const action = actionForProposal(proposal, props.actions);
              return (
                <DecisionCard
                  key={proposal.id}
                  room={props.room}
                  proposal={proposal}
                  action={action}
                  state={decisionCardState(proposal, action)}
                  onDecided={props.onDecided}
                  onChanged={props.onChanged}
                />
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </section>
      ) : null}
      {talking.length > 0 ? (
        <section className="os-team__decided" aria-labelledby="os-team-talking-h">
          <h2 id="os-team-talking-h" className="os-team__h">
            Still being discussed
          </h2>
          <ul className="os-team__talking">
            {talking.map((proposal) => (
              <li key={proposal.id}>
                <div className="os-team__talk-head">
                  <span className="os-mono">{proposal.id}</span>
                  <span>{agentLabel(proposal.by)}</span>
                  <span className="os-chip">{proposal.kind === "file" ? "file" : "decision"}</span>
                  <span className="os-team__muted">{proposalWord(proposal)}</span>
                </div>
                <p className="os-team__summary">{proposal.summary}</p>
                {proposal.disputeReason ? <p className="os-team__muted">Disagreement: {proposal.disputeReason}</p> : null}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Replace `src/ui/components/TeamRoomView.tsx`.** Points a reviewer should check:
  - It polls every 3 s while the room is running, paused, or out of reach, so a decision made in another window shows up.
  - The 1-second tick only runs while the room runs, so a paused room does not tick.
  - It opens a fresh event stream whenever the status turns into "running" from something else (a Continue, or a decision that resumed the room), instead of each button doing it.
  - Each of its states draws its own `PageHeader`, so there is always exactly one h1.

```tsx
// Team Room, one room selected: the page header (Stop or Continue), the task and
// the status, then the conversation on the left and, on the right, the decision
// cards, the limits and the notebook. The room is read from getTeamRoom and kept
// fresh by the live event stream: every new stream event triggers a (debounced)
// refetch, and a room that is running, paused or out of reach is also polled so
// a dropped stream can never leave the screen stale.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, RefreshCw, ShieldCheck, Square } from "lucide-react";
import { TeamRoomError, continueTeamRoom, getTeamRoom, stopTeamRoom, useTeamRoomStream } from "../../api";
import type { TeamRoomDetail } from "../../types";
import { deriveTimeline, deriveTurns, isPaused, mergeEvents, plural, roomEndSentence, roomLede, roomSoFar, roomStatusView } from "../teamRoomShared";
import AgentConfirmModal from "./AgentConfirmModal";
import Banner from "./Banner";
import PageHeader from "./PageHeader";
import StatusWord from "./StatusWord";
import { TeamRoomDecided, TeamRoomNeedsYou } from "./TeamRoomDecision";
import TeamRoomLimits from "./TeamRoomLimits";
import TeamRoomProblem, { problemFromError, type TeamProblem } from "./TeamRoomProblem";
import TeamRoomTimeline from "./TeamRoomTimeline";
import { ClampText } from "./TeamRoomTurn";
import { useInterval } from "./useInterval";

const CONTINUE_TURNS = 4;

export default function TeamRoomView({ roomId, onBack }: { roomId: string; onBack: () => void }) {
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<TeamRoomDetail | null>(null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<{ notFound: boolean; message: string } | null>(null);
  const [reconnectKey, setReconnectKey] = useState(0);
  const [stopOpen, setStopOpen] = useState(false);
  const [continueOpen, setContinueOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<TeamProblem | null>(null);
  const [, forceTick] = useState(0);
  const roomIdRef = useRef(roomId);
  roomIdRef.current = roomId;

  const { events: liveEvents, status: streamStatus } = useTeamRoomStream(roomId, reconnectKey);

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    const asked = roomId;
    try {
      const next = await getTeamRoom(asked);
      if (asked !== roomIdRef.current) return;
      setDetail(next);
      setLoadError(null);
    } catch (error) {
      if (asked !== roomIdRef.current) return;
      const notFound = error instanceof TeamRoomError && error.status === 404;
      setLoadError({ notFound, message: error instanceof TeamRoomError ? error.message : "Agent OS isn't responding." });
    }
  }, [roomId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setDetail(null);
    setLoadError(null);
    setProblem(null);
    void refresh();
  }, [roomId, refresh]);

  // New stream events mean something changed (a turn, a proposal, an action):
  // refetch once the burst settles instead of once per event.
  const eventCount = liveEvents.length;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (eventCount === 0) return undefined;
    const id = setTimeout(() => void refresh(), 250);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [eventCount, refresh]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (streamStatus === "ended") void refresh();
  }, [streamStatus, refresh]);

  const paused = detail ? isPaused(detail.room) : false;
  const running = detail?.room.status === "running";
  // A paused room is polled too: the decision may be made in another window.
  useInterval(() => void refresh(), running || paused || loadError !== null ? 3000 : null);
  // The clock reads Date.now() while the room runs, so a re-render every second
  // keeps it moving. A paused room does not tick: its clock is stopped.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running) return undefined;
    const id = setInterval(() => forceTick((n) => n + 1), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [running]);

  // A room that runs again (Continue here, or a decision made in another window)
  // needs a fresh event stream: the old one ended when the room paused.
  const status = detail?.room.status ?? null;
  const lastStatus = useRef<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status === "running" && lastStatus.current !== null && lastStatus.current !== "running") setReconnectKey((k) => k + 1);
    lastStatus.current = status;
  }, [status]);

  const events = useMemo(() => mergeEvents(detail?.events || [], liveEvents), [detail, liveEvents]);
  const timeline = useMemo(() => deriveTimeline(events, detail?.proposals || [], detail?.actions || []), [events, detail]);

  const backButton = (
    <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost os-team__back" onClick={onBack}>
      <ArrowLeft size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> All rooms
    </button>
  );

  if (loadError && !detail) {
    return (
      <div className="os-team__view">
        {backButton}
        <PageHeader title="Team Room" titleId="os-team-title" />
        <Banner
          tone={loadError.notFound ? "warn" : "danger"}
          actions={
            loadError.notFound ? undefined : (
              <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void refresh()}>
                <RefreshCw size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> Retry
              </button>
            )
          }
        >
          {loadError.notFound ? "That room doesn't exist (it may have been removed)." : `Couldn't load this room. ${loadError.message}`}
        </Banner>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!detail) {
    return (
      <div className="os-team__view">
        {backButton}
        <PageHeader title="Team Room" titleId="os-team-title" />
        <p className="os-team__hint" aria-live="polite">
          Loading this room…
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { room, proposals, actions, notebook } = detail;
  const statusView = roomStatusView(room);
  const isRunning = room.status === "running";
  const endSentence = roomEndSentence(room);
  const so = roomSoFar(deriveTurns(events), proposals, actions);
  const waiting = so.waitingFiles + so.waitingOther;
  const waitingText =
    so.waitingOther === 0
      ? `${plural(so.waitingFiles, "file")} ${so.waitingFiles === 1 ? "waits" : "wait"} for your decision.`
      : `${plural(waiting, "proposal")} ${waiting === 1 ? "waits" : "wait"} for your decision.`;
  // Plain-English notices from the server (a model that can't follow the reply
  // format). Server text, shown as text. The cost warning lives in the Limits panel.
  const notices = room.hints || [];

  async function doStop() {
    setBusy(true);
    setProblem(null);
    try {
      await stopTeamRoom(room.id);
      setStopOpen(false);
      void refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      setStopOpen(false);
      setProblem(problemFromError(error));
      void refresh();
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function doContinue() {
    setBusy(true);
    setProblem(null);
    try {
      await continueTeamRoom(room.id, CONTINUE_TURNS);
      setContinueOpen(false);
      void refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      setContinueOpen(false);
      setProblem(problemFromError(error));
      void refresh();
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const headerActions = isRunning ? (
    <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--danger" onClick={() => setStopOpen(true)}>
      <Square size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> Stop room
    </button>
  ) : room.status === "needs_you" ? (
    <button type="button" className={`os-btn ${paused ? "os-btn--secondary" : "os-btn--primary"}`} onClick={() => setContinueOpen(true)}>
      {paused ? `Continue without deciding (+${CONTINUE_TURNS} turns)` : `Continue (+${CONTINUE_TURNS} turns)`}
    </button>
  ) : undefined;

  return (
    <div className="os-team__view">
      {backButton}
      <PageHeader title="Team Room" titleId="os-team-title" lede={roomLede(room)} actions={headerActions} />

      <div className="os-team__bar">
        <div className="os-team__task">
          <span className="os-micro">Task</span>
          <ClampText text={room.task} className="os-team__task-text" />
        </div>
        <div className="os-team__bar-status" role="status">
          <StatusWord state={statusView.state} label={statusView.label} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {endSentence ? <p className="os-team__end">{endSentence}</p> : null}
      {waiting > 0 ? (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="os-team__link os-team__jump"
          onClick={() => document.getElementById("os-team-decisions")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "auto", block: "start" })}
        >
          Jump to the decision
        </button>
      ) : null}
      {problem ? <TeamRoomProblem problem={problem} /> : null}
      {loadError ? <Banner tone="warn">Lost contact with Agent OS. This page shows the last thing it saw and keeps trying.</Banner> : null}
      {notices.map((notice) => (
        <Banner key={notice} tone="info">
          {notice}
        </Banner>
      ))}

      <div className="os-team__room">
        <div className="os-team__main">
          <TeamRoomTimeline items={timeline} running={isRunning} currentRunId={room.currentTurn?.runId || null} turnsAllowed={room.turnsAllowed} />
          <p className="os-team__sofar">
            <ShieldCheck size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>
              <b>What Agent OS did so far.</b> Passed <b>{so.messages}</b> {so.messages === 1 ? "message" : "messages"} between the agents and
              saved <b>{plural(so.saved, "file")}</b>
              {so.saved > 0 ? (
                <>
                  : <code className="os-mono">{so.savedPaths.join(", ")}</code>
                </>
              ) : null}
              .{waiting > 0 ? <span className="os-team__wait"> {waitingText}</span> : null}
            </span>
          </p>
        </div>

        <aside className="os-team__side" aria-label="Decisions and limits">
          <TeamRoomNeedsYou room={room} proposals={proposals} actions={actions} onDecided={refresh} onChanged={refresh} />
          <TeamRoomLimits room={room} nowMs={Date.now()} />
          <TeamRoomDecided room={room} proposals={proposals} actions={actions} onDecided={refresh} onChanged={refresh} />
          {notebook.trim() ? (
            <section className="os-team__notebook" aria-labelledby="os-team-notebook-h">
              <h2 id="os-team-notebook-h" className="os-team__h">
                Notebook
              </h2>
              {/* notebook.md is markdown the server writes ("**Hermes Agent** (turn 1, ...)"). It is shown as plain text on purpose (agents wrote it), so the bold markers are dropped. */}
              <ClampText text={notebook.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, "$1")} className="os-team__notebook-text" />
            </section>
          ) : null}
        </aside>
      </div>

      {stopOpen ? (
        <AgentConfirmModal
          title="Stop this room?"
          confirmLabel="Stop room"
          danger
          busy={busy}
          onConfirm={() => void doStop()}
          onClose={() => (busy ? null : setStopOpen(false))}
        >
          <p>This stops the agent that is working right now. What was already said stays in the room. A file you already saved stays saved, and you can still undo it.</p>
        </AgentConfirmModal>
      ) : null}
      {continueOpen ? (
        <AgentConfirmModal
          title={`Continue for ${CONTINUE_TURNS} more turns?`}
          confirmLabel="Continue"
          busy={busy}
          onConfirm={() => void doContinue()}
          onClose={() => (busy ? null : setContinueOpen(false))}
        >
          <p>
            This starts the real agents again for up to {CONTINUE_TURNS} more turns. Each turn may cost money on their own model accounts.
          </p>
          {paused ? <p>The file waiting for you stays waiting, and you can still decide on it later.</p> : null}
        </AgentConfirmModal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

The three limits stay numeric fields with the prototype's hint lines; the page also gets the example chips, "Who is in the room" and the past-rooms table.

```tsx
// Team Room, no room selected: the task and limits form, who is in the room and
// what Agent OS does by itself, and the table of past rooms. Starting always
// goes through a confirm modal because it launches two real agents that may
// spend money on their own accounts.
import { useEffect, useState, type CSSProperties, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Bot, CheckCircle2, MessagesSquare, Play, RefreshCw, XCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { getExecutionGateStatus, listAgents, listTeamRooms, startTeamRoom } from "../../api";
import { navigateTo } from "../../nav";
import type { AgentSummary, ExecutionGateStatus, TeamRoomSummary } from "../../types";
import { COST_CAP_NOTE, OPENCLAW_MODEL_PATTERN, agentLabel, agentMaker, roomStatusView, usd } from "../teamRoomShared";
import AgentConfirmModal from "./AgentConfirmModal";
import Banner from "./Banner";
import EmptyState from "./EmptyState";
import PageHeader from "./PageHeader";
import { TimeAgo } from "./RelativeTime";
import StatusWord from "./StatusWord";
import TeamRoomProblem, { problemFromError, type TeamProblem } from "./TeamRoomProblem";
import { useInterval } from "./useInterval";

const MAX_TASK = 4000;

const EXAMPLES = [
  { label: "Launch checklist", task: "Draft a one-page launch checklist for the blog-site and agree on one version." },
  { label: "Organise notes", task: "Compare two ways to organise my research notes and agree on one." },
  { label: "Short README", task: "Write a short README for the my-app project that a new person can follow." }
];

// Status, task, turns, cost, started.
const ROOM_COLUMNS = "minmax(150px, 200px) minmax(0, 1fr) 84px 84px 96px";

function clampInt(raw: string, min: number, max: number): number | null {
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(raw.trim())) return null;
  const n = Number(raw);
  return n >= min && n <= max ? n : null;
}

function excerpt(text: string, max = 110) {
  const flat = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  return flat.length > max ? `${flat.slice(0, max - 1)}…` : flat;
}

function WhoRow({ id, agents, failed }: { id: "hermes" | "openclaw"; agents: AgentSummary[] | null; failed: boolean }) {
  const found = agents?.find((agent) => agent.id === id);
  let state: ReactNode;
  if (agents === null) state = failed ? "—" : "…";
  else if (!found) state = "—";
  else if (found.detected.installed) {
    state = (
      <>
        Installed{found.detected.version ? <> · <code className="os-mono">{found.detected.version}</code></> : null}
      </>
    );
  } else {
    state = (
      <>
        Not installed{" "}
        <button type="button" className="os-team__link" onClick={() => navigateTo("setup")}>
          Open Setup
        </button>
      </>
    );
  }
  return (
    <li>
      <Bot size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div>
        <b>{agentLabel(id)}</b>
        <span className="os-team__sub">{agentMaker(id)}</span>
        <span className="os-team__sub">{state}</span>
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

export default function TeamRoomStart({ onOpenRoom }: { onOpenRoom: (id: string) => void }) {
  const [rooms, setRooms] = useState<TeamRoomSummary[] | null>(null);
  const [roomsFailed, setRoomsFailed] = useState(false);
  const [gate, setGate] = useState<ExecutionGateStatus | null>(null);
  const [gateFailed, setGateFailed] = useState(false);
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<AgentSummary[] | null>(null);
  const [agentsFailed, setAgentsFailed] = useState(false);
  const [task, setTask] = useState("");
  const [turns, setTurns] = useState("6");
  const [minutes, setMinutes] = useState("10");
  const [cost, setCost] = useState("");
  const [openclawModel, setOpenclawModel] = useState("");
  const [confirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);
  const [starting, setStarting] = useState(false);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<TeamProblem | null>(null);

  async function loadRooms() {
    try {
      const { rooms: list } = await listTeamRooms();
      setRooms(list);
      setRoomsFailed(false);
    } catch {
      setRoomsFailed(true);
    }
  }
  async function loadGate() {
    try {
      setGate(await getExecutionGateStatus());
      setGateFailed(false);
    } catch {
      setGateFailed(true);
    }
  }
  async function loadAgents() {
    try {
      setAgents((await listAgents()).agents);
      setAgentsFailed(false);
    } catch {
      setAgentsFailed(true);
    }
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    void loadRooms();
    void loadGate();
    void loadAgents();
  }, []);
  useInterval(() => void loadRooms(), 5000);
  useInterval(() => void loadGate(), 15000);
  useInterval(() => void loadAgents(), 15000);

  const taskTrimmed = task.trim();
  const turnsValue = clampInt(turns, 2, 12);
  const minutesValue = clampInt(minutes, 1, 30);
  const costBlank = cost.trim() === "";
  const costValue = costBlank ? null : Number(cost);
  const costValid = costBlank || (Number.isFinite(costValue) && (costValue as number) > 0 && (costValue as number) <= 1000);
  const taskValid = taskTrimmed.length >= 1 && task.length <= MAX_TASK;
  const modelTrimmed = openclawModel.trim();
  const modelValid = modelTrimmed === "" || OPENCLAW_MODEL_PATTERN.test(modelTrimmed);
  const capSet = !costBlank && costValid;
  const formValid = taskValid && turnsValue !== null && minutesValue !== null && costValid && modelValid;
  const gateOff = gate !== null && (!gate.enabled || gate.level === 0);

  async function confirmStart() {
    if (!formValid || turnsValue === null || minutesValue === null) return;
    setStarting(true);
    setProblem(null);
    try {
      const room = await startTeamRoom({
        task: taskTrimmed,
        limits: { maxTurns: turnsValue, maxMinutes: minutesValue, maxCostUsd: costBlank ? null : (costValue as number) },
        ...(modelTrimmed ? { openclawModel: modelTrimmed } : {})
      });
      setConfirmOpen(false);
      onOpenRoom(room.id);
    } catch (error) {
      setConfirmOpen(false);
      const next = problemFromError(error);
      setProblem(next);
      if (next.code === "execution_gate_off") void loadGate();
    } finally {
      setStarting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="os-team__startpage">
      <PageHeader
        title="Team Room"
        titleId="os-team-title"
        lede="Hermes Agent and OpenClaw talk a task through, one message at a time. You set the limits, read along, and decide what gets saved."
      />

      {gateOff ? <TeamRoomProblem problem={{ code: "execution_gate_off", message: "" }} onOpenRoom={onOpenRoom} /> : null}
      {gateFailed && gate === null ? (
        <Banner tone="info">Couldn&apos;t check the Safety setting just now. Starting a room will tell you if it is blocking.</Banner>
      ) : null}
      {problem ? <TeamRoomProblem problem={problem} onOpenRoom={onOpenRoom} /> : null}

      <div className="os-team__start">
        <form
          className="os-team__form"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            if (formValid && !gateOff) setConfirmOpen(true);
          }}
        >
          <h2 className="os-team__h">The task</h2>
          <label className="os-field">
            <span className="os-field__label">What should the two of them work out together?</span>
            <textarea
              rows={4}
              value={task}
              onChange={(event) => setTask(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="For example: Compare two ways to organise my research notes and agree on one."
              aria-describedby="os-team-task-count"
            />
            <span
              id="os-team-task-count"
              className={`os-team__count os-mono${task.length > MAX_TASK ? " os-team__count--over" : ""}`}
            >
              {task.length.toLocaleString()} / {MAX_TASK.toLocaleString()}
            </span>
          </label>
          <div className="os-team__examples" role="group" aria-label="Example tasks">
            <span className="os-team__small">Or try one:</span>
            {EXAMPLES.map((example) => (
              <button
                key={example.label}
                type="button"
                className="os-chip os-team__example"
                onClick={() => {
                  setTask(example.task);
                  document.querySelector<HTMLTextAreaElement>(".os-team__form textarea")?.focus();
                }}
              >
                {example.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <h2 className="os-team__h os-team__h--spaced">Limits</h2>
          <div className="os-team__limit-fields">
            <label className="os-field">
              <span className="os-field__label">Turns (2 to 12)</span>
              <input
                inputMode="numeric"
                value={turns}
                onChange={(event) => setTurns(event.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={turnsValue === null}
                aria-describedby="os-team-turns-hint"
              />
              <span id="os-team-turns-hint" className="os-team__hint">
                A turn is one message from one agent.
              </span>
            </label>
            <label className="os-field">
              <span className="os-field__label">Minutes (1 to 30)</span>
              <input
                inputMode="numeric"
                value={minutes}
                onChange={(event) => setMinutes(event.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={minutesValue === null}
                aria-describedby="os-team-minutes-hint"
              />
              <span id="os-team-minutes-hint" className="os-team__hint">
                The room stops when time is up. Time spent waiting for you does not count.
              </span>
            </label>
            <label className="os-field">
              <span className="os-field__label">Cost cap in USD (optional)</span>
              <input
                inputMode="decimal"
                value={cost}
                placeholder="No cap"
                onChange={(event) => setCost(event.target.value)}
                aria-invalid={!costValid}
                aria-describedby="os-team-cost-hint"
              />
              <span id="os-team-cost-hint" className="os-team__hint">
                The room stops if the cost reaches this.
              </span>
            </label>
          </div>
          <p className="os-team__hint">The room stops at whichever limit comes first. Hermes Agent speaks first.</p>
          {capSet ? (
            <p className="os-team__protocol" role="note">
              {COST_CAP_NOTE}
            </p>
          ) : null}
          <label className="os-field os-team__model">
            <span className="os-field__label">OpenClaw model for this room (optional)</span>
            <input
              value={openclawModel}
              placeholder="OpenClaw's own setting"
              maxLength={100}
              spellCheck={false}
              autoCapitalize="off"
              onChange={(event) => setOpenclawModel(event.target.value)}
              aria-invalid={!modelValid}
              aria-describedby="os-team-model-help"
            />
            <span id="os-team-model-help" className="os-team__hint">
              {modelValid
                ? "Leave empty to use OpenClaw's own setting. Example: ollama/phi4"
                : "Use only letters, numbers and . _ : / - (no spaces, and don't start with -). Example: ollama/phi4"}
            </span>
          </label>

          <div className="os-team__go">
            <button type="submit" className="os-btn os-btn--primary" disabled={!formValid || gateOff}>
              <Play size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
              Start room
            </button>
            <span className="os-team__hint">
              {!formValid && taskTrimmed.length > 0
                ? "Check the fields above: turns 2 to 12, minutes 1 to 30, cost above 0, and a plain model name."
                : "You can stop it at any time."}
            </span>
          </div>
        </form>

        <div className="os-team__aside">
          <h2 className="os-team__h">Who is in the room</h2>
          <ul className="os-team__who">
            <WhoRow id="hermes" agents={agents} failed={agentsFailed} />
            <WhoRow id="openclaw" agents={agents} failed={agentsFailed} />
          </ul>
          <p className="os-team__hint">
            Each agent uses the brain you chose on{" "}
            <button type="button" className="os-team__link" onClick={() => navigateTo("agents")}>
              Agents
            </button>
            .
          </p>

          <h2 className="os-team__h os-team__h--spaced">What Agent OS does by itself</h2>
          <p className="os-team__lede-small">
            In this room the agents only talk. Agent OS passes each message along, and it asks you before it saves anything.
          </p>
          <ul className="os-team__does">
            <li className="yes">
              <CheckCircle2 size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
              <div>
                <b>Saves a file you approve</b>
                <span className="os-team__sub">
                  Only <code>.md</code>, <code>.txt</code> or <code>.html</code>, only inside the Workspace sandbox, and only after both agents agree
                  and you press Approve.
                </span>
              </div>
            </li>
            <li className="yes">
              <CheckCircle2 size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
              <div>
                <b>Lets you Undo any save</b>
                <span className="os-team__sub">Undo puts the sandbox back as it was before.</span>
              </div>
            </li>
            <li className="no">
              <XCircle size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
              <div>Never runs commands or touches your project folders</div>
            </li>
            <li className="no">
              <XCircle size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
              <div>Never sends messages or emails for you</div>
            </li>
            <li className="no">
              <XCircle size={18} aria-hidden="true" />
              <div>Never goes past the turns or minutes you set. The cost cap only counts turns that report a cost.</div>
            </li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>

      <section className="os-team__past" aria-labelledby="os-team-past">
        <h2 id="os-team-past" className="os-team__h">
          Past rooms
        </h2>
        {roomsFailed && rooms !== null ? <Banner tone="warn">Couldn&apos;t refresh your rooms just now. This is the last list Agent OS sent.</Banner> : null}
        {rooms === null && roomsFailed ? (
          <Banner
            tone="danger"
            actions={
              <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void loadRooms()}>
                <RefreshCw size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> Retry
              </button>
            }
          >
            Couldn&apos;t load your rooms. Agent OS isn&apos;t responding.
          </Banner>
        ) : rooms === null ? (
          <p className="os-team__hint" aria-live="polite">
            …
          </p>
        ) : rooms.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState icon={MessagesSquare} title="No rooms yet" body="Write a task above and start your first one." />
        ) : (
          <div className="os-table os-team__rooms" role="table" aria-label="Past rooms" style={{ "--os-table-cols": ROOM_COLUMNS } as CSSProperties}>
            <div className="os-table__head" role="row">
              {["Status", "Task", "Turns", "Cost", "Started"].map((heading) => (
                <span key={heading} className="os-table__cell os-micro" role="columnheader">
                  {heading}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
            {rooms.map((room) => {
              const view = roomStatusView({ status: room.status, pausedFor: room.pausedFor });
              return (
                <div key={room.id} className="os-table__row os-team__room-row" role="row">
                  <div className="os-table__cell os-team__room-status" role="cell">
                    <StatusWord state={view.state} label={view.label} />
                    {room.status === "needs_you" && !room.pausedFor && room.needsApproval > 0 ? (
                      <span className="os-team__small">{room.needsApproval} waiting for your approval</span>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                  <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">
                    <button type="button" className="os-team__room-open" onClick={() => onOpenRoom(room.id)}>
                      {excerpt(room.task)}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="os-table__cell os-mono" role="cell" title="Turns used / turns allowed">
                    {room.turnsDone}/{room.turnsAllowed}
                  </div>
                  <div className="os-table__cell os-mono" role="cell" title={typeof room.costUsd === "number" ? undefined : "No turn reported a cost"}>
                    {usd(room.costUsd)}
                  </div>
                  <div className="os-table__cell os-team__small" role="cell">
                    <TimeAgo since={room.createdAt} />
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </section>

      {confirmOpen ? (
        <AgentConfirmModal
          title="Start this Team Room?"
          confirmLabel="Start room"
          busy={starting}
          onConfirm={() => void confirmStart()}
          onClose={() => (starting ? null : setConfirmOpen(false))}
        >
          <p>
            This starts real Hermes Agent and OpenClaw runs on this computer, for up to{" "}
            <strong className="os-mono">{turnsValue}</strong> turns or <strong className="os-mono">{minutesValue}</strong> minutes.
          </p>
          <p>
            Each turn may cost money on those agents&apos; own model accounts.{" "}
            {costBlank ? "You have not set a cost cap." : `The room stops if known cost reaches $${costValue}.`}
          </p>
          {capSet ? <p>{COST_CAP_NOTE}</p> : null}
          {modelTrimmed ? (
            <p>
              OpenClaw will use <strong className="os-mono">{modelTrimmed}</strong> in this room.
            </p>
          ) : null}
          <p>The room asks you before it saves any file, and you can stop it at any time.</p>
        </AgentConfirmModal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

The page keeps `import "../ui/runs.css"` because the live turn embeds `RunConsole`, whose rules live there.

```tsx
// Team Room screen: Hermes Agent and OpenClaw discuss a task in turns while
// you watch. With no ?room=<id> it shows the start form and past rooms; with
// one it shows that room live. The route is page=team. Each of the two views
// draws its own page header (one h1, "Team Room").
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { navigateTo, queryParam } from "../nav";
import TeamRoomStart from "../ui/components/TeamRoomStart";
import TeamRoomView from "../ui/components/TeamRoomView";
import "../ui/runs.css";
import "../ui/teamRoom.css";

export default function TeamRoomPage() {
  const [roomId, setRoomId] = useState(() => queryParam("room"));
  const pageRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const firstRender = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    function sync() {
      setRoomId(queryParam("room"));
    }
    window.addEventListener("aos-navigate", sync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("aos-navigate", sync);
  }, []);

  // Opening or closing a room swaps the whole view, so the button that was
  // clicked disappears. Put the focus on the page itself so a keyboard or
  // screen reader user starts at the top of the new view.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (firstRender.current) {
      firstRender.current = false;
      return;
    }
    pageRef.current?.focus();
  }, [roomId]);

  function openRoom(id: string) {
    setRoomId(id);
    navigateTo("team", { room: id });
  }
  function closeRoom() {
    setRoomId("");
    navigateTo("team");
  }

  return (
    <div className="os-team" ref={pageRef} tabIndex={-1} role="region" aria-labelledby="os-team-title">
      {roomId ? <TeamRoomView roomId={roomId} onBack={closeRoom} /> : <TeamRoomStart onOpenRoom={openRoom} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

/* Team Room (SP2, Task A3). Cobalt tokens only (src/ui/tokens.css), no colour

}
.os-team__decision-head svg {
  flex: none;
  color: var(--os-warn);
}
.os-team__decision[data-state="saved"] .os-team__decision-head svg,
.os-team__decision[data-state="recorded"] .os-team__decision-head svg {
  color: var(--os-ok);
}
.os-team__decision[data-state="rejected"] .os-team__decision-head svg,
.os-team__decision[data-state="undone"] .os-team__decision-head svg {
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
.os-team__decision[data-state="refused"] .os-team__decision-head svg {
  color: var(--os-danger);
}
.os-team__decision .os-team__sub {
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-1);
}
.os-team__summary {
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: var(--os-sp-2) 0 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-14);
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.os-team__file {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--os-sp-2);
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-3);
}
.os-team__file code {
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  font-weight: 500;
}
.os-team__prev-wrap {
  margin: var(--os-sp-3) 0 0;
  padding-left: var(--os-sp-3);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--os-line-3);
}
.os-team__prev {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 2px 0;
  font: 400 var(--os-fs-12) / 1.7 var(--os-font-mono);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.os-team__prev[tabindex] {
  max-height: 18em;
  overflow: auto;
}
.os-team__more {
  display: block;
  padding: 2px 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  font: 400 var(--os-fs-12) / 1.7 var(--os-font-mono);
  color: var(--os-text-3);
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.os-team__more:hover {
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-team__note {
  margin: var(--os-sp-3) 0 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-team__acts {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--os-sp-2);
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-4);
}
.os-team__decision [role="alert"],
.os-team__decision [role="status"] {
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-3);
}
.os-team__talking {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.os-team__talking li {
  padding: var(--os-sp-3) 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--os-line-1);
}
.os-team__talking li:first-child {
  padding-top: 0;
  border-top: 0;
}
.os-team__talk-head {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--os-sp-2);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}

/* ---- Limits and notebook ---- */
.os-team__limits,
.os-team__notebook {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--os-sp-3);
}
.os-team__meters {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--os-sp-3);
}
.os-team__foot-note {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-team__notebook-text .os-team__text {
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}

/* ---- Start page ---- */
.os-team__start {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 620px) minmax(0, 1fr);
  column-gap: var(--os-sp-9);
  align-items: start;
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-3);
}
.os-team__form,
.os-team__aside {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--os-sp-3);
  min-width: 0;
}
.os-team__form textarea {
  min-height: 96px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  resize: vertical;
}
.os-team__count {
  align-self: flex-end;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
.os-team__count--over {
  color: var(--os-danger);
}
.os-team__examples {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--os-sp-2);
}
.os-team__example {
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color var(--os-dur-quick) var(--os-ease-out), color var(--os-dur-quick) var(--os-ease-out);
}
.os-team__example:hover {
  border-color: var(--os-line-3);
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
.os-team__limit-fields {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--os-sp-4);
}
.os-team__limit-fields .os-team__hint {
  min-height: 3.6em;
}
.os-team__go {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--os-sp-4);
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-5);
}
.os-team__who,
.os-team__does {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.os-team__who li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr);
  column-gap: var(--os-sp-3);
  padding: var(--os-sp-3) 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--os-line-1);
}
.os-team__who li:first-child {
  padding-top: var(--os-sp-1);
  border-top: 0;
}
.os-team__who svg,
.os-team__does svg {
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
.os-team__who b {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-15);
  font-weight: 640;
  font-stretch: 90%;
}
.os-team__does li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr);
  column-gap: var(--os-sp-3);
  padding: var(--os-sp-3) 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--os-line-1);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-14);
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.os-team__does li:first-child {
  padding-top: var(--os-sp-1);
  border-top: 0;
}
.os-team__does .yes svg {
  color: var(--os-ok);
}
.os-team__does b {
  font-weight: 620;
}

/* ---- Past rooms (table rows come from kit.css) ---- */
.os-team__past {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--os-sp-3);
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-5);
}
.os-team__room-row {
  position: relative;
}
.os-team__room-row:hover,
.os-team__room-row:focus-within {
  background: var(--os-surface-1);
}
.os-team__room-status {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 2px;
}
.os-team__room-open {
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-14);
  color: var(--os-text-1);
  text-align: left;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  cursor: pointer;
}
/* The whole row opens the room: the button stretches over it. */
.os-team__room-open::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
}

/* ---- Widths ---- */
@media (max-width: 1320px) {
  .os-team__start {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 340px;
    column-gap: var(--os-sp-7);
  }
  .os-team__room {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 340px;
    column-gap: var(--os-sp-7);
  }
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .os-team__start,
  .os-team__room {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    row-gap: var(--os-sp-7);
  }
  .os-team__jump {
    display: inline;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .os-team__limit-fields {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .os-team__bar {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: var(--os-sp-3);
  }
  .os-team__rooms .os-table__head {
    display: none;
  }
  .os-team__rooms .os-table__row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--os-sp-2) var(--os-sp-4);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .os-team *,
  .os-team *::before,
  .os-team *::after {
    transition: none !important;
    animation: none !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}

### Task B3: Workspace page (Cobalt, "Saved by", Undo this save, Copy path, Show in Finder)

Why this exists, in plain words: the Workspace page is the one place a person can see every file Agent OS and their agents have kept. After this task it is built on the new Cobalt page kit instead of the old `PageFrame` and `aos-*` look, with the orange "Filter" button and every other old orange gone. It keeps the same four endpoints (`GET /api/workspace`, `GET /api/workspace/file`, `GET /api/workspace/raw`, `POST /api/workspace/files`) and the sandboxed HTML preview frame, and it adds the things the spec asks for:
- every file says **who saved it** ("You", "Agent OS", "Team Room (Hermes)", "Changed outside Agent OS", or "—" when nobody knows), read from Task B2's `savedBy`;
- a **Saved by agents** filter chip and an "n saved by agents" count;
- **Undo this save** on a file a Team Room saved, through the existing `POST /api/team-rooms/:id/actions/:aid/undo` route, never offered when the Team Room history is gone (Review Focus 3);
- **Copy path**, and **Show in Finder** in the desktop app only (hidden in the browser).

**Depends on:** Task B2 (the `savedBy` field and `summary.savedByAgents`; this task stops in Step 1 if they are missing) and Task C1 (the page kit: `PageHeader`, `Banner`, `EmptyState`, and `src/ui/kit.css`). Run it after both are merged. It does not depend on any Team Room task: the page only reads `savedBy` and calls the undo route that exists today.

**The three things a worker must not skip:**
1. **Show in Finder needs an owner decision.** `tauri-plugin-opener` is not in this repo today (checked: no match in `desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml`, `desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/default.json`, `desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs` or `package.json`). Part 2 asks the owner before anything is installed and has both outcomes written out. The page code is the same in both; only one flag and one function body differ.
2. **The page needs the real folder on disk to reveal it.** The listing's `publicPath` is always the display text `~/.hermes-agent-os/...` (it is hard-coded in `server/runtime/store.js`, line 76, and a test pins that it never holds the real home folder). If `AGENT_OS_HOME` is set it is simply wrong as a real path. Part 1 therefore adds one small, tested field, `roots[].absolutePath`, that is `null` on the public demo.
3. **Undo removes or restores a file, so it asks first.** The Team Room page asks with `AgentConfirmModal` (titled "Undo this save?" after Task A3). The Workspace reuses the same dialog with the same title, so both pages behave alike and the modal keeps its focus trap and `os-modal-title`.

**Decisions this task makes (so nobody has to guess):**
- **Notes keep landing in `notes/`**, as today (the prototype says `inbox/`; the real page has always saved to `notes/`, and moving where a person's notes go is not part of this task). The copy says "notes/".
- **A note never silently replaces an existing file.** Today the server overwrites without asking. The form checks the loaded list and asks first ("notes/x.md already exists. Saving replaces what is in it.").
- **Filtering moves into the browser.** The page loads the whole list once (the server already caps it at 500 files) and filters by type, name, folder and "Saved by agents" instantly. It no longer sends `query` or `kind` to the server. If exactly 500 files come back, the count line says the list stops there.
- **The old folder buttons (Demo, Notes, Loop folder, Vault, Swarm, Video) go away.** Files are grouped by folder like the prototype. The `?folder=` and `?file=` links that other pages use (Loop, Swarm, Studio, Memory) keep working: a `?folder=loop` link shows an extra "Folder loop/ ×" chip that filters the list, and a `?file=` link opens that file.
- **The "Open Loop" button goes away** (the prototype has none). Loop is a Labs page; the empty `loop/` folder state still offers an "Open Loop" button.
- **The page root is a `<section aria-labelledby>`**, like the kit's Sessions example, so the old `PageFrame` `<main>` goes with `PageFrame`. The app then has no `<main>` landmark on core pages; that is a shell question (see the summary), not something one page should fix alone.
- **Notices live in the pane, not in a toast.** The shell owns the one toast (Hold to stop all). A good result ("Saved notes/x.md.", "Undone. ...", "Copied the path.") is a status line that goes away after 8 seconds; a problem is a `Banner` with a Dismiss button and stays.
- **No polling.** The old page never polled. It keeps a Refresh button, and refreshes after its own actions (save, undo). Adding 5 s polling would walk up to 500 files and read Team Room logs (B2) every 5 s for no clear gain.
- **`audit.mjs` needs no change:** no mode checks this page's `h1` (the only `h1` check is the Sessions one in `deeplinks`, line 96), and the `h1` stays "Workspace" anyway. The `pages` mode does check this page for sideways scroll and console errors at three sizes, and Step 20 runs it.

**Review Focus 3, UI side** (the server side is Task B2): a file whose Team Room history is gone, whose log is damaged, or that changed after an agent saved it arrives with `savedBy.kind` of `"unknown"`. The page shows "—", or the server's own words "Changed outside Agent OS" (decision P10), never offers "Undo this save", and does not crash. The probe `workspace.mjs` proves each of those, plus a corrupted `team-room` record with no `roomId` (also no Undo) and an Undo that the server refuses (a plain-words message, the list refreshes).

- [ ] **Step 8: Create the desktop helper (both outcomes).**

Create `src/ui/desktop.ts`. As written here it is the "no opener" version: `OPENER_INSTALLED` is `false`, so `canRevealInFinder()` is always `false` and the page hides the button everywhere. Step 9 swaps the marked block if the owner said yes. The page code never changes.

```ts
// Is this window the Agent OS desktop app (the Tauri shell) rather than a
// browser tab? The Rust shell opens the window with ?desktop=1, and the shell
// keeps that parameter (main.tsx removes only ?launch). window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__
// is the fallback marker. UpdateBanner.tsx keeps its own private copy of this check.
export function isDesktopApp(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return false;
  if (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("desktop") === "1") return true;
  return "__TAURI_INTERNALS__" in window;
}

// OPENER-START (Task B3). Step 9 replaces everything between these two markers
// when the owner has approved tauri-plugin-opener. Nothing else in the file changes.
export const OPENER_INSTALLED = false;

export async function revealInFinder(_absolutePath: string): Promise<void> {
  throw new Error("Show in Finder is not available in this build.");
}
// OPENER-END

// The Workspace page shows its "Show in Finder" button only when this is true:
// in the desktop app, and only when the opener is installed. In a browser tab
// there is no Finder to open, so the button is simply not drawn.
export function canRevealInFinder(): boolean {
  return OPENER_INSTALLED && isDesktopApp();
}
```

Run `npx tsc -b`. Expected: no output.

#### Part 3: pure page logic and the small markdown reader

Why: the page's rules are small functions that need no screen: what kind a file is, which files a filter keeps, when Undo may be offered, what a note is called, and what each error says in plain words. Written and checked first, in plain Node, they cannot hide behind the UI. There is no unit-test runner for `src/` in this repo, so the check is a throwaway script that bundles the two files with esbuild (already in `node_modules`: it is Vite's bundler, so nothing is installed) and runs `node:assert`. It lives in the git-ignored audit folder and is **not committed**.

- [ ] **Step 10: Write the check first, and see it fail.**

Create `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/workspace-logic.mjs` (git-ignored):

````js
// Throwaway check of the Workspace page's pure logic and the small Markdown
// reader. Not part of the repo (git-ignored). Run it from the worktree root:
//   node .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/workspace-logic.mjs
// It bundles src/ui/workspaceShared.ts and src/ui/miniMarkdown.tsx with esbuild
// (already in node_modules: it is Vite's bundler) into .superpowers/ui-audit/.tmp/,
// then runs plain assertions. No browser and no server are needed.
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { mkdir, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const REPO = path.resolve(HERE, "../../..");
const { build } = createRequire(path.join(REPO, "package.json"))("esbuild");
const OUT = path.join(REPO, ".superpowers/ui-audit/.tmp");
await mkdir(OUT, { recursive: true });

async function bundle(entry, name) {
  const outfile = path.join(OUT, `${name}.mjs`);
  await build({ entryPoints: [entry], outfile, bundle: true, packages: "external", platform: "node", format: "esm", jsx: "automatic", logLevel: "silent" });
  return import(`${pathToFileURL(outfile).href}?t=${Date.now()}`);
}
// One bundle holds both the logic and the two error classes it tests with, so `instanceof` agrees.
await writeFile(path.join(OUT, "shared-entry.ts"), 'export * from "../../../src/ui/workspaceShared";\nexport { ApiError, TeamRoomError } from "../../../src/api";\n');
const S = await bundle(path.join(OUT, "shared-entry.ts"), "workspace-shared");
const { ApiError, TeamRoomError } = S;
const { default: MiniMarkdown } = await bundle(path.join(REPO, "src/ui/miniMarkdown.tsx"), "mini-markdown");
const { renderToStaticMarkup } = await import("react-dom/server");
const { createElement } = await import("react");
const render = (source) => renderToStaticMarkup(createElement(MiniMarkdown, { source }));

const ROOM = "room-20261012-093000-ab12";
const file = (over = {}) => ({
  id: "workspace/notes/a.md", name: "a.md", relativePath: "notes/a.md", root: "workspace", kind: "text", size: 10,
  updatedAt: "2026-10-12T09:00:00.000Z", publicPath: "~/.hermes-agent-os/workspace/notes/a.md",
  savedBy: { kind: "unknown", label: "—" }, ...over
});
let failures = 0;
function check(name, fn) {
  try { fn(); console.log(`PASS ${name}`); } catch (error) { failures += 1; console.log(`FAIL ${name}: ${String(error.message).split("\n")[0]}`); }
}

check("typeOf tells Markdown by extension, and trusts the server's kind", () => {
  assert.equal(S.typeOf({ name: "a.md", kind: "text" }), "md");
  assert.equal(S.typeOf({ name: "READ.MD", kind: "text" }), "md");
  assert.equal(S.typeOf({ name: "a.markdown", kind: "other" }), "other", "no text to show, so not Markdown");
  assert.equal(S.typeOf({ name: "a.txt", kind: "text" }), "txt");
  assert.equal(S.typeOf({ name: "a.json", kind: "text" }), "txt");
  assert.equal(S.typeOf({ name: "a.html", kind: "html" }), "html");
  assert.equal(S.typeOf({ name: "a.png", kind: "image" }), "image");
  assert.equal(S.typeOf({ name: "a.zip", kind: "other" }), "other");
  assert.equal(S.typeOf({ name: "a", kind: "surprise" }), "other");
});

check("sizes and plurals", () => {
  assert.equal(S.formatSize(0), "0 B");
  assert.equal(S.formatSize(1023), "1023 B");
  assert.equal(S.formatSize(1200), "1.2 KB");
  assert.equal(S.formatSize(3 * 1024 * 1024), "3 MB");
  assert.equal(S.formatSize(Number.NaN), "—");
  assert.equal(S.formatSize(-5), "—");
  assert.deepEqual([S.filesWord(0), S.filesWord(1), S.filesWord(2)], ["files", "file", "files"]);
});

check("groups, names and display paths", () => {
  const top = file({ id: "workspace/readme.md", name: "readme.md", relativePath: "readme.md" });
  const deep = file({ id: "workspace/notes/a/b.md", name: "b.md", relativePath: "notes/a/b.md" });
  const exp = file({ id: "exports/r.html", name: "r.html", relativePath: "r.html", root: "exports", kind: "html" });
  const exported = file({ id: "workspace/exports/x.md", name: "x.md", relativePath: "exports/x.md" });
  assert.equal(S.groupKeyOf(top), "");
  assert.equal(S.groupLabel(""), "Top level");
  assert.equal(S.groupKeyOf(deep), "notes");
  assert.equal(S.groupLabel("notes"), "notes/");
  assert.notEqual(S.groupKeyOf(exp), S.groupKeyOf(exported), "the exports root and a workspace folder named exports are two groups");
  assert.equal(S.groupLabel(S.groupKeyOf(exp)), "exports/");
  assert.equal(S.nameInGroup(deep), "a/b.md");
  assert.equal(S.nameInGroup(top), "readme.md");
  assert.equal(S.nameInGroup(exp), "r.html");
  assert.equal(S.displayPath(deep), "notes/a/b.md");
  assert.equal(S.displayPath(exp), "exports/r.html");
});

check("folderFromQuery accepts plain folder names only", () => {
  assert.equal(S.folderFromQuery("loop"), "loop");
  assert.equal(S.folderFromQuery("all"), "");
  assert.equal(S.folderFromQuery(""), "");
  assert.equal(S.folderFromQuery("../etc"), "");
  assert.equal(S.folderFromQuery("a/b"), "");
  assert.equal(S.folderFromQuery("x".repeat(65)), "");
});

check("filters: type, name, Saved by agents and folder, and the chip counts", () => {
  const a = file({ savedBy: { kind: "team-room", label: "Hermes", roomId: ROOM, actionId: "A1" } });
  const b = file({ id: "workspace/loop/b.txt", relativePath: "loop/b.txt", name: "b.txt", savedBy: { kind: "you", label: "You" } });
  const c = file({ id: "workspace/loop/c.html", relativePath: "loop/c.html", name: "c.html", kind: "html" });
  const e = file({ id: "exports/loop/d.png", relativePath: "loop/d.png", name: "d.png", root: "exports", kind: "image" });
  const all = [a, b, c, e];
  const none = { type: "all", query: "", onlyAgents: false, folder: "" };
  assert.equal(S.filterFiles(all, none).length, 4);
  assert.deepEqual(S.filterFiles(all, { ...none, type: "md" }).map((f) => f.name), ["a.md"]);
  assert.deepEqual(S.filterFiles(all, { ...none, query: " LOOP/ " }).map((f) => f.name), ["b.txt", "c.html", "d.png"]);
  assert.deepEqual(S.filterFiles(all, { ...none, onlyAgents: true }).map((f) => f.name), ["a.md"]);
  assert.deepEqual(S.filterFiles(all, { ...none, folder: "loop" }).map((f) => f.name), ["b.txt", "c.html", "d.png"], "the old rule: a folder further down in either root counts");
  assert.deepEqual(S.filterFiles(all, { ...none, folder: "LOOP", type: "html" }).map((f) => f.name), ["c.html"]);
  assert.equal(S.filterFiles([file({ savedBy: undefined })], { ...none, onlyAgents: true }).length, 0, "a file with no record is never counted as an agent's");
  const counts = S.countByType(all);
  assert.deepEqual([counts.all, counts.md, counts.txt, counts.html, counts.image, counts.pdf], [4, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0]);
});

check("groupFiles orders groups and puts the newest file first", () => {
  const top = file({ id: "workspace/z.md", name: "z.md", relativePath: "z.md" });
  const n1 = file({ id: "workspace/notes/old.md", name: "old.md", relativePath: "notes/old.md", updatedAt: "2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z" });
  const n2 = file({ id: "workspace/notes/new.md", name: "new.md", relativePath: "notes/new.md", updatedAt: "2026-10-11T00:00:00.000Z" });
  const d = file({ id: "workspace/drafts/x.md", name: "x.md", relativePath: "drafts/x.md" });
  const e = file({ id: "exports/e.html", name: "e.html", relativePath: "e.html", root: "exports", kind: "html" });
  const groups = S.groupFiles([e, n1, d, n2, top]);
  assert.deepEqual(groups.map((g) => g.label), ["Top level", "drafts/", "notes/", "exports/"]);
  assert.deepEqual(groups[2].files.map((f) => f.name), ["new.md", "old.md"]);
});

check("savedByView: the four kinds, and a damaged value reads —", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(S.savedByView({ kind: "you", label: "You" }), { who: "You", detail: "", unknown: false, byAgent: false, text: "You" });
  assert.equal(S.savedByView({ kind: "agent-os", label: "Agent OS" }).who, "Agent OS");
  const team = S.savedByView({ kind: "team-room", label: " Hermes ", roomId: "r", actionId: "A1" });
  assert.deepEqual([team.who, team.detail, team.byAgent, team.text], ["Team Room", "Hermes", true, "Team Room (Hermes)"]);
  assert.equal(S.savedByView({ kind: "team-room", label: "—" }).text, "Team Room");
  assert.deepEqual(S.savedByView({ kind: "unknown", label: "—" }), { who: "—", detail: "", unknown: true, byAgent: false, text: "—" });
  // Decision P10: a Team Room file changed after the save reads the server's own words, never "You".
  assert.deepEqual(S.savedByView({ kind: "unknown", label: "Changed outside Agent OS" }), { who: "Changed outside Agent OS", detail: "", unknown: false, byAgent: false, text: "Changed outside Agent OS" });
  assert.equal(S.savedByView(undefined).unknown, true);
  assert.equal(S.savedByView(null).who, "—");
  assert.equal(S.savedByView({ kind: "surprise", label: "x" }).who, "—");
  assert.equal(S.savedByView({ kind: "team-room", label: "x".repeat(200) }).detail.length, 60);
});

check("undoTarget: Undo only for a Team Room save with two real ids (Review Focus 3)", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(S.undoTarget({ kind: "team-room", label: "Hermes", roomId: ROOM, actionId: "A1" }), { roomId: ROOM, actionId: "A1" });
  assert.equal(S.undoTarget({ kind: "unknown", label: "—" }), null);
  assert.equal(S.undoTarget({ kind: "you", label: "You" }), null);
  assert.equal(S.undoTarget({ kind: "you", label: "You", roomId: ROOM, actionId: "A1" }), null, "ids on the wrong kind are ignored");
  assert.equal(S.undoTarget({ kind: "agent-os", label: "Agent OS" }), null);
  assert.equal(S.undoTarget({ kind: "team-room", label: "Hermes" }), null, "no ids");
  assert.equal(S.undoTarget({ kind: "team-room", label: "Hermes", roomId: ROOM }), null, "no action id");
  assert.equal(S.undoTarget({ kind: "team-room", label: "Hermes", roomId: "../x", actionId: "A1" }), null, "bad room id");
  assert.equal(S.undoTarget({ kind: "team-room", label: "Hermes", roomId: ROOM, actionId: "A1/../.." }), null, "bad action id");
  assert.equal(S.undoTarget({ kind: "team-room", label: "Hermes", roomId: ROOM, actionId: "B1" }), null);
  assert.equal(S.undoTarget(undefined), null);
  assert.equal(S.undoTarget(null), null);
});

check("undoProblemText: plain words for each refusal, never a raw code", () => {
  const t = (code, status = 409, message = code) => S.undoProblemText(new TeamRoomError(message, code, status));
  assert.match(t("action_not_found", 404), /record for this save is gone/);
  assert.match(t("room_not_found", 404), /record for this save is gone/);
  assert.match(t("already_undone"), /already undone/);
  assert.match(t("nothing_to_undo"), /nothing to undo/);
  assert.match(t("cannot_undo"), /cannot be undone/);
  assert.match(t("path_mismatch"), /Nothing was changed/);
  assert.match(t("backup_missing"), /from before this save is missing/);
  assert.equal(t("link_refused", 409, "A link is in the way. Nothing was changed."), "A link is in the way. Nothing was changed.");
  assert.match(t("link_refused", 409, "link_refused"), /link in the way was refused/);
  assert.equal(t("something_new", 400), "Undo did not work. Nothing was changed.");
  assert.match(t("internal_error", 500), /Something went wrong inside Agent OS/);
  assert.match(S.undoProblemText(new TypeError("Failed to fetch")), /can't be reached, so it is not known whether the save was undone/);
  assert.match(S.undoProblemText(new ApiError("x", "", 400)), /^Undo did not work\./);
});

check("saveProblemText and previewProblem", () => {
  assert.match(S.saveProblemText(new ApiError("big", "", 413)), /^That note is too big/);
  assert.match(S.saveProblemText(new ApiError("x", "", 403)), /outside the workspace/);
  assert.match(S.saveProblemText(new ApiError("x", "", 400)), /name or text/);
  assert.equal(S.saveProblemText(new ApiError("x", "Plain sentence from the server.", 400)), "Plain sentence from the server.");
  assert.match(S.saveProblemText(new ApiError("x", "", 500)), /Nothing was saved/);
  assert.equal(S.saveProblemText(new TypeError("Failed to fetch")), "Agent OS can't be reached. Nothing was saved.");
  assert.deepEqual(S.previewProblem(new ApiError("nope", "", 404)), { text: "This file is no longer in the workspace.", gone: true });
  const missing = S.previewProblem(new ApiError("ENOENT: no such file or directory, realpath '/Users/x/ws/a.md'", "", 500));
  assert.deepEqual(missing, { text: "This file is no longer in the workspace.", gone: true });
  assert.ok(!/ENOENT|Users/.test(missing.text), "the raw text is never shown");
  assert.equal(S.previewProblem(new ApiError("boom", "", 500)).gone, false);
  assert.match(S.previewProblem(new TypeError("Failed to fetch")).text, /can't be reached/);
});
