Run it from the worktree root:

```bash
node .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/workspace-logic.mjs 2>&1 | head -6
```

Expected: it stops with a stack trace that starts `Error: Build failed with 1 error:` and has a line ending `ERROR: Could not resolve "../../../src/ui/workspaceShared"`. In plain English: the file the check wants to test does not exist yet, so there is nothing to bundle. No `PASS` line appears.

- [ ] **Step 11: Create `src/ui/workspaceShared.ts`.**

What is in it, in the order of the file:
- **What a file is.** `typeOf` reads the server's `kind` and tells Markdown apart by `.md` (the server calls `.md`, `.txt`, `.json`, `.csv`, `.css`, `.js` and `.ts` all "text"). `TYPE_INFO` holds the three words each type needs: the chip word, the full name for the preview, and the little tag on a row. The Markdown, Text and HTML chips are always drawn; Images, Audio, Video, PDF and Other appear only when a file of that type exists.
- **Folders.** A file's group is its first folder. A file at the top of the workspace is in the `""` group (shown as "Top level"); everything in the Exports root is in the `"exports/"` group. The key ends in a slash on purpose: no real folder can be called that, so the Exports root and a workspace folder named `exports` stay two groups. `inFolder` is the old page's rule for `?folder=` links, kept as it was, so Loop, Swarm, Studio and Memory links still land where they did.
- **Filters and groups.** `filterFiles` is the one place that decides what the list shows. `groupFiles` puts top-level files first, folders A to Z, Exports last, and the newest file first inside a group.
- **Who saved it.** `savedByView` turns B2's `savedBy` into the words the page shows. Anything it does not recognise, including no value at all, reads `—` (and `Unknown` to a screen reader). `undoTarget` is **Review Focus 3** in one function: it returns the two ids only for a `team-room` save that has both, and both must look exactly like real ones. A file whose history is gone, a damaged record without `roomId`, and a file you saved over all give `null`, and the page then draws no Undo button.
- **Notes.** `noteFileName` cleans a name the way the server does (`sanitizeWriteRelativePath`), so the "Saved as" line on the form is the name that is really written, and a taken name is noticed before anything is overwritten. It also trims dashes off both ends, so "Ideas!" is not saved as `Ideas-.md`.
- **Paths.** `absolutePathOf` joins `roots[].absolutePath` (from Part 1) with the file's path. It is `null` on the public demo, and then there is nothing to reveal.
- **Plain words.** `undoProblemText`, `saveProblemText` and `previewProblem` never show a raw code (`backup_missing`) or a raw system error. One detail worth knowing: the server answers a missing file with a 500 whose text starts `ENOENT` (it does not map it to 404), so `previewProblem` reads both as "gone" and never shows that text, which names a real folder.

````ts
// Pure logic for the Workspace page: what kind a file is, how the list is
// filtered and grouped, how "Saved by" reads, when Undo may be offered, how a
// note name is cleaned, and plain-words messages for errors. No React in here,
// so every rule can be checked on its own (.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/workspace-logic.mjs).
import { ApiError, TeamRoomError } from "../api";
import type { WorkspaceFile, WorkspaceListedFile, WorkspaceListing, WorkspaceSavedBy } from "../types";

// ---------- what a file is ----------

export type TypeKey = "md" | "txt" | "html" | "image" | "audio" | "video" | "pdf" | "other";
export type TypeFilter = "all" | TypeKey;

// `chip` is the filter button's word, `label` the full name in the preview
// header, `tag` the small box on a list row.
export const TYPE_INFO: Record<TypeKey, { label: string; chip: string; tag: string }> = {
  md: { label: "Markdown", chip: "Markdown", tag: "MD" },
  txt: { label: "Text", chip: "Text", tag: "TXT" },
  html: { label: "HTML", chip: "HTML", tag: "HTML" },
  image: { label: "Image", chip: "Images", tag: "IMG" },
  audio: { label: "Audio", chip: "Audio", tag: "AUDIO" },
  video: { label: "Video", chip: "Video", tag: "VIDEO" },
  pdf: { label: "PDF", chip: "PDF", tag: "PDF" },
  other: { label: "Other", chip: "Other", tag: "FILE" }
};

// Three chips are always drawn. The others appear only when a file of that type exists.
export const ALWAYS_CHIPS: TypeKey[] = ["md", "txt", "html"];
export const OPTIONAL_CHIPS: TypeKey[] = ["image", "audio", "video", "pdf", "other"];

// The server stops listing at 500 files (MAX_FILES in server/runtime/workspace.js)
// and returns the text of a file only up to 256 KB (MAX_TEXT_PREVIEW_BYTES).
export const LIST_LIMIT = 500;
export const PREVIEW_MAX_BYTES = 256 * 1024;

type NameAndKind = Pick<WorkspaceFile, "name" | "kind">;
type WhereItLives = Pick<WorkspaceFile, "root" | "relativePath">;

// The server says "text" for .md, .txt, .json, .csv and so on. The page tells
// Markdown apart by its extension so it can draw it.
export function typeOf(file: NameAndKind): TypeKey {
  switch (file.kind) {
    case "text":
      return file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".md") ? "md" : "txt";
    case "html":
      return "html";
    case "image":
      return "image";
    case "audio":
      return "audio";
    case "video":
      return "video";
    case "pdf":
      return "pdf";
    default:
      return "other";
  }
}

export function formatSize(size: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(size) || size < 0) return "—";
  if (size < 1024) return `${size} B`;
  if (size < 1024 * 1024) return `${Math.round(size / 102.4) / 10} KB`;
  return `${Math.round(size / 104857.6) / 10} MB`;
}

export function filesWord(count: number): string {
  return count === 1 ? "file" : "files";
}

// ---------- folders ----------

// A file's group is its first folder ("notes"), "" for a file at the top of the
// workspace, and "exports/" (a name no real folder can have) for the Exports root.
export function groupKeyOf(file: WhereItLives): string {
  if (file.root === "exports") return "exports/";
  const slash = file.relativePath.indexOf("/");
  return slash === -1 ? "" : file.relativePath.slice(0, slash);
}

export function groupLabel(key: string): string {
  if (key === "") return "Top level";
  return key.endsWith("/") ? key : `${key}/`;
}

// The file's name inside its group: "notes/a/b.md" is "a/b.md" in the notes group.
export function nameInGroup(file: WhereItLives): string {
  if (file.root === "exports") return file.relativePath;
  const slash = file.relativePath.indexOf("/");
  return slash === -1 ? file.relativePath : file.relativePath.slice(slash + 1);
}

// The path shown to the person, relative to the workspace ("notes/plan.md").
export function displayPath(file: WhereItLives): string {
  return file.root === "exports" ? `exports/${file.relativePath}` : file.relativePath;
}

// The ?folder= link other pages use (Loop, Swarm, Studio, Memory). Anything
// that is not a plain folder name means "every folder".
export function folderFromQuery(raw: string): string {
  if (raw === "all") return "";
  return /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$/.test(raw) ? raw : "";
}

// The same rule the old page used: the folder is the first part of the path
// inside a root, or a folder further down (for example exports/<run>/...).
export function inFolder(file: Pick<WorkspaceFile, "id" | "relativePath">, folder: string): boolean {
  const wanted = folder.toLowerCase();
  if (!wanted) return true;
  return file.relativePath.toLowerCase().startsWith(`${wanted}/`) || file.id.toLowerCase().includes(`/${wanted}/`);
}

// ---------- filters, counts, groups ----------

export interface FileFilters {
  type: TypeFilter;
  query: string;
  onlyAgents: boolean;
  folder: string;
}

export function countByType(files: WorkspaceListedFile[]): Record<TypeFilter, number> {
  const counts: Record<TypeFilter, number> = { all: files.length, md: 0, txt: 0, html: 0, image: 0, audio: 0, video: 0, pdf: 0, other: 0 };
  for (const file of files) counts[typeOf(file)] += 1;
  return counts;
}

export function filterFiles(files: WorkspaceListedFile[], filters: FileFilters): WorkspaceListedFile[] {
  const query = filters.query.trim().toLowerCase();
  return files.filter((file) => {
    if (filters.type !== "all" && typeOf(file) !== filters.type) return false;
    if (filters.onlyAgents && file.savedBy?.kind !== "team-room") return false;
    if (filters.folder && !inFolder(file, filters.folder)) return false;
    if (query && !displayPath(file).toLowerCase().includes(query)) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

export interface FileGroup {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  files: WorkspaceListedFile[];
}

// Top-level files first, then folders A to Z, then Exports. Newest file first inside a group.
export function groupFiles(files: WorkspaceListedFile[]): FileGroup[] {
  const byKey = new Map<string, WorkspaceListedFile[]>();
  for (const file of files) {
    const key = groupKeyOf(file);
    const list = byKey.get(key);
    if (list) list.push(file);
    else byKey.set(key, [file]);
  }
  const rank = (key: string) => (key === "" ? 0 : key === "exports/" ? 2 : 1);
  return Array.from(byKey.entries())
    .sort(([a], [b]) => rank(a) - rank(b) || a.localeCompare(b))
    .map(([key, list]) => ({
      key,
      label: groupLabel(key),
      files: [...list].sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt.localeCompare(a.updatedAt) || a.relativePath.localeCompare(b.relativePath))
    }));
}

// ---------- who saved it ----------

export interface SavedByView {
  // The short word for a list row: "You", "Agent OS", "Team Room" or "—".
  who: string;
  // The agent's name for a Team Room save ("Hermes"), otherwise "".
  detail: string;
  // True when nobody is on record. The page shows "—" and tells a screen reader "Unknown".
  unknown: boolean;
  byAgent: boolean;
  // One plain phrase for the preview line and for tests: "Team Room (Hermes)".
  text: string;
}

export function savedByView(savedBy: WorkspaceSavedBy | null | undefined): SavedByView {
  const label = typeof savedBy?.label === "string" ? savedBy.label.trim().slice(0, 60) : "";
  switch (savedBy?.kind) {
    case "you":
      return { who: "You", detail: "", unknown: false, byAgent: false, text: "You" };
    case "agent-os":
      return { who: "Agent OS", detail: "", unknown: false, byAgent: false, text: "Agent OS" };
    case "team-room": {
      const detail = label && label !== "—" ? label : "";
      return { who: "Team Room", detail, unknown: false, byAgent: true, text: detail ? `Team Room (${detail})` : "Team Room" };
    }
    case "unknown":
      // The server may name what it knows without knowing who (decision P10):
      // "Changed outside Agent OS". A bare "—" or an empty label stays unknown.
      if (label && label !== "—") return { who: label, detail: "", unknown: false, byAgent: false, text: label };
      return { who: "—", detail: "", unknown: true, byAgent: false, text: "—" };
    default:
      return { who: "—", detail: "", unknown: true, byAgent: false, text: "—" };
  }
}

const ROOM_ID_PATTERN = /^room-\d{8}-\d{6}-[0-9a-f]{4}$/;
const ACTION_ID_PATTERN = /^A\d{1,4}$/;

// Review Focus 3: "Undo this save" is offered only when the server named a Team
// Room save with both ids, and both ids look exactly like real ones. A file
// whose history is gone, or that changed after the agent's save, arrives as kind
// "unknown", so this returns null and the page draws no Undo button.
export function undoTarget(savedBy: WorkspaceSavedBy | null | undefined): { roomId: string; actionId: string } | null {
  if (!savedBy || savedBy.kind !== "team-room") return null;
  const { roomId, actionId } = savedBy;
  if (typeof roomId !== "string" || typeof actionId !== "string") return null;
  return ROOM_ID_PATTERN.test(roomId) && ACTION_ID_PATTERN.test(actionId) ? { roomId, actionId } : null;
}

// ---------- notes ----------

export const NOTE_EXTS = ["md", "txt", "html"] as const;
export type NoteExt = (typeof NOTE_EXTS)[number];

// The file name the server will really write. It applies the same cleaning as
// sanitizeWriteRelativePath (server/runtime/workspace.js): any character that is
// not a letter, digit, dot, dash or underscore becomes a dash and runs of dashes
// shrink to one. It also trims dashes and dots off both ends, so "Ideas!" is not
// saved as "Ideas-.md". The server cleans an already clean name the same way, so
// the name shown in "Saved as" is the name that is written. An empty name
// becomes note-<date>. `todayIso` is a date such as "2026-10-12".
export function noteFileName(rawName: string, ext: NoteExt, todayIso: string): string {
  let base = rawName.trim().replace(/\.(md|txt|html)$/i, "");
  base = base.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, "-").replace(/-+/g, "-").replace(/^[.-]+/, "").slice(0, 80).replace(/[.-]+$/, "");
  if (!base) base = `note-${todayIso}`;
  return `${base}.${ext}`;
}

// ---------- paths ----------

// Joins a folder and a "a/b.md" path with the folder's own separator.
export function joinNative(root: string, relative: string): string {
  const sep = root.includes("\\") && !root.includes("/") ? "\\" : "/";
  const base = root.endsWith("/") || root.endsWith("\\") ? root.slice(0, -1) : root;
  return `${base}${sep}${relative.split("/").filter(Boolean).join(sep)}`;
}

type Roots = WorkspaceListing["roots"];

// The real path of a file on this machine, or null when the server did not say
// (the public demo). Only Show in Finder needs it.
export function absolutePathOf(file: WhereItLives, roots: Roots): string | null {
  const root = roots.find((item) => item.id === file.root);
  return root?.absolutePath ? joinNative(root.absolutePath, file.relativePath) : null;
}

// What Copy path puts on the clipboard: the real path when known, else the display path.
export function copyPathOf(file: WhereItLives & Pick<WorkspaceFile, "publicPath">, roots: Roots): string {
  return absolutePathOf(file, roots) || file.publicPath;
}

// The workspace folder as the page shows it ("~/.hermes-agent-os/workspace") and,
// when the server says so, as the real path on this machine (for Show in Finder).
export function sandboxPaths(roots: Roots): { display: string; absolute: string | null } {
  const root = roots.find((item) => item.id === "workspace");
  return { display: root?.publicPath || "", absolute: root?.absolutePath || null };
}

// ---------- messages in plain words ----------

export interface Notice {
  tone: "ok" | "warn" | "danger";
  text: string;
}

// A fetch that never got an answer throws a plain TypeError, not one of our two error classes.
function unreachable(error: unknown): boolean {
  return !(error instanceof ApiError) && !(error instanceof TeamRoomError);
}

export function undoProblemText(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof TeamRoomError) {
    switch (error.code) {
      case "room_not_found":
      case "action_not_found":
        return "The Team Room record for this save is gone, so Agent OS cannot undo it from here. The file is unchanged.";
      case "already_undone":
        return "That save was already undone.";
      case "nothing_to_undo":
        return "That save was refused when it was made, so there is nothing to undo.";
      case "cannot_undo":
        return "That kind of save cannot be undone.";
      case "path_mismatch":
        return "The Team Room record does not match this file, so Undo refused. Nothing was changed.";
      case "backup_missing":
        return "The copy of the file from before this save is missing, so Agent OS cannot undo it. The file is unchanged.";
      case "link_refused":
        return error.message && error.message !== "link_refused"
          ? error.message
          : "A link in the way was refused, so Undo did nothing. Nothing was changed.";
      default:
        return error.status >= 500
          ? "Something went wrong inside Agent OS. Press Refresh to see how the file is now."
          : "Undo did not work. Nothing was changed.";
    }
  }
  if (unreachable(error)) return "Agent OS can't be reached, so it is not known whether the save was undone. Press Refresh to check.";
  return "Undo did not work. Press Refresh to see how the file is now.";
}

export function saveProblemText(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof ApiError) {
    if (error.detail) return error.detail;
    if (error.status === 413) return "That note is too big. A note can hold up to 256 KB of text.";
    if (error.status === 403) return "That place is outside the workspace, so nothing was saved.";
    if (error.status === 400) return "Agent OS could not save a note with that name or text. Change the name and try again.";
    return "Agent OS could not save the note. Nothing was saved.";
  }
  if (unreachable(error)) return "Agent OS can't be reached. Nothing was saved.";
  return "Agent OS could not save the note. Nothing was saved.";
}

// `gone` means the file left the workspace since the list loaded. The server
// answers 500 with an ENOENT text for a missing file (it does not map it to 404),
// so both are read as "gone". The raw text is never shown.
export function previewProblem(error: unknown): { text: string; gone: boolean } {
  if (error instanceof ApiError && (error.status === 404 || /ENOENT/.test(error.message))) {
    return { text: "This file is no longer in the workspace.", gone: true };
  }
  if (unreachable(error)) return { text: "Agent OS can't be reached, so this file could not be opened.", gone: false };
  return { text: "Agent OS could not open this file.", gone: false };
}
````

- [ ] **Step 12: Create `src/ui/miniMarkdown.tsx`.**

A reader for the few things a note needs: `#`, `##`, `###` headings, bullet and numbered lists, fenced code, `**bold**` and `` `code` ``. It makes React elements, never HTML text: every piece of the note goes through React, which escapes it, so `<script>` in a note is shown as text. There are no links and no images. Headings are drawn as `h3`, `h4`, `h5`, because the page's `h1` is "Workspace" and the preview's `h2` is the file name. Anything it does not understand is shown as plain text, and odd input (an unclosed fence, a lone `-`) cannot loop.

````tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

// A small, safe Markdown reader for the Workspace preview. It draws headings
// (#, ##, ###), bullet and numbered lists, fenced code, **bold** and `code`,
// and nothing else: no links, no images, no raw HTML. Every piece of text goes
// through React, which escapes it, so a note can never inject markup. Anything
// it does not understand is shown as plain text.

type Block =
  | { kind: "heading"; level: 1 | 2 | 3; text: string }
  | { kind: "ul" | "ol"; items: string[] }
  | { kind: "code"; text: string }
  | { kind: "p"; text: string };

const BULLET = /^\s*[-*]\s+(.*)$/;
const NUMBERED = /^\s*\d+[.)]\s+(.*)$/;
const STARTS_A_BLOCK = /^(#{1,3}\s|\s*[-*]\s|\s*\d+[.)]\s|\s*```)/;

function parse(source: string): Block[] {
  const blocks: Block[] = [];
  const lines = source.replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n").split("\n");
  let i = 0;
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i];
    if (!line.trim()) {
      i += 1;
      continue;
    }
    if (line.trimStart().startsWith("```")) {
      const body: string[] = [];
      i += 1;
      while (i < lines.length && !lines[i].trimStart().startsWith("```")) {
        body.push(lines[i]);
        i += 1;
      }
      i += 1; // the closing fence (or the end of the text)
      blocks.push({ kind: "code", text: body.join("\n") });
      continue;
    }
    const heading = /^(#{1,3})\s+(.*)$/.exec(line);
    if (heading) {
      blocks.push({ kind: "heading", level: heading[1].length as 1 | 2 | 3, text: heading[2] });
      i += 1;
      continue;
    }
    const bullet = BULLET.test(line);
    if (bullet || NUMBERED.test(line)) {
      const pattern = bullet ? BULLET : NUMBERED;
      const items: string[] = [];
      while (i < lines.length) {
        const match = pattern.exec(lines[i]);
        if (!match) break;
        items.push(match[1]);
        i += 1;
      }
      blocks.push({ kind: bullet ? "ul" : "ol", items });
      continue;
    }
    // A paragraph runs until a blank line or the start of another block.
    const paragraph = [line];
    i += 1;
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() && !STARTS_A_BLOCK.test(lines[i])) {
      paragraph.push(lines[i]);
      i += 1;
    }
    blocks.push({ kind: "p", text: paragraph.join(" ") });
  }
  return blocks;
}

function inline(text: string, base: string): ReactNode[] {
  const parts: ReactNode[] = [];
  const pattern = /\*\*([^*]+)\*\*|`([^`]+)`/g;
  let last = 0;
  let index = 0;
  for (let match = pattern.exec(text); match; match = pattern.exec(text)) {
    if (match.index > last) parts.push(text.slice(last, match.index));
    parts.push(
      match[1] !== undefined ? (
        <strong key={`${base}-${index}`}>{match[1]}</strong>
      ) : (
        <code key={`${base}-${index}`}>{match[2]}</code>
      )
    );
    last = match.index + match[0].length;
    index += 1;
  }
  if (last < text.length) parts.push(text.slice(last));
  return parts;
}

// Headings are drawn as h3, h4 and h5 (not h1 and h2): the page's own h1 is
// "Workspace" and the preview's h2 is the file name, so a note's "# Title"
// sits one level below them.
export default function MiniMarkdown({ source }: { source: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="os-md">
      {parse(source).map((block, n) => {
        const key = `b${n}`;
        switch (block.kind) {
          case "heading":
            return block.level === 1 ? (
              <h3 key={key} className="os-md__h1">{inline(block.text, key)}</h3>
            ) : block.level === 2 ? (
              <h4 key={key} className="os-md__h2">{inline(block.text, key)}</h4>
            ) : (
              <h5 key={key} className="os-md__h3">{inline(block.text, key)}</h5>
            );
          case "ul":
            return <ul key={key}>{block.items.map((item, j) => <li key={j}>{inline(item, `${key}-${j}`)}</li>)}</ul>;
          case "ol":
            return <ol key={key}>{block.items.map((item, j) => <li key={j}>{inline(item, `${key}-${j}`)}</li>)}</ol>;
          case "code":
            return <pre key={key} className="os-md__code">{block.text}</pre>;
          default:
            return <p key={key}>{inline(block.text, key)}</p>;
        }
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
````

#### Part 4: the page styles

Why before the page: the page code names these classes, so the styles are written first and the page can be looked at as soon as it exists. Every colour, size and space is a token from `src/ui/tokens.css`; there is no colour literal in the file.

How the prototype's names map to the app's tokens (so a reviewer can compare the two files): `--hair` is `--os-line-1`, `--hair-2` is `--os-line-2`, `--edge` is `--os-line-3`, `--ink` is `--os-text-1`, `--ink-soft` is `--os-text-2`, `--ink-faint` is `--os-text-3`, `--surface-1/2/3` are `--os-surface-1/2/3`, `--r1/--r2` are `--os-r-sm/--os-r-md`, `--mono` is `--os-font-mono`, and `--ease` is `--os-ease-out`.

Four rules the file follows, each one a place the old page or the prototype would otherwise slip:
- **Load order.** `DashboardRoot.tsx` imports the page files before `base.css` and `kit.css`, so a rule that meets a base or kit rule must win by being more specific, not by coming later. Every selector therefore starts with `.os-ws` (or `.os-md`), which makes it two classes.
- **One accent.** Cobalt appears only through the kit's primary buttons ("New note", "Save note") and the focus ring. The prototype draws the lock icon in cobalt text; this file draws it in neutral ink, because the written rule (cobalt is for the primary action, the live state and the focus ring) outranks that detail.
- **The open file's mark** is a 2 px ink bar drawn as a shape on the row (`::before`), not a coloured border.
- **Motion** is the one 140 ms background fade (`--os-dur-quick`) on a row and on the Preview/Source switch. `tokens.css` already turns every transition down to 1 ms under reduced motion.

#### Part 5: the page

Why: this is the page itself. Three new files carry it (the note form, the preview pane, the page), and the old `src/pages/WorkspacePage.tsx` is replaced in full. Nothing outside these files changes: `DashboardRoot.tsx` still renders `<WorkspacePage />`, and `kit.css` and the kit components come from Task C1.

**What the page shows, state by state, and where each value comes from.** The words in quotes are exact. `—` means "not known" and `…` means "loading". Nothing on this page is invented: every number and name is read from the list or the file.

| Part of the page | Value or state | Exact words | Source |

| Header | title and lede | "Workspace" and "A private folder on this Mac for your notes and for files your agents save, after you approve them." | fixed text |
| Header | public demo | lede "A shared workspace on the public demo server. Sample notes are already here." and an info banner titled "Public demo · sandboxed" saying "This workspace is shared with every visitor. Read demo/briefing.md, then save your own note. Do not paste secrets. Writes cannot leave the workspace, and they do not run shell." | `getProductStatus().demoPublic`, `DEMO_BADGE` |
| Header | a file is open | primary button "New note" (it clears the open file and puts the cursor in Name) | the `?file=` address |
| Folder bar | path | `~/.hermes-agent-os/workspace`; `…` while loading, `—` when the list cannot load | `roots[].publicPath` of the `workspace` root |
| Folder bar | counts | "N files" and "n saved by agents" (`1 file` in the singular); `…` while loading, `—` when unreachable | `summary.total` and `summary.savedByAgents` (counted over every file, not only the shown ones) |
| Folder bar | buttons | "Refresh" (off while a refresh runs); "Show in Finder" only when `canRevealInFinder()` and `roots[].absolutePath` is a string and no file is open (it shows the workspace folder) | `desktop.ts`, Part 1 |
| Filters | type chips | "All", "Markdown", "Text", "HTML", then "Images", "Audio", "Video", "PDF", "Other" only when a file of that type exists; each ends in its count; the pressed one has a check mark | `typeOf(file)` over `files`; counts ignore the other filters, like the prototype |
| Filters | other | text field "Filter by name" (matches the path shown, any case); chip "Saved by agents" (`savedBy.kind === "team-room"`); chip "Folder loop/" with an X when the address has `?folder=loop` | `files[].savedBy`, `?folder=` |
| List | loading | six grey skeleton rows; a screen reader hears "Loading files…" | request in flight |
| List | cannot load | "Agent OS can't be reached" / "The file list could not load. Check that Agent OS is still running, then try again." / button "Try again" | the request failed and no list was ever loaded |
| List | no files at all | "No files yet" / "Write a note on the right, or approve a file in a Team Room. Saved files appear here." / button "Open Team Room" | `files.length === 0` |
| List | a folder link with nothing in it | for Loop: "No Loop briefings yet" / "Open Loop and save today's briefing. It will appear in this folder." / buttons "Open Loop" and "Show all files". For any other folder: "Nothing in {folder}/ yet" / "Files saved to this folder will appear here." / "Show all files" | `inFolder` finds no file |
| List | filters hide everything | "No files match these filters" / button "Clear filters" (clears type, name, agents and folder) | `filterFiles` returned nothing |
| List | ready | a heading per folder ("notes/", "3 files"), then one row per file: name, "Saved by words · 3h ago", a tag ("MD", "TXT", "HTML", "IMG", "AUDIO", "VIDEO", "PDF", "FILE") | `savedByView`, `agoLabel(updatedAt)`, `TYPE_INFO` |
| List | line under it | "Showing 4 of 10 files." when filters hide some; "The list stops at 500 files, so some files may not be shown." at 500 | `visible` against `files`, `LIST_LIMIT` |
| Saved by (rows and preview) | each kind | "You", "Agent OS", "Team Room (Hermes)" (the agent's name from the Team Room's own log; just "Team Room" if the log has none), "—" (with "Unknown" for a screen reader) when nobody is on record | `savedBy.kind` and `savedBy.label` from Task B2 |
| Preview | header | the path ("notes/plan.md", or "exports/..." for the Exports root), a tag ("Markdown", "Text", "HTML", "Image", "Audio", "Video", "PDF", "Other"), the size ("1.2 KB"), "Saved by ...", and "3h ago" (the full date on hover) | `displayPath`, `typeOf`, `formatSize`, `savedBy`, `updatedAt` |
| Preview | buttons | "Preview"/"Source" for Markdown, "Locked preview"/"Source" for HTML; "Copy path"; "Show in Finder" (same rule as the bar); "Undo this save" only when `undoTarget(savedBy)` is not null | `undoTarget`, `copyPathOf`, `absolutePathOf` |
| Preview | text loading / failed | "Loading preview…"; or a danger banner "This file could not be opened" with the reason in words and "Try again" (or "Refresh the list" if the file is gone) | `getWorkspaceFileDetail(id).previewText`, `previewProblem` |
| Preview | too big | "This file is larger than 256 KB, so Agent OS does not show its text here." | `file.size` against `PREVIEW_MAX_BYTES` |
| Preview | empty / no preview | "This file is empty." / "This file type has no inline preview. It stays in the workspace, and Agent OS does not open or download it." | the text, `typeOf` |
| Preview | HTML | the lock note ("Locked preview. This HTML is drawn inside a sandbox. Scripts and forms are switched off and links do nothing, so the page cannot reach Agent OS or the rest of your Mac.") above an `iframe` with `sandbox=""` and `src` set to `/api/workspace/raw?id=...` (unchanged from today) | the raw route |
| Undo | the question | dialog "Undo this save?", the path, "The Team Room (Hermes) saved this file. Undo puts it back as it was before that save. If the Team Room created the file, Undo removes it.", buttons "Cancel" and "Undo save" | `AgentConfirmModal` (title id `os-modal-title`) |
| Undo | results | "Undone. notes/x.md is back to how it was before the agent saved it." or "Undone. notes/x.md was removed, because the Team Room created it." (the list reloads either way); a refusal is a warning in plain words, for example "The copy of the file from before this save is missing, so Agent OS cannot undo it. The file is unchanged." | `undoTeamAction(roomId, actionId)`, then `getWorkspaceListing()` |
| New note | form | "New note", "Write something down. It is saved in notes/ inside the workspace.", fields "Name" (placeholder `note-<today>`), "Type" (.md, .txt, .html), "Note"; the line "Saved as notes/<cleaned name>"; buttons "Save note" and "Clear"; hint "Only .md, .txt and .html files can be saved here." | `noteFileName`, `writeWorkspaceFile({ folder: "notes", name, content })` |
| New note | not ready | "Save note" is off, with the hint "Saving is available once the file list has loaded." or "Saving is available once Agent OS can be reached." | the list's load state |
| New note | name taken | a warning "notes/x.md already exists" / "Saving replaces what is in it." with "Replace file" and "Choose another name" (focus goes to the safe one); Save never replaces by itself | `files` (compared without regard to case) |
| New note | saved / failed | "Saved notes/x.md." and the new file opens ("Saved by You"); or a danger banner "The note was not saved" with the reason, and the text stays in the form | `writeWorkspaceFile` result, `saveProblemText` |
| Messages | other | "Copied the path."; "Could not copy. The path is ..."; "That file is not in the workspace any more."; "Could not refresh the list. Agent OS can't be reached."; "Finder could not be opened. The file is at ..." | the action that failed |

How the pieces work together, in plain English:
- **One list, filtered in the browser.** The page asks for `GET /api/workspace` once (no `query` or `kind`, so the server sends everything it lists, up to 500 files) and does the rest itself. Typing in the filter is instant and sends nothing.
- **The address stays in step.** Opening a file writes `?file=<id>` (and `?folder=` if a folder chip is on) with the existing `navigateTo`, and `aos-navigate` or `popstate` reads it back, so Loop, Swarm, Studio and Memory links keep working, and the menu's "Workspace" item (which clears both) resets the page.
- **Undo never guesses.** The button exists only for a `team-room` save with both ids. The question comes first. After a yes the page calls the Team Room's own route, reloads the list, and says in words what happened. If the server refuses, the file is left alone and the reason is shown without any error code.
- **A file that vanishes** (deleted outside Agent OS between the list and the click) is handled: the preview says so, "Refresh the list" drops it, and the address stops naming it.
- **Notes land in `notes/`**, never anywhere else, and a note never silently replaces a file.

- [ ] **Step 16: Create `src/ui/components/WorkspaceNoteForm.tsx`.**

The form owns its own fields. It does not know about the address or the list beyond `files` (to notice a taken name) and `loadState` (to hold Save back until the list is here). It tells the page one thing, through `onSaved`.

````tsx
import { Check } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { writeWorkspaceFile } from "../../api";
import type { WorkspaceFile, WorkspaceListedFile } from "../../types";
import { NOTE_EXTS, noteFileName, saveProblemText, type NoteExt } from "../workspaceShared";
import Banner from "./Banner";

interface Props {
  // null until the list has loaded: the form needs it to notice a name that is already taken.
  files: WorkspaceListedFile[] | null;
  loadState: "loading" | "ready" | "error";
  demoPublic: boolean;
  // The page's "New note" button adds one to this number to ask for focus on the Name field.
  focusToken: number;
  onSaved: (file: WorkspaceFile, fileName: string) => void;
}

const todayIso = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

// Notes always go into notes/ (as this page has always done). The file name is
// cleaned here exactly as the server will clean it, so "Saved as" is the truth
// and a name that is already taken is noticed before anything is overwritten.
export default function WorkspaceNoteForm({ files, loadState, demoPublic, focusToken, onSaved }: Props) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [ext, setExt] = useState<NoteExt>("md");
  const [body, setBody] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState("");
  const [askReplace, setAskReplace] = useState(false);
  const nameRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const keepRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (focusToken > 0) nameRef.current?.focus();
  }, [focusToken]);

  const fileName = noteFileName(name, ext, todayIso());
  const target = `notes/${fileName}`;
  const taken = Boolean(files?.some((file) => file.id.toLowerCase() === `workspace/${target}`.toLowerCase()));
  const canSave = loadState === "ready" && body.trim().length > 0 && !busy;

  // A different name or type is a different question: ask again.
  useEffect(() => setAskReplace(false), [fileName]);

  // When the question appears, focus goes to the safe answer, so a second Enter
  // can never replace a file by accident.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (askReplace) keepRef.current?.focus();
  }, [askReplace]);

  async function save() {
    setBusy(true);
    setProblem("");
    try {
      const saved = await writeWorkspaceFile({ folder: "notes", name: fileName, content: body });
      setName("");
      setBody("");
      setAskReplace(false);
      onSaved(saved.file, fileName);
    } catch (error) {
      setProblem(saveProblemText(error));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  // Save never replaces a file by itself. When the name is taken it only asks;
  // the "Replace file" button in the question is the one way to go ahead.
  function submit() {
    if (!canSave) return;
    if (taken) {
      setAskReplace(true);
      return;
    }
    void save();
  }

  function clear() {
    setName("");
    setBody("");
    setProblem("");
    setAskReplace(false);
    nameRef.current?.focus();
  }

  const hint =
    loadState === "loading"
      ? "Saving is available once the file list has loaded."
      : loadState === "error"
        ? "Saving is available once Agent OS can be reached."
        : "Only .md, .txt and .html files can be saved here.";

  return (
    <div>
      <h2 className="os-ws__h2">New note</h2>
      <p className="os-ws__lede2">
        Write something down. It is saved in <code className="os-mono">notes/</code> inside the workspace.
      </p>
      <form
        className="os-ws__form"
        onSubmit={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          submit();
        }}
      >
        <div className="os-ws__name-row">
          <label className="os-field">
            <span className="os-field__label">Name</span>
            <input
              ref={nameRef}
              value={name}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setName(event.target.value);
                setProblem("");
              }}
              placeholder={demoPublic ? "visitor-note" : `note-${todayIso()}`}
              autoComplete="off"
              spellCheck={false}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="os-field">
            <span className="os-field__label">Type</span>
            <select
              value={ext}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setExt(event.target.value as NoteExt);
                setProblem("");
              }}
            >
              {NOTE_EXTS.map((option) => (
                <option key={option} value={option}>
                  .{option}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        <p className="os-ws__saveas">
          Saved as <span className="os-mono">{target}</span>
        </p>
        <label className="os-field">
          <span className="os-field__label">Note</span>
          <textarea
            value={body}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setBody(event.target.value);
              setProblem("");
            }}
            rows={7}
            placeholder="Start typing. Markdown works in .md files."
          />
        </label>
        {askReplace ? (
          <Banner
            tone="warn"
            title={`${target} already exists`}
            actions={
              <>
                <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--danger" onClick={() => void save()} disabled={busy}>
                  Replace file
                </button>
                <button ref={keepRef} type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={() => nameRef.current?.focus()}>
                  Choose another name
                </button>
              </>
            }
          >
            Saving replaces what is in it.
          </Banner>
        ) : null}
        {problem ? (
          <Banner tone="danger" title="The note was not saved">
            {problem}
          </Banner>
        ) : null}
        <div className="os-ws__form-actions">
          <button type="submit" className="os-btn os-btn--primary" disabled={!canSave}>
            <Check size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
            {busy ? "Saving…" : "Save note"}
          </button>
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={clear}>
            Clear
          </button>
          <p className="os-ws__hint">{hint}</p>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
````

- [ ] **Step 17: Create `src/ui/components/WorkspacePreview.tsx`.**

The preview pane for one open file. The page gives it `key={file.id}`, so opening another file starts it fresh. It also exports `SavedByWords`, the one place that draws "—", so the list rows and the preview agree.

````tsx
import { Copy, FolderOpen, Lock, Undo2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { getWorkspaceFileDetail, undoTeamAction } from "../../api";
import type { WorkspaceListedFile, WorkspaceListing } from "../../types";
import { canRevealInFinder, revealInFinder } from "../desktop";
import MiniMarkdown from "../miniMarkdown";
import {
  PREVIEW_MAX_BYTES,
  TYPE_INFO,
  absolutePathOf,
  copyPathOf,
  displayPath,
  formatSize,
  previewProblem,
  savedByView,
  typeOf,
  undoProblemText,
  undoTarget,
  type Notice,
  type SavedByView
} from "../workspaceShared";
import AgentConfirmModal from "./AgentConfirmModal";
import Banner from "./Banner";
import { agoLabel } from "./RelativeTime";

// "Saved by" in words. Nobody on record reads "—" (and "Unknown" for a screen reader).
export function SavedByWords({ view }: { view: SavedByView }) {
  if (view.unknown) {
    return (
      <>
        <span aria-hidden="true">—</span>
        <span className="os-visually-hidden">Unknown</span>
      </>
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      {view.who}
      {view.detail ? ` (${view.detail})` : ""}
    </>
  );
}

type Detail =
  | { state: "idle" }
  | { state: "loading" }
  | { state: "ready"; text: string }
  | { state: "error"; problem: string; gone: boolean };

interface Props {
  file: WorkspaceListedFile;
  roots: WorkspaceListing["roots"];
  // Asks the page for a fresh list. `false` means "do not tell the person the file went missing".
  onRefresh: (announceMissing?: boolean) => Promise<WorkspaceListing | null>;
  onNotice: (notice: Notice | null) => void;
}

// The right-hand pane for one file: who saved it, Copy path, Show in Finder
// (desktop only), Undo this save (Team Room saves only), and the preview. The
// page gives it key={file.id}, so everything here starts fresh for each file.
export default function WorkspacePreview({ file, roots, onRefresh, onNotice }: Props) {
  const type = typeOf(file);
  const saved = savedByView(file.savedBy);
  const target = undoTarget(file.savedBy);
  const absolute = absolutePathOf(file, roots);
  const canReveal = canRevealInFinder() && Boolean(absolute);
  const needsText = file.kind === "text" || file.kind === "html";
  // The server sends the text of a file only up to 256 KB. Asking for more would
  // come back empty and read as "This file is empty", which would be untrue.
  const tooBig = needsText && file.size > PREVIEW_MAX_BYTES;
  const canToggle = type === "md" || type === "html";
  const rawUrl = `/api/workspace/raw?id=${encodeURIComponent(file.id)}`;

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"view" | "source">("view");
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<Detail>({ state: "idle" });
  const [retry, setRetry] = useState(0);
  const [undoOpen, setUndoOpen] = useState(false);
  const [undoBusy, setUndoBusy] = useState(false);
  const source = canToggle && mode === "source";

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!needsText || tooBig) {
      setDetail({ state: "idle" });
      return undefined;
    }
    let live = true;
    setDetail({ state: "loading" });
    getWorkspaceFileDetail(file.id).then(
      (result) => {
        if (live) setDetail({ state: "ready", text: result.previewText || "" });
      },
      (error) => {
        if (!live) return;
        const problem = previewProblem(error);
        setDetail({ state: "error", problem: problem.text, gone: problem.gone });
      }
    );
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [file.id, file.updatedAt, needsText, tooBig, retry]);

  async function copyPath() {
    const text = copyPathOf(file, roots);
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      onNotice({ tone: "ok", text: "Copied the path." });
    } catch {
      onNotice({ tone: "warn", text: `Could not copy. The path is ${text}` });
    }
  }

  async function reveal() {
    if (!absolute) return;
    try {
      await revealInFinder(absolute);
    } catch {
      onNotice({ tone: "warn", text: `Finder could not be opened. The file is at ${absolute}` });
    }
  }

  async function undo() {
    if (!target) return;
    setUndoBusy(true);
    try {
      await undoTeamAction(target.roomId, target.actionId);
      setUndoOpen(false);
      const next = await onRefresh(false);
      const still = next ? next.files.some((item) => item.id === file.id) : null;
      const name = displayPath(file);
      onNotice({
        tone: "ok",
        text:
          still === null
            ? `Undone. The list could not refresh, so press Refresh to see ${name}.`
            : still
              ? `Undone. ${name} is back to how it was before the agent saved it.`
              : `Undone. ${name} was removed, because the Team Room created it.`
      });
    } catch (error) {
      setUndoOpen(false);
      onNotice({ tone: "danger", text: undoProblemText(error) });
      await onRefresh(false);
    } finally {
      setUndoBusy(false);
    }
  }

  function body() {
    if (type === "image") return <img className="os-ws__media" src={rawUrl} alt={file.name} />;
    if (type === "audio") return <audio className="os-ws__media" controls src={rawUrl} />;
    if (type === "video") return <video className="os-ws__media" controls src={rawUrl} />;
    if (type === "pdf") return <iframe className="os-ws__frame os-ws__frame--tall" title={`PDF: ${file.name}`} src={rawUrl} />;
    if (type === "other") {
      return <p className="os-ws__plain">This file type has no inline preview. It stays in the workspace, and Agent OS does not open or download it.</p>;
    }
    if (type === "html" && !source) {
      return (
        <>
          <p className="os-ws__lock" role="note">
            <Lock size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>
              <b>Locked preview.</b> This HTML is drawn inside a sandbox. Scripts and forms are switched off and links do nothing, so the page
              cannot reach Agent OS or the rest of your Mac.
            </span>
          </p>
          <iframe className="os-ws__frame" sandbox="" title={`Locked preview of ${displayPath(file)}`} src={rawUrl} />
        </>
      );
    }
    if (tooBig) {
      return <p className="os-ws__plain">This file is larger than 256 KB, so Agent OS does not show its text here.</p>;
    }
    if (detail.state === "loading" || detail.state === "idle") {
      return (
        <p className="os-ws__plain" role="status">
          Loading preview…
        </p>
      );
    }
    if (detail.state === "error") {
      return (
        <Banner
          tone="danger"
          title="This file could not be opened"
          actions={
            detail.gone ? (
              <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void onRefresh(true)}>
                Refresh the list
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => setRetry((n) => n + 1)}>
                Try again
              </button>
            )
          }
        >
          {detail.problem}
        </Banner>
      );
    }
    if (!detail.text.trim()) return <p className="os-ws__plain">This file is empty.</p>;
    if (type === "md" && !source) {
      return (
        <div className="os-ws__page">
          <MiniMarkdown source={detail.text} />
        </div>
      );
    }
    return (
      <div className="os-ws__page os-ws__page--src">
        <pre>{detail.text}</pre>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <h2 className="os-ws__title os-mono">{displayPath(file)}</h2>
      <div className="os-ws__meta">
        <span className="os-ws__tag">{TYPE_INFO[type].label}</span>
        <span className="os-mono">{formatSize(file.size)}</span>
        <span className="os-ws__vbar" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span>
          Saved by{" "}
          <b>
            <SavedByWords view={saved} />
          </b>
        </span>
        <span className="os-ws__vbar" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span title={new Date(file.updatedAt).toLocaleString()}>{agoLabel(file.updatedAt)}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="os-ws__tools">
        {canToggle ? (
          <div className="os-ws__seg" role="group" aria-label="View">
            <button type="button" aria-pressed={!source} onClick={() => setMode("view")}>
              {type === "html" ? "Locked preview" : "Preview"}
            </button>
            <button type="button" aria-pressed={source} onClick={() => setMode("source")}>
              Source
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <div className="os-ws__tool-buttons">
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void copyPath()}>
            <Copy size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
            Copy path
          </button>
          {canReveal ? (
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void reveal()}>
              <FolderOpen size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
              Show in Finder
            </button>
          ) : null}
          {target ? (
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => setUndoOpen(true)} aria-haspopup="dialog">
              <Undo2 size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
              Undo this save
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
      {body()}
      {undoOpen && target ? (
        <AgentConfirmModal
          title="Undo this save?"
          confirmLabel="Undo save"
          danger
          busy={undoBusy}
          onConfirm={() => void undo()}
          onClose={() => {
            if (!undoBusy) setUndoOpen(false);
          }}
        >
          <p className="os-mono">{displayPath(file)}</p>
          <p>
            The Team Room{saved.detail ? ` (${saved.detail})` : ""} saved this file. Undo puts it back as it was before that save. If the Team Room created
            the file, Undo removes it.
          </p>
        </AgentConfirmModal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
````

Replace the whole file (the old one imports `PageFrame` and uses `aos-*` classes; this one uses neither). The file name, the default export and the lack of props stay, so `DashboardRoot.tsx` is untouched.

````tsx
// The Workspace page: every file Agent OS and your agents have kept, who saved
// each one, a preview, and a form for a new note. It loads the whole list once
// (GET /api/workspace, at most 500 files) and filters it in the browser. One
// file's text comes from GET /api/workspace/file, a note goes out through
// POST /api/workspace/files, and "Undo this save" calls the Team Room's own
// undo route. There is no polling: the list reloads after this page's own
// actions and when Refresh is pressed.
import {
  Check,
  File as FileIcon,
  FileAudio,
  FileCode,
  FileImage,
  FileText,
  FileVideo,
  FolderOpen,
  History,
  Plus,
  RefreshCw,
  ServerOff,
  Users,
  X,
  type LucideIcon
} from "lucide-react";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { getProductStatus, getWorkspaceListing } from "../api";
import { DEMO_BADGE } from "../demo";
import { navigateTo, queryParam } from "../nav";
import type { WorkspaceFile, WorkspaceListedFile, WorkspaceListing } from "../types";
import Banner from "../ui/components/Banner";
import EmptyState from "../ui/components/EmptyState";
import PageHeader from "../ui/components/PageHeader";
import { agoLabel } from "../ui/components/RelativeTime";
import WorkspaceNoteForm from "../ui/components/WorkspaceNoteForm";
import WorkspacePreview, { SavedByWords } from "../ui/components/WorkspacePreview";
import { canRevealInFinder, revealInFinder } from "../ui/desktop";
import {
  ALWAYS_CHIPS,
  LIST_LIMIT,
  OPTIONAL_CHIPS,
  TYPE_INFO,
  countByType,
  displayPath,
  filesWord,
  filterFiles,
  folderFromQuery,
  groupFiles,
  inFolder,
  nameInGroup,
  sandboxPaths,
  savedByView,
  typeOf,
  type Notice,
  type TypeFilter,
  type TypeKey
} from "../ui/workspaceShared";
import "../ui/workspace.css";

const ICONS: Record<TypeKey, LucideIcon> = {
  md: FileText,
  txt: FileIcon,
  html: FileCode,
  image: FileImage,
  audio: FileAudio,
  video: FileVideo,
  pdf: FileIcon,
  other: FileIcon
};

type LoadState = "loading" | "ready" | "error";

function FileRow({ file, current, onSelect }: { file: WorkspaceListedFile; current: boolean; onSelect: (id: string) => void }) {
  const type = typeOf(file);
  const Icon = ICONS[type];
  const saved = savedByView(file.savedBy);
  return (
    <li>
      <button type="button" className="os-ws__row" aria-current={current ? "true" : undefined} onClick={() => onSelect(file.id)}>
        <Icon size={17} aria-hidden="true" className="os-ws__row-icon" />
        <span className="os-ws__row-text">
          <span className="os-ws__nm os-mono" title={displayPath(file)}>
            {nameInGroup(file)}
          </span>
          <span className="os-ws__by">
            <span className={saved.byAgent ? "os-ws__agent" : undefined}>
              <SavedByWords view={saved} />
            </span>{" "}
            · <span title={new Date(file.updatedAt).toLocaleString()}>{agoLabel(file.updatedAt)}</span>
          </span>
        </span>
        <span className="os-ws__tag">{TYPE_INFO[type].tag}</span>
      </button>
    </li>
  );
}

function WorkspaceRules({ display }: { display: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="os-ws__rules">
      <h3 className="os-ws__h3">How the workspace works</h3>
      <ul>
        <li>
          <FolderOpen size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>
            <b>One folder.</b> Agent OS reads and writes inside {display ? <code className="os-mono">{display}</code> : "its workspace folder"} and its
            exports folder, and nowhere else. This page never browses the rest of your disk.
          </span>
        </li>
        <li>
          <FileIcon size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>
            <b>Three note types.</b> You can write <code className="os-mono">.md</code>, <code className="os-mono">.txt</code> and{" "}
            <code className="os-mono">.html</code> notes here. Other files in the folder can still be previewed.
          </span>
        </li>
        <li>
          <Users size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>
            <b>Agents save only after you approve.</b> A file from the Team Room arrives as a proposal first.
          </span>
        </li>
        <li>
          <History size={17} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span>
            <b>Team Room saves can be undone.</b> Select the file and use Undo this save. If Agent OS cannot tell who saved a file, it shows — and
            offers no Undo.
          </span>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function WorkspacePage() {
  const [listing, setListing] = useState<WorkspaceListing | null>(null);
  const [loadState, setLoadState] = useState<LoadState>("loading");
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [type, setType] = useState<TypeFilter>("all");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [onlyAgents, setOnlyAgents] = useState(false);
  const [folder, setFolder] = useState(() => folderFromQuery(queryParam("folder")));
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(() => queryParam("file") || null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<Notice | null>(null);
  const [focusToken, setFocusToken] = useState(0);
  const [demoPublic, setDemoPublic] = useState(false);

  // refresh() is created once, so it reads the latest values through refs.
  const listingRef = useRef(listing);
  listingRef.current = listing;
  const selectedRef = useRef(selectedId);
  selectedRef.current = selectedId;
  const folderRef = useRef(folder);
  folderRef.current = folder;
  const paneRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);

  // The address keeps ?folder= and ?file= (Loop, Swarm, Studio and Memory link here with them).
  function syncUrl(fileId: string | null, folderName: string) {
    navigateTo("workspace", { ...(fileId ? { file: fileId } : {}), ...(folderName ? { folder: folderName } : {}) });
  }

  const refresh = useCallback(async (announceMissing = true): Promise<WorkspaceListing | null> => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    try {
      const data = await getWorkspaceListing();
      setListing(data);
      setLoadState("ready");
      const wanted = selectedRef.current;
      if (wanted && !data.files.some((file) => file.id === wanted)) {
        setSelectedId(null);
        navigateTo("workspace", folderRef.current ? { folder: folderRef.current } : {});
        if (announceMissing) setNotice({ tone: "warn", text: "That file is not in the workspace any more." });
      }
      return data;
    } catch {
      if (listingRef.current) setNotice({ tone: "warn", text: "Could not refresh the list. Agent OS can't be reached." });
      else setLoadState("error");
      return null;
    } finally {
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh(true);
  }, [refresh]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void getProductStatus()
      .then((product) => setDemoPublic(Boolean(product.demoPublic)))
      .catch(() => setDemoPublic(false));
  }, []);

  // Other parts of the app change the address and fire the app's navigation
  // event (a menu click on Workspace clears the folder and the file).
  useEffect(() => {
    function sync() {
      setFolder(folderFromQuery(queryParam("folder")));
      setSelectedId(queryParam("file") || null);
    }
    window.addEventListener("aos-navigate", sync);
    window.addEventListener("popstate", sync);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("aos-navigate", sync);
      window.removeEventListener("popstate", sync);
    };
  }, []);

  // Good news goes away by itself after 8 seconds, like the toast. A problem stays until it is dismissed.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (notice?.tone !== "ok") return undefined;
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setNotice(null), 8000);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [notice]);

  const files = useMemo(() => listing?.files ?? [], [listing]);
  const counts = useMemo(() => countByType(files), [files]);
  const visible = useMemo(() => filterFiles(files, { type, query, onlyAgents, folder }), [files, type, query, onlyAgents, folder]);
  const groups = useMemo(() => groupFiles(visible), [visible]);
  const selected = useMemo(() => files.find((file) => file.id === selectedId) ?? null, [files, selectedId]);
  const folderIsEmpty = useMemo(() => folder !== "" && !files.some((file) => inFolder(file, folder)), [files, folder]);
  const filtersActive = type !== "all" || query.trim() !== "" || onlyAgents || folder !== "";
  const chipKeys: TypeFilter[] = ["all", ...ALWAYS_CHIPS, ...OPTIONAL_CHIPS.filter((key) => counts[key] > 0 || type === key)];
  const sandbox = sandboxPaths(listing?.roots ?? []);
  const canRevealFolder = canRevealInFinder() && Boolean(sandbox.absolute);

  function selectFile(id: string) {
    setSelectedId(id);
    setNotice(null);
    syncUrl(id, folder);
    paneRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
  }

  function newNote() {
    setSelectedId(null);
    setNotice(null);
    syncUrl(null, folder);
    setFocusToken((n) => n + 1);
  }

  function clearFolder() {
    setFolder("");
    syncUrl(selectedId, "");
  }

  function clearFilters() {
    setType("all");
    setQuery("");
    setOnlyAgents(false);
    if (folder) clearFolder();
  }

  function onSaved(file: WorkspaceFile, fileName: string) {
    setNotice({ tone: "ok", text: `Saved notes/${fileName}.` });
    setSelectedId(file.id);
    // refresh() reads the wanted file through this ref, which is otherwise only
    // updated by the next render. Set it now so the new file is not seen as "missing".
    selectedRef.current = file.id;
    syncUrl(file.id, folder);
    void refresh(false);
  }

  async function revealFolder() {
    if (!sandbox.absolute) return;
    try {
      await revealInFinder(sandbox.absolute);
    } catch {
      setNotice({ tone: "warn", text: `Finder could not be opened. The folder is at ${sandbox.absolute}` });
    }
  }

  // Up and Down move between rows, Home and End jump to the first and last.
  function onListKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {
    if (!["ArrowDown", "ArrowUp", "Home", "End"].includes(event.key)) return;
    const rows = Array.from(event.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>(".os-ws__row"));
    const at = rows.indexOf(document.activeElement as HTMLButtonElement);
    if (at === -1) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const next =
      event.key === "Home" ? 0 : event.key === "End" ? rows.length - 1 : Math.min(rows.length - 1, Math.max(0, at + (event.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1)));
    rows[next]?.focus();
  }

  // The line under the list: how many the filters hide, and the server's 500 file limit.
  const countText = [
    filtersActive && visible.length !== files.length ? `Showing ${visible.length} of ${files.length} ${filesWord(files.length)}.` : "",
    files.length >= LIST_LIMIT ? `The list stops at ${LIST_LIMIT} files, so some files may not be shown.` : ""
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" ");
  const total = listing ? String(listing.summary.total) : loadState === "error" ? "—" : "…";
  const byAgents = listing ? String(listing.summary.savedByAgents) : loadState === "error" ? "—" : "…";

  function listBody() {
    if (loadState === "loading") {
      return (
        <div role="status">
          <span className="os-visually-hidden">Loading files…</span>
          <div aria-hidden="true">
            {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
              <div key={n} className="os-skeleton os-ws__skeleton" />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (loadState === "error") {
      return (
        <EmptyState
          icon={ServerOff}
          title="Agent OS can't be reached"
          body="The file list could not load. Check that Agent OS is still running, then try again."
          action={
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void refresh(true)} disabled={refreshing}>
              <RefreshCw size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
              Try again
            </button>
          }
        />
      );
    }
    if (folderIsEmpty) {
      return (
        <EmptyState
          icon={FolderOpen}
          title={folder === "loop" ? "No Loop briefings yet" : `Nothing in ${folder}/ yet`}
          body={folder === "loop" ? "Open Loop and save today's briefing. It will appear in this folder." : "Files saved to this folder will appear here."}
          action={
            <>
              {folder === "loop" ? (
                <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => navigateTo("loop")}>
                  Open Loop
                </button>
              ) : null}
              <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={clearFolder}>
                Show all files
              </button>
            </>
          }
        />
      );
    }
    if (files.length === 0) {
      return (
        <EmptyState
          icon={FolderOpen}
          title="No files yet"
          body="Write a note on the right, or approve a file in a Team Room. Saved files appear here."
          action={
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => navigateTo("team")}>
              <Users size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
              Open Team Room
            </button>
          }
        />
      );
    }
    if (visible.length === 0) {
      return (
        <EmptyState
          icon={FolderOpen}
          title="No files match these filters"
          action={
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={clearFilters}>
              Clear filters
            </button>
          }
        />
      );
    }
    return groups.map((group) => (
      <div key={group.key || "top"} className="os-ws__group">
        <h3 className="os-ws__group-head">
          <code className="os-mono">{group.label}</code>
          <span>
            {group.files.length} {filesWord(group.files.length)}
          </span>
        </h3>
        <ul className="os-ws__rows">
          {group.files.map((file) => (
            <FileRow key={file.id} file={file} current={file.id === selectedId} onSelect={selectFile} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    ));
  }

  return (
    <section className="os-ws" aria-labelledby="os-workspace-title">
      <PageHeader
        title="Workspace"
        titleId="os-workspace-title"
        lede={
          demoPublic
            ? "A shared workspace on the public demo server. Sample notes are already here."
            : "A private folder on this Mac for your notes and for files your agents save, after you approve them."
        }
        actions={
          selectedId ? (
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--primary" onClick={newNote}>
              <Plus size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
              New note
            </button>
          ) : null
        }
      />
      {demoPublic ? (
        <div className="os-ws__gap">
          <Banner tone="info" title={DEMO_BADGE}>
            This workspace is shared with every visitor. Read demo/briefing.md, then save your own note. Do not paste secrets. Writes cannot leave the
            workspace, and they do not run shell.
          </Banner>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <div className="os-ws__bar">
        <span className="os-ws__path">
          <FolderOpen size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
          <code className="os-mono">{sandbox.display || (loadState === "loading" ? "…" : "—")}</code>
        </span>
        <span>
          <span className="os-mono">{total}</span> {listing ? filesWord(listing.summary.total) : "files"}
        </span>
        <span>
          <span className="os-mono">{byAgents}</span> saved by agents
        </span>
        <span className="os-ws__bar-right">
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={() => void refresh(true)} disabled={refreshing}>
            <RefreshCw size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
            Refresh
          </button>
          {!selectedId && canRevealFolder ? (
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={() => void revealFolder()}>
              <FolderOpen size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
              Show in Finder
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="os-ws__main">
        <section aria-labelledby="os-ws-files-title">
          <h2 id="os-ws-files-title" className="os-visually-hidden">
            Files
          </h2>
          <div className="os-ws__filters">
            <div className="os-ws__chips" role="group" aria-label="File type">
              {chipKeys.map((key) => (
                <button key={key} type="button" className="os-chip" aria-pressed={type === key} onClick={() => setType(key)}>
                  {type === key ? <Check size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
                  {key === "all" ? "All" : TYPE_INFO[key].chip}
                  <span className="os-ws__n os-mono">{listing ? counts[key] : loadState === "error" ? "—" : "…"}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="os-ws__find">
              <div className="os-field os-ws__search">
                <input
                  type="search"
                  value={query}
                  onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Filter by name"
                  aria-label="Filter by name"
                  autoComplete="off"
                />
              </div>
              <button type="button" className="os-chip" aria-pressed={onlyAgents} onClick={() => setOnlyAgents((on) => !on)}>
                {onlyAgents ? <Check size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
                Saved by agents
              </button>
              {folder ? (
                <button type="button" className="os-chip" aria-label={`Folder ${folder}/. Remove this filter.`} onClick={clearFolder}>
                  Folder {folder}/
                  <X size={14} aria-hidden="true" />
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="os-ws__list" onKeyDown={onListKeyDown}>
            {listBody()}
          </div>
          {loadState === "ready" && countText ? (
            <p className="os-ws__count" role="status">
              {countText}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </section>
        <section className="os-ws__pane" ref={paneRef} aria-label={selected ? "File preview" : "New note"}>
          {notice ? (
            notice.tone === "ok" ? (
              <p className="os-ws__ok" role="status">
                <Check size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
                {notice.text}
              </p>
            ) : (
              <div className="os-ws__gap">
                <Banner
                  tone={notice.tone}
                  actions={
                    <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={() => setNotice(null)}>
                      Dismiss
                    </button>
                  }
                >
                  {notice.text}
                </Banner>
              </div>
            )
          ) : null}
          {selected && listing ? (
            <WorkspacePreview key={selected.id} file={selected} roots={listing.roots} onRefresh={refresh} onNotice={setNotice} />
          ) : selectedId && loadState === "loading" ? (
            <p className="os-ws__plain" role="status">
              Opening the file…
            </p>
          ) : selectedId && loadState === "error" ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon={ServerOff}
              title="This file can't be opened yet"
              body="Agent OS can't be reached. Try again once it is running."
              action={
                <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void refresh(true)} disabled={refreshing}>
                  <RefreshCw size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
                  Try again
                </button>
              }
            />
          ) : (
            <>
              <WorkspaceNoteForm files={listing ? listing.files : null} loadState={loadState} demoPublic={demoPublic} focusToken={focusToken} onSaved={onSaved} />
              <WorkspaceRules display={sandbox.display} />
            </>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
````
