Run:

```bash
node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs pages 2>&1 | grep -i workspace
```

Expected: six lines, all `PASS`: `workspace@1280 no sideways scroll`, `workspace@1280 console clean`, and the same two for 1470 and 1512. Then open `.superpowers/ui-audit/shots/pages/1470x956/workspace.png` (use the Read tool) and look at it: the page header, the folder bar, the chips, grouped rows, and the "New note" form on the right. If a line says `FAIL`, fix the page and run it again. This mode uses the harness's throwaway server and temp `HOME`; never start `npm start` against the owner's own data folder.

#### Part 6: verify

Why: the unit logic is already proven (Part 3), so the probe proves what only a real page can: that the right words, buttons and states appear on real files, that Undo never shows when it should not, that the keyboard works, and that nothing scrolls sideways. It runs in the audit harness (a throwaway server on :8791 with a temp `HOME`; no real agent starts).

How the probe is built, so nobody is surprised:
- It makes **real files** on the throwaway server: two notes through `POST /api/workspace/files` (so the server itself records them as "You"), and several files written straight into the workspace folder (so the server has no record of who saved them), plus a picture in Exports. It learns the real folder from `roots[].absolutePath`, which also proves Part 1 end to end.
- It **simulates only the Team Room side**: the page's `GET /api/workspace` answer is passed through and given `savedBy` values for five files, and three Undo routes are answered by the probe. That is what lets it test a file the room created (Undo removes it), a file the room changed (Undo puts it back), an Undo the server refuses, a **damaged record with no `roomId`**, and a file you saved over after an agent did. The last two are **Review Focus 3**: they must show no Undo button, and "—" or "You", and nothing may crash.
- The real Team Room and the real undo route are covered by their own server tests (Tasks A1, A2, B2). The one thing left for the final check (Task E1) is a hand run: start a Team Room with the fake agents, Approve a file, open Workspace, press Undo this save.
- It reads `src/ui/desktop.ts` to learn whether the opener is installed, and expects Show in Finder to be present in the desktop app (`?desktop=1`) only then. It is never present in a browser tab.

- [ ] **Step 21: Create `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/workspace.mjs`** (git-ignored, not committed).

````js
// Task B3 probe: the Workspace page, from "Saved by" to Undo this save.
// Run from the worktree root:
//   node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/workspace.mjs
// It makes real files on the throwaway server (through the real API and straight
// into its workspace folder), then drives the real page in headless Chrome. The
// "Saved by" values that need a Team Room are simulated: the page's list request
// and the Undo route are answered here, so each case can be tested exactly
// (a damaged record, a refused Undo, a file the room created or changed).
import { mkdir, readFile, rm, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";

const ROOM_A = "room-20261012-101500-a1b2"; // saved a new file: Undo removes it
const ROOM_B = "room-20261012-111500-b2c3"; // changed a file that was already there: Undo puts the old copy back
const ROOM_C = "room-20261012-121500-c3d4"; // the server refuses Undo (the saved copy is gone)
const ID = (rel) => `workspace/${rel}`;
const TEAM = (label, roomId) => ({ kind: "team-room", label, roomId, actionId: "A1", at: "2026-10-12T10:00:00.000Z" });
const SAVED = {
  [ID("drafts/created.html")]: TEAM("Hermes", ROOM_A),
  [ID("drafts/updated.md")]: TEAM("OpenClaw", ROOM_B),
  [ID("drafts/refused.md")]: TEAM("Hermes", ROOM_C),
  [ID("drafts/corrupt.md")]: { kind: "team-room", label: "Hermes" }, // a damaged record: no room id, no action id
  [ID("drafts/overwritten.md")]: { kind: "you", label: "You" } // the person saved over it after an agent did
};
const PNG = Buffer.from("iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==", "base64");
const norm = (text) => text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();

export default async function ({ browser, openPage, shot, pass, fail, api, BASE, HERE }) {
  const REPO = path.resolve(HERE, "../..");
  const opener = /OPENER_INSTALLED\s*=\s*true/.test(await readFile(path.join(REPO, "src/ui/desktop.ts"), "utf8"));
  const check = (ok, name, detail = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, detail));

  // ---- 1. Real files on the throwaway server ------------------------------
  const first = await api("GET", "/api/workspace");
  const wsRoot = first.json.roots.find((r) => r.id === "workspace");
  const exRoot = first.json.roots.find((r) => r.id === "exports");
  check(typeof wsRoot?.absolutePath === "string" && path.isAbsolute(wsRoot.absolutePath) && wsRoot.publicPath.startsWith("~"), "the list names the real folder, and keeps the display path", JSON.stringify(wsRoot));
  const put = async (root, rel, data) => {
    const full = path.join(root, rel);
    await mkdir(path.dirname(full), { recursive: true });
    await writeFile(full, data);
  };
  await api("POST", "/api/workspace/files", { folder: "notes", name: "plan.md", content: "# Plan\n\nThree things to do:\n\n- write the **brief**\n- run `npm test`\n- <script>alert(1)</script>\n\n1. one\n2. two\n" });
  await api("POST", "/api/workspace/files", { folder: "notes", name: "todo.txt", content: "call the dentist\nbuy milk\n" });
  await put(wsRoot.absolutePath, "drafts/created.html", '<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><h1>Locked hello</h1><p id="js">js off</p><script>document.getElementById("js").textContent="js on"</script>');
  for (const name of ["updated", "refused", "corrupt", "overwritten"]) await put(wsRoot.absolutePath, `drafts/${name}.md`, `# ${name}\n`);
  await put(wsRoot.absolutePath, "drafts/hand.txt", "dropped in by hand\n");
  await put(exRoot.absolutePath, "shot.png", PNG);
  // What is really on the server now. Every count the page shows is checked against this.
  const seeded = (await api("GET", "/api/workspace")).json.files;
  const N = seeded.length;
  const isMd = (f) => f.kind === "text" && f.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".md");
  const countOf = (test) => seeded.filter(test).length;
  const inFolder = (folder) => countOf((f) => f.root === "workspace" && f.relativePath.startsWith(`${folder}/`));
  const nDrafts = inFolder("drafts");

  // ---- 2. The simulated Team Room side ------------------------------------
  const world = { removed: new Set(), cleared: new Set(), listCalls: 0, undoCalls: [] };
  async function simulate(tab) {
    await tab.route((url) => url.pathname === "/api/workspace", async (route) => {
      world.listCalls += 1;
      const res = await route.fetch();
      const json = await res.json();
      json.files = json.files
        .filter((f) => !world.removed.has(f.id))
        .map((f) => (world.cleared.has(f.id) ? { ...f, savedBy: { kind: "unknown", label: "—" } } : SAVED[f.id] ? { ...f, savedBy: SAVED[f.id] } : f));
      json.summary = { ...json.summary, total: json.files.length, shown: json.files.length, savedByAgents: json.files.filter((f) => f.savedBy?.kind === "team-room").length };
      await route.fulfill({ response: res, json });
    });
    await tab.route(`**/api/team-rooms/${ROOM_A}/actions/A1/undo`, (route) => {
      world.undoCalls.push("A");
      world.removed.add(ID("drafts/created.html"));
      return route.fulfill({ json: { action: { id: "A1", undone: true } } });
    });
    await tab.route(`**/api/team-rooms/${ROOM_B}/actions/A1/undo`, (route) => {
      world.undoCalls.push("B");
      world.cleared.add(ID("drafts/updated.md"));
      return route.fulfill({ json: { action: { id: "A1", undone: true } } });
    });
    await tab.route(`**/api/team-rooms/${ROOM_C}/actions/A1/undo`, (route) => {
      world.undoCalls.push("C");
      return route.fulfill({ status: 409, json: { ok: false, error: "backup_missing", message: "The saved copy for this action is missing." } });
    });
  }
  const rows = (tab) => tab.locator(".os-ws__row");
  const rowTexts = async (tab) => (await rows(tab).allInnerTexts()).map(norm);
  const row = (tab, name) => tab.locator(".os-ws__row", { has: tab.locator(".os-ws__nm", { hasText: name }) });
  const open = async (tab, name) => {
    await row(tab, name).first().click();
    await tab.locator(".os-ws__title").waitFor();
  };
  const undoButton = (tab) => tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Undo this save" });
  // Chrome logs the refused Undo (409), the aborted request, and the locked preview's blocked script as console errors. All three are expected here.
  const notRealErrors = (errors) => errors.filter((e) => !/Failed to load resource|Blocked script execution/.test(e));

  // ---- 3. The page at 1470 x 956 -------------------------------------------
  const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, 1470, 956, "workspace");
  await context.grantPermissions(["clipboard-read", "clipboard-write"], { origin: BASE });
  await simulate(tab);
  await tab.reload();
  await rows(tab).first().waitFor();

  // 3a. Structure and look
  const page = tab.locator("section.os-ws");
  check((await tab.locator("h1").count()) === 1 && (await tab.locator("h1").innerText()) === "Workspace", "one h1, and it says Workspace");
  check(/private folder on this Mac.*after you approve/.test(norm(await page.locator(".os-page-head__lede").innerText())), "the lede says agents save after you approve");
  check((await page.locator('[class*="aos-"]').count()) === 0, "no aos-* class on the page");
  check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^filter$/i }).count()) === 0, "the orange Filter button is gone");
  const look = await tab.evaluate(() => {
    const root = document.querySelector("section.os-ws");
    const orange = (css) => [...css.matchAll(/rgba?\((\d+),\s*(\d+),\s*(\d+)/g)].some((m) => Number(m[1]) >= 225 && Number(m[2]) >= 60 && Number(m[2]) <= 140 && Number(m[3]) <= 70);
    const oranges = [];
    const gradients = [];
    for (const el of [root, ...root.querySelectorAll("*")]) {
      const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
      if (orange([cs.color, cs.backgroundColor, cs.borderTopColor, cs.borderBottomColor, cs.outlineColor, cs.boxShadow].join(" "))) oranges.push(String(el.className || el.tagName));
      if (cs.backgroundImage.includes("gradient")) gradients.push(String(el.className || el.tagName));
    }
    return { oranges, gradients };
  });
  check(look.oranges.length === 0, "no legacy orange anywhere on the page", look.oranges.join(", "));
  check(look.gradients.length === 0, "no gradients on the page", look.gradients.join(", "));

  // 3b. The folder bar and the chips
  const bar = norm(await page.locator(".os-ws__bar").innerText());
  check(bar.includes(`${N} files`) && /4 saved by agents/.test(bar) && bar.includes("~/.hermes-agent-os/workspace"), `the bar shows the path, ${N} files and 4 saved by agents`, bar);
  const chips = (await page.locator(".os-ws__chips button").allInnerTexts()).map(norm);
  const wantChips = [`All ${N}`, `Markdown ${countOf(isMd)}`, `Text ${countOf((f) => f.kind === "text" && !isMd(f))}`, `HTML ${countOf((f) => f.kind === "html")}`, `Images ${countOf((f) => f.kind === "image")}`];
  check(JSON.stringify(chips) === JSON.stringify(wantChips), "type chips with counts; Images appears because a picture exists", JSON.stringify(chips));
  check((await page.locator(".os-ws__chips button").first().getAttribute("aria-pressed")) === "true", "All is pressed at first");
  const groups = (await page.locator(".os-ws__group-head").allInnerTexts()).map(norm);
  check(groups.includes(`drafts/ ${nDrafts} files`) && groups.includes("notes/ 2 files") && groups[groups.length - 1] === "exports/ 1 file", "files are grouped by folder, exports last", JSON.stringify(groups));

  // 3c. "Saved by" on every row
  const texts = await rowTexts(tab);
  const by = (name) => texts.find((t) => t.startsWith(name)) || "";
  check(/^plan\.md You · /.test(by("plan.md")) && /^welcome\.md Agent OS · /.test(by("welcome.md")) && /^created\.html Team Room \(Hermes\) · /.test(by("created.html")), "rows say You, Agent OS and Team Room (Hermes)", JSON.stringify(texts));
  check(/^hand\.txt — /.test(by("hand.txt")) && /^shot\.png — /.test(by("")) === false, "a file nobody is on record for says —", by("hand.txt"));
  check(/^corrupt\.md Team Room \(Hermes\)/.test(by("corrupt.md")) && /^overwritten\.md You /.test(by("overwritten.md")), "a damaged record and an overwritten file still read honestly");
  await shot(tab, "workspace", 1470, 956, "files");

  // 3d. Filters
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^Markdown/ }).click();
  const mdTags = await page.locator(".os-ws__row .os-ws__tag").allInnerTexts();
  check(mdTags.length === countOf(isMd) && mdTags.every((t) => t === "MD") && (await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^Markdown/ }).locator("svg").count()) === 1, "the Markdown chip shows 6 markdown files and a check mark");
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^All/ }).click();
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Saved by agents" }).click();
  const agentRows = await rowTexts(tab);
  const countLine = norm(await page.locator(".os-ws__count").innerText());
  check(agentRows.length === 4 && agentRows.every((t) => /Team Room/.test(t)) && countLine === `Showing 4 of ${N} files.`, `Saved by agents keeps the 4 Team Room files and says Showing 4 of ${N} files.`, `${agentRows.length} ${countLine}`);
  check(/4 saved by agents/.test(norm(await page.locator(".os-ws__bar").innerText())), "the bar count does not change with the filter");
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Saved by agents" }).click();
  await tab.getByLabel("Filter by name").fill("plan");
  check((await rows(tab).count()) === 1, "Filter by name finds plan.md");
  await tab.getByLabel("Filter by name").fill("zzzz");
  check((await tab.getByText("No files match these filters").count()) === 1, "no match is a designed state");
  await shot(tab, "workspace", 1470, 956, "no-match");
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Clear filters" }).click();
  check((await rows(tab).count()) === N && (await tab.getByLabel("Filter by name").inputValue()) === "", "Clear filters brings every file back");

  // 3e. A Markdown file
  await open(tab, "plan.md");
  check((await tab.locator(".os-ws__title").innerText()) === "notes/plan.md" && (await row(tab, "plan.md").first().getAttribute("aria-current")) === "true", "plan.md opens, and its row is marked as the current one");
  const meta = norm(await tab.locator(".os-ws__meta").innerText());
  check(/Markdown/.test(meta) && /Saved by You/.test(meta), "the preview says Markdown and Saved by You", meta);
  await tab.locator(".os-md").waitFor();
  const md = await tab.evaluate(() => {
    const root = document.querySelector(".os-md");
    return { h3: root.querySelector("h3")?.textContent, strong: root.querySelector("strong")?.textContent, code: root.querySelector("li code")?.textContent, scripts: root.querySelectorAll("script").length, links: root.querySelectorAll("a, img").length, text: root.textContent.includes("<script>alert(1)</script>"), ol: root.querySelectorAll("ol li").length };
  });
  check(md.h3 === "Plan" && md.strong === "brief" && md.code === "npm test" && md.ol === 2, "Markdown is drawn: heading, bold, code, lists", JSON.stringify(md));
  check(md.scripts === 0 && md.links === 0 && md.text, "a script tag in a note is shown as text and never runs");
  check((await undoButton(tab).count()) === 0, "no Undo on a file you saved yourself");
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Source" }).click();
  check((await tab.locator(".os-ws__page pre").innerText()).startsWith("# Plan") && (await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Source" }).getAttribute("aria-pressed")) === "true", "Source shows the raw text");
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Preview" }).click();
  await shot(tab, "workspace", 1470, 956, "preview-md");
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Copy path" }).click();
  const copied = await tab.evaluate(() => navigator.clipboard.readText());
  check(copied === path.join(wsRoot.absolutePath, "notes/plan.md"), "Copy path puts the real path on the clipboard", copied);
  check((await tab.locator(".os-ws__ok").innerText()).includes("Copied the path."), "and says so");
  check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Show in Finder" }).count()) === 0, "Show in Finder is hidden in a browser tab");

  // 3f. An HTML file: the locked preview
  await open(tab, "created.html");
  const frame = tab.locator('iframe[title^="Locked preview"]');
  check((await frame.getAttribute("sandbox")) === "" && (await frame.getAttribute("src")).startsWith("/api/workspace/raw?id="), "HTML is drawn in an iframe with an empty sandbox, from the raw route");
  await frame.waitFor();
  const inFrame = await tab.frameLocator('iframe[title^="Locked preview"]').locator("#js").innerText();
  check(inFrame === "js off", "scripts inside the preview did not run", inFrame);
  check((await tab.locator(".os-ws__lock").innerText()).includes("Locked preview."), "the lock note is there");
  await shot(tab, "workspace", 1470, 956, "preview-html");

  // 3g. Review Focus 3: when Undo is not offered
  for (const name of ["hand.txt", "corrupt.md", "overwritten.md", "plan.md", "welcome.md"]) {
    await open(tab, name);
    check((await undoButton(tab).count()) === 0, `no Undo this save on ${name}`);
  }
  await open(tab, "hand.txt");
  const handMeta = norm(await tab.locator(".os-ws__meta").innerText());
  check(/Saved by —/.test(handMeta), "a file nobody is on record for reads Saved by —", handMeta);
  await open(tab, "overwritten.md");
  check(/Saved by You/.test(norm(await tab.locator(".os-ws__meta").innerText())), "a file you saved over reads Saved by You");

  // 3h. Undo this save: the question, the keyboard, and each outcome
  await open(tab, "refused.md");
  check(/Saved by Team Room \(Hermes\)/.test(norm(await tab.locator(".os-ws__meta").innerText())) && (await undoButton(tab).count()) === 1, "a Team Room file has Undo this save");
  await undoButton(tab).focus();
  await undoButton(tab).press("Enter");
  const dialog = tab.getByRole("dialog");
  check((await dialog.count()) === 1 && (await tab.locator("#os-modal-title").innerText()) === "Undo this save?" && (await dialog.innerText()).includes("drafts/refused.md"), "Undo asks first, in a dialog titled Undo this save?");
  await shot(tab, "workspace", 1470, 956, "undo-dialog");
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) await tab.keyboard.press("Tab");
  check(await tab.evaluate(() => Boolean(document.activeElement?.closest('[role="dialog"]'))), "focus stays inside the dialog");
  await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
  check((await dialog.count()) === 0 && (await tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.textContent?.includes("Undo this save"))), "Escape closes it and focus returns to the button");
  check(world.undoCalls.length === 0, "nothing was undone by asking");
  // the server refuses
  const listsBefore = world.listCalls;
  await undoButton(tab).click();
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Undo save" }).click();
  await tab.getByText("copy of the file from before this save is missing", { exact: false }).waitFor();
  check(world.undoCalls.join("") === "C" && (await dialog.count()) === 0, "a refused Undo closes the dialog");
  const refusal = norm(await page.locator('[role="alert"]').innerText());
  check(refusal.includes("The file is unchanged.") && !/backup_missing/.test(refusal), "and says why in plain words, with no error code", refusal);
  check(world.listCalls > listsBefore && (await row(tab, "refused.md").count()) === 1 && (await undoButton(tab).count()) === 1, "the list is asked again, and the file stays");
  // the room changed a file that was there: Undo puts the old copy back
  await open(tab, "updated.md");
  await undoButton(tab).click();
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Undo save" }).click();
  await tab.locator(".os-ws__ok").getByText("back to how it was before the agent saved it").waitFor();
  check(world.undoCalls.join("") === "CB" && /Saved by —/.test(norm(await tab.locator(".os-ws__meta").innerText())) && (await undoButton(tab).count()) === 0, "Undo on a changed file says it is back, then Saved by — and no more Undo");
  // the room created a file: Undo removes it
  await open(tab, "created.html");
  const agentsBefore = norm(await page.locator(".os-ws__bar").innerText());
  await undoButton(tab).click();
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Undo save" }).click();
  await tab.locator(".os-ws__ok").getByText("was removed, because the Team Room created it").waitFor();
  check(world.undoCalls.join("") === "CBA" && (await row(tab, "created.html").count()) === 0 && (await tab.locator(".os-ws__title").count()) === 0 && (await tab.getByRole("heading", { name: "New note" }).count()) === 1, "Undo on a created file removes it and shows the New note form");
  check(!(await tab.getByText("is no longer in the workspace").count()), "and does not also claim the file went missing");
  const barAfter = norm(await page.locator(".os-ws__bar").innerText());
  check(barAfter.includes(`${N - 1} files`) && /2 saved by agents/.test(barAfter) && /3 saved by agents/.test(agentsBefore), `the counts update: from ${N} files and 3 saved by agents to ${N - 1} and 2`, barAfter);
  check(new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("file") === null, "the address no longer names the removed file");

  // 3i. New note: save, then a name that is taken
  const save = tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Save note" });
  check(await save.isDisabled(), "Save note is off until there is something to save");
  await tab.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Name", exact: true }).fill("Ideas for the blog!");
  check((await tab.locator(".os-ws__saveas").innerText()).includes("notes/Ideas-for-the-blog.md"), "Saved as shows the cleaned name the server will use");
  await tab.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Note", exact: true }).fill("Three ideas");
  await tab.waitForTimeout(300); // the button fades from its off look to cobalt
  check((await save.evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor)) === "rgb(56, 102, 238)", "Save note is the one cobalt button, once there is a note to save");
  await save.click();
  await tab.locator(".os-ws__ok").getByText("Saved notes/Ideas-for-the-blog.md.").waitFor();
  check((await tab.locator(".os-ws__title").innerText()) === "notes/Ideas-for-the-blog.md" && /Saved by You/.test(norm(await tab.locator(".os-ws__meta").innerText())), "the new note opens, Saved by You");
  const saved = await api("GET", "/api/workspace");
  check(saved.json.files.find((f) => f.id === ID("notes/Ideas-for-the-blog.md"))?.savedBy?.kind === "you", "the server also records it as yours");
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "New note" }).click();
  check(await tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.closest("label")?.textContent?.startsWith("Name")), "New note puts the cursor in Name");
  await tab.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Name", exact: true }).fill("ideas for the blog");
  await tab.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Note", exact: true }).fill("A different text");
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Save note" }).click();
  await tab.getByText("already exists", { exact: false }).waitFor();
  check(await tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.textContent?.includes("Choose another name")), "a taken name asks first, and focus lands on the safe answer");
  check((await readFile(path.join(wsRoot.absolutePath, "notes/Ideas-for-the-blog.md"), "utf8")) === "Three ideas", "nothing was replaced yet");
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Replace file" }).click();
  await tab.locator(".os-ws__ok").getByText("Saved notes/Ideas-for-the-blog.md.").waitFor();
  check((await readFile(path.join(wsRoot.absolutePath, "notes/Ideas-for-the-blog.md"), "utf8")) === "A different text", "Replace file replaces it");

  // 3j. Deep links other pages use
  await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=workspace&folder=loop`);
  await tab.getByText("No Loop briefings yet").waitFor();
  check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /Folder loop\// }).count()) === 1 && (await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Open Loop" }).count()) === 1, "?folder=loop shows its chip and an Open Loop button");
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Open Loop" }).click();
  check(new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("page") === "loop", "Open Loop goes to Loop");
  await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=workspace&folder=drafts`);
  await rows(tab).first().waitFor();
  check((await rows(tab).count()) === nDrafts - 1 && (await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /Folder drafts\// }).count()) === 1, "?folder=drafts lists only that folder");
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /Folder drafts\// }).click();
  check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /Folder drafts\// }).count()) === 0 && new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("folder") === null, "removing the folder chip clears the address too");
  await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=workspace&file=${encodeURIComponent(ID("notes/todo.txt"))}`);
  await tab.locator(".os-ws__title").waitFor();
  check((await tab.locator(".os-ws__title").innerText()) === "notes/todo.txt" && (await tab.locator(".os-ws__page pre").innerText()).includes("call the dentist"), "?file= opens that file");
  await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=workspace&file=${encodeURIComponent(ID("notes/nope.md"))}`);
  await tab.getByText("That file is not in the workspace any more.").waitFor();
  check((await tab.getByRole("heading", { name: "New note" }).count()) === 1 && new URL(tab.url()).searchParams.get("file") === null, "?file= for a file that is gone says so and shows the New note form");

  // 3k. Keyboard
  await tab.goto(`${BASE}/?page=workspace`);
  await rows(tab).first().waitFor();
  await rows(tab).first().focus();
  await tab.keyboard.press("ArrowDown");
  check(await tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement === document.querySelectorAll(".os-ws__row")[1]), "ArrowDown moves from row to row");
  const ring = await tab.evaluate(() => { const cs = getComputedStyle(document.activeElement); return { style: cs.outlineStyle, width: parseFloat(cs.outlineWidth) }; });
  check(ring.style !== "none" && ring.width >= 2, "the focused row has a visible ring", JSON.stringify(ring));
  await tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
  check((await tab.locator(".os-ws__title").count()) === 1, "Enter opens the file");
  await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Source" }).count();

  // 3l. No console errors on the way
  const real = notRealErrors(errors);
  check(real.length === 0, "no console errors", real.join(" / "));
  await context.close();

  // ---- 4. Loading, and Agent OS unreachable ---------------------------------
  {
    const { context: c, tab: t } = await openPage(browser, 1470, 956, "workspace");
    await t.route((url) => url.pathname === "/api/workspace", async (route) => {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));
      await route.continue();
    });
    await t.reload();
    await t.getByText("Loading files…").waitFor({ state: "attached" });
    const loadingBar = norm(await t.locator(".os-ws__bar").innerText());
    check(/…/.test(loadingBar) && (await t.locator(".os-ws__skeleton").count()) > 0 && (await t.getByRole("button", { name: "Save note" }).isDisabled()), "while loading: … for the counts, skeleton rows, Save note off", loadingBar);
    await shot(t, "workspace", 1470, 956, "loading");
    await rows(t).first().waitFor();
    await c.close();
  }
  {
    const { context: c, tab: t } = await openPage(browser, 1470, 956, "workspace");
    const down = (url) => url.pathname === "/api/workspace";
    await t.route(down, (route) => route.abort());
    await t.reload();
    await t.getByText("Agent OS can't be reached").waitFor();
    const downBar = norm(await t.locator(".os-ws__bar").innerText());
    check(/—/.test(downBar) && (await t.getByRole("button", { name: "Save note" }).isDisabled()) && (await t.getByText("Saving is available once Agent OS can be reached.").count()) === 1, "unreachable: — for the counts, Save note off and says why", downBar);
    await shot(t, "workspace", 1470, 956, "offline");
    await t.unroute(down);
    await t.getByRole("button", { name: "Try again" }).click();
    await rows(t).first().waitFor();
    check((await rows(t).count()) > 0, "Try again recovers when Agent OS is back");
    await c.close();
  }

  // ---- 5. A file that disappears after the list loaded -----------------------
  {
    await put(wsRoot.absolutePath, "drafts/vanish.md", "# soon gone\n");
    const { context: c, tab: t } = await openPage(browser, 1470, 956, "workspace");
    await simulate(t);
    await t.reload();
    await rows(t).first().waitFor();
    await rm(path.join(wsRoot.absolutePath, "drafts/vanish.md"));
    await open(t, "vanish.md");
    await t.getByText("This file is no longer in the workspace.").waitFor();
    const gone = norm(await t.locator('section.os-ws [role="alert"]').innerText());
    check(!/ENOENT|\//.test(gone.replace("This file is no longer in the workspace.", "")), "a vanished file says so in plain words, with no raw error", gone);
    await t.getByRole("button", { name: "Refresh the list" }).click();
    await t.getByText("That file is not in the workspace any more.").waitFor();
    check((await row(t, "vanish.md").count()) === 0, "refreshing drops it from the list");
    await c.close();
  }

  // ---- 6. Show in Finder: only in the desktop app, only with the opener ------
  {
    const { context: c, tab: t } = await openPage(browser, 1470, 956, "workspace");
    await t.goto(`${BASE}/?page=workspace&desktop=1`);
    await rows(t).first().waitFor();
    const finder = t.getByRole("button", { name: "Show in Finder" });
    check((await finder.count()) === (opener ? 1 : 0), opener ? "desktop app: Show in Finder is in the folder bar" : "no opener installed: no Show in Finder, even in the desktop app");
    await open(t, "plan.md");
    check((await finder.count()) === (opener ? 1 : 0), opener ? "desktop app: Show in Finder is in the preview tools" : "no opener installed: still no button next to a file");
    if (opener) {
      await finder.click();
      await t.locator('section.os-ws [role="alert"]').waitFor();
      check(/Finder/.test(norm(await t.locator('section.os-ws [role="alert"]').innerText())), "when the reveal fails, the page says so in words");
    }
    await c.close();
  }

  // ---- 7. Width, reduced motion, and screenshots at the three sizes ----------
  await put(wsRoot.absolutePath, "drafts/wide.html", "<!doctype html><h1>Wide</h1><p>A page for the width check.</p>");
  for (const [w, h] of [[800, 900], [1024, 640], [1280, 720], [1470, 956], [1512, 982]]) {
    const { context: c, tab: t } = await openPage(browser, w, h, "workspace");
    await simulate(t);
    await t.reload();
    await rows(t).first().waitFor();
    const overflowList = await t.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth);
    const covered = w === 1470 && h === 956; // this size was already photographed, in the order that tells the story
    if (!covered) await shot(t, "workspace", w, h, "files");
    await open(t, "plan.md");
    const overflowPreview = await t.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth);
    check(overflowList <= 0 && overflowPreview <= 0, `no sideways scroll at ${w} px`, `${overflowList}/${overflowPreview}`);
    if (!covered) await shot(t, "workspace", w, h, "preview-md");
    if (w === 1024) {
      await open(t, "wide.html");
      check((await t.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth)) <= 0, "no sideways scroll at 1024 px with an HTML preview open");
    }
    await c.close();
  }
  {
    const { context: c, tab: t } = await openPage(browser, 1470, 956, "workspace");
    await t.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "reduce" });
    await rows(t).first().waitFor();
    const duration = await t.evaluate(() => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(".os-ws__row")).transitionDuration);
    check(duration === "0.001s", "reduced motion switches the row transition off", duration);
    await c.close();
  }
}
````

### Task B4: Setup page (step rail + panel, on the Cobalt kit)

Why this exists, in plain words: Setup is where a new person gets Agent OS ready. It already works (same six steps, same jobs, same server calls); it looks like the old design. This task redraws it as the approved prototype shows: one calm panel with a step rail beside it, hairline tables instead of boxed cards, a footer that always stays in view, and an icon plus a word for every result. Nothing about what Setup does changes, with four small honest exceptions that the new layout needs: (1) the Hermes row no longer offers Update (Task B1 removed that step on the server, so the page must cope with an installed agent that has no update step); (2) a Back button and a Skip for now button join the footers so nobody is trapped on a step; (3) the Plan step's group button says "Update coding agents" when the only work is updates (today it says "Install"); (4) the Ready step's primary button is "Go to Home", because "Open a session" arrives with SP3.

- Modify: `src/ui/components/SetupCheckList.tsx` (whole file: becomes a table)
- Modify: `src/ui/components/SetupInstallPanel.tsx` (whole file: no outer panel, new look, same behaviour)
- Modify: `src/ui/components/SetupSignInPanel.tsx` (imports at lines 6-13, the `AGENTS` list, the `copied` field and the `onCopy` function at lines 152-162, `MARK` at lines 46-54, `STATE_TEXT` at lines 56-63, the signature at line 65, a new block after line 165, and the whole `return (...)` at lines 167-300)
- Modify: `src/ui/components/SetupReadyPanel.tsx` (whole file)
- Modify: `src/ui/components/SetupModal.tsx` (signature at lines 9-17 and the actions block at lines 80-88: two optional props, same defaults)
- Modify: `src/ui/setupGroupShared.ts` (append the `PlanSelection` type)
- Modify: `src/ui/setup.css` (whole file rewritten)

- Create: `src/ui/components/SetupStatus.tsx`, `SetupSegmented.tsx`, `SetupCommand.tsx`, `SetupFooter.tsx`, `SetupPlanGroup.tsx`, `SetupPlanRow.tsx`, `SetupChanges.tsx`

- Create (git-ignored, not committed): `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/setup.mjs`
- `.superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs`: no edit. Its `pages` mode only checks sideways scroll and console errors for `setup` (grep shows no h1 text check for it), and the Setup h1 stays "Setup".

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (all existing, unchanged):
  - `src/setupApi.ts`: `getSetupCheck(refresh)`, `getSetupPlan("all")`, `getBrainOptions(refresh)`, `startInstallJob({ steps, acceptOpenClawRisk })`, `getSetupJob(id)`, `cancelSetupJob(id)`, `retrySetupJob(id)`, `recallJobId` / `rememberJobId`, `friendlyError(error, fallback?)`, `getSignIn`, `startSignInRun`, `cancelSignInRun`, `openSignInTerminal`, `getReceipt`, `getAgentDetail`, and the types `SystemCheck`, `SetupPlan`, `SetupPlanStep`, `SetupJob`, `SetupJobStep`, `SignInInfo`, `SignInRun`, `ReceiptEntry`, `AgentDetail`, `BrainOptionsResponse`.
  - `src/api.ts`: `listAgents()` (for the agents' display labels and licences).
  - `src/ui/components/SetupBrainPanel.tsx`: default export and the types `BrainAgentLine`, `BrainPanelStatus` (unchanged), `useInterval`, `RelativeTime` (default) and `TimeAgo` (named) from `RelativeTime.tsx`.
  - The page kit from Task C1 (must be applied first): `PageHeader` (`{ eyebrow?, title, titleId?, lede?, actions? }`), `Banner` (`{ tone: "info" | "ok" | "warn" | "danger", title?, children?, actions? }`: `role="status"` for info/ok, `role="alert"` for warn/danger), `EmptyState` (`{ icon, title, body?, action? }`), and the table classes `.os-table`, `.os-table__head`, `.os-table__row`, `.os-table__cell` with the columns set by the custom property `--os-table-cols` on `.os-table` (same use as Task A3's room list).
  - Task B1 (must be applied first): the plan has no `hermes-update` step, so `stepsFor("hermes").updateStep` is `undefined`.
- Produces:
  - `SetupStatus({ tone: "ok" | "info" | "warn" | "error" | "unknown" | "live", children })` (icon plus word) and `type SetupTone`.
  - `SetupSegmented({ label, value, options: { value, label, disabled? }[], onChange, disabled? })` (radio group with roving tab stop and arrow keys).
  - `SetupCommand({ command, label? })` (code line with a copy button).
  - `SetupFooter({ onBack?, backDisabled?, note?, children })` (the sticky step footer).
  - `SetupPlanGroup`, `SetupPlanRow`, `SetupChanges` (Plan step) with the props written in Steps 7 and 8.
  - `SetupStepper({ steps: SetupStepDef[], onSelect })` where `SetupStepDef = { key, label, line, summary?, state, current }` and `SetupStepState = "done" | "current" | "not-reached" | "failed" | "partial"` (`partial` is a step that was passed with part of its job left: some agents without a brain, some not signed in).
  - `SetupModal` gains `cancelLabel?: string` (default "Cancel") and `confirmTone?: "primary" | "danger"` (default "primary"); its `id="os-setup-modal-title"` label stays. The Safety page's use of it is unchanged.
  - `SetupInstallPanel`: `title` becomes optional; every other prop is unchanged (the AI brain panel still passes `title`, `stepLabels`, `onCancel`, `onRetry`, `retryLabel`).
  - `SetupSignInPanel` gains `onBack?: () => void` and `onSummary?: (s: { signedIn: number; installed: number }) => void`.
  - `SetupReadyPanel` gains `onProblems?: (n: number | null) => void` (it has no Back button: its footer is "Run Setup again", "Open Safety" and "Go to Home").
  - `PlanSelection` is now exported from `src/ui/setupGroupShared.ts` (it used to come from `SetupPlanCard.tsx`).
  - CSS kept on purpose for the Safety page until its own task rebuilds it: `.os-setup__alert`, `.os-setup__loading`, `.os-setup-brain__error`, and the `.os-setup-modal*` rules.
- Consumed by: Task E1 (verification). The Safety task must not remove the CSS rules named above from `setup.css` before it stops using them.

**Rules for the worker (restated):** do not commit, push, tag or set `CI=true`; use only the fake agents of the audit harness (temp `HOME`); never read `.env` files or the `~/.claude`, `~/.codex`, `~/.cursor`, `~/.openclaw`, `~/.hermes` credential files; do not install packages (none are needed here); retry each check until it is green; report anything you could not do.

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the probe first and watch it fail.**

Create `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/setup.mjs` (git-ignored; do not commit). It uses only the fake agents. The one job it starts is "Update Claude Code", which runs the fake `claude update` (the script exits at once). It never updates Codex or OpenClaw.

```js
// Task B4: the Setup page (step rail, one panel, sticky footer).
// Run: node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/setup.mjs
const NAMES = ["Check", "Plan", "Install", "AI brain", "Sign in", "Ready"];
const clean = (s) => (s || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();

export default async function ({ browser, openPage, shot, pass, fail }) {
  const SUB = "setup";
  const text = async (tab, sel) => clean(await tab.locator(sel).first().textContent().catch(() => ""));
  const stepTitle = (tab) => text(tab, "#os-setup-step-title");
  const sideways = (tab) => tab.evaluate(() => document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth > document.scrollingElement.clientWidth);
  // The page root and everything inside it: no class that starts with "aos-" (the old look).
  const aosInside = (tab) =>
    tab.evaluate(
      () => [document.querySelector(".os-setup"), ...document.querySelectorAll(".os-setup *")].filter((el) => el && /(^|\s)aos-/.test(el.getAttribute("class") || "")).length
    );
  const dashLines = (tab) =>
    tab.evaluate(() =>
      (document.querySelector(".os-setup")?.innerText || "")
        .split("\n").map((l) => l.trim()).filter((l) => l.includes("—") && l !== "—")
    );
  const waitTitle = (tab, title, ms = 12000) =>
    tab.waitForFunction((t) => document.querySelector("#os-setup-step-title")?.textContent === t, title, { timeout: ms }).catch(() => {});
  const ok = (cond, name, why = "") => (cond ? pass(name) : fail(name, why));

  // ---- 1. Check step at three sizes: rail layout, table, footer, no sideways scroll
  for (const [w, h] of [[1470, 956], [1280, 720], [1024, 640]]) {
    const tag = `check@${w}`;
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, w, h, "setup&step=check");
    await tab.getByRole("table", { name: "What Agent OS found on this computer" }).waitFor({ timeout: 15000 }).catch(() => {});
    ok((await text(tab, "h1")) === "Setup", `${tag} h1 is Setup`, await text(tab, "h1"));
    ok((await stepTitle(tab)) === "Check", `${tag} panel title is Check`, await stepTitle(tab));
    ok(/Step 1 of 6/.test(await text(tab, ".os-setup-panel__count")), `${tag} says Step 1 of 6`);
    const names = (await tab.locator('ol[aria-label="Setup steps"] .os-setup-step__name').allTextContents()).map(clean);
    ok(names.join("|") === NAMES.join("|"), `${tag} rail names`, names.join("|"));
    const cur = tab.locator('ol[aria-label="Setup steps"] [aria-current="step"]');
    ok((await cur.count()) === 1 && /Check/.test((await cur.first().textContent()) || ""), `${tag} aria-current is on Check`);
    const table = tab.getByRole("table", { name: "What Agent OS found on this computer" });
    const missing = [];
    for (const n of ["Operating system", "Git", "Node", "Internet reachability", "Hermes Agent", "OpenClaw", "Claude Code", "Codex", "Cursor CLI"]) {
      if (!(await table.getByRole("rowheader", { name: n, exact: true }).count())) missing.push(n);
    }
    ok(missing.length === 0, `${tag} check rows`, `missing: ${missing.join(", ")}`);
    const n = await tab.locator(".os-setup-status").count();
    const bad = await tab.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll(".os-setup-status")].filter((el) => !el.querySelector("svg") || !el.textContent.trim()).length);
    ok(n >= 14 && bad === 0, `${tag} every result is an icon plus a word (${n})`, `${n} found, ${bad} without icon or word`);
    ok(
      (await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Check again", exact: true }).count()) === 1 &&
        (await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^Back$/ }).count()) === 0 &&
        (await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^Continue/ }).count()) === 1,
      `${tag} footer has Check again and Continue, no Back`
    );
    ok((await aosInside(tab)) === 0, `${tag} no aos-* class inside the page`);
    const dashes = await dashLines(tab);
    ok(dashes.length === 0, `${tag} no em dash in visible text`, dashes.slice(0, 3).join(" / "));
    const cols = await tab.evaluate(() => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(".os-setup__wrap") || document.body).gridTemplateColumns.split(" ").length);
    ok(cols === (w >= 1101 ? 2 : 1), `${tag} rail beside the panel from 1101 px, above it below`, `${cols} column(s)`);
    ok(!(await sideways(tab)), `${tag} no sideways scroll`);
    const footBottom = await tab.evaluate(() => document.querySelector(".os-setup-foot")?.getBoundingClientRect().bottom ?? 99999);
    ok(footBottom <= h + 1, `${tag} footer stays in view`, `bottom=${Math.round(footBottom)} of ${h}`);
    await shot(tab, SUB, w, h, "check");
    ok(errors.length === 0, `${tag} console clean`, errors.join(" | ").slice(0, 200));
    await context.close();
  }

  // ---- 2. One run through the whole flow at 1280 px (the icon-rail range)
  {
    const tag = "flow@1280";
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, 1280, 720, "setup&step=plan");
    await tab.locator(".os-setup-group").first().waitFor({ timeout: 15000 }).catch(() => {});
    ok((await stepTitle(tab)) === "Plan", `${tag} ?step=plan lands on Plan`, await stepTitle(tab));
    const groups = (await tab.locator(".os-setup-group h3").allTextContents()).map(clean);
    ok(groups.join("|") === "Always-on agents|Coding agents", `${tag} two groups`, groups.join("|"));

    // Hermes has no update step (Task B1): the Update choice is off and the row says why.
    const hermes = tab.getByRole("radiogroup", { name: /^Hermes.*keep or update$/ });
    ok((await hermes.count()) === 1 && (await hermes.getByRole("radio", { name: "Update" }).isDisabled()), `${tag} Hermes cannot be updated`);
    ok((await tab.getByText(/does not update this agent yet/i).count()) >= 1, `${tag} the Hermes row explains why`);
    const oc = tab.getByRole("radiogroup", { name: /^OpenClaw.*keep or update$/ });
    ok(!(await oc.getByRole("radio", { name: "Update" }).isDisabled()), `${tag} OpenClaw can be updated`);
    // Nothing chosen yet: no group button, nothing to change.
    ok((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /Update coding agents|Install coding agents|Set up Hermes/ }).count()) === 0, `${tag} no group button while nothing is chosen`);
    ok(/Nothing\. What is installed stays exactly as it is\./.test(await text(tab, ".os-setup-changes")), `${tag} empty "what changes" copy`);
    await shot(tab, SUB, 1280, 720, "plan");

    // Choose Update for Claude Code (the fake): the changes block, the group button, the footer.
    const claude = tab.getByRole("radiogroup", { name: /^Claude.*keep or update$/ });
    await claude.getByRole("radio", { name: "Update" }).click();
    ok((await claude.getByRole("radio", { name: "Update" }).getAttribute("aria-checked")) === "true", `${tag} Update is chosen for Claude`);
    ok(/Claude/.test(await text(tab, ".os-setup-changes")), `${tag} "what changes" lists Claude`);
    const updateBtn = tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Update coding agents" });
    ok((await updateBtn.count()) === 1, `${tag} group button says Update coding agents`);
    ok((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /Skip installing, continue/ }).count()) === 1, `${tag} footer offers Skip installing, continue`);
    await shot(tab, SUB, 1280, 720, "plan-update");

    // Arrow keys move the choice inside one radio group.
    await claude.getByRole("radio", { name: "Update" }).focus();
    await tab.keyboard.press("ArrowLeft");
    ok((await claude.getByRole("radio", { name: "Keep" }).getAttribute("aria-checked")) === "true", `${tag} ArrowLeft chooses Keep`);
    await tab.keyboard.press("ArrowRight");
    ok((await claude.getByRole("radio", { name: "Update" }).getAttribute("aria-checked")) === "true", `${tag} ArrowRight chooses Update`);

    // The confirm dialog keeps its label; Escape closes it and gives focus back.
    await updateBtn.click();
    const dlg = tab.getByRole("dialog");
    ok((await dlg.count()) === 1 && (await dlg.getAttribute("aria-labelledby")) === "os-setup-modal-title", `${tag} dialog is labelled by os-setup-modal-title`);
    ok((await text(tab, "#os-setup-modal-title")) === "Update coding agents?", `${tag} dialog title`, await text(tab, "#os-setup-modal-title"));
    ok(/Claude/.test((await dlg.textContent()) || ""), `${tag} dialog lists the step`);
    await shot(tab, SUB, 1280, 720, "plan-confirm");
    await tab.keyboard.press("Escape");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(250);
    ok((await tab.getByRole("dialog").count()) === 0, `${tag} Escape closes the dialog`);
    const back = await tab.evaluate(() => (document.activeElement?.textContent || "").trim());
    ok(/Update coding agents/.test(back), `${tag} focus returns to the button`, back);

    // Run the fake update: Install step with a log that follows the newest line.
    await updateBtn.click();
    await tab.getByRole("dialog").getByRole("button", { name: "Update coding agents" }).click();
    await waitTitle(tab, "Install");
    ok((await stepTitle(tab)) === "Install", `${tag} confirming goes to Install`, await stepTitle(tab));
    await tab.getByText("Done", { exact: true }).first().waitFor({ timeout: 30000 }).catch(() => {});
    ok(/\d+ of \d+ steps completed/.test((await tab.locator(".os-setup-job__meter").getAttribute("aria-label")) || ""), `${tag} segmented meter has a label`);
    const log = tab.getByRole("log", { name: "Setup log" });
    ok((await log.count()) === 1, `${tag} the log is role=log`);
    const follows = await log.evaluate((el) => el.scrollHeight - el.scrollTop - el.clientHeight < 24).catch(() => false);
    ok(follows, `${tag} the log follows the newest line`);
    ok((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^Continue/ }).isEnabled()) && (await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^Back$/ }).isEnabled()), `${tag} Continue and Back are enabled after the job`);
    ok((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).count()) === 0, `${tag} no Cancel after the job finished`);
    const planRail = clean(await tab.locator('ol[aria-label="Setup steps"] li').nth(1).textContent());
    ok(/Done/.test(planRail), `${tag} rail shows Plan as done`, planRail);
    await shot(tab, SUB, 1280, 720, "install");

    // Continue lands on AI brain, with focus on the new step's title.
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^Continue/ }).click();
    await waitTitle(tab, "AI brain");
    ok((await stepTitle(tab)) === "AI brain", `${tag} Continue goes to AI brain`, await stepTitle(tab));
    ok(await tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.id === "os-setup-step-title"), `${tag} focus moves to the new step's title`);
    await tab.locator(".os-brain").first().waitFor({ timeout: 10000 }).catch(() => {});
    const brainText = (await tab.locator(".os-setup-panel").textContent()) || "";
    ok(/OpenRouter/.test(brainText) && /Local/.test(brainText), `${tag} brain step shows OpenRouter and Local`);
    const codingTable = tab.getByRole("table", { name: "Coding agents: no choice needed" });
    ok((await codingTable.getByRole("rowheader").count()) === 3, `${tag} coding agents listed with no choice`);
    ok(/Nothing to choose/.test((await codingTable.textContent()) || ""), `${tag} coding rows say Nothing to choose`);
    await shot(tab, SUB, 1280, 720, "brain");
    // OpenClaw has no brain in the fake setup, so the footer offers Skip for now, not Continue.
    ok((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Skip for now" }).count()) === 1, `${tag} brain footer offers Skip for now`);

    // Back goes to Install (a job exists), Continue returns, Skip for now goes to Sign in.
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^Back$/ }).click();
    await waitTitle(tab, "Install");
    ok((await stepTitle(tab)) === "Install", `${tag} Back from AI brain returns to Install`);
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^Continue/ }).click();
    await waitTitle(tab, "AI brain");
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Skip for now" }).click();
    await waitTitle(tab, "Sign in");
    ok((await stepTitle(tab)) === "Sign in", `${tag} Skip for now goes to Sign in`, await stepTitle(tab));
    await tab.waitForFunction(() => !document.body.innerText.includes("Checking…"), null, { timeout: 15000 }).catch(() => {});
    const signTable = tab.getByRole("table", { name: "Coding agent sign-in" });
    ok((await signTable.getByRole("rowheader").count()) === 3, `${tag} three sign-in rows`);
    ok(/never sees your password/i.test((await tab.locator(".os-setup-panel").textContent()) || ""), `${tag} sign-in says Agent OS never sees your password`);
    ok((await tab.locator(".os-setup-status").filter({ hasText: /Signed in|Not signed in|Can't tell/ }).count()) >= 1, `${tag} sign-in rows have a status word`);
    ok((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Check again", exact: true }).count()) === 1, `${tag} sign-in footer has Check again`);
    await shot(tab, SUB, 1280, 720, "signin");
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^(Continue|Skip for now)$/ }).click();
    await waitTitle(tab, "Ready");
    ok((await stepTitle(tab)) === "Ready", `${tag} sign-in leads to Ready`, await stepTitle(tab));
    await tab.getByRole("table", { name: "What is ready" }).waitFor({ timeout: 15000 }).catch(() => {});
    ok(/Agent OS is ready|Almost ready/.test((await tab.locator(".os-setup-panel").textContent()) || ""), `${tag} Ready headline`);
    const receiptBtn = tab.getByRole("button", { name: "What Setup changed on this computer" });
    ok((await receiptBtn.getAttribute("aria-expanded")) === "false", `${tag} receipt starts closed`);
    await receiptBtn.click();
    ok((await receiptBtn.getAttribute("aria-expanded")) === "true" && /Every change/.test((await tab.locator(".os-setup-panel").textContent()) || ""), `${tag} receipt opens`);
    ok((await tab.locator(".os-setup-foot .os-btn--primary").first().textContent())?.trim() === "Go to Home", `${tag} Go to Home is the primary button`);
    ok((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Open Safety" }).count()) === 1, `${tag} Open Safety is offered`);
    await shot(tab, SUB, 1280, 720, "ready");
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Run Setup again" }).click();
    await waitTitle(tab, "Check");
    ok((await stepTitle(tab)) === "Check", `${tag} Run Setup again returns to Check`);
    ok((await aosInside(tab)) === 0, `${tag} no aos-* class at the end`);
    ok(errors.length === 0, `${tag} console clean`, errors.join(" | ").slice(0, 300));
    await context.close();
  }

  // ---- 3. The check failing: a designed error, then recovery on Retry
  {
    const tag = "offline@1280";
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, 1280, 720, "setup&step=check");
    await tab.getByRole("table", { name: "What Agent OS found on this computer" }).waitFor({ timeout: 15000 }).catch(() => {});
    await tab.route("**/api/setup/check*", (route) => route.fulfill({ status: 500, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify({ error: "boom" }) }));
    await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Check again", exact: true }).click();
    const banner = tab.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: "Couldn't check this computer" });
    await banner.waitFor({ timeout: 8000 }).catch(() => {});
    ok((await banner.count()) === 1, `${tag} the failed check shows an alert`, "no alert");
    ok(await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^Continue/ }).isDisabled(), `${tag} Continue is off while the check is failing`);
    await shot(tab, SUB, 1280, 720, "check-error");
    await tab.unroute("**/api/setup/check*");
    await banner.getByRole("button", { name: "Retry" }).click();
    await tab.getByRole("table", { name: "What Agent OS found on this computer" }).waitFor({ timeout: 10000 }).catch(() => {});
    ok((await tab.getByRole("table", { name: "What Agent OS found on this computer" }).count()) === 1, `${tag} Retry brings the table back`);
    // (Console errors are not asserted here: the 500 is the point of this test.)
    await context.close();
  }

  // ---- 4. Narrow windows: the rail becomes a strip above the panel; no sideways scroll
  for (const [w, h] of [[900, 700], [390, 800]]) {
    for (const stepName of ["plan", "signin"]) {
      const tag = `${stepName}@${w}`;
      const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, w, h, `setup&step=${stepName}`);
      await tab.locator(".os-setup-panel").waitFor({ timeout: 15000 }).catch(() => {});
      await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
      ok(!(await sideways(tab)), `${tag} no sideways scroll`);
      const cols = await tab.evaluate(() => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(".os-setup__wrap") || document.body).gridTemplateColumns.split(" ").length);
      ok(cols === 1, `${tag} one column`, `${cols}`);
      const nameShown = await tab.evaluate(() => {
        const el = document.querySelector('.os-setup-step__body[aria-current="step"] .os-setup-step__name');
        const r = el?.getBoundingClientRect();
        return Boolean(r && r.width > 0 && r.height > 0);
      });
      ok(nameShown, `${tag} the current step's name is visible in the strip`);
      const footBottom = await tab.evaluate(() => document.querySelector(".os-setup-foot")?.getBoundingClientRect().bottom ?? 99999);
      ok(footBottom <= h + 1, `${tag} footer stays in view`, `bottom=${Math.round(footBottom)} of ${h}`);
      await shot(tab, SUB, w, h, stepName);
      ok(errors.length === 0, `${tag} console clean`, errors.join(" | ").slice(0, 200));
      await context.close();
    }
  }

  // ---- 5. The Agents page's Brain card still draws (it shares SetupBrainPanel and SetupInstallPanel)
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, 1470, 956, "agents&agent=hermes");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    ok(errors.length === 0, "agents page console clean after the Setup component changes", errors.join(" | ").slice(0, 200));
    await shot(tab, SUB, 1470, 956, "agents-brain-card");
    await context.close();
  }

  // ---- 6. The rail: a passed step can be reopened; keyboard reaches it; exactly one current step
  {
    const tag = "rail@1280";
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, 1280, 720, "setup&step=ready");
    await tab.getByRole("table", { name: "What is ready" }).waitFor({ timeout: 15000 }).catch(() => {});
    const rail = tab.locator('ol[aria-label="Setup steps"]');
    ok((await rail.locator('[aria-current="step"]').count()) === 1, `${tag} exactly one current step`);
    const reopen = rail.getByRole("button", { name: /Check/ });
    ok((await reopen.count()) === 1, `${tag} Check can be reopened from Ready`);
    ok((await rail.getByRole("button", { name: /Ready/ }).count()) === 0, `${tag} the step on screen is not a button`);
    await reopen.focus();
    await tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
    await waitTitle(tab, "Check");
    ok((await stepTitle(tab)) === "Check", `${tag} Enter on the rail button opens Check`, await stepTitle(tab));
    ok(await tab.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.id === "os-setup-step-title"), `${tag} focus moves to the title after using the rail`);
    ok(errors.length === 0, `${tag} console clean`, errors.join(" | ").slice(0, 200));
    await context.close();
  }
}
```

```tsx
// An icon plus a word for one result on the Setup page: "Found", "Installed",
// "Signed in". Never colour alone. The word is always in full ink; only the icon
// carries the tone. "info" and "unknown" are neutral grey, because cobalt is only

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Activity, Circle, CircleAlert, CircleCheck, Info, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";

export type SetupTone = "ok" | "info" | "warn" | "error" | "unknown" | "live";

const ICONS = {

  info: Info,
  warn: TriangleAlert,
  error: CircleAlert,
  unknown: Circle,
  live: Activity
} as const;

export default function SetupStatus({ tone, children }: { tone: SetupTone; children: ReactNode }) {
  const Icon = ICONS[tone];
  return (
    <span className={`os-setup-status os-setup-status--${tone}`}>
```

Create `src/ui/components/SetupSegmented.tsx` (a two-button choice such as Keep / Update; it is a radio group, so one button is the tab stop and the arrow keys move the choice, like native radio buttons):

```tsx
// A small segmented choice (Keep | Update, Install | Skip) built as a radio group:
// one button is the tab stop, the arrow keys move the choice, a disabled option
// is skipped. Used by the Plan step.
import { useRef } from "react";

export interface SegmentOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export default function SetupSegmented({
  label,
  value,
  options,
  onChange,
  disabled = false
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  options: SegmentOption[];
  onChange: (next: string) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  const buttons = useRef<Array<HTMLButtonElement | null>>([]);
  const usable = options.map((o, i) => (!disabled && !o.disabled ? i : -1)).filter((i) => i >= 0);
  const checkedIndex = options.findIndex((o) => o.value === value && !o.disabled);
  // Exactly one button is a tab stop: the chosen one, or else the first usable one.
  const stop = checkedIndex >= 0 ? checkedIndex : (usable[0] ?? -1);

  function move(from: number, step: 1 | -1) {
    const at = usable.indexOf(from);
    if (at < 0 || usable.length < 2) return;
    const next = usable[(at + step + usable.length) % usable.length];
    onChange(options[next].value);
    buttons.current[next]?.focus();
  }

  return (
    <div className="os-setup-seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label={label}>
      {options.map((option, i) => (
        <button
          key={option.value}
          ref={(el) => {
            buttons.current[i] = el;
          }}
          type="button"
          role="radio"
          aria-checked={option.value === value}
          className="os-setup-seg__btn"
          disabled={disabled || Boolean(option.disabled)}
          tabIndex={i === stop ? 0 : -1}
          onClick={() => onChange(option.value)}
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            if (event.key === "ArrowRight" || event.key === "ArrowDown") {
              event.preventDefault();
              move(i, 1);
            } else if (event.key === "ArrowLeft" || event.key === "ArrowUp") {
              event.preventDefault();
              move(i, -1);
            }
          }}
        >
          {option.label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

Create `src/ui/components/SetupCommand.tsx` (a command shown as text you can select, with a copy button; used by the Plan step's exact commands, the install failure, and the sign-in terminal command):

```tsx
// One command on its own line, selectable, with a copy button. If the browser
// blocks copying, nothing breaks: the text is still there to select by hand.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Check, Copy } from "lucide-react";

export default function SetupCommand({ command, label = "Copy command" }: { command: string; label?: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
    },
    []
  );

  async function copy() {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(command);
      setCopied(true);
      if (timer.current) clearTimeout(timer.current);
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1800);
    } catch {
      // Clipboard access denied; the command is still on screen to select.
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="os-setup-cmd">
      <code className="os-mono">{command}</code>
      <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost os-setup-cmd__copy" onClick={() => void copy()} aria-label={copied ? "Copied" : label}>
        {copied ? <Check size={16} aria-hidden="true" /> : <Copy size={16} aria-hidden="true" />}
      </button>
      <span className="os-visually-hidden" role="status">
        {copied ? "Copied" : ""}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: The step rail (`SetupStepper.tsx`, whole file).**

Replace the whole file:

```tsx
// The Setup Assistant's step rail: Check, Plan, Install, AI brain, Sign in, Ready.
// Each step is a mark, a name and one line. A finished step says what it found
// ("Done · 5 agents found") and can be reopened; steps not reached yet are plain
// text. The mark is a shape as well as a colour (ring, dot, check, dashed ring,
// alert) and each step says its state to a screen reader, so the rail always
// reflects what the server knows, never a wizard's page number.
import { Circle, CircleAlert, CircleCheck, CircleDashed } from "lucide-react";

// "partial" = the step was passed with part of its job left ("Not finished · 1 of 2
// have a brain"). It is neither a failure nor a finished step, so it has its own mark.
export type SetupStepState = "done" | "current" | "not-reached" | "failed" | "partial";

export interface SetupStepDef {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  // The one line shown until there is something to report: what the step is for.
  line: string;
  // Shown instead of `line` when the step has something to report ("Done · 5 agents found").
  summary?: string;
  state: SetupStepState;
  // True for the step on screen (it can also be "done", e.g. a finished Ready).
  current: boolean;
}

const SPOKEN: Record<SetupStepState, string> = {
  done: "Done. ",
  current: "Current step. ",
  "not-reached": "Not reached yet. ",
  failed: "Needs attention. ",
  partial: "Not finished. "
};

function Mark({ state }: { state: SetupStepState }) {
  if (state === "done") {
    return <CircleCheck className="os-setup-step__mark os-setup-step__mark--done" size={22} aria-hidden="true" />;
  }
  if (state === "failed") {
    return <CircleAlert className="os-setup-step__mark os-setup-step__mark--failed" size={22} aria-hidden="true" />;
  }
  if (state === "partial") {
    return <CircleDashed className="os-setup-step__mark os-setup-step__mark--partial" size={22} aria-hidden="true" />;
  }
  if (state === "current") {
    return (
      <svg
        className="os-setup-step__mark os-setup-step__mark--current"
        width="22"
        height="22"
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        strokeWidth="1.5"
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  return <Circle className="os-setup-step__mark os-setup-step__mark--todo" size={22} aria-hidden="true" />;
}

export default function SetupStepper({ steps, onSelect }: { steps: SetupStepDef[]; onSelect: (index: number) => void }) {
  return (
    <ol className="os-setup-rail" aria-label="Setup steps">
      {steps.map((step, index) => {
        // Only a step that was passed (finished, failed or left half done) and is not the one on screen can be reopened.
        const reopen = (step.state === "done" || step.state === "failed" || step.state === "partial") && !step.current;
        const body = (
          <>
            <Mark state={step.state} />
            <span className="os-setup-step__text">
              <span className="os-visually-hidden">{SPOKEN[step.state]}</span>
              <b className="os-setup-step__name">{step.label}</b>
              <span className="os-setup-step__line">{step.summary || step.line}</span>
            </span>
          </>
        );
        return (
          <li key={step.key} className={`os-setup-step os-setup-step--${step.state}${step.current ? " is-current" : ""}`}>
            {reopen ? (
              <button type="button" className="os-setup-step__body" onClick={() => onSelect(index)}>
                {body}
              </button>
            ) : (
              <div className="os-setup-step__body" aria-current={step.current ? "step" : undefined}>
                {body}
              </div>
            )}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );
}
```

Every row is built from the real `GET /api/setup/check` data. The source of each value is in the comments. Rows no longer use a coloured dot; each result is an icon plus a word. The words are written so a wrong value is never shown as a success: unknown is "—", and a missing optional tool is "Optional" or "Handled by Setup", not "Failed".

Replace the whole file:

```tsx
// The "Check" step's table: one row per real probe from GET /api/setup/check,
// then one row per agent. Each result is an icon plus a word. Rows appear
// together (no staggered fake progress). Unknown values are "—".
import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from "react";
import SetupStatus, { type SetupTone } from "./SetupStatus";
import { AGENT_NAMES } from "../setupGroupShared";
import type { SystemCheck } from "../../setupApi";

const COLUMNS = "minmax(132px, 176px) minmax(0, 1fr) 176px";
const AGENT_IDS = ["hermes", "openclaw", "claude", "codex", "cursor"] as const;
// Hermes calls it a background service, OpenClaw a Gateway.
const SERVICE_WORD: Record<string, string> = { hermes: "background service", openclaw: "Gateway" };

interface RowDef {
  name: string;
  detail: ReactNode;
  tone: SetupTone;
  word: string;
}

function gb(n: number | null | undefined) {
  if (typeof n !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(n)) return "—";
  return `${n.toFixed(1)} GB`;
}

function computerRows(check: SystemCheck): RowDef[] {
  const tools = check.tools;
  const isMac = check.os === "darwin";
  const platform = isMac ? "macOS" : check.os === "win32" ? "Windows" : "Linux";
  const network = check.network || [];
  const reachable = network.filter((n) => n.ok).length;
  const unreachable = network.filter((n) => !n.ok).map((n) => n.host);
  const rows: RowDef[] = [
    { name: "Operating system", detail: `${platform}${check.osVersion ? ` ${check.osVersion}` : ""} · ${check.arch}`, tone: "ok", word: "Found" }
  ];
  if (isMac && check.isIntelMac) {
    rows.push({
      name: "Chip",
      detail: "Intel Mac. Hermes does not support Intel Macs yet, so Setup sets up OpenClaw only.",
      tone: "warn",
      word: "Limited"
    });
  }
  rows.push(
    typeof check.ramGb === "number"
      ? { name: "Memory", detail: `${check.ramGb.toFixed(1)} GB total`, tone: "ok", word: "Found" }
      : { name: "Memory", detail: "—", tone: "unknown", word: "—" },
    typeof check.freeDiskGb === "number"
      ? { name: "Free disk space", detail: gb(check.freeDiskGb), tone: "ok", word: "Found" }
      : { name: "Free disk space", detail: "—", tone: "unknown", word: "—" },
    tools?.git?.found
      ? { name: "Git", detail: tools.git.version || "Installed", tone: "ok", word: "Found" }
      : { name: "Git", detail: "Not found. It may be installed automatically.", tone: "info", word: "Not found" }
  );
  // An older system Node is not a problem: Setup gives OpenClaw its own newer copy.
  if (tools?.node?.found && tools.node.nodeOkForOpenClaw) {
    rows.push({ name: "Node", detail: tools.node.version || "Installed", tone: "ok", word: "Found" });
  } else if (tools?.node?.found) {
    rows.push({
      name: "Node",
      detail: `${tools.node.version || "Installed"} · older than OpenClaw needs, so Setup gives OpenClaw its own copy`,
      tone: "info",
      word: "Handled by Setup"
    });
  } else {
    rows.push({ name: "Node", detail: "Not found. A managed Node is downloaded if needed.", tone: "info", word: "Handled by Setup" });
  }
  rows.push(
    tools?.uv?.found || tools?.python3?.found
      ? {
          name: "Python and uv",
          detail: tools?.uv?.found ? `uv ${tools.uv.version || "installed"}` : `python3 ${tools?.python3?.version || "installed"}`,
          tone: "ok",
          word: "Found"
        }
      : { name: "Python and uv", detail: "Not found.", tone: "info", word: "Not found" },
    tools?.docker?.found
      ? tools.docker.running
        ? { name: "Docker", detail: "Installed, running", tone: "ok", word: "Found" }
        : { name: "Docker", detail: "Installed, not running", tone: "warn", word: "Not running" }
      : { name: "Docker", detail: "Not found. It is optional.", tone: "unknown", word: "Optional" }
  );
  if (!network.length) {
    rows.push({ name: "Internet reachability", detail: "—", tone: "unknown", word: "—" });
  } else if (reachable === network.length) {
    rows.push({ name: "Internet reachability", detail: `All ${network.length} install sites can be reached`, tone: "ok", word: "Reachable" });
  } else if (reachable > 0) {
    rows.push({
      name: "Internet reachability",
      detail: `${reachable} of ${network.length} install sites reachable. Can't reach ${unreachable.join(", ")}. Check your internet connection.`,
      tone: "warn",
      word: "Partly reachable"
    });
  } else {
    rows.push({
      name: "Internet reachability",
      detail: "Can't reach any install site. Check your internet connection.",
      tone: "error",
      word: "Not reachable"
    });
  }
  rows.push(
    check.ollama?.found
      ? { name: "Ollama", detail: check.ollama.version || "Installed", tone: "ok", word: "Found" }
      : { name: "Ollama", detail: "Not installed. Only needed for a Local brain.", tone: "unknown", word: "Not installed" }
  );
  return rows;
}

function agentRows(check: SystemCheck): RowDef[] {
  return AGENT_IDS.map((id) => {
    const entry = check.agents?.[id];
    const installed = Boolean(entry?.detected.installed);
    const service =
      installed && entry?.service && SERVICE_WORD[id] ? ` · ${SERVICE_WORD[id]} ${entry.service.running ? "running" : "stopped"}` : "";
    return {
      name: AGENT_NAMES[id],
      detail: installed ? (
        <>
          <span className="os-mono">{entry?.detected.version || "—"}</span>
          {service}
        </>
      ) : (
        "—"
      ),
      tone: installed ? "ok" : "unknown",
      word: installed ? "Installed" : "Not installed"
    } satisfies RowDef;
  });
}

function Row({ name, detail, tone, word }: RowDef) {
  return (
    <div className="os-table__row" role="row">
      <div className="os-table__cell os-setup-table__name" role="rowheader">
        {name}
      </div>
      <div className="os-table__cell os-setup-table__detail" role="cell">
        {detail}
      </div>
      <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">
        <SetupStatus tone={tone}>{word}</SetupStatus>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function SetupCheckList({ check }: { check: SystemCheck }) {
  return (
    <div
      className="os-table os-setup-table"
      role="table"
      aria-label="What Agent OS found on this computer"
      style={{ "--os-table-cols": COLUMNS } as CSSProperties}
    >
      <div className="os-table__head" role="row">
        {["This computer", "What Agent OS found", "Result"].map((heading) => (
          <span key={heading} className="os-table__cell os-micro" role="columnheader">
            {heading}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
      {computerRows(check).map((row) => (
        <Row key={row.name} {...row} />
      ))}
      <div className="os-table__group os-setup-table__group" role="presentation">
        <b>Agents</b>
        <span>Found on this computer</span>
      </div>
      {agentRows(check).map((row) => (
        <Row key={row.name} {...row} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// with a one-line description, the group's own action button (it sits in the
```
