              {actionLabel}
            </button>
            {hint ? <span className="os-setup-group__hint">{hint}</span> : null}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </header>
      {note ? (
        <p className="os-setup-group__note" role="status">
          {note}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <div className="os-table os-setup-table" role="table" aria-label={`${title}: your choices`} style={{ "--os-table-cols": COLUMNS } as CSSProperties}>
        <div className="os-table__head" role="row">
          {["Agent", "Your choice", "What happens"].map((heading) => (
            <span key={heading} className="os-table__cell os-micro" role="columnheader">
              {heading}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
        {children}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

Create `src/ui/components/SetupPlanRow.tsx`:

```tsx
// One agent's row on the Plan step. Everything on it comes off the plan the
// server computed (GET /api/setup/plan): what is installed, what an install or an
// update would do, the licence and the source links. Nothing is invented here, so
// an installed agent with no update step (Hermes today, Task B1) simply cannot be
// updated, and the row says so.
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { ExternalLink, Lock } from "lucide-react";
import SetupSegmented from "./SetupSegmented";
import SetupStatus from "./SetupStatus";
import { formatMinutes, formatSize, totalsOf, type PlanSelection } from "../setupGroupShared";
import type { SetupPlanStep } from "../../setupApi";

export interface OpenClawConsent {
  accepted: boolean;
  onToggle: (next: boolean) => void;
}

function Links({ license, sourceUrl, termsUrl }: { license?: string; sourceUrl?: string; termsUrl?: string | null }) {
  if (!license && !sourceUrl && !termsUrl) return null;
  return (
    <span className="os-setup-links">
      {license ? <span>Licence: {license}</span> : null}
      {termsUrl ? (
        <a href={termsUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
          Terms <ExternalLink size={12} aria-hidden="true" />
        </a>
      ) : null}
      {sourceUrl ? (
        <a href={sourceUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
          Official source <ExternalLink size={12} aria-hidden="true" />
        </a>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  );
}

export default function SetupPlanRow({
  label,
  license,
  keepStep,
  updateStep,
  installSteps,
  unsupportedStep,
  selection,
  onSelect,
  disabled = false,
  canSkip,
  consent
}: {
  label: string;
  license?: string;
  keepStep?: SetupPlanStep;
  updateStep?: SetupPlanStep;
  installSteps: SetupPlanStep[];
  unsupportedStep?: SetupPlanStep;
  selection: PlanSelection;
  onSelect: (next: PlanSelection) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  // Coding agents can be switched to Skip. An always-on agent that is not
  // installed is simply installed (leave the group with "Skip installing, continue").
  canSkip: boolean;
  // Only on the OpenClaw row.
  consent?: OpenClawConsent;
}) {
  const installStep = installSteps.find((s) => s.action === "install");
  const nodeStep = installSteps.find((s) => s.action === "prereq-node");
  // The step that carries the agent's own links (the Node step points at nodejs.org).
  const linkStep = unsupportedStep || keepStep || installStep || nodeStep;
  const passwordMoments = installSteps.flatMap((s) => s.passwordMoments || []);

  let control: ReactNode;
  let sub: ReactNode;
  let what: ReactNode;
  const installing = !keepStep && !unsupportedStep && installSteps.length > 0 && selection === "install";

  if (unsupportedStep) {
    control = <SetupStatus tone="unknown">Not supported here</SetupStatus>;
    sub = "—";
    what = (
      <>
        {unsupportedStep.description} Nothing will be installed for {label}.
      </>
    );
  } else if (keepStep) {
    const chosen = selection === "update" ? "update" : "keep";
    control = (
      <SetupSegmented
        label={`${label}: keep or update`}
        value={chosen}
        options={[
          { value: "keep", label: "Keep" },
          { value: "update", label: "Update", disabled: !updateStep }
        ]}
        onChange={(next) => onSelect(next === "update" ? "update" : "keep")}
        disabled={disabled}
      />
    );
    sub = <span className="os-mono">{keepStep.installedVersion || "—"}</span>;
    if (!updateStep) {
      what = (
        <span className="os-setup-lock">
          <Lock size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
          Agent OS does not update this agent yet. It stays as it is.
        </span>
      );
    } else if (chosen === "update") {
      what = `Runs ${label}'s own updater. It replaces the agent's program files. Your settings stay.`;
    } else {
      what = "Stays as it is.";
    }
  } else if (installSteps.length === 0) {
    // Not installed and the plan has no step for it (for example its install site cannot be reached).
    control = <SetupStatus tone="warn">Can't install now</SetupStatus>;
    sub = "Not installed";
    what = "Setup can't install this one right now. The reason is shown above the groups.";
  } else {
    const own = totalsOf(installSteps);
    control = canSkip ? (
      <SetupSegmented
        label={`${label}: install or skip`}
        value={selection === "install" ? "install" : "skip"}
        options={[
          { value: "install", label: "Install" },
          { value: "skip", label: "Skip" }
        ]}
        onChange={(next) => onSelect(next === "install" ? "install" : "skip")}
        disabled={disabled}
      />
    ) : (
      <span className="os-setup-fixed">Will be installed</span>
    );
    sub = (
      <>
        Not installed
        {own.complete ? (
          <span className="os-mono">
            {" "}
            · ~{formatSize(own.mb)} · {formatMinutes(own.minutes)}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </>
    );
    what =
      selection === "skip" ? (
        `Skipped. Nothing will be installed for ${label}.`
      ) : (
        <>
          {installStep?.summary || installStep?.description}
          {nodeStep ? (
            <span className="os-setup-needs">
              <b>Needs Node first.</b> {nodeStep.description}
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </>
      );
  }

  const showNote = installing && passwordMoments.length > 0;
  const showConsent = installing && Boolean(consent);

  return (
    <div className="os-table__row os-setup-row" role="row">
      <div className="os-table__cell" role="rowheader">
        <span className="os-setup-table__name">{label}</span>
        <span className="os-setup-table__sub">{sub}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">
        {control}
      </div>
      <div className="os-table__cell os-setup-table__detail" role="cell">
        <div>{what}</div>
        <Links license={license || linkStep?.license} sourceUrl={linkStep?.sourceUrl} termsUrl={linkStep?.termsUrl} />
      </div>
      {showNote || showConsent ? (
        <div className="os-setup-row__extra" role="cell">
          {showNote ? (
            <div className="os-setup-row__note" role="note">
              <Lock size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
              <div>
                {passwordMoments.map((moment, i) => (
                  <p key={i}>{moment}</p>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          {showConsent && consent ? (
            <label className="os-setup-row__consent">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={consent.accepted} disabled={disabled} onChange={(e) => consent.onToggle(e.target.checked)} />
              <span>I understand OpenClaw can act on this computer. Agent OS will switch it to ask before running commands.</span>
            </label>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// "What this changes on your computer": one entry per agent that the current
// choices would install or update, listing the plan's own `changes` lines, then a
// disclosure with the exact commands. With nothing chosen it says so.
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, CircleCheck, Lock } from "lucide-react";
import SetupCommand from "./SetupCommand";
import type { SetupPlanStep } from "../../setupApi";

export default function SetupChanges({ work, labels }: { work: SetupPlanStep[]; labels: Record<string, string> }) {
  const [showCommands, setShowCommands] = useState(false);
  const commandsId = useId();
  const byAgent = new Map<string, SetupPlanStep[]>();
  for (const step of work) byAgent.set(step.agentId, [...(byAgent.get(step.agentId) || []), step]);
  const withCommand = work.filter((s) => s.commandPreview);

  return (
    <section className="os-setup-changes" aria-label="What this changes on your computer">
      <h3>What this changes on your computer</h3>
      {work.length ? (
        <>
          <ul className="os-setup-changes__list">
            {Array.from(byAgent.entries()).map(([agentId, steps]) => {
              const lines = steps.flatMap((s) => (s.changes.length ? s.changes : [s.description]));
              return (
                <li key={agentId}>
                  <CircleCheck size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
                  <div>
                    <b>{labels[agentId] || agentId}</b>
                    <ul className="os-setup-changes__lines">
                      {lines.map((line, i) => (
                        <li key={i}>{line}</li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
            <li className="os-setup-changes__keep">
              <Lock size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>Everything else stays as it is.</span>
            </li>
          </ul>
          {withCommand.length ? (
            <div className="os-setup-changes__disclosure">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="os-btn os-btn--ghost"
                onClick={() => setShowCommands((v) => !v)}
                aria-expanded={showCommands}
                aria-controls={commandsId}
              >
                {showCommands ? <ChevronUp size={16} aria-hidden="true" /> : <ChevronDown size={16} aria-hidden="true" />}
                Show exact commands
              </button>
              {showCommands ? (
                <div id={commandsId} className="os-setup-changes__commands">
                  <p className="os-setup-changes__caption">Agent OS runs these after you confirm, as written here.</p>
                  {withCommand.map((step) => (
                    <div key={step.id}>
                      <p className="os-micro">{labels[step.agentId] || step.agentId}</p>
                      {step.action === "prereq-node" ? (
                        <p className="os-setup-changes__plain">{step.commandPreview}</p>
                      ) : (
                        <SetupCommand command={step.commandPreview as string} />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <ul className="os-setup-changes__list">
            <li className="os-setup-changes__keep">
              <CircleCheck size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
              <span>Nothing. What is installed stays exactly as it is.</span>
            </li>
          </ul>
          <p className="os-setup-changes__hint">You can run Setup again any time.</p>
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

- [ ] **Step 9: The install job (`SetupInstallPanel.tsx`, whole file).**

The behaviour is unchanged: the meter has one segment per real server step and never moves on a timer, the elapsed time is real (it survives a reload), the log follows the newest line unless the person scrolls up, and Cancel asks first. What changes: no outer panel and no h2 (the step panel owns the heading; the AI brain panel still passes a `title`, which is shown as a small heading), the failure and cancel messages use the kit's `Banner`, the "copy the command" button becomes a visible command row, and the cancel dialog says "Keep going" / "Cancel setup".

Replace the whole file:

```tsx
// The live-progress body shared by Install ("Update coding agents", "Set up
// Hermes + OpenClaw") and AI brain's Apply. Both start a SetupJob and this renders
// it the same way: a segmented meter over the job's real steps (never a timer
// bar), true elapsed time for the running step, a collapsible log that follows the
// newest line, and the failure, cancel and retry messages. It draws no panel of its
// own: the Setup step panel (or the Brain card) around it is the box.
import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Activity, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Circle, CircleAlert, CircleCheck, Terminal } from "lucide-react";
import Banner from "./Banner";
import RelativeTime from "./RelativeTime";
import SetupCommand from "./SetupCommand";
import SetupModal from "./SetupModal";
import SetupStatus, { type SetupTone } from "./SetupStatus";
import type { SetupJob, SetupJobStep } from "../../setupApi";

// Job log lines look like "2026-10-01T08:43:51.764Z message". Pull the time
// back out so elapsed time survives a reload instead of restarting at 0.
const LOG_TIME = /^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T[\d:.]+Z)\s/;

function lastLogTime(step: SetupJobStep | undefined) {
  const lines = step?.log || [];
  for (let i = lines.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
    const match = LOG_TIME.exec(lines[i]);
    if (match) return match[1];
  }
  return null;
}

// Hermes installs report real stages ("stage config: succeeded"); count the
// ones the server has actually logged as finished.
function finishedStages(step: SetupJobStep) {
  return (step.log || []).filter((line) => /\bstage \S+: succeeded/.test(line)).length;
}

type ShownStatus = "succeeded" | "failed" | "running" | "pending";

const SPOKEN: Record<ShownStatus, string> = { succeeded: "Done. ", failed: "Failed. ", running: "Running. ", pending: "Waiting. " };

function StepIcon({ status }: { status: ShownStatus }) {
  if (status === "succeeded") return <CircleCheck className="os-setup-job__icon os-setup-job__icon--ok" size={17} aria-hidden="true" />;
  if (status === "failed") return <CircleAlert className="os-setup-job__icon os-setup-job__icon--bad" size={17} aria-hidden="true" />;
  if (status === "running") return <Activity className="os-setup-job__icon os-setup-job__icon--live" size={17} aria-hidden="true" />;
  return <Circle className="os-setup-job__icon os-setup-job__icon--wait" size={17} aria-hidden="true" />;
}

export default function SetupInstallPanel({
  title,
  job,
  stepLabels,
  commandPreviews,
  onCancel,
  onRetry,
  retryLabel = "Retry",
  busy
}: {
  title?: string;
  job: SetupJob;
  stepLabels: Record<string, string>;
  commandPreviews?: Record<string, string | null | undefined>;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onRetry: () => void;
  retryLabel?: string;
  busy?: boolean;
}) {
  const [confirmingCancel, setConfirmingCancel] = useState(false);
  const [logCollapsed, setLogCollapsed] = useState(false);
  const [followLog, setFollowLog] = useState(true);
  const logRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const logId = useId();
  const firstSeenRunning = useRef<Record<string, number>>({});

  // Cancelling kills the running installer, so the server marks that step
  // "failed" (or leaves it "running"). That is the person's own cancel, not a
  // failure: show the step as not finished, and never as running once the job
  // itself has stopped.
  const stepStatus = (step: SetupJobStep): ShownStatus => {
    if (job.status === "cancelled" && (step.status === "running" || step.status === "failed")) return "pending";
    return step.status === "running" && job.status !== "running" ? "pending" : step.status;
  };

  const runningIndex = job.steps.findIndex((s) => stepStatus(s) === "running");
  const runningStep = runningIndex >= 0 ? job.steps[runningIndex] : undefined;
  if (runningStep && !firstSeenRunning.current[runningStep.id]) {
    firstSeenRunning.current[runningStep.id] = Date.now();
  }
  // A step starts when the one before it stopped talking; the first step
  // starts with the job. Both come from the server, so they survive a reload.
  const runningSince =
    runningIndex > 0 ? lastLogTime(job.steps[runningIndex - 1]) || job.startedAt : runningStep ? job.startedAt : null;

  const entries = job.steps.flatMap((step) => (step.log || []).map((line) => ({ tag: stepLabels[step.id] || step.id, line })));

  // Follow the newest line, also when the log is opened again after being hidden.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (followLog && logRef.current) logRef.current.scrollTop = logRef.current.scrollHeight;
  }, [entries.length, followLog, logCollapsed]);

  const failedStep = job.status === "failed" ? job.steps.find((s) => s.status === "failed") : undefined;
  const failedPreview = failedStep ? commandPreviews?.[failedStep.id] : null;

  function onLogScroll() {
    const el = logRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const atBottom = el.scrollHeight - el.scrollTop - el.clientHeight < 24;
    setFollowLog(atBottom);
  }

  const done = job.steps.filter((s) => s.status === "succeeded").length;
  const tone: SetupTone = job.status === "succeeded" ? "ok" : job.status === "failed" ? "error" : job.status === "cancelled" ? "warn" : "live";
  const word = job.status === "running" ? "In progress" : job.status === "succeeded" ? "Done" : job.status === "failed" ? "Failed" : "Cancelled";

  return (
    <div className="os-setup-job">
      {title ? <h3 className="os-setup-job__title">{title}</h3> : null}
      <div className="os-setup-job__top">
        <SetupStatus tone={tone}>{word}</SetupStatus>
        <span className="os-setup-job__count">
          <span className="os-mono">{done}</span> of <span className="os-mono">{job.steps.length}</span> steps completed
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* One segment per real step the server reported; filled only once that
          step has actually succeeded. The running step is outlined. */}
      <div className="os-setup-job__meter" role="img" aria-label={`${done} of ${job.steps.length} steps completed`}>
        {job.steps.map((step) => (
          <span key={step.id} className={`os-setup-job__seg os-setup-job__seg--${stepStatus(step)}`} />
        ))}
      </div>

      <ul className="os-setup-job__steps">
        {job.steps.map((step) => {
          const status = stepStatus(step);
          const stages = status === "running" ? finishedStages(step) : 0;
          return (
            <li key={step.id} className={status === "pending" ? "is-wait" : undefined}>
              <StepIcon status={status} />
              <span>
                <span className="os-visually-hidden">{SPOKEN[status]}</span>
                {stepLabels[step.id] || step.id}
              </span>
              {status === "running" ? (
                <span className="os-setup-job__elapsed">
                  Running · <RelativeTime since={runningSince || firstSeenRunning.current[step.id]} live /> elapsed
                  {stages ? ` · ${stages} installer ${stages === 1 ? "stage" : "stages"} done` : ""}
                </span>
              ) : status === "pending" ? (
                <span className="os-setup-job__elapsed">{job.status === "running" ? "Waiting" : "Not run"}</span>
              ) : (
                <span />
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>

      {failedStep ? (
        <>
          <Banner
            tone="danger"
            title="This step failed"
            actions={
              <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--primary" onClick={onRetry} disabled={busy}>
                {retryLabel}
              </button>
            }
          >
            {failedStep.error || "Setup step failed."}
          </Banner>
          {failedPreview ? (
            <div className="os-setup-job__manual">
              <p>Or run it yourself in your own terminal:</p>
              <SetupCommand command={failedPreview} label="Copy the command to run it yourself" />
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </>
      ) : null}

      {job.status === "cancelled" ? (
        <Banner
          tone="info"
          title="Setup was cancelled"
          actions={
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--primary" onClick={onRetry} disabled={busy}>
              {retryLabel}
            </button>
          }
        >
          Anything already finished stays as it is.
        </Banner>
      ) : null}

      <div className="os-setup-job__logbar">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="os-btn os-btn--ghost os-setup-job__logtoggle"
          onClick={() => setLogCollapsed((v) => !v)}
          aria-expanded={!logCollapsed}
          aria-controls={logId}
        >
          {logCollapsed ? <ChevronDown size={16} aria-hidden="true" /> : <ChevronUp size={16} aria-hidden="true" />}
          {logCollapsed ? "Show log" : "Hide log"}
        </button>
        {job.status === "running" ? (
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--danger" onClick={() => setConfirmingCancel(true)}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {!logCollapsed ? (
        <>
          <div className="os-setup-log">
            <div id={logId} className="os-mono os-setup-log__lines" ref={logRef} onScroll={onLogScroll} tabIndex={0} role="log" aria-label="Setup log">
              {entries.length ? (
                entries.map((entry, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="os-setup-log__line">
                    <span className="os-setup-log__tag">[{entry.tag}]</span> {entry.line}
                  </div>
                ))
              ) : (
                <div className="os-setup-log__line">Waiting for output…</div>
              )}
            </div>
            {!followLog ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="os-btn os-btn--secondary os-setup-log__jump"
                onClick={() => {
                  setFollowLog(true);
                  if (logRef.current) logRef.current.scrollTop = logRef.current.scrollHeight;
                }}
              >
                Jump to latest
              </button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
          <p className="os-setup-job__caption">
            <Terminal size={15} aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>Agent OS's own setup log, one line per thing it did.</span>
          </p>
        </>
      ) : null}

      {confirmingCancel ? (
        <SetupModal
          title="Cancel setup?"
          confirmLabel="Cancel setup"
          confirmTone="danger"
          cancelLabel="Keep going"
          onConfirm={() => {
            setConfirmingCancel(false);
            onCancel();
          }}
          onClose={() => setConfirmingCancel(false)}
        >
          <p>This stops the current step. Anything already installed stays installed.</p>
        </SetupModal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

New: a calm header, a table instead of three cards, one disclosure for the receipt, the footer with "Run Setup again" and two exits, and it tells the page how many things are left (`onProblems`) so the rail can show Ready as done only when it is. The receipt now names all five agents (before, a Claude Code update showed as "claude").

Replace the whole file:

```tsx
// The "Ready" step: a final look at what is in place. It is built from a FRESH
// check (refresh=1 on every load: a cached "it worked" would be stale the moment a
// job finishes) plus each always-on agent's live safety detail, and the append-only
// install receipt with the official uninstall steps. It is calm when all is well
// and plain about what is left when it is not: the headline never says "ready"
// over a problem.
import { useEffect, useId, useState } from "react";
import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from "react";
import { ArrowRight, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, CircleCheck, RefreshCw, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import Banner from "./Banner";
import SetupFooter from "./SetupFooter";
import SetupStatus from "./SetupStatus";
import type { AgentDetail, BrainOptionsResponse, ReceiptEntry, SystemCheck } from "../../setupApi";
import { getAgentDetail, getBrainOptions, getReceipt, getSetupCheck } from "../../setupApi";

const COLUMNS = "minmax(132px, 240px) minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(176px, auto)";

const AGENT_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  hermes: "Hermes",
  openclaw: "OpenClaw",
  claude: "Claude Code",
  codex: "Codex",
  cursor: "Cursor CLI",
  "managed-node": "Node 24 (managed by Agent OS)"
};

interface ReadyRow {
  name: string;
  detail: ReactNode;
  // true = in place, false = needs attention, null = not known (shown as "—").
  state: boolean | null;
  fixLabel?: string;
  onFix?: () => void;
}

interface ReadyCard {
  agentId: "hermes" | "openclaw";
  unsupported: boolean;
  rows: ReadyRow[];
}

// Count what is actually wrong, so the heading never says "ready" over a red row.
function buildCards(
  check: SystemCheck,
  brain: BrainOptionsResponse | null,
  details: Record<string, AgentDetail | null>,
  go: { toStep: (index: number) => void; openAgent: (agentId: string) => void }
) {
  let problems = 0;
  const cards: ReadyCard[] = (["hermes", "openclaw"] as const).map((agentId) => {
    const entry = check.agents?.[agentId];
    const unsupported = agentId === "hermes" && Boolean(check.isIntelMac);
    const installed = Boolean(entry?.detected.installed);
    const configured = brain?.current?.[agentId]?.configured ?? null;
    const serviceRunning = installed ? Boolean(entry?.service?.running) : null;
    const detail = details[agentId];
    const safeDefaults = installed ? (detail ? !detail.safety.permissive : null) : null;
    if (!unsupported) {
      if (!installed) problems += 1;
      else problems += [configured, serviceRunning, safeDefaults].filter((v) => v === false).length;
    }
    const rows: ReadyRow[] = [
      {
        name: "Installed",
        detail: installed ? <span className="os-mono">{entry?.detected.version || "—"}</span> : "—",
        state: installed,
        fixLabel: "Go to Plan",
        onFix: () => go.toStep(1)
      },
      {
        name: "Model provider configured",
        detail: installed ? brain?.current?.[agentId]?.summary || "—" : "—",
        state: installed ? configured : null,
        fixLabel: "Go to AI brain",
        onFix: () => go.toStep(3)
      },
      {
        name: agentId === "openclaw" ? "Gateway running" : "Background service running",
        detail: installed ? (entry?.service ? (entry.service.running ? "Running" : "Stopped") : "—") : "—",
        state: installed ? serviceRunning : null,
        fixLabel: "Go to AI brain",
        onFix: () => go.toStep(3)
      },
      {
        name: "Safe defaults applied",
        detail: installed ? (detail ? (detail.safety.permissive ? "Permissive mode is on" : "Permissive mode is off") : "—") : "—",
        state: safeDefaults,
        fixLabel: "Change on the Agents page",
        onFix: () => go.openAgent(agentId)
      }
    ];
    return { agentId, unsupported, rows };
  });
  return { cards, problems };
}

export default function SetupReadyPanel({
  onGoHome,
  onOpenSafety,
  onGoToStep,
  onOpenAgent,
  onProblems
}: {
  onGoHome: () => void;
  onOpenSafety: () => void;
  onGoToStep: (index: number) => void;
  onOpenAgent: (agentId: string) => void;
  // How many things are left to fix (null while unknown), so the step rail can show Ready as done only when it is.
  onProblems?: (problems: number | null) => void;
}) {
  const [check, setCheck] = useState<SystemCheck | null>(null);
  const [brain, setBrain] = useState<BrainOptionsResponse | null>(null);
  const [receipt, setReceipt] = useState<ReceiptEntry[] | null>(null);
  const [details, setDetails] = useState<Record<string, AgentDetail | null>>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showReceipt, setShowReceipt] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(false);
  const receiptId = useId();

  async function load() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(false);
    try {
      const [checkRes, brainRes, receiptRes, hermesDetail, openclawDetail] = await Promise.all([
        getSetupCheck(true),
        getBrainOptions(true),
        getReceipt(),
        getAgentDetail("hermes").catch(() => null),
        getAgentDetail("openclaw").catch(() => null)
      ]);
      setCheck(checkRes);
      setBrain(brainRes);
      setReceipt(receiptRes.receipt);
      setDetails({ hermes: hermesDetail, openclaw: openclawDetail });
    } catch {
      setError(true);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, []);

  const built = check && !error ? buildCards(check, brain, details, { toStep: onGoToStep, openAgent: onOpenAgent }) : null;
  const problems = built ? built.problems : null;
  useEffect(() => {
    onProblems?.(problems);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [problems]);

  // Uninstall steps grouped by what they remove, each from the receipt data.
  const uninstallByAgent = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const entry of receipt || []) {
    const steps = uninstallByAgent.get(entry.agentId) || [];
    for (const step of entry.uninstall) if (!steps.includes(step)) steps.push(step);
    uninstallByAgent.set(entry.agentId, steps);
  }

  if (loading && !check) {
    return (
      <>
        <div className="os-setup-panel__content">
          <p className="os-setup-loading" role="status">
            Checking this computer…
          </p>
        </div>
        <SetupFooter note="Reading what is in place." />
      </>
    );
  }
  if (error || !built) {
    return (
      <>
        <div className="os-setup-panel__content">
          <Banner
            tone="danger"
            title="Couldn't load the final check"
            actions={
              <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void load()}>
                <RefreshCw size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> Retry
              </button>
            }
          >
            Nothing was changed. Try again, or open Agents to see each agent on its own.
          </Banner>
        </div>
        <SetupFooter note="The final check did not finish." />
      </>
    );
  }

  const ready = built.problems === 0;
  return (
    <>
      <div className="os-setup-panel__content">
        <div className="os-setup-done">
          {ready ? (
            <CircleCheck className="os-setup-done__icon os-setup-done__icon--ok" size={30} aria-hidden="true" />
          ) : (
            <TriangleAlert className="os-setup-done__icon os-setup-done__icon--warn" size={30} aria-hidden="true" />
          )}
          <div>
            <b>{ready ? "Agent OS is ready" : `Almost ready: ${built.problems} thing${built.problems === 1 ? "" : "s"} left to fix`}</b>
            <span>{ready ? "Everything below is in place." : "Fix the items marked below, then check again."}</span>
          </div>
          <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={() => void load()} disabled={loading}>
            <RefreshCw size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
            {loading ? "Checking…" : "Check again"}
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="os-table os-setup-table" role="table" aria-label="What is ready" style={{ "--os-table-cols": COLUMNS } as CSSProperties}>
          <div className="os-table__head" role="row">
            {["Item", "What Agent OS found", "Result"].map((heading) => (
              <span key={heading} className="os-table__cell os-micro" role="columnheader">
                {heading}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
          {built.cards.map((card) => (
            <div key={card.agentId} role="rowgroup">
              <div className="os-table__group os-setup-table__group" role="presentation">
                <b>{AGENT_LABEL[card.agentId]}</b>
              </div>
              {card.unsupported ? (
                <div className="os-table__row" role="row">
                  <div className="os-table__cell os-setup-table__name" role="rowheader">
                    Support
                  </div>
                  <div className="os-table__cell os-setup-table__detail" role="cell">
                    Hermes doesn't support Intel Macs yet, so it isn't set up here.
                  </div>
                  <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">
                    <SetupStatus tone="unknown">Not supported</SetupStatus>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                card.rows.map((row) => (
                  <div key={row.name} className="os-table__row" role="row">
                    <div className="os-table__cell os-setup-table__name" role="rowheader">
                      {row.name}
                    </div>
                    <div className="os-table__cell os-setup-table__detail" role="cell">
                      {row.detail}
                    </div>
                    <div className="os-table__cell os-setup-ready__result" role="cell">
                      {row.state === true ? (
                        <SetupStatus tone="ok">Done</SetupStatus>
                      ) : row.state === false ? (
                        <>
                          <SetupStatus tone="error">Needs attention</SetupStatus>
                          {row.onFix ? (
                            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={row.onFix}>
                              {row.fixLabel || "Fix"}
                            </button>
                          ) : null}
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <SetupStatus tone="unknown">—</SetupStatus>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="os-setup-receipt">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="os-btn os-btn--ghost"
            onClick={() => setShowReceipt((v) => !v)}
            aria-expanded={showReceipt}
            aria-controls={receiptId}
          >
            {showReceipt ? <ChevronUp size={16} aria-hidden="true" /> : <ChevronDown size={16} aria-hidden="true" />}
            What Setup changed on this computer
          </button>
          {showReceipt ? (
            <div id={receiptId} className="os-setup-receipt__body">
              <p className="os-setup-receipt__cap">Every change Agent OS made is listed here, with the official way to undo it.</p>
              {receipt && receipt.length ? (
                <ul className="os-setup-receipt__list">
                  {receipt.map((entry, i) => (
                    <li key={i}>
                      <span className="os-mono">{new Date(entry.at).toLocaleString()}</span>
                      <span>
                        {AGENT_LABEL[entry.agentId] || entry.agentId} · {entry.action}
                        {entry.version ? ` (${entry.version})` : ""}
                      </span>
                      {entry.changes.length ? (
                        <ul className="os-setup-receipt__changes">
                          {/* recipes.js already writes these with a literal "~", e.g.
                              "Creates ~/.hermes..." -- never an absolute home path. */}
                          {entry.changes.map((c, j) => (
                            <li key={j}>{c}</li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      ) : null}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              ) : (
                <p className="os-setup-receipt__empty">Nothing installed or changed by Agent OS yet.</p>
              )}
              {uninstallByAgent.size ? (
                <>
                  <h4>How to remove each item</h4>
                  {Array.from(uninstallByAgent.entries()).map(([agentId, steps]) => (
                    <div key={agentId} className="os-setup-receipt__group">
                      <b>{AGENT_LABEL[agentId] || agentId}</b>
                      <ul>
                        {steps.map((step, i) => (
                          <li key={i} className="os-mono">
                            {step}
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>

      <SetupFooter note={ready ? "Setup keeps what works and asks before it changes anything." : "Fix the items marked above, then check again."}>
        <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={() => onGoToStep(0)}>
          <RefreshCw size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
          Run Setup again
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={onOpenSafety}>
          Open Safety
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--primary" onClick={onGoHome}>
          Go to Home
          <ArrowRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
      </SetupFooter>
    </>
  );
}
```

Two checks of the data, from the code above: `AgentDetail.safety.permissive` and `AgentDetail` come from `src/setupApi.ts` (the old file already read `detail.safety.permissive`); `ReceiptEntry.uninstall` is `string[]`. If `npx tsc` reports that `safety.permissive` does not exist, read `interface AgentSafetyStatus` in `src/setupApi.ts` and use the field the old Ready panel used.

- [ ] **Step 12: The stylesheet (`src/ui/setup.css`, whole file; `src/ui/laptop.css`, two blocks out).**

What changes: every rule for the old look goes (the numbered stepper strip, the check list, the plan cards, the install box, the Brain-step cards that nothing used, the three Ready cards, the old sign-in rows with their green and red borders). New rules draw the rail, the panel, the sticky footer, the status word, the tables, the segmented choice, the command row, the plan groups, the "what this changes" block, the job and its log, the sign-in rows and the Ready table and receipt.

Kept on purpose, because the Safety page and the confirm dialog still use them until the Safety task rebuilds that page: `.os-setup__alert`, `.os-setup__loading`, `.os-setup-brain__error` and the `.os-setup-modal*` rules (now in token colours). `.os-setup-brain__card--selected` and the other `.os-setup-brain__*` rules are not carried over: Step 1's grep proved nothing uses them.

Colours: every old amber (`245, 184, 75`), red (`255, 92, 122`) and green (`61, 220, 151`) literal is gone, replaced by `--os-warn`, `--os-danger` and `--os-ok` with their `-wash` and `-line` forms. The old sign-in rows' `signed_in` and `failed` borders are gone with the rows; the sign-in result is now an icon and a word. The one literal left is the neutral dark scrim behind the dialog, `rgba(5, 7, 11, 0.6)` (the palette uses the same one; it is not a status colour).

Layout rules worth knowing before you debug: the rail sits beside the panel from 1101 px up and lies flat above it below that (the probe checks the grid has two columns, then one); on a phone only the current step keeps its name; the footer is `position: sticky` and works only while no ancestor sets `overflow`, so never add `overflow` to `.os-setup`, `.os-setup__wrap` or `.os-setup-panel`; the tables take their columns from `--os-table-cols` (set in the components) and stack into one column at 640 px.

Replace the whole of `src/ui/setup.css` with:

```css
/* Setup page (SP2, Task B4): a step rail beside one panel, hairline tables and
   a footer that stays in view. Tokens only (tokens.css); the one neutral scrim
   colour in the modal is the palette's own. The page kit (kit.css) supplies the
   table classes, the banner and the empty state. Motion is 120-200 ms, and
   tokens.css switches it all off under prefers-reduced-motion.

   Colour note (same trap as base.css): `.os-shell button` (0,1,1) sets the
   colour of every button, so button-like classes here are written with two
   classes. */

/* ---- Page ------------------------------------------------------------- */
.os-setup {
  max-width: 1160px;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-bottom: var(--os-sp-6);
}
.os-setup > .os-banner {
  margin-bottom: var(--os-sp-4);
}
/* The rail beside the panel; above it (as a strip) below 1101 px. */
.os-setup__wrap {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 232px minmax(0, 1fr);
  column-gap: var(--os-sp-10);
  align-items: start;
}
@media (max-width: 1366px) {
  .os-setup__wrap {
    grid-template-columns: 212px minmax(0, 1fr);
    column-gap: var(--os-sp-8);
  }
}
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .os-setup__wrap {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    row-gap: var(--os-sp-5);
  }
}

/* ---- Step rail (SetupStepper.tsx) ------------------------------------- */
.os-setup-rail {
  position: sticky;
  top: calc(var(--os-bar-h) + var(--os-sp-4));
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.os-setup-step {
  position: relative;
}
/* The thin line that joins one mark to the next. */
.os-setup-step:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 23px;
  top: 40px;
  bottom: -4px;
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--os-line-2);
}
.os-setup-step .os-setup-step__body {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0, 1fr);
  column-gap: var(--os-sp-3);
  align-items: start;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 10px var(--os-sp-3) var(--os-sp-3);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--os-r-sm);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
  font: inherit;
  text-align: left;
}
.os-setup-step button.os-setup-step__body {
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--os-dur-quick) var(--os-ease-out);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .os-setup-step button.os-setup-step__body:hover {
    background: var(--os-surface-2);
  }
}
.os-shell .os-setup-step button.os-setup-step__body:focus-visible {
  outline-offset: 1px;
}
.os-setup-step .os-setup-step__body[aria-current="step"] {
  background: var(--os-surface-2);
  box-shadow: var(--os-e1);
}
.os-setup-step__mark {
  margin-top: 1px;
}
.os-setup-step__mark--done {
  color: var(--os-ok);
}
.os-setup-step__mark--current {
  color: var(--os-accent-strong);
}
.os-setup-step__mark--partial {
  color: var(--os-warn);
}
.os-setup-step__mark--failed {
  color: var(--os-danger);
}
.os-setup-step__mark--todo {
  color: var(--os-line-3);
}
.os-setup-step__text {
  display: block;
  min-width: 0;
}
.os-setup-step__name {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-15);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-stretch: 90%;
  line-height: 1.3;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
.os-setup-step__line {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 2px;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-setup-step--not-reached .os-setup-step__name {
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-setup-step--not-reached .os-setup-step__line {
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
/* Strip: the rail lies flat above the panel. Names stay, the one-line hints go. */
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .os-setup-rail {
    position: static;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--os-sp-1);
  }
  .os-setup-step {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .os-setup-step:not(:last-child)::after {
    display: none;
  }
  .os-setup-step .os-setup-step__body {
    grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: center;
    padding: var(--os-sp-2);
  }
  .os-setup-step__mark {
    margin-top: 0;
  }
  .os-setup-step__line {
    display: none;
  }
  .os-setup-step__name {
    font-size: var(--os-fs-14);
  }
}
/* Phone: only the current step keeps its name; the others are a mark you can
   still press (and a screen reader still reads their name and state). */
@media (max-width: 599px) {
  .os-setup-step {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }
  .os-setup-step.is-current {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
  }
  .os-setup-step:not(.is-current) .os-setup-step__body {
    grid-template-columns: 22px;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 40px;
    min-height: 40px;
  }
  .os-setup-step:not(.is-current) .os-setup-step__text {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
}

/* ---- The panel and its footer ----------------------------------------- */
.os-setup-panel {
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 880px;
  background: var(--os-surface-1);
  border-radius: var(--os-r-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--os-e1);
}
.os-setup-panel__head {
  padding: var(--os-sp-6) var(--os-sp-6) var(--os-sp-5);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--os-line-1);
}
.os-setup-panel__top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--os-sp-4);
}
/* Two classes so it beats the old global h2 rules. */
.os-setup-panel .os-setup-panel__title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-20);
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: 640;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
  scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--os-bar-h) + var(--os-sp-4));
}
/* Focused by code when the step changes. It is not a control, so no ring. */
.os-shell .os-setup-panel__title:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
}
.os-setup-panel__count {
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.os-setup-panel__lede {
  max-width: 70ch;
  margin: var(--os-sp-2) 0 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-15);
  line-height: var(--os-lh-body);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}
.os-setup-panel__content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--os-sp-5);
  min-width: 0;
  padding: var(--os-sp-4) var(--os-sp-6) var(--os-sp-6);
}
.os-setup-panel__content > * {
  min-width: 0;
}
/* The footer sticks to the bottom of the window while the step scrolls, so
   Continue is never below the fold. No ancestor may set overflow. */
.os-setup-foot {
  position: sticky;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 3;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--os-sp-3);
  padding: var(--os-sp-4) var(--os-sp-6);
  background: var(--os-surface-1);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--os-line-1);
  border-radius: 0 0 var(--os-r-lg) var(--os-r-lg);
}
.os-setup-foot .os-setup-foot__back {
  margin-left: calc(var(--os-sp-3) * -1);
}
.os-setup-foot__note {
  flex: 1 1 200px;
  min-width: 0;
  padding-right: var(--os-sp-2);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
  text-align: right;
}
.os-setup-foot__actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  gap: var(--os-sp-3);
}
.os-setup-foot .os-btn {
  min-height: 38px;
  padding: 0 var(--os-sp-4);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-14);
}
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .os-setup-panel__head {
    padding: var(--os-sp-5) var(--os-sp-4) var(--os-sp-4);
  }
  .os-setup-panel__content {
    padding: var(--os-sp-4);
  }
  .os-setup-foot {
    padding: var(--os-sp-3) var(--os-sp-4);
  }
  .os-setup-foot__note {
    flex-basis: 100%;
    order: -1;
    padding-right: 0;
    text-align: left;
  }
  .os-setup-foot__actions {
    margin-left: auto;
  }
}

/* ---- A result: icon plus a word (SetupStatus.tsx) ---------------------- */
.os-setup-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--os-sp-2);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  font-weight: 520;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
.os-setup-status svg {
  flex: none;
  margin-top: 1px;
}
.os-setup-status--ok svg {
  color: var(--os-ok);
}
.os-setup-status--info svg {
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-setup-status--warn svg {
  color: var(--os-warn);
}
.os-setup-status--error svg {
  color: var(--os-danger);
}
.os-setup-status--live svg {
  color: var(--os-accent-strong);
}
.os-setup-status--unknown svg {
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
.os-setup-status--unknown .os-setup-status__word {
  color: var(--os-text-2);
  font-weight: 450;
}

/* ---- Tables (the kit supplies .os-table*; these are Setup's cells) ------ */
.os-setup-table .os-table__row {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 6px 0;
  row-gap: var(--os-sp-2);
}
.os-setup-table .os-table__head {
  min-height: 30px;
}
.os-setup-table .os-setup-row {
  min-height: 60px;
}
.os-setup-table .os-setup-table__name {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-14);
  font-weight: 580;
  line-height: 1.3;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
.os-setup-table .os-setup-table__sub {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 2px;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-setup-table .os-setup-table__detail {
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.os-setup-table .os-setup-table__right {
  text-align: right;
}
.os-setup-table .os-mono {
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
}
.os-setup-table .os-setup-table__detail .os-mono {
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
/* The group label inside a table ("Agents  Found on this computer"). */
.os-setup-table__group > b {
  font-weight: inherit;
}
/* A row's second line (a note, a consent box, the live sign-in) spans the table. */
.os-setup-row__extra {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--os-sp-2);
  padding: var(--os-sp-1) 0 var(--os-sp-2);
}
.os-setup-row__note {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--os-sp-3);
  padding: var(--os-sp-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--os-warn-line);
  border-radius: var(--os-r-sm);
  background: var(--os-warn-wash);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
.os-setup-row__note svg {
  flex: none;
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: var(--os-warn);
}
.os-setup-row__note p {
  margin: 0;
}
.os-setup-row__note p + p {
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-1);
}
.os-setup-row__consent {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--os-sp-3);
  min-height: 32px;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.os-setup-row__consent input {
  flex: none;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  margin: 2px 0 0;
  accent-color: var(--os-accent);
}
.os-setup-links {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 2px var(--os-sp-4);
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-1);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
.os-setup-links a {
  color: var(--os-accent-strong);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.os-setup-links a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}
.os-setup-links svg {
  vertical-align: -1px;
}
.os-setup-lock {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--os-sp-2);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-setup-lock svg {
  flex: none;
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
.os-setup-needs {
  display: block;
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-1);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-setup-needs b {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
.os-setup-fixed {
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
/* Phone: every row stacks (name, then the choice, then what happens). */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .os-setup-table .os-table__head {
    display: none;
  }
  .os-setup-table .os-table__row {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    padding: var(--os-sp-3) 0;
  }
  .os-setup-table .os-setup-table__right {
    text-align: left;
  }
}

/* ---- Segmented choice (SetupSegmented.tsx) ----------------------------- */
.os-setup-seg {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 3px;
  border: 1px solid var(--os-line-3);
  border-radius: var(--os-r-md);
  background: var(--os-surface-1);
}
.os-setup-seg .os-setup-seg__btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 var(--os-sp-3);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: var(--os-r-sm);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  font-weight: 540;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--os-dur-quick) var(--os-ease-out), color var(--os-dur-quick) var(--os-ease-out);
}
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .os-setup-seg .os-setup-seg__btn[aria-checked="false"]:not(:disabled):hover {
    background: var(--os-surface-2);
    color: var(--os-text-1);
  }
}
.os-setup-seg .os-setup-seg__btn[aria-checked="true"] {
  background: var(--os-surface-3);
  color: var(--os-text-1);
  box-shadow: var(--os-e1);
}
.os-setup-seg .os-setup-seg__btn:disabled {
  color: var(--os-disabled);
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
.os-setup-seg .os-setup-seg__btn[aria-checked="true"]:disabled {
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-shell .os-setup-seg__btn:focus-visible {
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

/* ---- One command with a copy button (SetupCommand.tsx) ----------------- */
.os-setup-cmd {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--os-sp-2);
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: 3px 4px 3px var(--os-sp-3);
  border: 1px solid var(--os-line-2);
  border-radius: var(--os-r-sm);
  background: var(--os-term-bg);
}
.os-setup-cmd code {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.os-setup-cmd .os-setup-cmd__copy {
  flex: none;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 30px;
  min-height: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  padding: 0;
}

/* ---- Plan: the two groups (SetupPlanGroup.tsx) ------------------------- */
.os-setup-group {
  min-width: 0;
}
.os-setup-group + .os-setup-group {
  padding-top: var(--os-sp-5);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--os-line-1);
}
.os-setup-group__head {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--os-sp-3) var(--os-sp-5);
  margin-bottom: var(--os-sp-2);
}
.os-setup-group__titles {
  flex: 1 1 280px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.os-setup-group__titles h3 {
  display: inline;
  margin: 0 var(--os-sp-2) 0 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-16);
  font-weight: 620;
  font-stretch: 90%;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
.os-setup-group__sub {
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
.os-setup-group__titles p {
  max-width: 62ch;
  margin: var(--os-sp-1) 0 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-setup-group__action {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: var(--os-sp-1);
}
.os-setup-group__hint {
  max-width: 28ch;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
  text-align: right;
}
.os-setup-group__note {
  margin: 0 0 var(--os-sp-2);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-setup-group__note strong {
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
.os-setup-manual p {
  margin: 0 0 var(--os-sp-2);
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .os-setup-group__action {
    align-items: stretch;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .os-setup-group__action .os-btn {
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .os-setup-group__hint {
    max-width: none;
    text-align: left;
  }
}

/* ---- Plan: what this changes (SetupChanges.tsx) ------------------------ */
.os-setup-changes {
  padding-top: var(--os-sp-5);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--os-line-1);
}
.os-setup-changes h3 {
  margin: 0 0 var(--os-sp-2);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-16);
  font-weight: 620;
  font-stretch: 90%;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
.os-setup-changes__list {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.os-setup-changes__list > li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr);
  column-gap: 10px;
  padding: 6px 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-14);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
.os-setup-changes__list > li > svg {
  margin-top: 3px;
  color: var(--os-ok);
}
.os-setup-changes__list > li.os-setup-changes__keep > svg {
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-setup-changes__list b {
  font-weight: 600;
}
.os-setup-changes__lines {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-setup-changes__disclosure .os-btn {
  margin-left: calc(var(--os-sp-3) * -1);
}
.os-setup-changes__commands {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--os-sp-2);
  margin-top: var(--os-sp-2);
}
.os-setup-changes__caption {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-12);
  color: var(--os-text-3);
}
.os-setup-changes__plain {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-setup-changes__hint {
  margin: var(--os-sp-1) 0 0 28px;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}

/* ---- Install: one visible job (SetupInstallPanel.tsx) ------------------ */
.os-setup-job {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--os-sp-3);
  min-width: 0;
}
.os-setup-job__title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--os-fs-16);
  font-weight: 620;
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
.os-setup-job__top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--os-sp-4);
}
.os-setup-job__count {
  font-size: var(--os-fs-13);
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-setup-job__count .os-mono {
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
/* One segment per real step. Filled = that step succeeded; outlined cobalt =
   it is running; plain = not reached. A segment only changes when the server
   says so. */
.os-setup-job__meter {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--os-sp-1);
}
.os-setup-job__seg {
  flex: 1;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--os-line-2);
  transition: background var(--os-dur-base) var(--os-ease-out);
}
.os-setup-job__seg--succeeded {
  background: var(--os-ok);
}
.os-setup-job__seg--running {
  background: var(--os-accent-soft);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--os-accent-strong);
}
.os-setup-job__seg--failed {
  background: var(--os-danger);
}
.os-setup-job__steps {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.os-setup-job__steps li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  column-gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: var(--os-sp-2) 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--os-line-1);
  font-size: var(--os-fs-14);
  color: var(--os-text-1);
}
.os-setup-job__steps li:first-child {
  border-top: 0;
}
.os-setup-job__steps li.is-wait {
  color: var(--os-text-2);
}
.os-setup-job__icon--ok {
  color: var(--os-ok);
}

The script finds each block by its comment, so it does not depend on line numbers, and it stops with an error if a comment is missing:

```bash

a = s.index("  /* Setup: a lighter title and stepper, so the step's own buttons fit. */\n")
b = s.index("  /* Team Room: the explainer is one short paragraph")
s = s[:a] + s[b:]
a = s.index("/* --- Setup: the step's buttons never scroll away")
b = s.index("/* --- Chat: settings on the left")
s = s[:a] + s[b:]
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)
print("laptop.css:", len(s.splitlines()), "lines")
EOF
