Expected: the first command prints one line, `.os-content .aos-setup-grid,` (Mission Control's old grid, not ours); the second prints one line, the scrim `background: rgba(5, 7, 11, 0.6);`; the script prints `undefined tokens: []` and two equal brace counts (`226 226`).

- [ ] **Step 13: The page (`src/pages/SetupPage.tsx`, whole file).**

The logic is the old page's, kept on purpose: loading the check, the plan, the brain options and the agents; the starting step worked out from what is installed; `?step=` and the `aos-navigate` event; re-attaching to a running or failed job after a reload; the 1 s job poll; the Install, Cancel and Retry calls; the confirm dialog and its error; the OpenClaw consent. What is new: the render (rail, panel, footers, banners), the two small counters the rail needs (`signIn`, `readyProblems`), `previousStep` for Back, `groupAction` and `codingNote` for the Plan groups, and focus moving to the step title (it used to move to a wrapper `div`). The `wide` flag and the `aos-phase-page` class are gone, and so are the `Panel`, `os-fleet__banner` and `os-setup__alert` markup.

The Hermes rule (Task B1): Hermes has a keep step and no update step. Nothing here assumes otherwise. `stepsFor("hermes").updateStep` is `undefined`, `SetupPlanRow` turns its Update choice off and says why, and `selectedSteps` only adds an update step when one exists.

Replace the whole file:

```tsx
// The Setup Assistant: six steps (Check, Plan, Install, AI brain, Sign in, Ready)
// for a non-expert setting up Hermes and OpenClaw (the always-on agents) and
// Claude Code, Codex and Cursor (the coding agents). A step rail on the left, one
// panel on the right, a footer that stays in view. One decision per screen;
// nothing installs or configures without an explicit confirm. All data comes
// from server/runtime/setup/* through ../setupApi (see that file for the exact
// response shapes). The jobs, the polling and the confirm dialogs are the same as
// before; only what is drawn is new.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from "react";
import { ArrowRight, PackageCheck, RefreshCw, X } from "lucide-react";
import { listAgents } from "../api";
import { navigateTo, queryParam } from "../nav";
import type { AgentSummary } from "../types";
import Banner from "../ui/components/Banner";
import EmptyState from "../ui/components/EmptyState";
import PageHeader from "../ui/components/PageHeader";
import SetupBrainPanel, { type BrainAgentLine, type BrainPanelStatus } from "../ui/components/SetupBrainPanel";
import SetupChanges from "../ui/components/SetupChanges";
import SetupCheckList from "../ui/components/SetupCheckList";
import SetupCommand from "../ui/components/SetupCommand";
import SetupFooter from "../ui/components/SetupFooter";
import SetupInstallPanel from "../ui/components/SetupInstallPanel";
import SetupModal from "../ui/components/SetupModal";
import SetupPlanGroup from "../ui/components/SetupPlanGroup";
import SetupPlanRow from "../ui/components/SetupPlanRow";
import SetupReadyPanel from "../ui/components/SetupReadyPanel";
import SetupSignInPanel from "../ui/components/SetupSignInPanel";
import SetupStatus from "../ui/components/SetupStatus";
import SetupStepper, { type SetupStepDef, type SetupStepState } from "../ui/components/SetupStepper";
import { useInterval } from "../ui/components/useInterval";
import type { BrainOptionsResponse, SetupJob, SetupPlan, SetupPlanStep, SystemCheck } from "../setupApi";
import {
  cancelSetupJob,
  friendlyError,
  getBrainOptions,
  getSetupCheck,
  getSetupJob,
  getSetupPlan,
  recallJobId,
  rememberJobId,
  retrySetupJob,
  startInstallJob
} from "../setupApi";
import { BRAIN_AGENT_LABEL } from "../ui/brainShared";
import {
  AGENT_NAMES,
  CODING_IDS,
  OPERATOR_IDS,
  formatMinutes,
  formatSize,
  totalsOf,
  type PlanSelection
} from "../ui/setupGroupShared";
import "../ui/setup.css";

// `line` is what the rail says under the name until there is something to report;
// `lede` is the one sentence under the panel's title.
const STEPS = [
  {
    key: "check",
    label: "Check",
    line: "Look at this computer",
    lede: "Agent OS reads what is on this computer. It changes nothing in this step."
  },
  {
    key: "plan",
    label: "Plan",
    line: "Keep, update or install each agent",
    lede: "Choose what to do for each agent. Nothing runs until you press a group's button and confirm. Keeping an agent as it is is always safe."
  },
  {
    key: "install",
    label: "Install",
    line: "Do it, with a visible log",
    lede: "Agent OS carries out the plan one step at a time and shows every line it runs."
  },
  {
    key: "brain",
    label: "AI brain",
    line: "Models for always-on agents",
    lede: "Hermes and OpenClaw need a brain: the language model that does their thinking. Each one can use a different brain."
  },
  {
    key: "signin",
    label: "Sign in",
    line: "Sign in to the coding agents",
    lede: "Sign in to each coding agent with its own login. Agent OS never sees your password."
  },
  {
    key: "ready",
    label: "Ready",
    line: "See what is in place",
    lede: "A last look at what is in place on this computer."
  }
] as const;
const STEP = { check: 0, plan: 1, install: 2, brain: 3, signin: 4, ready: 5 } as const;
const AGENT_IDS = OPERATOR_IDS;
const ALL_AGENT_IDS = [...OPERATOR_IDS, ...CODING_IDS];
const CODING_COLUMNS = "minmax(132px, 176px) 176px minmax(0, 1fr)";

type GroupId = "operators" | "coding";

// What each agent should do by default: never an update, never a reinstall.
function defaultSelections(plan: SetupPlan) {
  const defaults: Record<string, PlanSelection> = {};
  for (const agentId of ALL_AGENT_IDS) {
    const steps = plan.steps.filter((s) => s.agentId === agentId);
    if (steps.some((s) => s.action === "skip-unsupported")) defaults[agentId] = "unsupported";
    else if (steps.some((s) => s.action === "keep")) defaults[agentId] = "keep";
    else defaults[agentId] = "install";
  }
  return defaults;
}

function installStepLabel(agentId: string | null, action: string) {
  const name = (agentId && AGENT_NAMES[agentId]) || "the agent";
  if (action === "install") return `Install ${name}`;
  if (action === "update") return `Update ${name}`;
  if (action === "prereq-node") return `Set up a Node 24 runtime for ${name}`;
  if (action === "keep") return `Keep ${name} as it is`;
  return `Skip ${name} (not supported here)`;
}

// A step asked for in the address (?step=brain), e.g. from the Get started
// checklist; anything that is not one of the six names is ignored.
function stepFromUrl(): number | null {
  const name = queryParam("step");
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(STEP, name) ? STEP[name as keyof typeof STEP] : null;
}

function brainReady(check: SystemCheck | null, brain: BrainOptionsResponse | null) {
  const hermesOk = !check?.agents?.hermes.detected.installed || Boolean(brain?.current.hermes.configured);
  const openclawOk = !check?.agents?.openclaw.detected.installed || Boolean(brain?.current.openclaw.configured);
  return hermesOk && openclawOk;
}

function plural(n: number, one: string) {
  return `${n} ${one}${n === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;
}

// The group's button: what pressing it will do, from the steps its choices run.
// No work, no button. Only updates say "Update", so the button never promises an install.
function groupAction(group: GroupId, work: SetupPlanStep[]): string | undefined {
  if (!work.length) return undefined;
  const installs = work.some((s) => s.action === "install" || s.action === "prereq-node");
  if (group === "coding") return installs ? "Install coding agents" : "Update coding agents";
  if (installs) return "Set up Hermes + OpenClaw";
  const names = Array.from(new Set(work.map((s) => AGENT_NAMES[s.agentId] || s.agentId)));
  return `Update ${names.join(" + ")}`;
}

// The line under the Coding agents heading: what the ticked work would download.
function codingNote(selected: SetupPlanStep[]): ReactNode {
  const downloads = selected.filter((s) => s.action === "install" || s.action === "prereq-node");
  const updates = selected.filter((s) => s.action === "update");
  const totals = totalsOf(downloads);
  if (downloads.length) {
    return totals.complete ? (
      <>
        <strong>
          About {formatSize(totals.mb)} to download and store · roughly {formatMinutes(totals.minutes)}
        </strong>
        <span> (depends on your internet connection){updates.length ? "; updates are extra" : ""}</span>
      </>
    ) : (
      <strong>Download sizes vary.</strong>
    );
  }
  if (updates.length) return <strong>Updates only. Their size varies.</strong>;
  return <strong>Nothing chosen, so nothing will change.</strong>;
}

function RetryButton({ onClick }: { onClick: () => void }) {
  return (
    <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={onClick}>
      <RefreshCw size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> Retry
    </button>
  );
}

// The AI brain step has nothing to choose for the coding agents; the table says so
// and shows whether each one is installed (from the check).
function CodingNoChoice({ check }: { check: SystemCheck | null }) {
  return (
    <div className="os-setup-coding">
      <div
        className="os-table os-setup-table"
        role="table"
        aria-label="Coding agents: no choice needed"
        style={{ "--os-table-cols": CODING_COLUMNS } as CSSProperties}
      >
        <div className="os-visually-hidden" role="row">
          {["Coding agent", "Found", "What to choose"].map((heading) => (
            <span key={heading} role="columnheader">
              {heading}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="os-table__group os-setup-table__group" role="presentation">
          <b>Coding agents</b>
          <span>No choice needed</span>
        </div>
        {CODING_IDS.map((id) => {
          const installed = Boolean(check?.agents?.[id]?.detected.installed);
          return (
            <div key={id} className="os-table__row" role="row">
              <div className="os-table__cell os-setup-table__name" role="rowheader">
                {AGENT_NAMES[id]}
              </div>
              <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">
                {check ? (
                  <SetupStatus tone={installed ? "ok" : "unknown"}>{installed ? "Installed" : "Not installed"}</SetupStatus>
                ) : (
                  <SetupStatus tone="unknown">—</SetupStatus>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="os-table__cell os-setup-table__detail" role="cell">
                Uses its own sign-in. Nothing to choose here.
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function SetupPage() {
  const [check, setCheck] = useState<SystemCheck | null>(null);
  const [checkError, setCheckError] = useState(false);
  const [rechecking, setRechecking] = useState(false);
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState<SetupPlan | null>(null);
  const [planError, setPlanError] = useState(false);
  const [brain, setBrain] = useState<BrainOptionsResponse | null>(null);
  const [agentsMeta, setAgentsMeta] = useState<AgentSummary[] | null>(null);

  const [stepIndex, setStepIndex] = useState(0);
  const initializedRef = useRef(false);
  const titleRef = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const focusOnStepChange = useRef(false);
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState("");

  const [selections, setSelections] = useState<Record<string, PlanSelection>>({});
  const [openClawRiskAccepted, setOpenClawRiskAccepted] = useState(false);
  // Which group's button was pressed; the confirm dialog is about that group only.
  const [confirmGroup, setConfirmGroup] = useState<GroupId | null>(null);
  const [installConfirmError, setInstallConfirmError] = useState("");
  const [installJob, setInstallJob] = useState<SetupJob | null>(null);
  const [installBusy, setInstallBusy] = useState(false);

  // What the AI brain panel is doing (it runs its own configure job and
  // result screen); used for the rail and for the footer's buttons.
  const [brainStatus, setBrainStatus] = useState<BrainPanelStatus>("idle");
  // What the Sign in and Ready steps last reported, so the rail can say "2 of 3 signed in"
  // and show Ready as done only when nothing is left to fix. null = not known yet.
  const [signIn, setSignIn] = useState<{ signedIn: number; installed: number } | null>(null);
  const [readyProblems, setReadyProblems] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // A job that is still running (or just failed) on the server survives a
  // reload or a trip to another page: re-attach to it instead of showing an
  // empty Install step. Returns the step to land on, or null. (A running
  // configure job is picked up again by the AI brain panel itself.)
  async function restoreJobs(): Promise<number | null> {
    const configureId = recallJobId("configure");
    if (configureId) {
      const job = await getSetupJob(configureId).catch(() => null);
      if (job && job.status === "running") return STEP.brain;
      rememberJobId("configure", null);
    }
    const installId = recallJobId("install");
    if (installId) {
      const job = await getSetupJob(installId).catch(() => null);
      if (job && (job.status === "running" || job.status === "failed")) {
        setInstallJob(job);
        return STEP.install;
      }
      rememberJobId("install", null);
    }
    return null;
  }

  async function loadAll(refresh = false) {
    setCheckError(false);
    setPlanError(false);
    let checkRes: SystemCheck;
    try {
      checkRes = await getSetupCheck(refresh);
      setCheck(checkRes);
    } catch {
      setCheckError(true);
      return;
    }
    try {
      const [planRes, brainRes, agentsRes] = await Promise.all([
        getSetupPlan("all"),
        getBrainOptions(refresh),
        listAgents().catch(() => null)
      ]);
      setPlan(planRes);
      setBrain(brainRes);
      setAgentsMeta(agentsRes ? agentsRes.agents : null);
      setSelections(defaultSelections(planRes));

      if (!initializedRef.current) {
        initializedRef.current = true;
        const restored = await restoreJobs();
        if (restored !== null) {
          setStepIndex(restored);
          return;
        }
        // A step named in the address (the Get started checklist uses this) wins
        // over the one worked out from what is installed.
        const asked = stepFromUrl();
        if (asked !== null) {
          setStepIndex(asked);
          return;
        }
        const anyInstalled = ALL_AGENT_IDS.some((id) => checkRes.agents?.[id]?.detected.installed);
        const needsAction = planRes.steps.some((s) => s.action === "install" || s.action === "prereq-node");
        // A brand-new computer starts at Check; a half-set-up one at Plan;
        // everything installed lands on AI brain, or Ready once configured.
        if (!anyInstalled) setStepIndex(STEP.check);
        else if (needsAction) setStepIndex(STEP.plan);
        else setStepIndex(brainReady(checkRes, brainRes) ? STEP.ready : STEP.brain);
      }
    } catch {
      setPlanError(true);
    }
  }

  // After a job finishes, what the page knew before (installed? configured?)
  // is stale; re-read it from the server so the next step is truthful.
  async function refreshServerState(includePlan: boolean) {
    try {
      const [checkRes, brainRes, planRes] = await Promise.all([
        getSetupCheck(true),
        getBrainOptions(true),
        includePlan ? getSetupPlan("all") : Promise.resolve(null)
      ]);
      setCheck(checkRes);
      setBrain(brainRes);
      if (planRes) {
        setPlan(planRes);
        setSelections(defaultSelections(planRes));
      }
    } catch {
      // The Ready step re-checks on its own; nothing to show here.
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadAll();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  // Already on Setup and a link (the checklist, the ⌘K palette) names another
  // step: go there instead of staying put.
  useEffect(() => {
    function onNavigate() {
      const asked = stepFromUrl();
      if (asked !== null && initializedRef.current) {
        focusOnStepChange.current = true;
        setStepIndex(asked);
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener("aos-navigate", onNavigate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("aos-navigate", onNavigate);
  }, []);

  const installStatus = installJob?.status;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (installStatus === "succeeded") void refreshServerState(true);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [installStatus]);

  // Moving to a new step unmounts the button that was just pressed, which
  // would drop keyboard focus on <body>; put it on the new step's title.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!focusOnStepChange.current) return;
    focusOnStepChange.current = false;
    titleRef.current?.focus();
  }, [stepIndex]);

  // The Ready step's count is only true while Ready is on screen.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (stepIndex !== STEP.ready) setReadyProblems(null);
  }, [stepIndex]);

  // Every step change a person causes goes through here; the first landing
  // (derived from the server) does not, so the page doesn't grab focus on load.
  function goToStep(index: number) {
    focusOnStepChange.current = true;
    setStepIndex(index);
  }

  // ---- where "Continue" and "Back" lead ----------------------------------------
  // Hermes/OpenClaw need an AI brain; the coding agents only need a sign-in. A
  // step is skipped when nothing in it applies, so a person who installed only
  // coding agents is never shown a brain screen about agents they don't have.
  // An agent the install job just finished counts even if the re-check is still
  // on its way.
  function groupInstalled(ids: readonly string[]) {
    const jobDid = Boolean(
      installJob?.steps.some((s) => s.agentId && ids.includes(s.agentId) && s.action !== "prereq-node" && s.status === "succeeded")
    );
    return jobDid || ids.some((id) => check?.agents?.[id as keyof NonNullable<SystemCheck["agents"]>]?.detected.installed);
  }
  const afterBrain = () => (groupInstalled(CODING_IDS) ? STEP.signin : STEP.ready);
  const afterInstall = () => (groupInstalled(OPERATOR_IDS) ? STEP.brain : afterBrain());
  const afterPlan = () => (groupInstalled(OPERATOR_IDS) && !brainReady(check, brain) ? STEP.brain : afterBrain());
  // Back skips the same steps Continue skips: Install only if a job exists, AI brain only
  // if Hermes or OpenClaw is installed, Sign in only if a coding agent is.
  function appliesTo(index: number) {
    if (index === STEP.install) return Boolean(installJob);
    if (index === STEP.brain) return groupInstalled(OPERATOR_IDS);
    if (index === STEP.signin) return groupInstalled(CODING_IDS);
    return true;
  }
  function previousStep(index: number) {
    for (let i = index - 1; i > 0; i -= 1) if (appliesTo(i)) return i;
    return STEP.check;
  }

  // ---- job polling ----------------------------------------------------------
  useInterval(
    async () => {
      if (!installJob) return;
      try {
        setInstallJob(await getSetupJob(installJob.id));
      } catch {
        // transient poll failure; next tick tries again
      }
    },
    installJob && installJob.status === "running" ? 1000 : null
  );

  function agentMeta(agentId: string) {
    return agentsMeta?.find((a) => a.id === agentId);
  }

  function stepsFor(agentId: string) {
    const all = plan?.steps.filter((s) => s.agentId === agentId) || [];
    return {
      keepStep: all.find((s) => s.action === "keep"),
      // Hermes has none (Task B1): an installed agent may have a keep step and nothing else.
      updateStep: all.find((s) => s.action === "update"),
      installSteps: all.filter((s) => s.action === "install" || s.action === "prereq-node"),
      unsupportedStep: all.find((s) => s.action === "skip-unsupported")
    };
  }

  // The steps a group's current choices would run, in plan order.
  function selectedSteps(ids: readonly string[]): SetupPlanStep[] {
    if (!plan) return [];
    const picked: SetupPlanStep[] = [];
    for (const agentId of ids) {
      const sel = selections[agentId];
      const { keepStep, updateStep, installSteps, unsupportedStep } = stepsFor(agentId);
      if (sel === "keep" && keepStep) picked.push(keepStep);
      else if (sel === "update" && updateStep) picked.push(updateStep);
      else if (sel === "install") picked.push(...installSteps);
      else if (sel === "unsupported" && unsupportedStep) picked.push(unsupportedStep);
      // "skip" (a coding agent switched to Skip) adds nothing.
    }
    return picked;
  }

  const idsOf = (group: GroupId) => (group === "operators" ? OPERATOR_IDS : CODING_IDS);
  const workIn = (group: GroupId) =>
    selectedSteps(idsOf(group)).filter((s) => s.action === "install" || s.action === "update" || s.action === "prereq-node");

  const needsOpenClawConsentInstall = selections.openclaw === "install";
  const operatorWorkSteps = workIn("operators");
  const codingWorkSteps = workIn("coding");
  const operatorWork = operatorWorkSteps.length > 0;
  const anyWork = operatorWork || codingWorkSteps.length > 0;
  const operatorsBlocked = operatorWork && needsOpenClawConsentInstall && !openClawRiskAccepted;

  async function confirmInstall() {
    if (!confirmGroup) return;
    setInstallBusy(true);
    setInstallConfirmError("");
    try {
      const job = await startInstallJob({
        steps: selectedSteps(idsOf(confirmGroup)).map((s) => s.id),
        acceptOpenClawRisk: confirmGroup === "operators" && needsOpenClawConsentInstall && openClawRiskAccepted
      });
      rememberJobId("install", job.id);
      setInstallJob(job);
      setConfirmGroup(null);
      goToStep(STEP.install);
    } catch (error) {
      // Keep the dialog open so the reason is readable next to the button.
      setInstallConfirmError(friendlyError(error));
    } finally {
      setInstallBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function onCancelInstall() {
    if (!installJob) return;
    try {
      setInstallJob(await cancelSetupJob(installJob.id));
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(friendlyError(error));
    }
  }

  async function onRetryInstall() {
    if (!installJob) return;
    setInstallBusy(true);
    setActionError("");
    try {
      setInstallJob(await retrySetupJob(installJob.id));
    } catch (error) {
      setActionError(friendlyError(error));
    } finally {
      setInstallBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const brainAgents: BrainAgentLine[] = AGENT_IDS.map((id) => ({
    id,
    label: BRAIN_AGENT_LABEL[id],
    installed: Boolean(check?.agents?.[id]?.detected.installed),
    configured: Boolean(brain?.current[id].configured)
  }));

  // Labels come from the job's own steps (agent + action), so they stay
  // readable after a reload even though the plan has changed since.
  const planStepLabels: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries([
    ...(plan?.steps || []).map((s) => [s.id, s.title] as const),
    ...(installJob?.steps || []).map((s) => [s.id, installStepLabel(s.agentId, s.action)] as const)
  ]);
  const planCommandPreviews: Record<string, string | null> = Object.fromEntries(
    (plan?.steps || []).map((s) => [s.id, s.commandPreview])
  );

  async function onRecheck() {
    setRechecking(true);
    try {
      await loadAll(true);
    } finally {
      setRechecking(false);
    }
  }

  // ---- the rail: state and a one-line summary per step, from what the page knows ----
  const installedCount = ALL_AGENT_IDS.filter((id) => check?.agents?.[id]?.detected.installed).length;
  const installNotDone = installJob?.status === "failed" || installJob?.status === "cancelled";
  const brainPartial = brainAgents.some((a) => a.installed) && !brainReady(check, brain);
  const signInPartial = Boolean(signIn && signIn.installed > 0 && signIn.signedIn < signIn.installed);

  function stepState(index: number): SetupStepState {
    if (index === STEP.install && installNotDone) return "failed";
    if (index === STEP.brain && brainStatus === "failed") return "failed";
    // Ready is done only when the final check found nothing left to fix.
    if (index === STEP.ready && index === stepIndex && readyProblems === 0) return "done";
    if (index < stepIndex) {
      if (index === STEP.brain && brainPartial) return "partial";
      if (index === STEP.signin && signInPartial) return "partial";
      return "done";
    }
    return index === stepIndex ? "current" : "not-reached";
  }

  function stepSummary(index: number, state: SetupStepState): string | undefined {
    if (index === STEP.check) return check ? `Done · ${installedCount} of ${ALL_AGENT_IDS.length} agents found` : undefined;
    if (index === STEP.plan) return installJob ? `Done · ${plural(installJob.steps.length, "step")} chosen` : "Done · no install run";
    if (index === STEP.install) {
      if (!installJob) return "Done · nothing to install";
      const total = installJob.steps.length;
      const finished = installJob.steps.filter((s) => s.status === "succeeded").length;
      if (installJob.status === "succeeded") return `Done · ${total} of ${total} steps`;
      if (installJob.status === "failed") return `Failed · ${finished} of ${total} steps done`;
      if (installJob.status === "cancelled") return `Cancelled · ${finished} of ${total} steps done`;
      return undefined;
    }
    if (index === STEP.brain) {
      if (state === "failed") return "Failed · try again";
      const installed = brainAgents.filter((a) => a.installed);
      if (!installed.length) return "Done · not needed";
      const set = installed.filter((a) => a.configured).length;
      return `${state === "partial" ? "Not finished" : "Done"} · ${set} of ${installed.length} have a brain`;
    }
    if (index === STEP.signin) {
      if (!groupInstalled(CODING_IDS) || signIn?.installed === 0) return "Done · not needed";
      if (!signIn) return undefined;
      return `${state === "partial" ? "Not finished" : "Done"} · ${signIn.signedIn} of ${signIn.installed} signed in`;
    }
    if (index === STEP.ready) {
      if (readyProblems === 0) return "Done · all set";
      return readyProblems ? `${plural(readyProblems, "thing")} left to fix` : undefined;
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  const steps: SetupStepDef[] = STEPS.map((s, i) => {
    const state = stepState(i);
    const reportable = state === "done" || state === "failed" || state === "partial" || (i === STEP.ready && i === stepIndex);
    return {
      key: s.key,
      label: s.label,
      line: s.line,
      summary: reportable ? stepSummary(i, state) : undefined,
      state,
      current: i === stepIndex
    };
  });

  const confirmSteps = confirmGroup ? selectedSteps(idsOf(confirmGroup)) : [];
  const confirmTotals = totalsOf(confirmSteps.filter((s) => s.action === "install" || s.action === "prereq-node"));
  const confirmAction = confirmGroup ? groupAction(confirmGroup, workIn(confirmGroup)) || "" : "";

  const operatorsLabel = groupAction("operators", operatorWorkSteps);
  const codingLabel = groupAction("coding", codingWorkSteps);
  const current = STEPS[stepIndex];

  // ---- one block per step: the content, then the footer ------------------------
  const checkStep = (
    <>
      <div className="os-setup-panel__content">
        {checkError ? (
          <Banner tone="danger" title="Couldn't check this computer" actions={<RetryButton onClick={() => void loadAll()} />}>
            Agent OS could not read what is installed. Nothing was changed. Try again.
          </Banner>
        ) : !check ? (
          <p className="os-setup-loading" role="status">
            Checking this computer…
          </p>
        ) : (
          <SetupCheckList check={check} />
        )}
      </div>
      <SetupFooter
        note={checkError ? "The check did not finish." : !check ? "Reading what is installed." : "Nothing on this computer was changed."}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          className="os-btn os-btn--secondary"
          onClick={() => void onRecheck()}
          disabled={rechecking || (!check && !checkError)}
        >
          <RefreshCw size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
          {rechecking ? "Checking…" : "Check again"}
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--primary" onClick={() => goToStep(STEP.plan)} disabled={!check || checkError}>
          Continue
          <ArrowRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
      </SetupFooter>
    </>
  );

  const planStep = (
    <>
      <div className="os-setup-panel__content">
        {planError ? (
          <Banner tone="danger" title="Couldn't load the setup plan" actions={<RetryButton onClick={() => void loadAll()} />}>
            Nothing was changed. Try again.
          </Banner>
        ) : !plan ? (
          <p className="os-setup-loading" role="status">
            Loading the setup plan…
          </p>
        ) : (
          <>
            {plan.blocked.length ? (
              <Banner tone="warn" title="Setup can't do everything here">
                {plan.blocked.map((b) => `${AGENT_NAMES[b.agentId] || b.agentId}: ${b.reason}`).join(" ")}
              </Banner>
            ) : null}
            {plan.manualSteps.length ? (
              <Banner tone="warn" title="Do this in a terminal first">
                <div className="os-setup-manual">
                  {plan.manualSteps.map((m, i) => (
                    <div key={i}>
                      <p>{m.reason}</p>
                      <SetupCommand command={m.command} />
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </Banner>
            ) : null}

            <SetupPlanGroup
              id="operators"
              title="Always-on agents"
              sub="Hermes · OpenClaw"
              description="Assistants that keep working in the background, even when you are away."
              actionLabel={operatorsLabel}
              onAction={() => {
                setInstallConfirmError("");
                setConfirmGroup("operators");
              }}
              actionDisabled={operatorsBlocked || installBusy}
              hint={operatorsBlocked ? "Tick the OpenClaw box in its row first." : undefined}
              note={!operatorWork ? "Nothing to install here. What is already installed is kept as it is." : undefined}
            >
              {AGENT_IDS.map((agentId) => (
                <SetupPlanRow
                  key={agentId}
                  label={agentMeta(agentId)?.label || AGENT_NAMES[agentId]}
                  license={agentMeta(agentId)?.license}
                  {...stepsFor(agentId)}
                  selection={selections[agentId] || "keep"}
                  onSelect={(next) => setSelections((prev) => ({ ...prev, [agentId]: next }))}
                  disabled={installBusy}
                  canSkip={false}
                  consent={
                    agentId === "openclaw"
                      ? { accepted: openClawRiskAccepted, onToggle: setOpenClawRiskAccepted }
                      : undefined
                  }
                />
              ))}
            </SetupPlanGroup>

            <SetupPlanGroup
              id="coding"
              title="Coding agents"
              sub="Claude Code · Codex · Cursor"
              description="Programming helpers you talk to. Each one signs in with its own account in a later step. Anything already installed is kept as it is."
              actionLabel={codingLabel}
              onAction={() => {
                setInstallConfirmError("");
                setConfirmGroup("coding");
              }}
              actionDisabled={installBusy}
              note={codingNote(selectedSteps(CODING_IDS))}
            >
              {CODING_IDS.map((agentId) => (
                <SetupPlanRow
                  key={agentId}
                  label={AGENT_NAMES[agentId]}
                  {...stepsFor(agentId)}
                  selection={selections[agentId] || "keep"}
                  onSelect={(next) => setSelections((prev) => ({ ...prev, [agentId]: next }))}
                  disabled={installBusy}
                  canSkip
                />
              ))}
            </SetupPlanGroup>

            <SetupChanges work={[...operatorWorkSteps, ...codingWorkSteps]} labels={AGENT_NAMES} />
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      <SetupFooter
        onBack={() => goToStep(STEP.check)}
        note={anyWork ? "Nothing runs until you press a group's button and confirm." : "Nothing will change. Continue to the next step."}
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`os-btn ${anyWork ? "os-btn--secondary" : "os-btn--primary"}`}
          onClick={() => goToStep(afterPlan())}
          disabled={!plan}
        >
          {anyWork ? "Skip installing, continue" : "Continue"}
          <ArrowRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
      </SetupFooter>
    </>
  );

  const installNote = !installJob
    ? "Nothing is running."
    : installJob.status === "running"
      ? "Continue unlocks when the install finishes."
      : installJob.status === "succeeded"
        ? "Install finished."
        : installJob.status === "failed"
          ? "A step failed. Retry it above, or go back to the plan."
          : "Setup was cancelled. Retry it above, or go back to the plan.";
  const installStep = installJob ? (
    <>
      <div className="os-setup-panel__content">
        <SetupInstallPanel
          job={installJob}
          stepLabels={planStepLabels}
          commandPreviews={planCommandPreviews}
          onCancel={onCancelInstall}
          onRetry={onRetryInstall}
          busy={installBusy}
        />
      </div>
      <SetupFooter onBack={() => goToStep(previousStep(STEP.install))} backDisabled={installJob.status === "running"} note={installNote}>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="os-btn os-btn--primary"
          onClick={() => goToStep(afterInstall())}
          disabled={installJob.status !== "succeeded"}
        >
          Continue
          <ArrowRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
      </SetupFooter>
    </>
  ) : (
    <>
      <div className="os-setup-panel__content">
        <EmptyState
          icon={PackageCheck}
          title="Nothing to install"
          body="No install is running right now. If your agents were already on this computer, you can move on."
          action={
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => goToStep(STEP.plan)}>
              Go to Plan
            </button>
          }
        />
      </div>
      <SetupFooter onBack={() => goToStep(previousStep(STEP.install))} note="Nothing is running.">
        <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--primary" onClick={() => goToStep(afterInstall())}>
          Continue
          <ArrowRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
      </SetupFooter>
    </>
  );

  const brainOk = brainReady(check, brain);
  const brainNeeded = brainAgents.some((a) => a.installed);
  const brainRunning = brainStatus === "running";
  const brainNote = brainRunning
    ? "Giving your agents a brain…"
    : !brain
      ? "Reading the brain options."
      : !brainNeeded
        ? "Hermes and OpenClaw are not installed, so there is no brain to set."
        : brainOk
          ? "Every installed agent has a brain."
          : "Pick a brain above, or skip for now.";
  const brainStep = (
    <>
      <div className="os-setup-panel__content">
        {brain ? (
          <>
            <SetupBrainPanel
              brain={brain}
              agents={brainAgents}
              onChanged={() => void refreshServerState(false)}
              onStatus={setBrainStatus}
              onContinue={() => goToStep(afterBrain())}
            />
            <CodingNoChoice check={check} />
          </>
        ) : planError ? (
          <Banner tone="danger" title="Couldn't load the AI brain options" actions={<RetryButton onClick={() => void loadAll()} />}>
            Nothing was changed. Try again.
          </Banner>
        ) : (
          <p className="os-setup-loading" role="status">
            Loading model provider options…
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
      <SetupFooter onBack={() => goToStep(previousStep(STEP.brain))} backDisabled={brainRunning} note={brainNote}>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`os-btn ${brainOk || !brainNeeded ? "os-btn--primary" : "os-btn--secondary"}`}
          onClick={() => goToStep(afterBrain())}
          disabled={brainRunning || !brain}
        >
          {brainOk || !brainNeeded ? "Continue" : "Skip for now"}
          <ArrowRight size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
        </button>
      </SetupFooter>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <div className="os-setup">
      <PageHeader
        title="Setup"
        titleId="os-setup-title"
        lede="Agent OS checks this computer, shows every change, and asks first. Run it again any time."
      />

      {actionError ? (
        <Banner
          tone="danger"
          actions={
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--ghost" onClick={() => setActionError("")} aria-label="Dismiss this message">
              <X size={14} aria-hidden="true" />
            </button>
          }
        >
          {actionError}
        </Banner>
      ) : null}

      <div className="os-setup__wrap">
        <SetupStepper steps={steps} onSelect={goToStep} />

        <section className="os-setup-panel" aria-labelledby="os-setup-step-title">
          <header className="os-setup-panel__head">
            <div className="os-setup-panel__top">
              <h2 id="os-setup-step-title" className="os-setup-panel__title" ref={titleRef} tabIndex={-1}>
                {current.label}
              </h2>
              <span className="os-setup-panel__count os-mono">
                Step {stepIndex + 1} of {STEPS.length}
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="os-setup-panel__lede">{current.lede}</p>
          </header>

          {stepIndex === STEP.check ? checkStep : null}
          {stepIndex === STEP.plan ? planStep : null}
          {stepIndex === STEP.install ? installStep : null}
          {stepIndex === STEP.brain ? brainStep : null}
          {stepIndex === STEP.signin ? (
            <SetupSignInPanel
              onContinue={() => goToStep(STEP.ready)}
              onGoToPlan={() => goToStep(STEP.plan)}
              onBack={() => goToStep(previousStep(STEP.signin))}
              onSummary={setSignIn}
            />
          ) : null}
          {stepIndex === STEP.ready ? (
            <SetupReadyPanel
              onGoHome={() => navigateTo("fleet")}
              onOpenSafety={() => navigateTo("safety")}
              onGoToStep={goToStep}
              onOpenAgent={(agentId) => navigateTo("agents", { agent: agentId })}
              onProblems={setReadyProblems}
            />
          ) : null}
        </section>
      </div>

      {confirmGroup ? (
        <SetupModal
          title={`${confirmAction}?`}
          confirmLabel={confirmAction}
          onConfirm={confirmInstall}
          onClose={() => setConfirmGroup(null)}
          busy={installBusy}
          error={installConfirmError}
        >
          <p>This will run:</p>
          <ul>
            {confirmSteps.map((s) => (
              <li key={s.id}>{planStepLabels[s.id] || s.id}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          {confirmGroup === "coding" && confirmTotals.complete ? (
            <p>
              About {formatSize(confirmTotals.mb)} to download and store, roughly {formatMinutes(confirmTotals.minutes)}. Anything
              already installed is kept as it is.
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </SetupModal>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

Where every value on screen comes from (nothing is made up; an unknown value is "—"):

| On screen | Source |
|---|---|
| Rail: "Done · 5 of 5 agents found" | `getSetupCheck()`: `agents[id].detected.installed` for the five ids |
| Rail: Plan "Done · 3 steps chosen" | the install job: `steps.length` from `startInstallJob` / `getSetupJob`; "Done · no install run" when there is no job |
| Rail: Install | the job's `status` and each step's `status`; "Done · nothing to install" when there is no job |
| Rail: AI brain "Not finished · 1 of 2 have a brain" | `agents.hermes/openclaw.detected.installed` from the check and `getBrainOptions().current[id].configured` |
| Rail: Sign in "Not finished · 2 of 3 signed in" | `SetupSignInPanel` `onSummary`, from `getSignIn(id).status` for each coding agent |
| Rail: Ready "4 things left to fix" / "Done · all set" | `SetupReadyPanel` `onProblems`, from `getSetupCheck(true)`, `getBrainOptions(true)` and `getAgentDetail(id)` |
| Check rows | `getSetupCheck(refresh)`: `os`, `osVersion`, `arch`, `isIntelMac`, `ramGb`, `freeDiskGb`, `tools.git/node/python3/uv/docker`, `network[]`, `ollama`, `agents[id].detected` and `.service` |
| Plan rows | `getSetupPlan("all")` steps: `keep` (`installedVersion`), `update`, `install` and `prereq-node` (`summary`, `description`, `approxMb`, `approxMinutes`, `passwordMoments`, `license`, `termsUrl`, `sourceUrl`), `skip-unsupported`; names and licences from `listAgents()` (`label`, `license`) |
| "What this changes" and the exact commands | the chosen steps' `changes` and `commandPreview` |
| Install job, log, Cancel, Retry | `startInstallJob`, `getSetupJob` (polled every second while running), `cancelSetupJob`, `retrySetupJob`; `recallJobId` / `rememberJobId` |
| AI brain | `getBrainOptions` and `SetupBrainPanel` (unchanged); the coding rows' "Installed" from `agents[id].detected.installed` |
| Sign in | `getSignIn`, `startSignInRun`, `cancelSignInRun`, `openSignInTerminal` |
| Ready | `getSetupCheck(true)`, `getBrainOptions(true)`, `getReceipt()`, `getAgentDetail("hermes")` and `("openclaw")` |

Every state and its exact copy:

| Step | State | What shows |
|---|---|---|
| Check | loading | "Checking this computer…"; footer "Reading what is installed."; Continue and Check again off |
| Check | error or offline | alert banner "Couldn't check this computer" / "Agent OS could not read what is installed. Nothing was changed. Try again." with Retry; footer "The check did not finish."; Continue off |
| Check | normal | the table; footer "Nothing on this computer was changed."; "Check again" ("Checking…" while it runs) and "Continue" |
| Plan | loading | "Loading the setup plan…" |
| Plan | error or offline | alert banner "Couldn't load the setup plan" / "Nothing was changed. Try again." with Retry; Continue off |
| Plan | blocked, or a manual step | warn banner "Setup can't do everything here" with the server's reasons; warn banner "Do this in a terminal first" with each reason and its command (copy button) |
| Plan | nothing chosen | no group buttons; "What this changes" says "Nothing. What is installed stays exactly as it is."; footer "Nothing will change. Continue to the next step." and a primary "Continue" |
| Plan | something chosen | the group's button ("Set up Hermes + OpenClaw", "Update OpenClaw", "Install coding agents" or "Update coding agents"); the changes block lists it; footer "Nothing runs until you press a group's button and confirm." and a secondary "Skip installing, continue" |
| Install | no job | empty state "Nothing to install" with "Go to Plan"; footer "Nothing is running." |
| Install | running, done, failed, cancelled | the job (see `SetupInstallPanel`); footer "Continue unlocks when the install finishes.", "Install finished.", "A step failed. Retry it above, or go back to the plan." or "Setup was cancelled. Retry it above, or go back to the plan."; Continue only after success; Back off while running |
| AI brain | loading | "Loading model provider options…" |
| AI brain | error or offline | alert banner "Couldn't load the AI brain options" with Retry |
| AI brain | normal | `SetupBrainPanel`, then the coding table "Coding agents: no choice needed" ("Installed" or "Not installed", "Uses its own sign-in. Nothing to choose here."); footer "Pick a brain above, or skip for now." with a secondary "Skip for now", or "Every installed agent has a brain." / "Hermes and OpenClaw are not installed, so there is no brain to set." with a primary "Continue" |
| Sign in, Ready | all states | in `SetupSignInPanel` and `SetupReadyPanel` (Steps 10 and 11) |

```tsx
  const dashboard =
    agentId === "hermes"
      ? { title: "Hermes dashboard", about: "Hermes's own page for its memory and settings, on this Mac only.", url: "http://127.0.0.1:9119", button: "Open dashboard" }
      : agentId === "openclaw"
        ? { title: "OpenClaw Control UI", about: "OpenClaw's own control page, served by its Gateway, on this Mac only.", url: "http://127.0.0.1:18789", button: "Open Control UI" }
        : null;

  return (
    <section className="os-agent-bay" aria-labelledby="os-agent-name">
      <header className="os-agent-head">
        <div>
          <h2 id="os-agent-name">{label}</h2>
          <p className="os-agent-head__who">{AGENT_MAKER[agentId] || "—"} · {operator ? "Operator" : "Builder"}</p>
          <p className="os-agent-head__about">{AGENT_ROLE[agentId]}</p>
        </div>
        {/* "Open session" / "New session" arrive with Sessions in SP3. */}
      </header>

      {detailError ? (
        <Banner
          tone="warn"
          title="Couldn't load this agent's details"
          actions={
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void loadDetail()}>
              <RefreshCw size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> Retry
            </button>
          }
        >
          {detailError}
        </Banner>
      ) : null}

      <section className="os-agent-version" aria-labelledby="os-agent-version-title">
        <h3 id="os-agent-version-title">Version</h3>
        {installed ? (
          <>
            <p className="os-agent-version__line">
              Installed <span className="os-mono">{agent?.detected.version || "—"}</span>
            </p>
            {versionFull ? (
              <details className="os-agent-version__details">
                <summary>Details</summary>
                <pre className="os-mono">{versionFull}</pre>
              </details>
            ) : null}
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="os-agent-version__missing">
            <StatusWord state="unknown" label="Not installed" />
            <p>{label} isn&apos;t installed on this Mac.</p>
            {SETUP_INSTALLED_AGENT_SET.has(agentId) ? (
              <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => navigateTo("setup")}>
                Open Setup
              </button>
            ) : agent?.homepage ? (
              <a className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" href={agent.homepage} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                How to install it <ExternalLink size={14} aria-hidden="true" />
              </a>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        )}
        <p className="os-agent-version__links">
          {agent?.homepage ? <a href={agent.homepage} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Homepage</a> : null}
          {agent?.docsUrl ? <a href={agent.docsUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Docs</a> : null}
        </p>
      </section>

      {installed ? (
        <div className="os-agt-secs">
          {agentId === "hermes" || agentId === "openclaw" ? <AgentBrainCard agentId={agentId} label={label} /> : null}
          {builderId ? (
            <>
              <BuilderBrainCard agentId={builderId} label={label} brains={brains} failed={brainsFailed} onChanged={() => onBrainsChanged?.()} />
              <PlanLimitSettings brains={brains} onChanged={() => onBrainsChanged?.()} />
            </>
          ) : null}

          <AgentSafetyPanel agentId={agentId} safety={detail?.safety ?? null} notes={detail?.config.notes ?? []} onFixed={() => void loadDetail()} />

          {operator ? (
            <AgentServicePanel agentId={agentId} label={label} service={detail?.service ?? null} checked={Boolean(detail)} onRefresh={() => void loadDetail()} />
          ) : null}

          {dashboard ? (
            <section className="os-panel os-agent-dash" aria-labelledby="os-agent-dash-title">
              <h3 id="os-agent-dash-title">Its own dashboard</h3>
              <div className="os-agent-dash__line">
                <div>
                  <b>{dashboard.title}</b>
                  <p>{dashboard.about} This is its default address, and it opens only while it is running.</p>
                  <span className="os-mono os-agent-dash__addr">{dashboard.url.replace("http://", "")}</span>
                </div>
                <a className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" href={dashboard.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                  {dashboard.button} <ExternalLink size={14} aria-hidden="true" />
                </a>
              </div>
            </section>
          ) : null}

          <section className="os-panel os-config" aria-labelledby="os-config-title">
            <h3 id="os-config-title" className="os-config__title">Configuration</h3>
            {!detail ? (
              <p><StatusWord state="loading" /></p>
            ) : (
              <>
                <p className="os-config__summary">
                  <StatusWord state={detail.config.ok ? "ready" : "waiting"} label={detail.config.ok ? "Configured" : "Needs attention"} />
                  <span>{detail.config.summary}</span>
                </p>
                {detail.config.problems.map((problem, index) => (
                  <p key={index} className="os-config__problem">{problem}</p>
                ))}
                {detail.config.fixHint ? <p className="os-config__hint">{detail.config.fixHint}</p> : null}
                {!detail.config.ok && SETUP_INSTALLED_AGENT_SET.has(agentId) ? (
                  <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => navigateTo("setup")}>
                    Open Setup
                  </button>
                ) : null}
              </>
            )}
          </section>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
```

```css
/* Agents (the prototype's agents.html): header, rail by role, detail sections.
   The panels keep their own markup; .os-agt-secs lays each one out as
   "title on the left, content on the right". */
.os-agents { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--os-sp-6); }
.os-agents__body {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 240px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: var(--os-sp-8);
  align-items: start;
}
@media (max-width: 1099px) {
  .os-agents__body { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--os-sp-5); }
}

/* Rail */
.os-agent-rail { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--os-bar-h, 48px) + var(--os-sp-4)); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--os-sp-4); }
.os-agent-rail__group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.os-shell button.os-agent-rail__item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 4px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--os-sp-2) var(--os-sp-3);
  text-align: left;
  color: var(--os-text-2);
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--os-r-sm);
  transition: background-color 140ms var(--os-ease-out), color 140ms var(--os-ease-out);
}
.os-shell button.os-agent-rail__item:hover { background: var(--os-surface-1); color: var(--os-text-1); }
.os-shell button.os-agent-rail__item--selected { background: var(--os-surface-2); color: var(--os-text-1); border-color: var(--os-line-1); }
.os-agent-rail__name { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--os-sp-2); font-size: var(--os-fs-14); font-weight: 560; }
.os-agent-rail__version { font-size: var(--os-fs-12); color: var(--os-text-3); }
.os-agent-rail__brain { font-size: var(--os-fs-12); }
.os-agent-rail__retry { align-self: flex-start; }
@media (max-width: 1099px) {
  .os-agent-rail { position: static; flex-direction: row; overflow-x: auto; gap: var(--os-sp-3); }
  .os-agent-rail__group { flex-direction: row; align-items: stretch; gap: var(--os-sp-1); }
  .os-agent-rail__group > .os-table__group { display: none; }
  .os-shell button.os-agent-rail__item { width: auto; min-width: 150px; }
}

/* Detail */
.os-agent-bay { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--os-sp-5); min-width: 0; }
.os-agent-bay__loading { margin: 0; }
.os-agent-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: var(--os-fs-26); font-stretch: 87.5%; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.os-agent-head__who { margin: var(--os-sp-1) 0 0; font-size: var(--os-fs-14); color: var(--os-text-2); }
.os-agent-head__about { margin: var(--os-sp-2) 0 0; font-size: var(--os-fs-14); color: var(--os-text-1); max-width: 60ch; }

.os-agent-version { padding: var(--os-sp-4) var(--os-sp-5); background: var(--os-surface-1); border: 1px solid var(--os-line-1); border-radius: var(--os-r-md); }
.os-agent-version h3 { margin: 0 0 var(--os-sp-2); font-size: var(--os-fs-15); }
.os-agent-version__line { margin: 0; font-size: var(--os-fs-14); color: var(--os-text-2); }
.os-agent-version__line .os-mono { margin-left: var(--os-sp-2); color: var(--os-text-1); }
.os-agent-version__details { margin-top: var(--os-sp-2); }
.os-agent-version__details summary { cursor: pointer; font-size: var(--os-fs-13); color: var(--os-text-2); }
.os-agent-version__details pre { margin: var(--os-sp-2) 0 0; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: var(--os-fs-12); color: var(--os-text-2); }
.os-agent-version__missing { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--os-sp-2); }
.os-agent-version__missing p { margin: 0; color: var(--os-text-2); }
.os-agent-version__links { display: flex; gap: var(--os-sp-4); margin: var(--os-sp-3) 0 0; font-size: var(--os-fs-13); }
.os-agent-version__links a { color: var(--os-accent-strong); }

/* Sections: each panel becomes a hairline row, title left, content right */
.os-agt-secs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.os-agt-secs > .os-panel {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 200px minmax(0, 1fr);
  column-gap: var(--os-sp-6);
  row-gap: var(--os-sp-3);
  align-items: start;
  padding: var(--os-sp-5) 0;
  background: none;
  border: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--os-line-1);
  border-radius: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.os-agt-secs > .os-panel > :first-child { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 / span 40; }
.os-agt-secs > .os-panel > :not(:first-child) { grid-column: 2; min-width: 0; }
.os-agt-secs h3 { margin: 0; font-size: var(--os-fs-15); font-weight: 600; color: var(--os-text-1); }
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .os-agt-secs > .os-panel { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .os-agt-secs > .os-panel > :first-child,
  .os-agt-secs > .os-panel > :not(:first-child) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: auto; }
}

.os-agent-dash__line { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--os-sp-4); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.os-agent-dash__line b { display: block; font-size: var(--os-fs-14); }
.os-agent-dash__line p { margin: var(--os-sp-1) 0; font-size: var(--os-fs-13); color: var(--os-text-2); max-width: 56ch; }
.os-agent-dash__addr { font-size: var(--os-fs-12); color: var(--os-text-3); }
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Create the probe `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/agents.mjs`** (git-ignored).

```js
// Task D1: Agents. Run: node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/agents.mjs
const W = 1470, H = 956;
const AGENTS_LIST = /\/api\/agents(\?|$)/;
export default async function ({ browser, openPage, shot, pass, fail }) {
  const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));

  // 1. The page, the rail by role, no letter tiles, no Launch panel.
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "agents&agent=hermes");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    check((await tab.locator("h1").first().textContent())?.trim() === "Agents", "h1 reads Agents");
    const rail = tab.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Agents" });
    const railText = (await rail.textContent()) || "";
    check(/Operators/.test(railText) && /Builders/.test(railText), "rail grouped Operators / Builders");
    check((await tab.locator(".os-agent-rail__mono, .os-agent-bay__mono").count()) === 0, "no letter tiles");
    check((await rail.locator(".os-agent-rail__version").count()) === 5, "a version slot per agent");
    check((await tab.getByRole("button", { name: /^Launch/ }).count()) === 0 && (await tab.locator(".os-agents textarea").count()) === 0, "no Launch panel on Agents");
    check(((await tab.locator("#os-agent-name").textContent()) || "").trim().length > 0, "detail h2 is the agent's name");
    check(/Nous Research · Operator/.test((await tab.locator(".os-agent-head__who").textContent()) || ""), "maker and role");
    const levels = await tab.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll(".os-agents h1, .os-agents h2, .os-agents h3")].map((h) => h.tagName));
    check(levels[0] === "H1" && levels[1] === "H2" && levels.slice(2).every((t) => t === "H3"), "heading order h1 > h2 > h3", levels.join(","));
    check(/Hold to stop all does not stop it/.test((await tab.locator(".os-service__note").textContent()) || ""), "D11 words on the background service");
    check((await tab.getByRole("link", { name: /Open dashboard/ }).getAttribute("href")) === "http://127.0.0.1:9119", "Hermes dashboard link (default address)");
    check(await tab.getByText("Safeguards").first().isVisible(), "Safeguards section");
    check(errors.length === 0, "no console errors", errors.join(" / "));
    await shot(tab, "agents", W, H, "hermes");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 2. Keyboard: focus Codex in the rail, Enter selects it; builders have no service or dashboard.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "agents&agent=hermes");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1200);
    await tab.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Agents" }).getByRole("button", { name: /Codex/ }).focus();
    await tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(800);
    check(/Codex/.test((await tab.locator("#os-agent-name").textContent()) || ""), "Enter on the rail selects Codex");
    check((await tab.locator(".os-service__note, .os-agent-dash").count()) === 0, "a builder shows no service or dashboard");
    check(/agent=codex/.test(tab.url()), "the address follows the selection");
    await shot(tab, "agents", W, H, "codex");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 3. Review Focus 5: an agent that is not installed.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "agents&agent=cursor");
    await tab.route("**/api/agents**", async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() !== "GET" || !AGENTS_LIST.test(route.request().url())) return route.continue();
      const res = await route.fetch();
      const body = await res.json();
      for (const a of body.agents || []) if (a.id === "cursor") a.detected = { ...a.detected, installed: false, version: "" };
      return route.fulfill({ response: res, json: body });
    });
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    const item = (await tab.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Agents" }).getByRole("button", { name: /Cursor/ }).textContent()) || "";
    check(/Not installed/.test(item), "rail says Not installed", item);
    check(await tab.getByText(/isn't installed on this Mac/).isVisible(), "detail says it isn't installed");
    check((await tab.locator(".os-agt-secs").count()) === 0, "no brain or safety sections for a missing agent");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 4. Review Focus 5: offline, then recovery on the poll.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "agents");
    await tab.route(AGENTS_LIST, (route) => route.abort());
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(3000);
    check(await tab.getByText("Can't reach Agent OS").first().isVisible(), "offline: banner in words");
    check((await tab.locator(".os-agent-bay__loading").count()) === 0, "offline: no endless loading");
    await shot(tab, "agents", W, H, "offline");
    await tab.unroute(AGENTS_LIST);
    await tab.waitForTimeout(6500);
    check((await tab.getByText("Can't reach Agent OS").count()) === 0, "recovers on its own (5 s poll while failing)");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 5. Layout: the icon rail at 1280, no sideways scroll at 1024.
  for (const [w, h] of [[1280, 720], [1024, 640]]) {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, w, h, "agents&agent=claude");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1200);
    const extra = await tab.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth);
    check(extra <= 0, `${w}x${h}: no sideways scroll`, `${extra}px`);
    await shot(tab, "agents", w, h, "claude");
    await context.close();
  }
}
```

### Task D2: Safety page (one level control, safeguards, pending approvals, Hold to stop all)

The Safety page becomes the prototype's `safety.html`:
- a banner while Machine control is on;
- **"How much may agents do?"**: one control with three levels, and a table of what the chosen level allows, asks about and blocks;
- **Safeguards that are always working**: a kit table;
- **Pending approvals**: a designed empty state until SP4;
- **Hold to stop all**: what it does and what it does not stop (D11).

The arming phrase "ENABLE MACHINE CONTROL" and the 1-second countdown stay exactly as today; arming moves into a dialog, as in the prototype. All server calls stay the same. Run after C1 (page kit) and C2 (which rewrites `fleet.css`, whose `.os-fleet__banner` class this page borrowed). Review Focus 5 (Safety part) is tested in Step 8.

- Create: `src/ui/safetyShared.ts` (pure: level words, what each level means, the level foot line, `levelOf`, `phraseMatches`, the always-on safeguards) and `test/safety-shared.test.js` (written first)

**Decisions taken while drafting (the owner can overturn any of them):**

| # | Question | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-D2-1 | The prototype's level words talk about sessions and "folders you choose" (marked "sample wording" in the prototype). | The words describe today's runs: agents run inside the Workspace, and risky steps ask or stop. They are kept in one place, `LEVEL_DETAIL`, so SP3 can change them with sessions. | Copy must be true when shipped. |
| D-D2-2 | The level control: radio buttons, where the arrow keys change the level? | Three buttons, one per level. The current one has `aria-pressed="true"` and the word "Current". Arrow keys never change the level; Enter or Space on a level does what that level needs (Look only applies at once, Run agents asks first, Machine control opens the arming dialog). | A safety level must never change just because focus moved. |
| D-D2-3 | Arming Machine control. | Picking Level 2 opens a dialog: what Level 2 allows, the phrase to type, and an "Arm" button that stays disabled until the phrase matches. Same request, phrase and 30-minute auto-off as today. | Prototype pattern. The spec keeps the phrase and the countdown, not the inline form. |
| D-D2-4 | The prototype's safeguards rows (hand-off, separate copy, update checks, OpenClaw cards). | Only rows that are true today: no skip-permissions flags, runs stay in the Workspace, updaters' questions are never answered for you (Task B1), and machine control. Below them, the existing real per-agent checks for Hermes and OpenClaw. | Real data only. The other rows arrive with the features (SP3 to SP5). |
| D-D2-5 | Pending approvals until SP4. | Designed empty state: "Nothing is waiting for you", plus the prototype's example card, clearly labelled "example, not real", with its buttons disabled. | Spec "Placeholders until later". The example shows what will come without pretending. |
| D-D2-6 | The prototype's "Hold to try it" practice button. | Not in SP2. The section explains with three still frames and a pointer to the real button in the top bar. | A practice copy needs a mode in `HoldToStopAll` that can never stop anything. That is safer as its own small task later than squeezed in here. |

- [ ] **Step 3: Write `src/ui/safetyShared.ts`.**

```ts
// Safety's words and small rules, in one place so later work (sessions in SP3)
// changes them here. `import type` only (decision P14).
import type { ExecutionGateStatus } from "../types";
import type { MachineControlStatus } from "../setupApi";

export const ARM_PHRASE = "ENABLE MACHINE CONTROL";

export const LEVELS: Record<number, { label: string; blurb: string }> = {
  0: { label: "Look only", blurb: "Agents are found and past runs shown. Nothing can run." },
  1: { label: "Run agents", blurb: "Agents run inside the Workspace. Risky steps ask or stop." },
  2: { label: "Machine control", blurb: "Agents can also drive apps on this Mac. Stays off unless you turn it on." }
};

export const LEVEL_DETAIL: Record<number, { can: string; asks: string; cannot: string }> = {
  0: {
    can: "See which agents are installed and look at past runs.",
    asks: "Nothing, because no agent can start.",
    cannot: "Run any agent, change files, or drive other apps on this Mac."
  },
  1: {
    can: "Run the agents you choose, each one in a folder inside the Workspace.",
    asks: "Anything risky. The agent asks or stops instead of going ahead. Agent OS never passes skip-permissions flags.",
    cannot: "Drive other apps on this Mac, change system settings, or reach folders outside the Workspace."
  },
  2: {
    can: "Everything in Level 1, plus see the screen and use the mouse and keyboard in other apps. macOS only.",
    asks: "The same risky steps as Level 1. Each shell command still asks you first.",
    cannot: "Stay on past 30 minutes. It also turns itself off when Agent OS restarts or you go back to Level 0."
  }
};

export function levelOf(
  gate: Pick<ExecutionGateStatus, "enabled"> & { level?: number },
  machineControl: Pick<MachineControlStatus, "armed"> | null
): 0 | 1 | 2 {
  if (gate.level === 0 || gate.level === 1 || gate.level === 2) return gate.level;
  // Older servers don't send a level; derive it from the two real flags.
  return gate.enabled ? (machineControl?.armed ? 2 : 1) : 0;
}

// The small line under each level button: what pressing it does.
export function levelFoot(n: 0 | 1 | 2, current: 0 | 1 | 2 | null, countdown: string): string {
  if (current === null) return "…";
  if (n === current) return n === 2 ? `On. Turns off in ${countdown}` : "Current";
  if (n === 2) return "Off. Needs a typed phrase";
  if (n === 1 && current === 0) return "Asks you first";
  return "Applies at once";
}

export function phraseMatches(text: string): boolean {
  return text.trim() === ARM_PHRASE;
}

// Safeguards that hold at every level, today (decision D-D2-4).
export const ALWAYS_ON: Array<{ title: string; detail: string; who: string }> = [
  {
    title: "No skip-permissions flags, ever",
    detail: "Agent OS never starts an agent with a launch option that switches its safety questions off. No setting allows it.",
    who: "All five agents"
  },
  {
    title: "Runs stay inside the Workspace",
    detail: "Every run works in a folder inside the Workspace. A folder outside it is refused before the run starts.",
    who: "All five agents"
  },
  {
    title: "Updater questions are never answered for you",
    detail: "Setup runs each agent's own updater without answering yes for you. If an updater asks something, the update stops and says so.",
    who: "Hermes, OpenClaw"
  }
];
```

`src/ui/components/SafetyLevels.tsx` (decision D-D2-2: buttons, never arrow-key changes):

```tsx
import { Check, CircleHelp, Lock, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { LEVEL_DETAIL, LEVELS, levelFoot } from "../safetyShared";

type Level = 0 | 1 | 2;
const ROWS = [
  { key: "can", word: "Agents can", Icon: ShieldCheck, tone: "ok" },
  { key: "asks", word: "Agents ask first", Icon: CircleHelp, tone: "warn" },
  { key: "cannot", word: "Agents cannot", Icon: Lock, tone: "idle" }
] as const;

export default function SafetyLevels({
  current,
  countdown,
  supported,
  onPick
}: {
  current: Level | null;
  countdown: string;
  supported: boolean;
  onPick: (n: Level) => void;
}) {
  const shown: Level = current ?? 1;
  const detail = LEVEL_DETAIL[shown];
  return (
    <section className="os-saf-section" aria-labelledby="os-saf-levels-title">
      <div className="os-saf-section__head">
        <h2 id="os-saf-levels-title">How much may agents do?</h2>
        <p className="os-saf-section__quiet">One setting for all five agents</p>
      </div>
      <div className="os-saf-ladder" aria-hidden="true">
        <span>Less power</span>
        <span className="os-saf-ladder__line" />
        <span>More power</span>
      </div>
      <div className="os-saf-levels" role="group" aria-label="Safety level">
        {([0, 1, 2] as Level[]).map((n) => {
          const on = current === n;
          const unsupported = n === 2 && !supported;
          return (
            <button
              key={n}
              type="button"
              className={`os-saf-level${on ? " is-current" : ""}${n === 2 && on ? " is-armed" : ""}`}
              aria-pressed={on}
              disabled={current === null || on || unsupported}
              onClick={() => onPick(n)}
            >
              <span className="os-saf-level__n os-mono" aria-hidden="true">{n}</span>
              <span className="os-saf-level__text">
                <span className="os-saf-level__t">{LEVELS[n].label}</span>
                <span className="os-saf-level__d">{unsupported ? "Only available on macOS." : LEVELS[n].blurb}</span>
              </span>
              <span className="os-saf-level__f">
                {on && n !== 2 ? <Check size={13} aria-hidden="true" /> : n === 2 && !on ? <Lock size={13} aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
                {levelFoot(n, current, countdown)}
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="os-saf-detail" aria-live="polite">
        <h3>What Level {shown} · {LEVELS[shown].label} means</h3>
        <div className="os-table os-saf-can" role="table" aria-label={`What Level ${shown} allows`}>
          {ROWS.map(({ key, word, Icon, tone }) => (
            <div key={key} className="os-table__row" role="row">
              <div className={`os-table__cell os-saf-can__w os-saf-can__w--${tone}`} role="cell">
                <Icon size={16} aria-hidden="true" />
                {word}
              </div>
              <div className="os-table__cell" role="cell">{detail[key]}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { OctagonX } from "lucide-react";

const FRAMES = [
  { fill: 0, time: "0 s", label: "Hold to stop all", caption: "You press. Nothing has happened yet." },
  { fill: 0.5, time: "0.6 s", label: "Keep holding…", caption: "Keep holding. Letting go cancels." },
  { fill: 1, time: "1.2 s", label: "Keep holding…", caption: "Full. All agent work stops." }
];

export default function SafetyStopInfo() {
  return (
    <section className="os-saf-section" aria-labelledby="os-saf-stop-title">
      <div className="os-saf-section__head">
        <h2 id="os-saf-stop-title">Hold to stop all</h2>
        <p className="os-saf-section__quiet">The red button in the top bar, on every page</p>
      </div>
      <div className="os-saf-stop">
        <div>
          <p className="os-saf-stop__lede">One press and hold stops all agent work at once. The hold is on purpose, so a stray click can never end your work.</p>
          <ol className="os-saf-stop__steps">
            <li>Press and hold the button for about a second.</li>
            <li>A red fill grows across it. Let go early and nothing happens.</li>
            <li>When the fill is full, Agent OS stops every agent run, Team Room turns included. Files already changed stay as they are.</li>
          </ol>
          <p className="os-saf-stop__not">
            It does not stop the Hermes background service or the OpenClaw Gateway, and it leaves Agent OS&apos;s own setup jobs running. Each service has its own Stop on Agents.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="os-saf-frames" aria-hidden="true">
          {FRAMES.map((frame) => (
            <div key={frame.time} className="os-saf-frame">
              <span className="os-saf-frame__btn">
                <span className="os-saf-frame__fill" style={{ transform: `scaleX(${frame.fill})` }} />
                <OctagonX size={15} />
                <span>{frame.label}</span>
              </span>
              <span className="os-saf-frame__t"><span className="os-mono">{frame.time}</span> {frame.caption}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
    } else {

      setArmError("");
      if (currentLevel === 0) {
        setActionError("Turn on Run agents (Level 1) first. Machine control builds on it.");
        return;
      }
      setShowArm(true);
    }
  }
```

  - **The returned markup** replaces both returns: the early "isn't responding" one and the main one.

```tsx

    <section className="os-safety" aria-labelledby="os-safety-title">

        >
          Agents can drive apps on this Mac. It turns itself off in <span className="os-mono" role="timer" aria-live="off">{countdown}</span>
          {expiresLabel ? <> at {expiresLabel}</> : null}.
        </Banner>
      ) : null}
      {loadFailed ? (
        <Banner
          tone="warn"
          title={known ? "Lost contact with Agent OS" : "Can't reach Agent OS"}
          actions={
            <button type="button" className="os-btn os-btn--secondary" onClick={() => void loadGate()}>
              <RefreshCw size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> Retry
            </button>
          }
        >
          {known ? "This is the last level it reported. This page tries again every few seconds." : "The safety level shows when it answers. This page tries again every few seconds."}
        </Banner>
      ) : null}
      {actionError ? <Banner tone="danger">{actionError}</Banner> : null}
      <PageHeader
        titleId="os-safety-title"
        title="Safety"
        lede="You decide how much agents may do. Pick a level, see what agents are asking, and stop all agent work with one press and hold."
      />
      <SafetyLevels current={known ? currentLevel : null} countdown={countdown} supported={supported} onPick={pickLevel} />
      <SafetySafeguards
        hermes={hermesDetail}
        openclaw={openclawDetail}
        checked={safeguardsChecked}
        machine={{ on: armed, countdown }}
        onOpenAgent={(agentId) => navigateTo("agents", { agent: agentId })}
      />
      <SafetyApprovals />
      <SafetyStopInfo />

      {showEnableConfirm ? (
        <SetupModal title="Turn on Run agents?" confirmLabel="Turn on" onConfirm={confirmEnable} onClose={() => setShowEnableConfirm(false)} busy={enableBusy} error={enableError}>
          <p>Agents you start will run for real, each inside the Workspace. Every run still shows its command and folder before it starts.</p>
        </SetupModal>
      ) : null}

      {showArm ? (
        <SetupModal
          title="Turn on Machine control"
          confirmLabel={armBusy ? "Arming…" : "Arm"}
          confirmDisabled={!phraseMatches(phrase) || armBusy}
          onConfirm={() => void armMachineControl()}
          onClose={() => setShowArm(false)}
          busy={armBusy}
          error={armError}
        >

          <ul className="os-saf-arm-list">
            <li>See your screen.</li>

            <li><Clock size={14} aria-hidden="true" /> Turn off by itself after <span className="os-mono">30</span> minutes. To use it again, you type the phrase again.</li>
            <li>Risky steps still ask you first. Nothing is answered for you.</li>
          </ul>
          <label className="os-field">
            <span className="os-field__label">Type {ARM_PHRASE} to turn it on</span>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={phrase}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setPhrase(e.target.value);
                setArmError("");
              }}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === "Enter" && phraseMatches(phrase)) {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  void armMachineControl();
                }
              }}
              autoComplete="off"
              autoCapitalize="off"
              spellCheck={false}
              aria-invalid={armError ? true : undefined}
              aria-describedby="os-saf-arm-hint"
            />
          </label>
          <p id="os-saf-arm-hint" className="os-saf-arm-hint" aria-live="polite">
            {phraseMatches(phrase) ? "The phrase matches. Press Arm." : "The Arm button stays off until the phrase matches."}
          </p>
        </SetupModal>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
```
