- [ ] **Step 8: Create the probe `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/safety.mjs`** (git-ignored). The throwaway server runs with the execution gate on (Level 1). Arming would be real on this Mac, so the probe stubs the arm request and never arms for real.

```js
// Task D2: Safety. Run: node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/safety.mjs
const W = 1470, H = 956;
const MC = "**/api/admin/machine-control";
const json = (route, body, status = 200) => route.fulfill({ status, contentType: "application/json", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
export default async function ({ browser, openPage, shot, pass, fail }) {
  const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));

  // 1. The page at Level 1.
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "safety");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    check((await tab.locator("h1").first().textContent())?.trim() === "Safety", "h1 reads Safety");
    const levels = tab.getByRole("group", { name: "Safety level" }).getByRole("button");
    check((await levels.count()) === 3, "three level buttons");
    check((await levels.nth(1).getAttribute("aria-pressed")) === "true", "Level 1 is current (aria-pressed)");
    check(/Current/.test((await levels.nth(1).textContent()) || ""), "the current level says Current in words");
    check(await tab.getByText("What Level 1 · Run agents means").isVisible(), "level detail for Level 1");
    check(await tab.getByText("Safeguards that are always working").isVisible(), "safeguards section");
    check(await tab.getByText("No skip-permissions flags, ever").isVisible(), "a true-today safeguard row");
    check(await tab.getByText("Nothing is waiting for you").isVisible(), "pending approvals: designed empty state");
    check(await tab.getByText(/example, not real/).isVisible(), "the example card is labelled as an example");
    const stop = (await tab.locator(".os-saf-stop").textContent()) || "";
    check(/does not stop the Hermes background service or the OpenClaw Gateway/.test(stop), "D11 words in Hold to stop all");
    check((await tab.locator(".os-safety .os-micro").count()) === 0, "no capitals-only captions left");
    check(errors.length === 0, "no console errors", errors.join(" / "));
    await shot(tab, "safety", W, H, "level-1");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 2. Keyboard arming: the arrow keys never change the level; Enter on Level 2 opens the dialog;
  //    Arm stays off until the phrase matches; the request is the same as before.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "safety");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    let armBody = null;
    await tab.route(MC, async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() === "GET") return route.continue();
      armBody = route.request().postDataJSON();
      return json(route, { supported: true, armed: true, expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60_000).toISOString(), remainingMs: 1_800_000 });
    });
    const levels = tab.getByRole("group", { name: "Safety level" }).getByRole("button");
    await levels.nth(0).focus();
    await tab.keyboard.press("ArrowRight");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(400);
    check((await tab.getByRole("dialog").count()) === 0 && (await levels.nth(1).getAttribute("aria-pressed")) === "true", "arrow keys do not change the level");
    await levels.nth(2).focus();
    await tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(400);
    check(/Turn on Machine control/.test((await tab.locator("#os-setup-modal-title").textContent()) || ""), "Enter on Level 2 opens the arming dialog");
    const dialog = tab.getByRole("dialog");
    const arm = dialog.getByRole("button", { name: /^Arm/ });
    check(await arm.isDisabled(), "Arm is off until the phrase matches");
    await dialog.locator("input").focus();
    await tab.keyboard.type("ENABLE MACHINE");
    check(await arm.isDisabled(), "a partial phrase keeps Arm off");
    await tab.keyboard.type(" CONTROL");
    check(!(await arm.isDisabled()), "the full phrase turns Arm on");
    check(await dialog.getByText("The phrase matches. Press Arm.").isVisible(), "the hint says so in words");
    await shot(tab, "safety", W, H, "arming");
    await tab.keyboard.press("Enter");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(800);
    check(Boolean(armBody) && armBody.enable === true && String(armBody.phrase).trim() === "ENABLE MACHINE CONTROL" && armBody.confirm === true, "the same arm request as before", JSON.stringify(armBody));
    await context.close();
  }

  // 3. Machine control on (stubbed): the banner, the 1 s countdown, Turn off now.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "safety");
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 29 * 60_000 + 41_000).toISOString();
    await tab.route("**/api/execution-gate", (r) => (r.request().method() === "GET" ? json(r, { enabled: true, level: 2 }) : r.continue()));
    await tab.route(MC, (r) => (r.request().method() === "GET" ? json(r, { supported: true, armed: true, expiresAt, remainingMs: 1_781_000 }) : r.continue()));
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1500);
    check(await tab.getByText("Machine control is on.").isVisible(), "armed banner");
    const first = await tab.locator("[role='timer']").first().textContent();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(2100);
    const second = await tab.locator("[role='timer']").first().textContent();
    check(first !== second && /^\d\d:\d\d$/.test(second || ""), "the countdown ticks every second", `${first} -> ${second}`);
    check(await tab.getByRole("button", { name: "Turn off now" }).isVisible(), "Turn off now offered");
    check(/On, \d\d:\d\d left/.test((await tab.locator(".os-saf-guards").textContent()) || ""), "the machine-control row shows the time left");
    await shot(tab, "safety", W, H, "armed");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 4. Review Focus 5: offline, then recovery on the 5 s poll.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, W, H, "safety");
    const gate = /\/api\/(execution-gate|admin\/machine-control)/;
    await tab.route(gate, (r) => r.abort());
    await tab.reload();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(3000);
    check(await tab.getByText("Can't reach Agent OS").first().isVisible(), "offline: says so in words");
    check(await tab.getByRole("group", { name: "Safety level" }).getByRole("button").nth(0).isDisabled(), "offline: no level can be picked while unknown");
    await shot(tab, "safety", W, H, "offline");
    await tab.unroute(gate);
    await tab.waitForTimeout(6000);
    check((await tab.getByText("Can't reach Agent OS").count()) === 0, "recovers on its own (5 s poll)");
    await context.close();
  }

  // 5. Layout: the icon rail at 1280, no sideways scroll at 1024.
  for (const [w, h] of [[1280, 720], [1024, 640]]) {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, w, h, "safety");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1200);
    const extra = await tab.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth);
    check(extra <= 0, `${w}x${h}: no sideways scroll`, `${extra}px`);
    await shot(tab, "safety", w, h, "level-1");
    await context.close();
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Create the probe `.superpowers/ui-audit/probes/leftovers.mjs`** (git-ignored).

```js
// Task D3: SP1 leftovers. Run: node .superpowers/ui-audit/audit.mjs probe .superpowers/ui-audit/probes/leftovers.mjs
export default async function ({ browser, openPage, pass, fail }) {
  const check = (ok, name, why = "") => (ok ? pass(name) : fail(name, String(why)));

  // 1. One main landmark on a core page, and never two on a Labs page.
  {
    const { context, tab, errors } = await openPage(browser, 1470, 956, "fleet");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1200);
    check((await tab.locator("main, [role='main']").count()) === 1, "Home: exactly one main landmark");
    check(errors.length === 0, "no console errors", errors.join(" / "));
    await context.close();
    const labs = await openPage(browser, 1470, 956, "chat");
    await labs.tab.waitForTimeout(1200);
    check((await labs.tab.locator("main, [role='main']").count()) <= 1, "Labs page: never two main landmarks");
    await labs.context.close();
  }

  // 2. The Labs icon is as big as the menu icons; the pill's icon is not cobalt.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, 1470, 956, "fleet");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1200);
    const sizes = await tab.evaluate(() => [
      document.querySelector(".os-nav__labs-toggle svg")?.getAttribute("width"),
      document.querySelector(".os-nav__item svg")?.getAttribute("width")
    ]);
    check(sizes[0] === sizes[1], "Labs icon matches the menu icons", sizes.join(" vs "));
    const pill = await tab.evaluate(() => {
      const svg = document.querySelector(".os-gs-pill svg");
      return svg ? getComputedStyle(svg).color : "none";
    });
    check(pill === "none" || !/56, 102, 238/.test(pill), "the pill's icon is not cobalt", pill);
    await context.close();
  }

  // 3. A hung server: Hold to stop all gives up after the time limit and says so.
  {
    const { context, tab } = await openPage(browser, 1470, 956, "fleet");
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1000);
    await tab.route(/\/api\/runs\?/, () => {}); // never answers
    const button = tab.getByRole("button", { name: /hold to stop all/i });
    await button.hover();
    await tab.mouse.down();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(1400);
    await tab.mouse.up();
    await tab.waitForTimeout(9500);
    const toast = (await tab.locator(".os-toast").allTextContents()).join(" ");
    check(/Couldn't reach Agent OS/.test(toast) && !/Stopped/.test(toast), "a hung run list ends with an honest message", toast || "(no toast)");
    check(!(await button.isDisabled()), "the button is usable again");
    await context.close();
  }
}
```
